# 2015: current events archive

**Source-preservation edition.**

This chronological reference preserves 4,939 Wikipedia event assertions across 365 dates, including topic hierarchy, original citations and pinned revisions. SQLite is authoritative; this UTF-8 Markdown is its readable companion.

Source selection and wording are Wikipedia’s, and are not certified exhaustive, impartial or factually correct. Publication does not imply independent checking of every assertion. Original wording, errors and dated reporting figures remain visible. Editorial accounts are separately labeled and cited.

Database: [2015.sqlite](2015.sqlite). Edition SHA-256: `5fa3cee4ebc22e54bd4f13ad011c6ed98754f481616eddb68c0f54d72076143d`. Publication: `preservation-release-1.0`. Extraction/Markdown profile: `annual-series-1.2`. Date: 2026-10-22.

Original entries without attached citations: 30. These have separate editorial evidence. Full-event reviews complete: 12; partial: 18; without a full-event review: 4,909. Partial reviews leave unsupported details explicit.

Exact original daily files, Wikipedia payloads/metadata and prior extraction candidates are embedded losslessly, with hashes, an exact retirement manifest and Git checkpoint. Wikipedia attribution and CC BY-SA obligations remain applicable. Publisher URLs identify evidence; full publisher articles and images are not reproduced.

Template display uses explicit original arguments without calculated conversions, live expansion or inferred links. Unsupported template markup and source reliability tags remain visible. Orphan topics and malformed/unbulleted material are preserved with the handling notes below; no missing child or event is invented.

Commented-out source assertions remain labeled non-event material in the database and handling notes; they are excluded from ordinary event totals.

## January

### 2015-01-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1099713482](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20January%201&oldid=1099713482>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-01-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** The death toll of the suicide bombing in Ibb, Yemen, that occurred on December 31 rises to 49 with the injury count rising to 70.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/death-toll-of-yemen-anti-huthi-bomb-blast-rises-to-49-115010100472_1.html>).

<a id="event-2015-01-01-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A shooting kills one and injures six people in Killarney, Calgary, Canada, with police making no arrests.

Source citations (as archived): [National Post](<http://news.nationalpost.com/2015/01/01/up-to-seven-shot-at-calgary-house-party-two-in-critical-condition/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-01-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lithuania adopts the euro as its official currency, becoming the 19th member of the Eurozone.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2014/12/31/news/economy/lithuania-europe-euro/>).

<a id="event-2015-01-01-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. fast-food restaurant chain Chick-fil-A warns that a security breach may have leaked credit card details of 9,000 customers in five states.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-2893614/Chik-Fil-says-looking-possible-payment-card-breach-affect-9-000-customer-cards.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-01-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Palestine Authority signs a treaty to join and participate in the International Criminal Court.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/abbas-oks-palestinian-application-to-join-international-criminal-court-1420050385>).

<a id="event-2015-01-01-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Eurasian Economic Union between Russia, Kazakhstan, Belarus, Kyrgyzstan and Armenia comes into effect

Source citations (as archived): [Novinite](<http://www.novinite.com/articles/165734/Eurasian+Economic+Union+Starts+Functioning>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-01-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Vietnam’s new marriage law goes into effect, abolishing regulations that “prohibit marriage between people of the same sex.”

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/2015-01-07/gay-weddings-planned-as-vietnam-marriage-law-is-repealed.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-01-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mario Cuomo, former governor of the U.S. state of New York, dies at the age of 82.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/01/02/us-usa-politics-cuomo-idUSKBN0KB00F20150102>).

### 2015-01-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1099713555](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20January%202&oldid=1099713555>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-01-02-0-1"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Somali al-Shabaab militants attack an army base on the outskirts of Baidoa, killing seven soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150102230104/http://www.dailytimes.com.pk/foreign/03-Jan-2015/at-least-7-killed-in-al-shabaab-attack-at-somali-military-base>).

<a id="event-2015-01-02-0-3"></a>

Context: Islamist insurgency in Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** Boko Haram militants attack a bus in Waza, Cameroon, killing eleven people and injuring six.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.wlky.com/national/boko-harm-attack-in-cameroon-kills-11/30501694>).

<a id="event-2015-01-02-0-5"></a>

Context: 1998 United States embassy bombings.

**Archived source account.** Abu Anas al-Libi, a one-time associate of Osama bin Laden, dies in New York, United States, while awaiting trial for allegedly plotting the bombings of the U.S. embassies in Kenya and Tanzania.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/suspected-plotter-u-s-embassy-attacks-abu-anas-al-libi-n278866>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-01-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The MS Norman Atlantic ferry fire death toll rises to at least eleven with as many as 19 people still unaccounted for.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/world-news/europe/investigators-board-charred-tragic-ferry-to-search-for-cause-of-deadly-blaze-and-possibly-more-bodies-30878560.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-01-02-2-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States enacts more sanctions on North Korea in response to their alleged involvement in the hacking attack on Sony. The sanctions target the North Korean Special Operation Force and 10 government officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/01/02/us-northkorea-cyberattack-sanctions-idUSKBN0KB16U20150102>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

**Archived source account.** The Singapore-registered cargo ship MV Höegh Osaka runs aground on Bramble Bank off the coast of the Isle of Wight, in the entrance to Southampton Water.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-hampshire-30670746>).

<a id="event-2015-01-03-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** \{\{MS\|Bulk Jupiter\}\}, a Norwegian-owned cargo ship, sinks off the coast of Vietnam, with eighteen dead and one survivor.

Source citations (as archived): [KRON](<http://kron4.com/2015/01/03/vietnam-cargo-ship-sinks-off-the-coast-of-vietnam/>).

**Archived source account.** The Cypriot-registered cargo ship MV Cemfjord sinks off the northern coast of Scotland leaving eight onboard missing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-north-east-orkney-shetland-30670842>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-01-03-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A prison in Bruges, Belgium, will euthanise serial rapist and murderer Frank Van Den Bleeken on January 11.

Source citations (as archived): [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.co.uk/belgian-serial-rapist-murderer-frank-van-den-bleeken-be-euthanised-january-1481742>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-01-03-4-1"></a>

Context: Greek parliamentary election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Former Prime Minister George Papandreou announces the formation of a new party, Movement of Democratic Socialists, threatening to push the long-dominant PASOK under the election threshold.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/europe/2015/01/greece-george-papandreou-new-party-2015146210586284.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/01/02/us-greece-politics-idUSKBN0KB0VD20150102>).

### 2015-01-05

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

The Greek government condemned what it called an "unprovoked and cowardly" attack and demanded an investigation and punishment for those responsible.

<a id="event-2015-01-05-0-4"></a>

<a id="event-2015-01-05-1-1"></a>

### 2015-01-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1099714434](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20January%207&oldid=1099714434>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-01-07-0-1"></a>

Context: Charlie Hebdo shooting.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen attack the Paris office of the French satirical magazine Charlie Hebdo, killing twelve people and injuring ten. Some witnesses report that the gunmen identified themselves as belonging to al-Qaeda in Yemen. A 2011 issue had depicted a cartoon of the Islamic prophet Muhammed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-30710883>).

<a id="event-2015-01-07-0-2"></a>

Context: Charlie Hebdo shooting.

**Archived source account.** French police identify three suspects in the killings with raids being conducted in the city of Reims for the assailants, brothers Said and Cherif Kaouchi, aged 32 and 34, respectively, and Hamyd Mourad, 18.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/gunmen-storm-paris-satirical-newspaper-killing-at-least-11/2015/01/07/f358b17a-9660-11e4-aabd-d0b93ff613d5_story.html?Post+generic=%3Ftid%3Dsm_twitter_washingtonpost>); [Bloomberg](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160304063914/http://washpost.bloomberg.com/Story?docId=1376-NHTWIY6S972K01-716V33OPHBUNGPGTPTOAN7V75P>).

<a id="event-2015-01-07-0-4"></a>

Context: al-Qaeda insurgency in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** A car bomb explodes outside a police college in the Yemeni capital Sana'a with at least 38 people reported dead and more than 50 wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/01/07/us-yemen-security-idUSKBN0KG0AD20150107?feedName=worldNews&amp;feedType=RSS>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-30706208>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2015/01/car-bomb-explodes-outside-yemen-police-centre-2015175443717838.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-01-08-0-2"></a>

### 2015-01-09

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1229618885](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20January%209&oldid=1229618885>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-01-09-0-1"></a>

Context: Charlie Hebdo shooting.

<a id="event-2015-01-09-0-2"></a>

Context: Charlie Hebdo shooting / The two suspect brothers take a hostage at a sign printing company, Création Tendance Découverte, in the French town of Dammartin-en-Goële..

**Archived source account.** The standoff ends with the two brothers dead and the hostage released.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/id/102323454>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-30752239>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/01/09/europe/charlie-hebdo-paris-shooting/index.html>).

<a id="event-2015-01-09-0-3"></a>

Context: Charlie Hebdo shooting.

**Archived source account.** A second hostage situation of unclear connection occurs at a Jewish market, Hypercacher, in the eastern Paris suburb of Vincennes. There are two suspected hostage takers, Hayat Boumeddiene, 26, and Amedy Coulibaly, 32, who were previously suspected of shooting a policewoman dead earlier in the week. There are at least sixteen hostages.

Source citations (as archived): [Herald-Sun](<http://www.heraldsun.com.au/news/world/charlie-hebdo-attack-shooting-at-paris-kosher-grocery/story-fni0xs61-1227180200292?from=herald+sun_rss>).

<a id="event-2015-01-09-0-4"></a>

Context: Charlie Hebdo shooting / A second hostage situation of unclear connection occurs at a Jewish market, Hypercacher, in the eastern Paris suburb of Vincennes. There are two suspected hostage takers, Hayat Boumeddiene, 26, and Amedy Coulibaly, 32, who were previously suspected of shooting a policewoman dead earlier in the week. There are at least sixteen hostages..

**Archived source account.** The concurrent standoff ends with Coulibaly dead as well as four hostages. Four additional hostages and two police officers require hospitalization. Boumeddiene remains at large.

Source citations (as archived): [MSNBC](<http://www.msnbc.com/msnbc/paris-suspects-cornered-hostage-charlie-hebdo>).

<a id="event-2015-01-09-0-6"></a>

Context: 2015 Baga massacre.

**Archived source account.** Refugees flee Nigeria's Borno State following the Boko Haram massacre in the town of Baga. 7,300 flee to neighbouring Chad while over 1,000 are trapped on the island of Kangala in Lake Chad. Nigeria's army vows to recapture the town, while Niger and Chad withdraw their forces from a transnational force tasked with combating militants.

Source citations (as archived): [UNHCR](<http://www.unhcr.org/54afb6dc9.html>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/blogs/thetwo-way/2015/01/09/376122497/reports-of-boko-haram-led-massacre-in-captured-nigerian-town>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-01-09-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 193-vehicle pileup along a snowy Interstate 94 highway in Kalamazoo County, Michigan leaves one motorist dead and 20 injured. A fire among the vehicles which includes a chemical tanker and a truck loaded with fireworks further compounds the disaster. The debris and fire closes the expressway for over 14 hours. Exploding fireworks hit rescue workers injuring an additional three.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://www.wzzm13.com/story/news/local/kalamazoo/2015/01/09/closed-serious-crash/21493615/>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/01/10/us/michigan-traffic-pileup/>).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-30738604>).

<a id="event-2015-01-09-3-1"></a>

<a id="event-2015-01-09-3-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<http://gulfnews.com/news/gulf/saudi-arabia/saudi-blogger-flogged-in-public-for-insulting-islam-1.1438732>); [Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/jan/09/saudi-blogger-first-lashes-raif-badawi>).

### 2015-01-10

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-01-10-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomb attack on a Shiite mosque in Rawalpindi, Pakistan, kills at least seven people. Militants linked to the Taliban and al-Qaeda have previously attacked the country's Shiite minority.

Source citations (as archived): [AAP](<http://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/2015/01/10/suicide-blast-kills-seven-pakistan>).

<a id="event-2015-01-10-0-2"></a>

Context: Boko Haram.

**Archived source account.** A female suicide bomber, believed to be aged around 10 years old, kills herself and 19 others, possibly against her will, at a market in the northeastern city of Maiduguri, Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/nigerian-market-hit-by-suicide-bomber-1420926209?mod=ask>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-30761963>).

<a id="event-2015-01-10-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War spillover in Lebanon.

**Archived source account.** A suicide attack by al-Nusra Front (al-Qaeda's official affiliate in Syria) at a café in Tripoli, Lebanon, kills at least seven people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/01/10/us-lebanon-attack-idUSKBN0KJ0ML20150110>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-01-10-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A traffic accident between an oil tanker truck and passenger coach en route to Shikarpur from Karachi on the Pakistan National Highway Link Road near Gulshan-e-Hadeed, Karachi, results in at least 57 dead and scores injured.

Source citations (as archived): [The News](<http://www.thenews.com.pk/article-171442-30-passengers-die-in-horrific-road-mishap-near-Karachi>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-01-10-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bomb threat on Tigerair Flight 539 at Melbourne Airport, Victoria, Australia, causes disruptions for passengers and airlines throughout the airport.

Source citations (as archived): [News.com.au](<http://www.news.com.au/national/victoria/bomb-scare-at-melbourne-airport/story-fnii5sms-1227180231653>).

<a id="event-2015-01-10-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A shooting spree in Moscow, Idaho, U.S., leaves three dead and one injured. After a high-speed chase on Highway 195 ten miles away in the neighboring state of Washington, Pullman police arrest the suspect, John Lee.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150111220443/http://m.sfgate.com/news/crime/article/Suspect-arrested-after-3-killed-in-Idaho-shooting-6007762.php>).

<a id="event-2015-01-10-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A mass poisoning at a funeral in Mozambique involves beer that was deliberately contaminated with crocodile bile leaving at least 56 dead and 146 hospitalized.

Source citations (as archived): [FOX8LIVE](<https://archive.is/20150118054510/http://www.fox8live.com/story/27820680/56-people-die-after-drinking-poisoned-beer-in-mozambique>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-01-10-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** SpaceX successfully launches a Falcon 9 rocket from Cape Canaveral, Florida, as part of boosting its Dragon spacecraft into space for a Monday arrival at the ISS in the SpaceX CRS-5 resupply mission. However, an experimental recovery attempt of the first stage fails when it crash-lands on a floating platform possibly due to insufficient hydraulic fluid, resulting in damage to the platform. The state of the destruction of the launch vehicle is publically unknown.

Source citations (as archived): [Space.com](<http://www.space.com/28173-spacex-reusable-rocket-test-dragon-launch.html>); [Twitter](<https://twitter.com/elonmusk/status/553963793056030721>).

<a id="event-2015-01-10-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Golden Gate Bridge Highway and Transportation District temporarily closes the Golden Gate Bridge until Monday to install a $30 million moveable barrier between opposite traffic flows.

Source citations (as archived): [SF Gate](<http://www.sfgate.com/bayarea/article/Golden-Gate-Bridge-closed-but-traffic-keeps-6006858.php>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-01-10-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In American football, Tom Brady of the New England Patriots breaks the National Football League records for career postseason yardage and touchdown passes in the AFC Divisional playoff game against the Baltimore Ravens won by the Patriots 35–31, advancing them to the AFC Championship game.

Source citations (as archived): [Sports Illustrated](<https://www.si.com/nfl/2015/01/10/tom-brady-nfl-playoff-passing-records>).

**Archived source account.** Australia wins 2–0 against United Arab Emirates to advance to the 2015 AFC Asian Cup Final for the second consecutive time.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/sport/football/article-2928114/Australia-2-0-United-Arab-Emirates-Socceroos-book-Asian-Cup-final-clash-South-Korea.html>).

### 2015-01-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1335285364](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20January%2028&oldid=1335285364>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-01-28-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Lebanese conflict.

**Archived source account.** Following a January 18 airstrike against a Hezbollah convoy, Hezbollah targets an Israeli military convoy near the Lebanon border at the Shebaa farms area, killing two and wounding another seven. While the Israeli military responds with artillery fire upon several South Lebanon border villages and Shebaa Farms, Hezbollah responds with mortar shells. Cross fire fighting kills a Spanish UN peacekeeper in the town of Ghajar.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/01/28/world/mideast-golan/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-31015862>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/01/28/mideast-israel-lebanon-un-idUSL6N0V72UB20150128>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-01-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Chinese yuan becomes the fifth most-highly-used currency in the world.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/165c93f348304a95aec94ce00eead3ec/chinas-yuan-joins-top-5-most-used-global-currencies>).

<a id="event-2015-01-28-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The US Air Force Secretary Deborah Lee James picks the Boeing 747-8 for the next replacement of Air Force One.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/01/28/us-airforce-boeing-idUSKBN0L12FP20150128>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-01-28-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Vietnamese military Bell UH-1 Iroquois helicopter crashes in southern Ho Chi Minh City killing four people.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.straitstimes.com/news/asia/south-east-asia/story/four-killed-vietnam-military-helicopter-crash-army-20150128>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-01-28-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The High Court of Australia finds that a group of 157 Sri Lankan asylum seekers were legally detained by Australian authorities at sea. The government acted lawfully and the group is not entitled to damages.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-01-28/sri-lankan-asylum-seekers-legally-detained-at-sea-high-court/6051426>).

<a id="event-2015-01-28-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A federal judge in Albuquerque, New Mexico sentences an ex-Los Alamos physicist Pedro Leonardo Mascheroni, who pleaded guilty in 2013 to offering to spy on the US to help Venezuela develop a nuclear weapon, to five years imprisonment.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/8b54704b35c44359b4e5b2476d7e1dab/ex-los-alamos-scientist-be-sentenced-nuke-spy-sting>); [AP](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-31033686>).

<a id="event-2015-01-28-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The President of Sri Lanka Maithripala Sirisena reinstates former Chief Justice Shirani Bandaranayake who had been sacked by former President Mahinda Rajapaksa.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2015/01/28/sri-lanka-politics-judiciary-idINL4N0V74B920150128>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-01-28-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Akram Hasson becomes leader of Israel's former government party Kadima and thus the first Druze ever to lead a Jewish party.

Source citations (as archived): [Israel National News](<http://www.israelnationalnews.com/News/News.aspx/190589#.VMl455t0zug>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-01-28-5-1"></a>

Context: Discoveries of exoplanets.

**Archived source account.** The Astrophysical Journal publishes research from the University of Rochester and the University of Leiden announcing the discovery of either a brown dwarf substellar object or a gas giant exoplanet titled J1407b. The object is the first known nonstar to have a super ring system.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-01-29/faraway-planet-j1407b-is-lord-of-the-rings/6053418>).

### 2015-01-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1099795597](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20January%2029&oldid=1099795597>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-01-29-0-1"></a>

Context: 2014 Sydney hostage crisis.

**Archived source account.** A coronial inquest into the siege at the Lindt Cafe in the center of Sydney begins. The inquest hears that one hostage was killed by gunman Man Haron Monis while another was killed by fragments of a bullet or bullets fired by New South Wales Police Force officers.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/in-depth/sydney-siege/sydney-siege-inquest-lindt-cafe-deaths-investigated/story-fnqxbywy-1227200443586>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-31033369#>).

<a id="event-2015-01-29-0-3"></a>

Context: Taliban insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Taliban attacks across Afghanistan kill 17 people.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/ac09f1ab3f0f48cf9e5fc326591d21d8/taliban-bomb-kills-4-attack-kills-11-afghanistan>).

<a id="event-2015-01-29-0-4"></a>

Context: Taliban insurgency.

**Archived source account.** An Afghan national kills three American contractors at Hamid Karzai International Airport, the lone shooter was also killed in the incident.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-01-29/three-u-s-contractors-said-killed-in-kabul-airport-shooting>).

<a id="event-2015-01-29-0-6"></a>

Context: Moro insurgency in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** Philippines President Benigno Aquino III distances himself from a botched raid against a terrorist, Zulkifli Abdhir, that killed around 50 people, including police officers and Abdhir, while pledging support for a peace process with the Moro people. Supreme Court Chief Justice Maria Lourdes Sereno urges the public to continue to support the peace treaty.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<http://mobile.nytimes.com/2015/01/29/world/asia/philippine-police-raid.html?referrer=>).

<a id="event-2015-01-29-0-8"></a>

Context: Iraqi insurgency (2011–present).

**Archived source account.** Several attacks around Baghdad including bombings and shootings kill at least sixteen people.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2015/01/29/world/middleeast/ap-ml-iraq.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2015-01-29-0-10"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Ansar Beit al-Maqdis claims responsibility for widespread attacks on Egyptian army and police targets throughout the Sinai Peninsula killing at least 25 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Ynet News](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4620994,00.html>).

<a id="event-2015-01-29-0-12"></a>

Context: Shia insurgency in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Shiite Houthi rebels seize a Yemeni military base south of the capital, Sana'a, where U.S. military advisers once trained Yemeni counterterrorism forces to fight Al-Qaeda in the south of the country. Forces loyal to former President Ali Abdullah Saleh had manned the captured base.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/shiite-rebels-capture-key-military-base-in-yemen-1422538857>).

<a id="event-2015-01-29-0-13"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Paraguayan People's Army kills a German couple who lived on a ranch near Yby Yaú in northern Paraguay.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.de/german-couple-killed-in-paraguay-by-guerrilla-kidnappers/a-18225293?maca=en-TWITTER-EN-2004-xml-mrss>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-01-29-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Philippine economy grew by more than 6% in 2014 making it the second fastest growing economy in Asia after China. This is the longest sustained growth period in the country since the 1950s. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Economic Times](<http://m.economictimes.com/news/international/business/philippines-economy-surges-by-6-per-cent-for-third-consecutive-year/articleshow/46051103.cms>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-01-29-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Nieto Express propane gas tanker truck explodes near the loading dock of a maternity and children's hospital (Hospital Materno Infantil Cuajimalpa) in Mexico City, collapsing much of the hospital with at least three deaths and 70 people injured, 22 of whom are children.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/7b2ca0245e454b74a8a34910d86969cc/gas-blast-mexico-city-childrens-hospital-dozens-injured>); [AFP/Reuters](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-01-30/gas-blast-at-mexico-children-hospital/6056392>); [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/news/world/gas-tank-explodes-mexico-city-children-hospital-article-1.2096039>).

<a id="event-2015-01-29-2-2"></a>

Context: Malaysia Airlines Flight 370.

**Archived source account.** Without recovering any physical evidence, including the data recorders, Malaysia officially declares the loss of Flight 370 over the Indian Ocean an accident meaning that victims families can seek compensation.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2015/01/29/malaysia-flight-mh370-declared-accoide/22513121/>).

<a id="event-2015-01-29-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Heavy snowfall in northern England leads to the closures of hundreds of schools, roads and Manchester Airport.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-31036671>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-01-29-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Dutch police arrest a fake gunman who disrupted the Netherlands news broadcaster NOS after storming into the studio and demanding airtime.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-31051114>).

<a id="event-2015-01-29-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** American hip hop music mogul Suge Knight drives a vehicle into a crowd in Compton, California near Los Angeles resulting in the death of a pedestrian in what authorities are calling a hit and run.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/investigations/marion-suge-knight-involved-hit-run-killed-pedestrian-n296596>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Entertainment_News/2015/01/29/Suge-Knight-involved-in-hit-and-run-on-film-set-victim-dead/8701422589429/>); [Twitter](<https://twitter.com/tercar1/status/561189703769415681>).

### 2015-01-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1265774581](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20January%2030&oldid=1265774581>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-01-30-0-1"></a>

Context: Sectarianism in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** Sunni militants linked to the Pakistani Taliban kill at least 40 people and injure 50 in a bombing at a Shiite mosque in the Shikarpur District of Pakistan's Sindh province.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-31056086>).

<a id="event-2015-01-30-0-3"></a>

Context: Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant.

**Archived source account.** Islamic State fighters kill Kurdish commander Brigadier General Shirko Rauf and five other peshmerga soldiers in heavy fighting in Iraq's Kirkuk province.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/jan/30/kurdish-commander-killed-islamic-state-attack-kirkuk>).

<a id="event-2015-01-30-0-5"></a>

Context: 2014–15 Russian military intervention in Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The Government of Ukraine and pro-Russian separatists call off peace talks that were to be held in Minsk.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/01/30/uk-ukraine-crisis-idUKKBN0L30XW20150130>).

<a id="event-2015-01-30-0-6"></a>

Context: 2014–15 Russian military intervention in Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Artillery fire kills at least twelve civilians in Donetsk.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/fda722a6c31b4c0aa2bd694a45eaa1df/12-civilians-5-troops-killed-eastern-ukraine>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-01-30-1-1"></a>

Context: Greek government-debt crisis.

**Archived source account.** The new Greek government, represented by finance minister Yanis Varoufakis, meets with Jeroen Dijsselbloem, the head of the Eurogroup, and declares that Greece now rejects any further cooperation with its main international lenders known as the troika (the Eurogroup, the IMF, and the ECB); instead, it wants to negotiate directly with other European countries.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.de/greek-government-refuses-to-work-with-troika/a-18226767>).

#### Health

<a id="event-2015-01-30-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention report that this season's influenza hospitalizations of 65-year-old and older Americans hit a record high since the 2005-2006 season.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/5b615d5c5e3a4507ab72122f98ef4c39/flu-hospitalizations-elderly-hit-record-high-cdc-says>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-01-30-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israel announces plans to build 430 new settler homes in the West Bank.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2015/01/30/Israel-to-build-430-new-West-Bank-settler-homes-.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-01-30-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A judge at the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia upholds the conviction of five men in connection with the Srebrenica massacre.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-31053503>).

<a id="event-2015-01-30-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Los Angeles police arrest American hip hop mogul Suge Knight on suspicion for murder in relation to the January 29 hit-and-run incident in Compton, California.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/01/29/entertainment/suge-knight-hit-and-run/index.html>).

<a id="event-2015-01-30-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Justice Minister Michael Masutha paroles South African apartheid-era death squad commander Eugene de Kock, nicknamed "Prime Evil", after having served 20 years for killing activists.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-31054912>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-01-30-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Zhelyu Zhelev, who became the first democratically elected president of Bulgaria, dies at 79.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/newswires/2911098-bulgarias-first-democratically-elected-president-zhelev-dies/>); [Novinite](<http://www.novinite.com/articles/166247/Bulgaria&#x27;s+Former+President+Zhelyu+Zhelev+Dies>).

<a id="event-2015-01-30-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** King Salman of Saudi Arabia names a new cabinet and replaces officials in several key government positions, removing two sons of the late monarch Abdullah from their regional governorships in the process.

Source citations (as archived): [Ahram Online](<http://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/2/8/121751/World/Region/New-Saudi-king-announces-major-government-shakeup-.aspx>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-01-30-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two balloonists, Troy Bradley of the United States and Leonid Tiukhtyaev of Russia, are crossing the Pacific Ocean in the Two Eagles gas balloon and have surpassed the distance and duration records for straight gas balloons. They are set to land in Mexico on Saturday.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-31052066?ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_campaign=bbc_breaking&amp;ns_source=twitter&amp;ns_linkname=news_central>).

<a id="event-2015-01-30-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The German Chemical Society's Angewandte Chemie International Edition publishes research from chemist Donald Fleming of the University of British Columbia announcing the confirmational discovery of a new form of chemical bond, the vibrational bond.

Source citations (as archived): [Scientific American](<http://www.scientificamerican.com/article/chemists-confirm-the-existence-of-new-type-of-bond/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-01-30-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Rita Jeptoo, who won the 2014 Boston Marathon, is banned from running after testing positive for erythropoietin, a blood-boosting hormone.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo Sports](<https://sports.yahoo.com/blogs/the-turnstile/marathon-champ-rita-jeptoo-receives-two-year-ban-for-positive-drug-test-141220783.html>).

### 2015-01-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1229629641](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20January%2031&oldid=1229629641>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-01-31-0-1"></a>

Context: 2014–15 Russian military intervention in Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine and Russian-backed separatists conduct peace talks as fighting rages in eastern Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/01/31/us-ukraine-crisis-casualties-idUSKBN0L409K20150131>).

<a id="event-2015-01-31-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Democratic Republic of the Congo launches a campaign against Hutu rebels.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/dr-congo-says-offensive-against-hutu-rebels-underway-161230672.html>).

<a id="event-2015-01-31-0-4"></a>

Context: Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant.

**Archived source account.** A monitoring group claims that ISIL has reportedly released a video showing the execution of Japanese hostage Kenji Goto.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2015/01/japanese-hostage-beheaded-isil-150131201857344.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-01-31-1-1"></a>

Context: Indonesia AirAsia Flight 8501.

**Archived source account.** France orders an official investigation into the crash of AirAsia Flight 8501 which had a French copilot flying the aircraft at the time of its crash.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150203055623/http://www.france24.com/en/20150131-french-judge-probe-airasia-crash/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-01-31-2-1"></a>

Context: Italian presidential election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Voters elect Sergio Mattarella President of Italy.

Source citations (as archived): [Corriere della Sera](<http://www.corriere.it/politica/speciali/2015/elezioni-presidente-repubblica/notizie/elezione-mattarella-presidente-repubblica-a02d9392-a90e-11e4-96d4-6a68544c2eeb.shtml>).

<a id="event-2015-01-31-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Richard von Weizsäcker, who was president of West Germany from 1984 to 1990 and became the first president of reunified Germany from 1990 to 1994, dies at the age of 94.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.de/former-german-president-richard-von-weizsäcker-dies/a-18227460>).

<a id="event-2015-01-31-2-4"></a>

Context: Queensland state election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** The Liberal National Party of Queensland loses its parliamentary majority, with outgoing Premier Campbell Newman losing his own seat of Ashgrove. It is unclear whether the Australian Labor Party, led by Annastacia Palaszczuk, has won an outright majority or if the result is a hung parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-02-01/queensland-election-2015-labor-set-to-pull-off-stunning-victory/6060156>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-01-31-3-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Australian Open.

**Archived source account.** In tennis, American Serena Williams defeats Maria Sharapova of Russia in straight sets in the Women's Singles final. It is the sixth Australian Open crown and 19th Grand Slam singles title for the current world \#1.

Source citations (as archived): [AAP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150602134347/http://www.msn.com/en-au/sport/tennis/williams-wins-sixth-australian-open-title/ar-AA8MCOp?ocid=UP94DHP>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2015/jan/30/maria-sharapova-serena-williams-australian-open-final-aggression>).

<a id="event-2015-01-31-3-3"></a>

Context: 2015 AFC Asian Cup.

**Archived source account.** In football, host nation Australia defeats South Korea 2–1 in the final of the Asian Cup.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-01-31/asian-cup-final-australia-v-south-korea-key-match-ups/6057636>); [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-01-31/asian-cup-final3a-australia-v-south-korea-live-blog/6059790>).

<a id="event-2015-01-31-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** In golf, Lydia Ko of New Zealand, who does not turn 18 until 24 April, becomes the youngest golfer of either sex to be ranked number 1 in the world, surpassing the previous record of Tiger Woods by nearly four years. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [New Zealand Herald](<http://www.nzherald.co.nz/sport/news/article.cfm?c_id=4&amp;objectid=11394885&amp;ref=NZH_Tw>).

<a id="event-2015-01-31-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** In American football, The Board of Selectors for Pro Football Hall of Fame announces the induction of eight individuals as the 2015 induction class which will formally enter the Hall in August. The inductees are Junior Seau, Jerome Bettis, Charles Haley, Will Shields, Tim Brown, and Mick Tingelhoff as players, and Bill Polian and Ron Wolf as contributors.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC Sports](<http://profootballtalk.nbcsports.com/2015/01/31/junior-seau-leads-a-strong-eight-man-class-into-the-hall-of-fame/related/>).


## February

### 2015-02-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1309553056](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20February%201&oldid=1309553056>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-02-01-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Steelworkers union strikes against Royal Dutch Shell Plc at nine U.S. oil and chemical plants. Up until recently oil prices had undergone steep drops since June, but the union's action as part of the supply chain caused the market price to soar more than eight percent.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2015/02/02/refineries-labor-strikes-idINL1N0VB09D20150202>).

<a id="event-2015-02-01-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Quintana Roo switches to the Southeastern Time Zone, which has the same effect as observing Eastern Standard Time year-round, to boost tourism.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/01/29/Cancun-switches-to-Eastern-time-zone/7591422575975/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-02-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Egypt deports Australian journalist Peter Greste after being jailed with two al-Jazeera colleagues Mohamed Fahmy and Baher Mohamed 400 days before.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-31083890>).

<a id="event-2015-02-01-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four-hundred African migrants charge past Moroccan border forces by throwing rocks, trying to storm border fences separating Spain's North African enclave Melilla, but Spanish guards repel them.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2015/02/01/spain-400-migrants-repelled-after-charging-moroccan-guards-storming-melilla/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-02-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pro-democracy protesters peacefully return to the streets of Hong Kong for the first time since the end of Occupy Central protests in December.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP France 24](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150208092247/http://www.france24.com/en/20150201-pro-democracy-protesters-return-hong-kong-streets/?aef_campaign_date=2015-02-01&amp;aef_campaign_ref=partage_aef&amp;ns_campaign=reseaux_sociaux&amp;ns_linkname=editorial&amp;ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_source=twitter>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/02/01/us-hongkong-protests-idUSKBN0L514X20150201>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-02-01-3-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Australian Open.

**Archived source account.** In tennis, Novak Djokovic of Serbia beats Andy Murray of the United Kingdom in the Australian Open Men's Singles Final. Djokovic is the first man to win five Australian Open championships in the open era.

Anthem says the medical information and financial data was not compromised.

### 2015-02-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1104626771](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20February%207&oldid=1104626771>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-02-07-0-1"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

<a id="event-2015-02-07-0-5"></a>

<a id="event-2015-02-07-1-0"></a>

<a id="event-2015-02-07-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The management of Twentieth Century Fox considers granting permission to a group of investors, including some hedge funds, seeking to amend the company's charter and turn their type of voting shares of stock into non-voting shares, a conversion that might raise that type of shares' market price and that also would further concentrate control in the hands of Rupert Murdoch and his family.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/02/07/us-fox-votingshares-exclusive-idUSKBN0LA2HP20150207>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-02-07-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** TransAsia cancels dozens of flights to retrain its pilots following the February 4 crash of TransAsia Airways Flight 235 which killed at least 43 people.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/afp/article-2943574/TransAsia-starts-pilot-retraining-deadly-crash.html>).

#### Law and crime

**Archived source account.** A gunman shoots six people, killing four, including several children, in Douglasville, Georgia, ending with the gunman committing suicide.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2015/02/07/7-people-shot-5-dead-in-georgia-shooting/>).

<a id="event-2015-02-07-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 17-year-old male opens fire on a man at the Monroeville Mall in the Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania area, striking his intended target as well as two bystanders hospitalizing three people.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.news24.com/news24/World/News/Teen-arrested-in-US-mall-shooting-20150208>); [Pittsburgh Post-Gazette](<http://www.post-gazette.com/local/2015/02/07/Shots-fired-at-Monroeville-Mall/stories/201502070146>).

**Archived source account.** Queensland Liberal National Party voters elect Lawrence Springborg as their leader with John-Paul Langbroek as deputy leader.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-02-07/lawrence-springborg-new-lnp-leader-queensland/6077536>).

<a id="event-2015-02-07-5-2"></a>

Context: Slovak same-sex marriage referendum.

**Archived source account.** Although greater than 90% vote in favor of the referendum, Slovak election officials deem the result invalid due to a low 21% voter turnout, far short of the 50% or greater turnout required for the results to be legally binding.

Source citations (as archived): [The Slovak Spectator](<http://spectator.sme.sk/c/20053434/referendum-invalid-turnout-low.html>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2015-02-14-1-0"></a>

**Editorial account; source review partial.** Australia Post dates Palaszczuk becoming Queensland premier to February 14, 2015.

Editorial date: 2015-02-14. Checked: 2026-10-22. The swearing-in date is supported. Government House location and the full minority-government election wording were not established by this biography.

Evidence: [Australia Post](<https://auspost.com.au/about-us/corporate-information/board-of-directors/annastacia-palaszczuk>).

Original source account: Premier Annastacia Palaszczuk is sworn in at Government House in Brisbane after officially winning minority government in the Queensland state election, 2015.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

### 2015-02-25

Context: 2015 Brit Awards.

Source citations (as archived): [PA](<http://www.watoday.com.au/entertainment/music/brit-awards-2015-madonna-falls-off-stage-during-living-for-love-performance-20150226-13p7um.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/music/2015/feb/25/mark-ronson-wins-best-british-single-at-brit-awards-2015>).

<a id="event-2015-02-25-0-3"></a>

Context: 2015 Brit Awards.

**Archived source account.** Ed Sheeran wins Best British album for x.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/music/2015/feb/25/ed-sheeran-wins-best-album-at-brit-awards-2015>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-02-25-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 187 people are killed in avalanches in northeastern Afghanistan

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-31636599>).

#### Health

<a id="event-2015-02-25-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Atlanta-based U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), were so concerned about a study released today in The New England Journal of Medicine, that they are launching another new study about why so many people are becoming infected by or exposed to the potentially deadly Clostridium difficile ("C. diff.") bacterium after going to the doctor's or dentist's office.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/02/25/health/deadly-bacteria-doctors-offices/index.html>); [CDC](<https://www.cdc.gov/hai/organisms/cdiff/tracking-Cdiff.html>); [NEJM](<http://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa1408913#t=article>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-02-25-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An arrest warrant is issued for Khaleda Zia, former Prime Minister of Bangladesh, after she fails to show up to face graft charges.

Source citations (as archived): [BD News](<http://bdnews24.com/politics/2015/02/25/arrest-warrants-out-for-khaleda-zia-in-graft-cases>).

<a id="event-2015-02-25-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Film director Roman Polanski testifies at a closed to the media court hearing in Kraków, Poland, regarding a US request for his extradition over a 1977 child sex crime conviction. The hearing is later postponed until April.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/film/2015/feb/25/roman-polanski-testifies-at-extradition-hearing-in-poland>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/02/25/europe/roman-polanski-extradition/>).

<a id="event-2015-02-25-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Morgan Stanley agrees to pay $2.6 billion to settle with the United States Department of Justice over its sale of residential mortgage backed securities.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-02-25/morgan-stanley-reaches-2-6-billion-mortgage-accord-with-u-s->).

<a id="event-2015-02-25-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Austrian Parliament passes a bill, partly aimed at tackling Islamist radicalism, that gives Muslims more legal security but bans foreign funding for mosques and imams.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-31629543>).

<a id="event-2015-02-25-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A United States district court judge orders documents turned over to hedge fund NML Capital with regard to the flow of funds in a February 9 issuance of Argentina dollar denominated sovereign bonds.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/02/26/us-argentina-debt-idUSKBN0LU1FU20150226>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-02-25-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Argentine National Congress approves installation of a Chinese satellite tracking station in Patagonia.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/d82158686f51409b9c5cffad71d19bc1/argentina-congress-oks-deal-china-satellite-station>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-02-25-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Faure Gnassingbé, the President of Togo, announces his candidacy for the forthcoming election in April.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/togo-president-gnassingbe-seek-fresh-term-april-election-211029637.html>).

### 2015-02-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1099966757](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20February%2026&oldid=1099966757>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-02-26-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** A Taliban suicide bomb attack on a Turkish government vehicle in Kabul kills at least one person.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-south-asia-31635709?ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_campaign=bbc_breaking&amp;ns_source=twitter&amp;ns_linkname=news_central>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/suicide-bomb-attack-turkish-embassy-vehicle-kills-one-kabul-n313086>).

<a id="event-2015-02-26-0-3"></a>

Context: Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant.

**Archived source account.** "Jihadi John", an ISIL terrorist featured in many beheading videos, is identified as Mohammed Emwazi, a Kuwaiti-born man who lived in the United Kingdom and was on a terrorism watch list.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/jihadi-john-the-islamic-state-killer-behind-the-mask-is-a-young-londoner/2015/02/25/d6dbab16-bc43-11e4-bdfa-b8e8f594e6ee_story.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/02/27/world/europe/jihadi-john-mohammed-emwazi-identified.html?_r=0>); [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/isis-militant-jihadi-john-identified-mohammed-emwazi/>).

<a id="event-2015-02-26-0-4"></a>

Context: Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant.

**Archived source account.** ISIS posts a video showing the destruction of Mosul Museum, the second largest in Iraq and rich in artifacts from thousands of years of Iraqi history.

Source citations (as archived): [National Post](<http://news.nationalpost.com/2015/02/26/video-shows-isis-militants-roaming-through-iraq-museum-with-sledgehammers-and-power-tools-destroying-artifacts/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-02-26-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** French actresses Marion Cotillard and Mélanie Laurent, and French President François Hollande begin their two-day state visit to the Philippines, where they are to discuss climate change.

Source citations (as archived): [GMA News](<http://www.gmanetwork.com/news/photo/102481/french-actress-marion-cotillard-arrives-in-manila>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-02-26-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Norwegian police raid the offices of the Catholic Church’s diocese in Oslo, charging the church administration with serious fraud under the suspicion of wrongfully claiming as much as NOK 50 million in state support by presenting fraudulent membership statistics.

Source citations (as archived): [NewsInEnglish](<http://www.newsinenglish.no/2015/02/26/police-raid-catholic-diocese-in-oslo/>).

<a id="event-2015-02-26-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Guardian publishes articles alleging that the Chicago Police Department have been running a black site at Homan Square for detained Americans; former justice officials call for investigation. The CPD denies the allegations.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2015/feb/24/chicago-police-detain-americans-black-site>); [The Guardian²](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2015/feb/25/chicago-homan-square-former-justice-officials-call-for-investigation>); [Chicago Sun-Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150226224203/http://chicago.suntimes.com/news-chicago/7/71/393084/homan-square-site-chicago-police-deny-report-secret-interrogation-compound>).

<a id="event-2015-02-26-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A United Nations report claims that a North Korean shipping company has been renaming and reflagging its vessels to avoid an arms embargo.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-31635564>).

<a id="event-2015-02-26-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Effective midnight, Washington, D.C. joins Alaska, Colorado, and Washington state as the only places in the United States that locally purport to override federal law and allow the use of marijuana for recreational purposes.

Source citations (as archived): [HuffPost](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/2015/02/26/marijuana-legalization-dc_n_6753554.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-02-26-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The US Federal Communications Commission votes to classify internet service providers as public utilities, creating net neutrality rules. The FCC also votes to preempt state laws in North Carolina and Tennessee that effectively prevent municipal broadband providers from expanding outside their existing service areas.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/6e1a7d433381466bbd700df770ceb323/regulators-move-toward-tougher-rules-internet-providers>).

### 2015-02-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1259816967](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20February%2028&oldid=1259816967>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant.

**Archived source account.** A series of car bombs kill 19 people in Balad Ruz, east-central Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.news24.com/news24/World/News/Bombings-kill-19-people-in-Iraq-20150228>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-02-28-1-1"></a>

Context: Lithuania–United States relations:.

**Archived source account.** Lithuania signs a trade agreement to buy liquefied natural gas from the United States in a move aimed at reducing the EU Baltic state's heavy dependence on Russian gas deliveries.

Bush, former U.S. Vice President Dick Cheney, former CIA Director George Tenet, and U.S. Senators Bob Menendez (D–NJ) and Marco Rubio (R–FL) would be banned from entering the country.

<a id="event-2015-02-28-2-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Straits Times](<http://www.straitstimes.com/news/asia/east-asia/story/top-china-advisory-body-cppcc-ousts-former-top-hu-jintao-aide-ling-jihua-2>).


## March

### 2015-03-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076206013](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20March%201&oldid=1076206013>).

#### Political elections

<a id="event-2015-03-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Estonian parliamentary election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** The ruling Reform Party wins the elections, but loses the majority that it has had with its current coalition partner, the Social Democratic Party. For the first time in many years, two new parties cross the election threshold, the right-of-centre Free Party and the eurosceptic Conservative People's Party of Estonia.

Source citations (as archived): [Estonian Public Broadcasting](<http://news.err.ee/v/main_news/4249bcba-7176-4b74-af11-9e4812c78368>).

<a id="event-2015-03-01-0-3"></a>

Context: Andorran parliamentary election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Despite losing five seats, the Democrats for Andorra narrowly retains their absolute majority in the General Council, winning 15 of the 28 seats.

Source citations (as archived): [Elections Andorra](<http://www.eleccions.ad/resultats>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-03-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASA astronauts perform the third of three ISS spacewalks completing the cabling reroutings needed in preparation for the 2017 arrival of the first commercial spacecraft capable of transporting astronauts.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/30e730eaf1734889ba397a41244edd52/astronauts-take-3rd-spacewalk-complete-tricky-cable-job>).

### 2015-03-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131349604](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20March%202&oldid=1131349604>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-03-02-0-1"></a>

Context: Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant:.

**Archived source account.** A coalition of Iraqi Armed Forces and militia numbering around 30,000 launches an offensive against Islamic State positions in Tikrit. Troops seize control of the district of al-Tin and al-Abeid.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-31699632>).

<a id="event-2015-03-02-0-3"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Libya's Council of Deputies agrees to resume peace talks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/reuters/article-2976267/Libyas-elected-parliament-agrees-resume-UN-talks--spokesman.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-03-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hewlett-Packard announces that it will buy Aruba Networks, a California-based manufacturer of wi-fi equipment, for approximately $2.7 billion in combined cash and equity.

Source citations (as archived): [HP Inc. press release](<http://www8.hp.com/us/en/hp-news/press-release.html?id=1923193#.VPW5-o73-iw,>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-03-02-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In response to joint exercises held by South Korea and the United States, North Korea fires two short-range missiles off its coast.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/03/01/us-northkorea-missles-idUSKBN0LX1UI20150301>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-03-02-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A man shoots to death a woman and a seven-year-old boy then himself in the Queensland town of Biddeston, west of Brisbane, Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-03-02/three-dead-in-shooting-near-toowoomba/6275670?WT.mc_id=newsmail>).
