<a id="event-2015-03-02-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Durham Police arrest English and Sunderland footballer Adam Johnson over suspected sexual activity with a 15-year-old girl.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-31702374>).

### 2015-03-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1099968981](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20March%203&oldid=1099968981>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-03-03-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Norwegian Air Shuttle will ground all passengers in Norway, Denmark, and Sweden as the result of an industrial dispute. The action leaves 35,000 people stranded.

Source citations (as archived): [The local](<http://www.thelocal.no/20150303/800-staff-sent-home-after-norwegian-strike-action>).

<a id="event-2015-03-03-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Royal Bank of Scotland will fire 14,000 staff as they retreat from geographic positions in US and Asian markets.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/2015/mar/03/rbs-could-cut-14000-staff-us-asia-ross-mcewan>).

<a id="event-2015-03-03-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Target Corporation, a major U.S. retail chain, announces cuts that will mean the loss of thousands of jobs, part of a revival plan adopted by CEO Brian Cornell.

Source citations (as archived): [Target press release](<http://pressroom.target.com/news/target-shares-roadmap-to-transform-business>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-03-03-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Villarrica volcano explodes in southern Chile leading to the evacuation of 3,000 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/photo/2015-03/04/c_134035257.htm>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-03-03-2-1"></a>

Context: Assassination of Boris Nemtsov.

**Archived source account.** Russian authorities refuse entry into Russia at Moscow's Sheremetyevo International Airport to a Latvian lawmaker and vice-chair of the biggest bloc in the EU, Sandra Kalniete. Having received no reasonable explanation for the ban, she flies back to Brussels.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://au.news.yahoo.com/world/a/26494872/polish-latvian-officials-barred-from-entering-russia-for-nemtsov-funeral/>).

<a id="event-2015-03-03-2-2"></a>

Context: Assassination of Boris Nemtsov.

**Archived source account.** Russia's authorities deny Poland's Senate speaker Bogdan Borusewicz entry into Russia for the funeral of slain Kremlin critic Nemtsov.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150306053002/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/polish-top-senator-russia-banned-nemtsovs-funeral-29327285>).

<a id="event-2015-03-03-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** North Korea lifts restrictions on entry into the country imposed ostensibly to stop the spread of the Ebola virus.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-31704999>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-03-03-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former CIA director and U.S. Army officer David Petraeus pleads guilty in federal court to a charge of unauthorized removal and retention of classified information.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters vis MSN](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150305163640/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/crime/former-cia-director-petraeus-pleads-guilty-to-federal-charge-doj/ar-BBibqYX>).

<a id="event-2015-03-03-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Turkish court orders President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan to pay 10,000 lira ($4,000) in compensation for the mental anguish caused to artist Mehmet Aksoy for having called his sculpture Monument to Humanity — meant to promote reconciliation between Turkey and Armenia — a "monstrosity" in 2011.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2015/03/03/court-fines-turkish-president-erdogan-for-calling-armenia-peace-monument/>).

<a id="event-2015-03-03-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** China detains Jing Chunhua, a senior official from Hebei province of China, for investigation by the Communist Party's anti-graft agency for violating party discipline and breaking the law. Jing is the second provincial-ranked official from Hebei province to undergo investigation since the wider anti-corruption campaign began in 2013.

Source citations (as archived): [CRI](<http://english.cri.cn/12394/2015/03/04/3861s868438.htm>).

<a id="event-2015-03-03-3-4"></a>

Context: Same-sex marriage in Slovenia.

**Archived source account.** Slovenia becomes the 11th EU member state and the first post-communist state to legalize same-sex marriage and adoption of children by same-sex couples, after a parliamentary vote of 51–28.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/03/04/us-slovenia-gaymarriage-idUSKBN0M00ZP20150304>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-03-03-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu addresses a joint meeting of the United States Congress over the nuclear program of Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-31716684>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/live/netanyahu-address/netanyahu-speech-will-air-in-israel-with-5-minute-delay>).

<a id="event-2015-03-03-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Myanmarese students on a march to Yangon to protest an academic bill defy a police order to disperse in Letpadan Township.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-31716169>).

<a id="event-2015-03-03-4-3"></a>

Context: Norwegian Nobel Committee.

**Archived source account.** For the first time in its 114-year-old history, the Norwegian Nobel Committee (which awards the Nobel Peace Prize) replaces against his will its head, Thorbjørn Jagland. Kaci Kullmann Five succeeds Jagland who will still remain a member of the committee.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-03-04/nobel-peace-committee-demotes-controversial-head/6278812>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-03-03-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An archaeological expedition claims to have found the legendary White City in northeastern Honduras, with artifacts that range in dates from the 11th to 14th century.

Source citations (as archived): [National Geographic](<http://news.nationalgeographic.com/news/2015/03/150302-honduras-lost-city-monkey-god-maya-ancient-archaeology/>).

### 2015-03-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076205888](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20March%204&oldid=1076205888>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-03-04-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** South of Sicily, Italy's Coast Guard saves 941 trafficked migrants aboard five motorized dinghies and two larger vessels near southern Italian ports. Authorities cannot account for ten people.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/0a813713c2e84a40a08993a75284a12d/nearly-1000-migrants-rescued-italy-10-die>).

<a id="event-2015-03-04-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 33 miners die in a suspected gas explosion at the Zasyadko coal mine in rebel-held Donetsk region of Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-31725243>); [Reuters](<http://www.news24.com/news24/World/News/Thirty-three-miners-killed-in-Ukraine-20150304>).

<a id="event-2015-03-04-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Turkish Airlines Flight TK726, landing in dense fog in the Nepalese capital Kathmandu, skids off a slippery runway, however, there are no serious injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/turkish-airlines-jet-skids-off-runway-passengers-escape/story?id=29375335>).

<a id="event-2015-03-04-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A toxic chemical fire forces the closure of the Port of Vancouver (Canada's largest and North America's fourth largest port). Authorities later manage to contain the fire, and identify the chemical as trichloroisocyanuric acid.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/british-columbia/port-metro-vancouver-chemical-fire-under-control-1.2982024>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-03-04-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scientists report the finding of a 2.8-million-year-old jawbone (the "Ledi jaw") forming a potential link between the 3.2-million-year-old hominin (human-like primate) Lucy (Australopithecus) found in the same area, and the 2.35-million-year-old remains of Homo habilis found at nearby Hadar. If assigned to the genus Homo, the new remains represent the oldest known human, some 400,000 years older than previously found.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-31718336>).

<a id="event-2015-03-04-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Microsoft co-founder Paul Allen and his team of researchers find the Musashi, one of Japan's biggest and most famous battleships which was sunk by American forces in 1944, on the floor of the Sibuyan Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/03/03/intl_world/paul-allen-japanese-battleship-musashi/>).

### 2015-03-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131349740](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20March%205&oldid=1131349740>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-03-05-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A knife-wielding assailant injures the American ambassador to South Korea, Mark Lippert, in the South Korean capital city of Seoul. Authorities report that the injuries on his face and wrist are not life-threatening.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150306173717/http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/news/2015/03/05/0200000000AEN20150305001400315.html?input=www.tweeter.com>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-31743055>).

<a id="event-2015-03-05-0-2"></a>

Context: Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013).

**Archived source account.** Separate attacks in Baghdad kill at least eight people.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/b304d1777cfe46869d7d844084670733/attacks-iraqi-capital-kill-least-8-people>).

<a id="event-2015-03-05-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong-based luxury hotel chain Mandarin Oriental confirms that credit card data has been stolen in a hack attack on the company's network.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-31753935>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-03-05-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Indian government censors the documentary India's Daughter depicting a December 2012 gang rape and murder due to perceived incitement to violence that the outrage about the film might cause. Nevertheless, the BBC telecasts the film.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-2978760/India-bans-broadcast-gang-rapist-documentary.html>); [The Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/BBC-ignores-ban-telecasts-Nirbhaya-documentary-Indias-Daughter/articleshow/46464046.cms>).

<a id="event-2015-03-05-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The American Ringling Bros. and Barnum &amp; Bailey Circus will phase-out the inclusion of elephants in their performances by 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/df575148221544f4adaf3bea2adbb635/apnewsbreak-ringling-bros-eliminating-elephant-acts>).

<a id="event-2015-03-05-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** His Eminence, Edward Cardinal Egan, the immediate past Archbishop-Emeritus of New York, dies in New York City at the age of 82.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/03/06/nyregion/cardinal-edward-m-egan-former-archbishop-of-new-york-dies-at-82.html?action=click&amp;pgtype=Homepage&amp;version=Moth-Visible&amp;module=inside-nyt-region&amp;region=inside-nyt-region&amp;WT.nav=inside-nyt-region>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-03-05-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** American pharmaceutical company AbbVie Inc buys leukemia drugmaker Pharmacyclics Inc for $21 billion.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/955c9977c0014003945ea4fff8589106/abbvie-buy-leukemia-drugmaker-pharmacyclics-21b>).

<a id="event-2015-03-05-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A New York state appellate court in Manhattan rules to approve in its entirety the 2011 settlement by Bank of America with 22 institutional investors including BlackRock Inc, MetLife Inc, and Allianz SE's Pacific Investment Management Co to resolve claims over $174 billion of mortgage securities issued by the former Countrywide Financial Corp. in a $8.5 billion settlement.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/03/05/us-bofa-settlement-ruling-idUSKBN0M121Z20150305>).

<a id="event-2015-03-05-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Dublin-based generic drugmaker, specialty drug supplier, and medical imaging agent producer Mallinckrodt Plc increases its presence in U.S. hospitals by buying privately held Ikaria Inc, a maker of a respiratory drug and its delivery system, for $2.3 billion from a group of investors led by private equity firm Madison Dearborn Partners LLC. The deal includes INOmax, which is the only approved product to treat hypoxic respiratory failure in infants through nitric oxide.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/03/05/us-malinckrodt-deal-idUSKBN0M11BS20150305>).

<a id="event-2015-03-05-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Energy-rich Kazakhstan suspends Russian fuel and gas imports to protect its domestic market from a surplus due to a weakened ruble which has sent ripples of economic uncertainty through Central Asia.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Central Asia](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150308084147/http://www.timesca.com/news/15052-kazakhstan-suspends-fuel-import-from-russia>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-03-05-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tanzanian flooding kills 42 people near Lake Victoria in the Kahama District.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/96e8a22f248a4ee5bfb20f25ffe17998/floods-kill-42-people-tanzania-authorities-say>).

<a id="event-2015-03-05-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Delta Air Lines McDonnell Douglas MD-88 aircraft attempting to complete a snowing landing, veers to the left side off of a recently-plowed runway, thereby missing the end of runway emergency arresting device, and skids onto the edge of water embankment at LaGuardia Airport, New York, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [The Aviation Herald](<http://avherald.com/h?article=482b659f&amp;opt=0>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/c84dbf7a5a814de2b80e0bfc0140af08/plane-skids-runway-laguardia-no-injuries-reported>).

<a id="event-2015-03-05-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** American actor Harrison Ford is in stable condition after he crash-lands his 1942 Ryan Aeronautical ST3KR single-engine World War II-era training plane at the Penmar Golf Course, in Venice, Los Angeles, California, just west of the Santa Monica Airport.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150308162652/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/ap-source-harrison-ford-crash-lands-plane-on-golf-course/ar-BBihP3m>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/03/05/entertainment/harrison-ford-plane-crash/>).

#### Health

<a id="event-2015-03-05-4-1"></a>

Context: Ebola virus epidemic in West Africa.

**Archived source account.** Liberia's last known ebola patient is discharged from a treatment center in Monrovia. The country now needs 42 days without a subsequent diagnosed infection to be declared disease free.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/03/06/world/africa/last-ebola-patient-in-liberia-beatrice-yardolo-discharged-from-treatment.html?_r=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-03-05-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The manufacturer of a medical instrument for endoscopic procedures, Olympus Corp, lacked US FDA clearance to sell the current version when it caused an outbreak of infections, including two deaths, from an antibiotic-resistant strain of bacteria, "superbug" Carbapenem-resistant enterobacteriaceae, or CRE, at Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center between October 2014 and January 2015 (see February 19).

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/1156c693d0fe4adcb55ba5192ddc374c/maker-device-superbug-outbreak-lacked-fda-clearance>).

<a id="event-2015-03-05-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Phoenix, Arizona jury deadlocks in a second trial allowing convicted murderer American Jodi Arias to be spared the death penalty. She will be sent to prison for life for killing her lover in 2008.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/ae327446e1d94010b4ab095a74296a77/court-jodi-arias-jurors-reach-verdict-sentencing-retrial>).

<a id="event-2015-03-05-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Supreme Court schedules oral arguments for hearing cases regarding the bans by states of gay marriage on April 28, 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150307184403/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/national/businesses-back-gay-marriage-top-us-court-sets-argument-date/ar-BBigwAn>).

<a id="event-2015-03-05-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A mob storms the central jail in Dimapur, India, and kills Farid Khan, an undocumented migrant from Bangladesh in custody as a rape suspect. The mob ransacks and destroys over 20 shops and torches ten vehicles including a police jeep.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindu](<http://www.thehindu.com/news/national/other-states/centre-concerned-as-tensions-run-high-in-nagaland/article6966122.ece>).

### 2015-03-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1259601179](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20March%206&oldid=1259601179>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-03-06-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Canadian special forces member Sgt. Andrew Doiron is shot and killed by Kurdish Peshmerga fighters in Iraq in a friendly fire incident, the first Canadian death in Operation Impact.

Source citations (as archived): [Ottawa Citizen](<https://ottawacitizen.com/news/national/canadian-soldier-dies-in-friendly-fire-incident-in-iraq-dnd-says>).

<a id="event-2015-03-06-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least two knife-wielding attackers injure nine people at a train station in southern China; the police fatally shoot one of the suspects.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/8327c31a43d04e859324d1740efc88ce/knife-attack-china-train-station-leaves-9-injured>).

<a id="event-2015-03-06-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom's National Crime Agency arrests a man as a suspected hacker in western England in connection with a June 15, 2014 cyber attack on the messaging service used by employees at the U.S. Department of Defense.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/275b4d6908b445578dd3641385d6f1e8/uk-authorities-arrest-suspect-us-dod-cyber-attack>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-03-06/u-s-department-of-defense-hacking-suspect-arrested-in-u-k->).

<a id="event-2015-03-06-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Justice Department charges two Vietnamese citizens (Quoc Nguyen and Giang Hoang Vu) and a Canadian (David-Manuel Santos Da Silva) with running a massive cyberfraud ring that stole one billion email addresses, then sent spam offering knockoff software products of Adobe Systems Inc with the hacking having occurred between February 2009 and June 2012. The victim breaches include a massive 2011 attack on email marketing firm Epsilon, a unit of Alliance Data Systems Corp. Although the other two are in custody, Nguyen remains at large. The charge against Da Silva is conspiracy to commit money laundering.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/03/06/us-usa-cybercrime-justice-idUSKBN0M21ZK20150306>).

#### Business and Economy

<a id="event-2015-03-06-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** S&amp;P Dow Jones Indices announces it will add the company Apple Inc. to its Dow Jones Industrial Average index of stocks on March 19, replacing AT&amp;T.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/03/07/business/dealbook/apple-to-replace-att-in-dow-index.html?action=click&amp;pgtype=Homepage&amp;module=second-column-region&amp;region=top-news&amp;WT.nav=top-news&amp;hp&amp;_r=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-03-06-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A road accident along the highway between Ismaïlia and Cairo in Egypt, east of Cairo, involving a bus that collided with a microbus kills fifteen people.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/cca5177fd19a438bbb8b758ceb8d3e4c/road-accident-east-egyptian-capital-kills-15-people>).

<a id="event-2015-03-06-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two massive snowy traffic jams in Kentucky strand motorists for 24 hours or longer. One stretched for about 26 miles along Interstate 65 from just north of Elizabethtown past Shepherdsville, and the other stretched the entire length of Interstate 24 in Kentucky, more than 90 miles.

Source citations (as archived): [AP, I-65](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/c054af59ade54693aba158a36d35a4be/thousands-stranded-ky-interstates-nearly-24-hours>); [WSMV-TV, I-24](<http://www.wsmv.com/story/28272092/hundreds-of-drivers-stranded-in-ky-governor-declares-state-of-emergency>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-03-06-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Writing in the FIFA Weekly magazine, FIFA president Sepp Blatter calls Iran to end its "intolerable" ban on women attending soccer matches, describing the situation as one that "cannot continue."

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/03/06/football/iran-ban-women-matches-sepp-blatter-fifa/>).

#### Health

<a id="event-2015-03-06-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approves the country's first biosimilar drug, Zarxio (Europe: 2009, as Zarzio), made by Novartis. Biosimilars are a relatively new class of drugs designed to pave the way for less expensive versions of the complex biologics drug class, and they are not synthesized from chemicals like other drugs, but are made from living cells. Some well known biologics include Remicade and Enbrel for autoimmune diseases, and Herceptin and Avastin for cancer. Zarxio, used to prevent infection in cancer patients receiving chemotherapy, is a close copy of Neupogen, made by Amgen.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/03/07/health/fda-approves-zarxio-first-biosimilar-drug.html?ref=health>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-03-06-5-1"></a>

Context: 2014 Taipei Metro attack.

**Archived source account.** The New Taipei City district court sentences Cheng Chieh to death for the May 2014 knife attack on a Taipei Metro train that left four dead and 22 passengers injured.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/bf81743bdad14535b2288f6da82a6ebd/taiwan-subway-slasher-sentenced-death-killing-4>).

<a id="event-2015-03-06-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) Director John O. Brennan announces plans for a major restructuring and reorganization, including a focus on digital espionage (through the creation of the CIA Directorate of Digital Innovation). The plan will end some longstanding divisions, and create ten new centers that team analysts with operators, fostering collaboration and focus on a range of new security issues and threats, and replacing geographic division offices with hybrid mission centers modeled on the CIA Counterterrorism Center.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150308163631/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/national/cia-plans-major-reorganization-and-a-focus-on-digital-espionage/ar-AA9tiCw>).

<a id="event-2015-03-06-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Customs officers at the Shahjalal International Airport catch Son Young Nam, a North Korean diplomat trying to smuggle an estimated $1.4 million worth of gold into Bangladesh. Bangladesh authorities release him but will still seek to press charges.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/03/06/us-bangladesh-northkorea-diplomat-idUSKBN0M20JT20150306>).

<a id="event-2015-03-06-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Madison Police Department officers fatally shoot an unarmed 19-year-old black teenager who was suspected of a recent battery. A struggle ensued between the suspect and an officer, and the teen was fatally shot.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150308101934/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/wisconsin-police-fatally-shoot-black-teen-prompting-protest/ar-AA9u6Z3>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-03-06-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASA's Dawn spacecraft enters orbit around the dwarf planet Ceres.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/34b5bf4679324ea39140b686f272503b/nasas-dawn-spacecraft-moves-dwarf-planet-ceres>); [JPL](<http://www.jpl.nasa.gov/news/news.php?feature=4503>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/f406818ffc2344cbab2db0b2c83cc2a6/nasas-dawn-spacecraft-moves-dwarf-planet-ceres>).

<a id="event-2015-03-06-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** India's Universal Primer Technology disputes the credit for inventing DNA barcoding with the University of Guelph in Canada.

Source citations (as archived): [Nature India](<http://www.natureasia.com/en/nindia/article/10.1038/nindia.2015.20>); [IBN7](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150606120137/http://www.ibn7.com/biotech/item/86981-indian-scientists-peeved-over-credit-grab>).

### 2015-03-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1185673292](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20March%207&oldid=1185673292>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-03-07-0-1"></a>

Context: Boko Haram.

**Archived source account.** Maiduguri city in northeast Nigeria sees five suicide bomb blasts with 54 dead and 143 wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/e919a0bfeaed4701b65accfe7651789e/5-suicide-bomb-blasts-rock-maiduguri-city-northeast-nigeria>).

<a id="event-2015-03-07-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A suspected terrorist attack in Bamako, Mali, kills five people.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.bdlive.co.za/africa/africannews/2015/03/07/five-dead-in-suspected-terror-attack-in-mali-nightclub>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/03/07/africa/mali-bar-shooting/index.html>).

<a id="event-2015-03-07-0-4"></a>

Context: Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant.

**Archived source account.** In Iraq, ISIL destroys the ancient city of Hatra following the destruction of Nimrud.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://m.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-31779484>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-03-07-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The US Secret Service locks down the White House after a loud noise (later revealed to be a burned-out souvenir truck) is heard on the South Lawn, moments before U.S. President Barack Obama and his family were due to take off by helicopter. He and his family were not yet on the South Lawn when the noise was heard.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150309145231/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/politics/white-house-on-lockdown-after-loud-bang-pool-report/ar-AA9uIzo>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/03/08/us-usa-securtity-obama-idUSKBN0M30LX20150308>).

<a id="event-2015-03-07-1-2"></a>

Context: Assassination of Boris Nemtsov.

**Archived source account.** Russian authorities arrest five men, Anzor Gubashev and Zaur Dadayev, suspects from the rebellious North Caucasus region, according to Russian state media reports, relying on a statement from the Russian Federal Security Service Director Alexander Bortnikov. However, Nemtsov's daughter, Zhanna Nemtsova, speaking from Germany, says she has no idea who they are. Many still suspect Russian governmental involvement in his death.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/03/07/europe/russia-nemtsov-murder-arrest/index.html>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/a371bf8eabce499495e2b6bcd578d3aa/nemtsov-killing-suspects-whereabouts-unknown>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-03-07-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** According to former U.S. President Jimmy Carter, the flu causes his Vice President, Walter Mondale, 87, to be hospitalized at the famed Mayo Clinic, in Rochester, Minnesota.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/03/07/us/vice-president-walter-mondale-sick/index.html>).

### 2015-03-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1226057687](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20March%208&oldid=1226057687>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-03-08-0-1"></a>

Context: Boko Haram.

**Archived source account.** Forces from Niger and Chad launch a ground and air offensive against Boko Haram Islamist militants in northeastern Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-31789412>).

<a id="event-2015-03-08-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A rocket and shelling attack in Kidal, northern Mali kills three people, including a UN peacekeeper.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/03/peacekeeper-killed-attack-mali-kidal-150308092228277.html>).

<a id="event-2015-03-08-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bomb explodes outside French supermarket Carrefour in Alexandria, Egypt, killing one person and wounding six.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.news24.com/news24/Africa/News/1-killed-6-wounded-in-Egypt-blast-20150308>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-03-08-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** American writer and producer Sam Simon, co-creator of the longest running animated sitcom, The Simpsons, dies at the age of 59 after a 3-year battle with terminal colorectal cancer.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-31801198>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-03-08-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A unknown gunman in a vehicle kills Dreekius Oricko Johnson, 28, and wounds former Tennessee Titans and New York Jets running back Chris Johnson in Orlando, Florida.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150309095539/http://www.msn.com/en-us/sports/nfl/former-jets-rb-chris-johnson-shot-in-florida-one-dead/ar-AA9wVxl>).

<a id="event-2015-03-08-2-2"></a>

Context: Assassination of Boris Nemtsov.

**Archived source account.** A court in Moscow charges two men of Chechen origin, Zaur Dadayev and Ansor Gubashev, who were among five arrested March 7, with the murder of Russian opposition leader Boris Nemtsov. The others also arrested, Gubashev's younger brother Shahid Gubashev and two others named only as Bakhayev and Eskerkhanov, are still only suspects.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150311055957/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/two-charged-with-nemtsov-murder-in-russian-court/ar-AA9whWS>).

<a id="event-2015-03-08-2-3"></a>

Context: Assassination of Boris Nemtsov.

**Archived source account.** A sixth suspect in Nemtsov's murder, Beslan Shavanov, 30, who had been holed up in a building in Chechnya's capital, Grozny, blows himself up.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/03/07/europe/russia-nemtsov-murder-arrest/index.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-03-08-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Army, working with the U.S. Navy and NASA, through its Joint Multi-Role Technology Demonstrator transport helicopter re-design program, in the latest issue of Army Technology Magazine, takes note of some new designs Sikorsky-Boeing (the Sikorsky Defiant, which like the existing Sikorsky X2 and Sikorsky S-97 Raider, features a faster pusher propeller) and Bell Helicopter (the V-280 Valor, which resembles a slimmed-down version of the tilt-rotor V-22 Osprey, and comes in three versions: a troop- and equipment-carrying utility style, a medevac, and an attack chopper) have come up with since they were selected by the Pentagon in August 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [Popular Science](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150309230320/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/technology/army-plans-the-war-helicopters-of-tomorrow/ar-AA9t0Ys>).

<a id="event-2015-03-09-0-3"></a>

**Editorial account; source review complete.** ANOC identifies sailor Florence Arthaud among the victims of the March 9 accident in Argentina.

Editorial date: 2015-03-09. Checked: 2026-10-22. The short biographical entry is supported; the death context is supplied by its preserved parent assertion.

Evidence: [Association of National Olympic Committees](<https://www.anocolympic.org/noc-highlights/tragic-accident-for-french-olympians/>).

Original source account: Florence Arthaud - a yachtswoman

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2015-03-09-0-5"></a>

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-03-09-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Celebrity British lawyer Amal Clooney files a case in the United Nations on behalf of former Philippines President Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo.

Source citations (as archived): [Philippine Star](<http://www.philstar.com/headlines/2015/03/09/1431539/clooneys-wife-wants-philippine-government-apologize-gma>).

<a id="event-2015-03-09-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Barack Obama signs an executive order declaring Venezuela a national security threat to the U.S.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150309221405/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/obama-declares-venezuela-a-threat-to-us-national-security/ar-AA9yzFS>); [White House text of the order](<http://www.whitehouse.gov/the-press-office/2015/03/09/executive-order-declaration-national-emergency-respect-venezuela>).

<a id="event-2015-03-09-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S.'s Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) Director, James Comey, announces an increased reward of $5 million (up from $1 million, issued in 2012) for information leading to the return of a former FBI agent Robert Levinson (who disappeared March 9, 2007, in Iran and who was paid by the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) to gather information about Iran's nuclear program).

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150309225835/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/us-offers-dollar5m-for-return-of-ex-fbi-agent-missing-in-iran/ar-AA9z5BA>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-03-09-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A man kills five people in the Japanese city of Sumoto in a prolonged stabbing attack.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC and AFP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-03-09/japanese-man-arrested-after-five-people-found-stabbed-to-death/6291812>).

<a id="event-2015-03-09-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** American film director Randall Miller pleads guilty to involuntary manslaughter and criminal trespassing and will spend two years in county jail and another eight on probation in regards to the February 20, 2014, death of camera assistant Sarah Jones by a freight train on a bridge over the Altamaha River in Wayne County, Georgia (six other crew members were also injured), during filming of a biopic about singer Gregg Allman called Midnight Rider.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-31804884>).

<a id="event-2015-03-09-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In a five-day national dragnet last week, Operation Cross Check, the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) rounds up 2,059 people who had been convicted of crimes and had been living in the country illegally. Most were not violent criminals (none were implicated in terrorism; almost all the 912 misdemeanors were for driving under the influence, DWI; 476 of the felons were charged with an immigration violation, though some were convicted of manslaughter, robbery, rape, and child pornography).

Source citations (as archived): [Tribune Washington Bureau](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150312141303/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/us-immigration-officials-announce-2000-arrests-in-nationwide-raids/ar-AA9zEPf>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-03-09-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Solar-powered aircraft Solar Impulse 2 begins its circumnavigation of the earth.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-31772140>).

<a id="event-2015-03-09-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Explorers of a stalactite cave in Israel's Galilee region uncover a small collection of 2,300-year-old silver coins and jewelry believed to have been hidden from the time of Alexander the Great of Macedonia. The discovery could be the first of its kind to be found from that period in this area.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150311135602/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/treasure-from-era-of-alexander-the-great-found-in-israel/ar-AA9yfat>).

Source citations (as archived): [Rolling Stone](<https://www.rollingstone.com/music/news/robin-thicke-and-pharrell-lose-blurred-lines-lawsuit-20150310>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-03-10-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A large number of Class A drugs became legal in Republic of Ireland after a legislative mistake overruled the 1977 Misuse of drugs act. this prompted some emergency legislation being rushed through but effectively a single day where the use of drugs became legal.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Post](<https://www.irishpost.com/entertainment/yokegate-remembering-irish-government-accidentally-legalised-drugs-24-hours-169327#:~:text=Despite%20the%20government&#x27;s%20best%20efforts,a%20colloquial%20term%20for%20Ecstasy.>).

<a id="event-2015-03-10-3-1"></a>

<a id="event-2015-03-10-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Wikimedia Foundation and eight other organisations file a lawsuit in the state of Maryland, US against the National Security Agency and the United States Department of Justice regarding the NSA's mass surveillance program. The Wikimedia Foundation is the owner and parent company of Wikipedia.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/tech/security/wikimedia-sues-nsa-alleging-mass-internet-surveillance-n320756>).

Source citations (as archived): [RTT](<http://www.rttnews.com/2468460/pakistan-completely-lifts-moratorium-on-death-penalty.aspx?type=pn>).

Previously, the strike had been cited as a reason for recent oil price increases.

The Citigroup processing of payments would violate a requirement that Argentina treat bondholders equally.

<a id="event-2015-03-15-4-1"></a>

**Editorial account; source review partial.** NASCAR reports defending champion Harvick winning at Phoenix for a fourth straight time and extending his top-two streak to seven, the longest since Petty in 1975.

Editorial date: 2015-03-15. Checked: 2026-10-22. The race, status and streak comparison are supported. The opened passages do not pin the streak to the exact November start claimed by the source. This is a complete source sentence retained as an assertion, not a topic label.

Evidence: [NASCAR Wire Service](<https://www.nascar.com/news-media/2015/03/15/harvick-wins-fourth-straight-phoenix-race/>).

Original source account: In auto racing, defending Sprint Cup champion Kevin Harvick wins the 2015 CampingWorld.com 500 at Phoenix International Raceway in his fourth straight win at the track, extending a streak of top-2 finishes dating back to last November. At 7 races, this is the longest such streak since Richard Petty's 11-race streak in 1975.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2015-03-15-4-2"></a>

Context: In auto racing, defending Sprint Cup champion Kevin Harvick wins the 2015 CampingWorld.com 500 at Phoenix International Raceway in his fourth straight win at the track, extending a streak of top-2 finishes dating back to last November. At 7 races, this is the longest such streak since Richard Petty's 11-race streak in 1975..

**Archived source account.** The race also features a top-5 finish for 2004 champion Kurt Busch in his first race after being suspended for three races on domestic abuse charges. Earlier in the week, a federal court declined to charge Busch with abuse of his ex-girlfriend occurring last September, leading to his reinstatement.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://espn.go.com/racing/nascar/cup/story/_/id/12490483/kevin-harvick-wins-fourth-straight-race-phoenix-rout>).

<a id="event-2015-03-20-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Biogen Idec Inc. reports that a drug in a phase II clinical research trial has achieved the first experimental demonstration of a statistically significant reduction in amyloid plaque as well as a slowing of clinical impairment in patients with Alzheimer's disease. The antibody drug, aducanumab, blocked beta amyloid formation, a protein that forms toxic brain-destroying plaques, and significantly slowed cognitive decline.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/03/20/us-biogen-alzheimers-idUSKBN0MG1OU20150320>).

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1100347637](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20March%2027&oldid=1100347637>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-03-27-0-1"></a>

Context: 2015 military intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** A Middle Eastern coalition led by the Saudi Arabian army and Egyptian navy attacks positions in Yemen for the second successive day, resulting in at least ten deaths in Saada Governorate. Saudi Arabia declares that it will enforce a "no-fly zone".

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/03/27/middleeast/yemen-saudi-arabia-airstrikes/index.html>).

<a id="event-2015-03-27-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Somalia.

**Archived source account.** Militants believed to be from al-Shabab attack and temporarily occupy a Mogadishu hotel leaving at least nine people dead.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/b0340e6250a74dec805196c70501b044/gunfire-blast-militants-attack-hotel-somali-capital>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-03-27-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A stampede at a Hindu festival in Langalbandh, Bangladesh, kills at least ten people with dozens more injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Bangla News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150328232209/http://www.en.banglanews24.com/fullnews/bn/108611.html>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/cb48134524b74d09bbe65d8c9ccddb9e/police-say-10-dead-stampede-bangladesh>).

<a id="event-2015-03-27-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Power returns to Amsterdam after a 5-hour blackout that caused the closure of Amsterdam Airport Schiphol and disrupted public transport networks throughout the Netherlands.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/reuters/article-3014341/Amsterdam-surroundings-hit-power-grid-outage.html>).

<a id="event-2015-03-27-1-3"></a>

Context: Germanwings Flight 9525.

**Archived source account.** Investigators, searching one of the two residences of the co-pilot Andreas Lubitz, find a torn doctor's note granting Lubitz medical leave—deeming him unfit for work—for a period including the day of the crash.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/03/27/europe/france-germanwings-plane-crash-main/index.html>).

<a id="event-2015-03-27-1-4"></a>

Context: Germanwings Flight 9525.

**Archived source account.** In imitation of current U.S. policy, Lufthansa, together with other German airlines announce plans to mandate that two people (either two pilots or a pilot and a flight attendant) must be inside the cockpit at all times.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/03/27/europe/france-germanwings-plane-crash-main/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-03-27-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A jury in the U.S. state of California votes for the defendant in a sexual discrimination case brought by Ellen Pao against Silicon Valley venture capital firm Kleiner Perkins Caufield &amp; Byers.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/business/technology/la-fi-tn-ellen-pao-loses-kleiner-perkins-20150325-story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-03-27-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Italy's highest court acquits American Amanda Knox and Italian Raffaele Sollecito of the murder of Briton Meredith Kercher.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-32096621>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-03-27-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. Senate Minority Leader Harry Reid (D-Nevada) announces he will not seek re-election to the United States Senate and intends to retire at the end of his term in January 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/03/27/politics/harry-reid-retiring-announcement-2016/index.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-03-27-4-1"></a>

Context: Soyuz TMA-16M.

**Archived source account.** Soyuz TMA-16M launches carrying three crew members to the International Space Station. Russian cosmonaut Mikhail Korniyenko and American astronaut Scott Kelly begin a special year-long mission to test the effects of long-term habitation on the human body under conditions of micro gravity and radiation.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/russian-soyuz-spacecraft-russian-us-astronauts-blasts-off-200655593.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Germanwings Flight 9525.

<a id="event-2015-03-28-1-2"></a>

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-03-28-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Congolese bar owner whom Amanda Knox falsely accused of killing Meredith Kercher criticises a lack of justice in the surprise decision by Italy to quash her conviction yesterday, citing diplomatic pressure coupled with Knox's wealth and status as American, as opposed to his being African.

Source citations (as archived): [Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2015/mar/28/amanda-knox-free-rich-american-patrick-lumumba-meredith-kercher-murder>).

<a id="event-2015-03-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Nigerian general election, 2015.

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-03-28-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In association football, Russia, recovering after Friday's abandoned Euro 2016 qualifier in Montenegro, press for UEFA to award them victory. Among the injured were goalkeeper Igor Akinfeev, knocked out of the game in the first minute, concussed and nursing a neck injury after a flare struck him in the head; Dmitri Kombarov, struck by another object; Alan Dzagoev, struck by projectiles while being treated for another injury.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/football/2015/mar/28/russia-demand-victory-abandoned-match-montenegro>).

### 2015-03-29

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-32103971>).

Meade, Maryland, base perimeter guards shoot and kill one person and injure another person as two men attempt to crash the entrance gate with their vehicle. The incident also injures a guard. #### International relations

<a id="event-2015-04-02-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China files a protest after two American jet fighters landed on April 1 at an air base in Taiwan.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150414014325/https://au.news.yahoo.com/world/a/26923712/china-objects-after-us-fighter-planes-land-in-taiwan/>); [Reuters](<https://news.yahoo.com/china-angered-u-fighter-jets-land-taiwan-090328736.html>).

<a id="event-2015-04-02-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran, the United States, the United Kingdom, France, Russia, People's Republic of China, Germany, and the European Union (the P5+1) reach a breakthrough agreement on the general framework for an agreement on Iran's nuclear program, but sign no verbal agreement or official document. The deadline for a full deal is June 30, 2015.

<a id="event-2015-04-02-4-1"></a>

Context: Indiana Senate Bill 101.

**Archived source account.** A Christian-owned Indiana pizza shop closes its doors after receiving death and arson threats in response to the restaurant's saying it would not cater a same-sex wedding; the owners are afraid they may close permanently or leave town.

**Archived source account.** A GoFundMe page gets over US$50,000 from supporters.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/morning-mix/wp/2015/04/02/indianas-memories-pizza-wouldnt-cater-gay-wedding-gets-40k-in-crowdfunding/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-04-05-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Swedish Prime Minister Stefan Löfven says that neither he nor any other of his cabinet-level ministers will be attending the 70th anniversary of the end of World War II in Moscow due to Russia's actions in Ukraine. Sweden joins a large group of European countries unofficially boycotting the May 9th Victory Day parade.

Source citations (as archived): [The Local](<http://www.thelocal.se/20150405/swedish-ministers-to-forego-russian-party>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/asia/china/11516700/Giant-pandas-in-China-set-record-for-longest-recorded-sex-session.html>); [The Straits Times](<http://www.straitstimes.com/news/asia/east-asia/story/pandas-breaks-record-mating-session-18-minutes-broadcast-online-20150405>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-04-06-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Indonesian court rejects Andrew Chan's and Myuran Sukumaran's appeal against the President of Indonesia Joko Widodo's refusal to grant them clemency against the death penalty as organisers of the Bali Nine plot to smuggle heroin to Australia in 2005.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/gul-ahmad-saeed-accused-killing-14-pakistan-over-marriage-wrangle-n336381>).

Source citations (as archived): [CNN Money](<http://money.cnn.com/2015/04/06/media/phi-kappa-psi-rolling-stone-legal-action/index.html>).

**Archived source account.** In basketball, Dick Bavetta, John Calipari, Spencer Haywood, Lisa Leslie, Dikembe Mutombo and Jo Jo White are announced as 2015 inductees to the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame. <a id="event-2015-04-28-4-2"></a>

Context: In Major League Baseball, the Baltimore Orioles announce several changes to their upcoming schedule due to the riots in the city:.

**Editorial account; source review partial.** MLB described the crowdless game as unprecedented.

Editorial date: 2015-04-28. Checked: 2026-10-22. Announcement timing and both postponements need separate corroboration here.

Evidence: [MLB](<https://www.mlb.com/news/anthony-castrovince-mlb-game-without-crowd-also-without-precedent/c-121075114>).

Original source account: After having two home games at Camden Yards with the Chicago White Sox postponed, the Orioles announce that the teams will play their April 29 game there with no fans allowed to attend. This is the first time in MLB history that a game has been held behind closed doors.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2015-04-28-4-3"></a>

Context: In Major League Baseball, the Baltimore Orioles announce several changes to their upcoming schedule due to the riots in the city:.

**Editorial account; source review complete.** The postponed games were rescheduled for a May 28 doubleheader.

Editorial date: 2015-04-28. Checked: 2026-10-22. Schedule confirmed.

Evidence: [Baltimore Orioles / MLB](<https://www.mlb.com/news/tomorrows-orioles-white-sox-game-at-205-pm-et-and-be-closed-to-the-public/c-121044106>).

Original source account: The two postponed games will be made up as a doubleheader on May 28.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2015-04-28-4-4"></a>

Context: In Major League Baseball, the Baltimore Orioles announce several changes to their upcoming schedule due to the riots in the city:.

**Editorial account; source review complete.** The Orioles retained home-team status at Tropicana Field.

Editorial date: 2015-04-28. Checked: 2026-10-22. Relocation confirmed.

Evidence: [MLB](<https://www.mlb.com/news/orioles-to-be-home-team-at-tropicana-field-as-series-vs-rays-relocates/c-121046530>).

Original source account: The Orioles' upcoming weekend series against the Tampa Bay Rays, scheduled for Camden Yards, will instead be played at the Rays' home of Tropicana Field. The Orioles will be the designated home team for scoring purposes.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2015-05-02-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** New research has suggested lung cancer patients could benefit from the use of statin drugs. Dr. Chris Cardwell, Ph.D., and researchers at Queens University Belfast in Northern Ireland found lung cancer patients who used statins within a year of diagnosis had a reduced risk of death from the disease, the American Association for Cancer Research reported. To make their finding, the research team looked at data on about 14,000 patients who were newly diagnosed with lung cancer between the years of 1998 and 2009 and were a part of the English cancer registry.

<a id="event-2015-05-03-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Preventive medicine researchers from Harvard University and Northwestern University conduct a study on long-term (13 years; 793 people) pre-cancer changes (mostly leukemia, prostate cancer, lung cancers, and skin cancers) in telomeres, the protective ends of DNA. Some said, in previous short-look studies, that focused mostly on their known role in the pace of regular aging, that they either got shorter or longer. There was a 3-4 year period of accelerated aging, and then it halted a few years before cancer was diagnosed.

Source citations (as archived): [Medical News Today](<http://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/293339.php>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-05-03-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Curtis Culwell Center attack: Two gunmen attacked the Curtis Culwell Center in the US city of Garland, Texas, which is holding an exhibition of drawings of the Prophet Muhammad. Both gunman were shot dead by police. Their car was found to contain no explosives. One security guard was hospitalized and is expected to recover. The attacks were reminiscent of the Charlie Hebdo shootings in Paris in January 2015. ISIL claimed responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS Dallas Fort Worth](<http://dfw.cbslocal.com/2015/05/03/breaking-shooting-in-garland/>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/05/04/us/garland-mohammed-drawing-contest-shooting/>).

### 2015-05-04

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-05-04-0-1"></a>

Context: Curtis Culwell Center attack.

**Archived source account.** One of the two attackers, Elton Simpson, had linked himself to ISIL on Twitter before his attack on the exhibition of drawings of the prophet Mohammed at the Curtis Culwell Center in Garland, Texas. He had been a member of a since-closed Phoenix mosque; he and his partner, 34-year-old Nadir Hamid Soofi, who had gone to college in Utah, had been known to and were investigated by law enforcement, but nevertheless, officers did not know that they were planning an imminent attack of this type, and they were not thought to be an imminent threat, despite having admired the late Anwar al-Awlaki, and swearing loyalty to Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi, prominent figures in al-Qaeda in Iraq and in ISIL, respectively.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/05/04/us/garland-mohammed-drawing-contest-shooting/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-05-10-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The President of Cuba, Raul Castro, is received in an official private audience with Pope Francis, who will become the third Pope to visit the still officially Communist island before visiting the U.S. this October. Some restrictions on exercise of religion, and a few restrictions on other rights, have been lifted or relaxed, especially after Pope John Paul II's historic 1998 meeting with Fidel Castro, Pope Emeritus Benedict XVI's trip during his reign, and especially in 2014 and earlier this year, after Raul and Francis and U.S. President Barack Obama's diplomatic team dramatically improved U.S.-Cuba relations. President Castro went there to thank Francis, whom he publicly has stated his admiration for, for his efforts, and spoke of the possibility of converting and of officially restoring the Church.

Source citations (as archived): [Holy See Press Office](<http://www.microsofttranslator.com/BV.aspx?ref=IE8Activity&amp;a=http%3A%2F%2Fpress.vatican.va%2Fcontent%2Fsalastampa%2Fit%2Fbollettino%2Fpubblico%2F2015%2F05%2F10%2F0353%2F00780.html>).

### 2015-05-22

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-05-22-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant captures the border crossing at Al Waleed (al-Tanf in Syria), the last remaining border crossing between Syria and Iraq controlled by the Government of Syria. <a id="event-2015-05-22-0-3"></a>

Context: Mexican Drug War.

**Archived source account.** At least 42 members of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel and two Federal Police officers are killed in a shootout in the state of Michoacán. The death toll is preliminary and is expected to rise.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/05/23/us-mexico-violence-idUSKBN0O729M20150523?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>).

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150522201803/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/london-homes-near-wembley-evacuated-after-wwii-bomb-is-found/ar-BBk6YAV>).

<a id="event-2015-05-22-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Myanmar Navy rescues two boats carrying 208 migrants as it faces growing international pressure to tackle the Rohingya migration crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/05/burundi-refugees-cholera-epidemic-worsening-150522110614073.html>).

**Archived source account.** Voters in Ireland go to the polls to vote on constitutional referendums, including one that would allow same-sex marriage.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-32835572>).

<a id="event-2015-05-22-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate passes legislation to allow President Barack Obama to fast track trade negotiations with other countries. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://abcnews.go.com/Politics/wireStory/senate-approves-obamas-hard-fought-trade-negotiating-bill-31247978>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2015-05-22-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Science publishes a series of papers on biodiversity in the deep sea, including tens of thousands of single-celled organisms most of which had not been previously identified.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-32831814>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-05-22-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In cricket, Pakistan plays a Twenty20 match against Zimbabwe at Lahore. This is the first time a test playing nation toured Pakistan for a cricket match since the 2009 attack on the Sri Lanka national cricket team.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) issues a mandate that all artificial trans fatty acids (trans fats) must be eliminated within three years (2018) from all foods grown, imported to, or sold within the United States. It is the strictest and most final type of ruling, even more so than a black-box warning or a warning to list ingredients, that can be given from the federal agency, which has ultimate jurisdiction over the safety of all food and drug products, public or private, in the United States. The substances occur in processed meats and other foods, and have been repeatedly implicated in atherosclerotic coronary heart disease, diabetes, and some cancers.,,,

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150618181858/http://www.msn.com/en-us/foodanddrink/foodnews/fda-bans-artificial-trans-fats-in-united-states-food-supply/ar-BBldG5q?ocid=ansfoodDailyMeal11>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/to-your-health/wp/2015/06/16/the-100-year-old-scientist-who-pushed-the-fda-to-ban-artificial-trans-fat/>); [CNN Money](<http://money.cnn.com/2015/06/16/news/companies/fda-artificial-trans-fats-ban/index.html>); [FDA's statement](<http://www.fda.gov/NewsEvents/Newsroom/PressAnnouncements/ucm451237.htm>).

**Editorial account; source review partial.** Indonesia officially set the first Ramadan fasting day as June 18, 2015.

Evidence: [Indonesian Cabinet Secretariat](<https://setkab.go.id/en/hilal-not-be-seen-government-assign-the-beginning-of-ramadhan-fell-on-thursday/>).

Original source account: Muslims begin fasting at the start of the lunar calendar month of Ramadan, 2015.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

Evidence: [Associated Press via Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/6/23/kurdish-forces-capture-isil-base-near-syrias-raqqa>).

Original source account: The Kurdish People's Protection Units (YPG) capture the military base Brigade 93 and enter the town of Ayn Issa, the first defense line of ISIL north of its de facto capital al-Raqqah.

<a id="event-2015-06-27-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis, in an Apostolic Letter, done "Motu Proprio" (Latin: "On his own initiative"), creates the Secretariat for Communications, the second such Secretariat he has created, after the earlier Secretariat for the Economy, as part of a reform of the Roman Curia (Secretariats are the highest level of Curial dicastery, or department). It will incorporate Vatican Information Service (VIS), the News.va and Pope apps, the Vatican Television Center, the Vatican.va website and.va domain name, the L'Osservatore Romano newspaper, the Holy See Press Office, Vatican Radio, and the Pontifical Council for Social Communications. ### 2015-07-01

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-07-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Shells fired by Houthi forces have killed at least 18 people near the southern port city of Aden, meanwhile United Nations officials have warned that a deadly dengue fever outbreak is rapidly gaining pace in the war-torn country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/07/01/us-yemen-security-idUSKCN0PB54N20150701?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=worldNews>).

Context: Sinai insurgency: July 2015 Sinai attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/ISIS-suicide-bombers-attack-army-checkpoints-in-Egypt-60-killed/articleshow/47896781.cms>); [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/M/ML_EGYPT_THE_LATEST?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

The group were among "the most dangerous terrorists" wanted in Egypt according to Giza deputy security director Magdy Abd El-Aal. It has also been reported that Nasser al-Hafi, a former MP and a leading lawyer for the Muslim Brotherhood was among those killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Ahram](<http://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/64/134288/Egypt/Politics-/Egypts-security-forces-kill-nine-terrorists-during.aspx>).

### 2015-07-06

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-07-06-0-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** An Iraqi Air Force Sukhoi Su-25 jet, returning from a bombing raid against ISIL militants in the north, accidentally drops a bomb on Baghdad destroying several homes and killing at least 7 civilians. American officials claimed that as many as 65% of Iraqi air force bombers do not drop their bombs due to "lack of targets".

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1514106/iraqi-warplane-accidentally-bombs-baghdad>).

<a id="event-2015-07-06-0-3"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-33408473>).

<a id="event-2015-07-06-0-5"></a>

On the final lap, a major crash sent Austin Dillon into the catch fence in front of the grandstands, causing minor injuries to five fans. Dillon himself walked away unhurt.

Source citations (as archived): [News24](<http://www.news24.com/sport24/OtherSport/TourdeFrance/Horror-crash-mars-Tour-de-France-Stage-3-20150706>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/cycling/33416098>).

Evidence: [Dong-A Ilbo](<https://www.donga.com/en/article/all/20150815/411279/1>).

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

Of particular concern is Tampa Bay, which has had historic rainfall in late July and early August.,

In addition, Hurricane Jimena, which is expected to intensify to near category 5 strength on Saturday, is trailing Ignacio and also heading toward Hawaii.,,,

Source citations (as archived): [Hawaii News Now](<http://www.hawaiinewsnow.com/story/29912019/gov-ige-signs-emergency-proclamation-as-hurricane-ignacio-tracks-toward-state>); [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/hawaii-awaits-hurricane-while-still-recovering-from-rain/2015/08/28/6ecb56b6-4df7-11e5-80c2-106ea7fb80d4_story.html>); [Maui Now](<http://mauinow.com/2015/08/28/hurricanes-ignacio-jimena-expected-to-strengthen/>); [The Honolulu Star-Advertiser](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150828024040/http://www.staradvertiser.com/news/breaking/20150824_Kilo_Loke_moving_into_Northwest_Hawaiian_Islands.html?id=322716741>).

### 2015-09-03

<a id="event-2015-09-03-0-2"></a>

Nearby fisherman rescue 19 people with more than 40 missing. The Malaysian Maritime Enforcement Agency states that the boat was taking migrant workers home to Tanjung Balai in Indonesia's Sumatra province for the Hari Raya Haji celebration.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2015/09/03/malaysia-boat-capsized-idINKCN0R30CX20150903>); [The NY Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/news/world/boat-100-migrants-capsizes-malaysia-dead-article-1.2347017>); [Malaysian Star](<http://www.thestar.com.my/News/Nation/2015/09/04/40-Indonesians-missing-at-sea-Boat-ferrying-illegal-immigrants-home-capsizes-off-Sabak-Bernam/>).

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<http://mobile.nytimes.com/aponline/2015/09/03/world/americas/ap-lt-guatemala-political-crisis.html?referrer=>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-34147891>).

**Archived source account.** Kim Davis, the Rowan County, Kentucky, clerk, is jailed for contempt of court for continuing to refuse, on grounds of religious freedom, to issue marriage licenses to same-sex couples per U.S. District Judge David Bunning's August 12, 2015, order. The deputy clerks are ordered to issue these licenses.,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/09/03/us-usa-gaymarriage-kentucky-idUSKCN0R13S220150903>); [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/09/04/us/kim-davis-same-sex-marriage.html>).

She is accused of exposing herself to children and is charged with two misdemeanor counts of indecent exposure involving children under age 13.,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/2015/09/16/former-star-trek-voyager-actress-charged-with-indecent-exposure-in-tennessee>); [Huffington Post](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/jennifer-lien-indecent-exposure_55f95acbe4b0e333e54be09d>).

The judge rules that Brady had been given no notice that ball deflation would result in a suspension. The NFL announces that they will appeal the ruling.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/447fd7860e6b4d148130e7dce66c53c3/judge-lets-brady-play-ruling-against-nfl-deflategate>); [ESPN](<http://espn.go.com/boston/nfl/story/_/id/13570716/tom-brady-new-england-patriots-wins-appeal-nfl-deflategate>).
