Context: Guatemalan general election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Guatemala go to the polls for a general election. The presidential election appears headed for a runoff.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted2.ap.org/APDEFAULT/3d281c11a96b4ad082fe88aa0db04305/Article_2015-09-07-LT--Guatemala-Election/id-f6a2029375f34a898cb28bf2f9ddce75>).

<a id="event-2015-09-06-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thailand's National Reform Council (NRC) rejects a controversial new constitution, 135 to 105, with 7 abstentions. This result dissolves the NRC, continues military rule for at least 7 months, and delays the scheduled January 2016 referendum to early 2017 or later. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [AsiaOne](<http://news.asiaone.com/news/asia/thai-council-rejects-proposed-constitution#sthash.hEeIlde7.dpuf>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-34149523>).

### 2015-09-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076186961](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20September%207&oldid=1076186961>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-09-07-0-1"></a>

Context: Turkey–PKK conflict.

**Archived source account.** Turkish jets strike PKK militant positions across south-east Turkey and northern Iraq and deploy special forces to the Iraqi border following a deadly PKK attack which left at least 16 Turkish soldiers dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/09/07/us-mideast-crisis-turkey-kurds-idUSKCN0R70BG20150907>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-09-07-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The patent office in India rejects Pfizer's petition for a patent on an arthritis drug, tofacitinib, re-affirming their rejection of the same drug in 2011. The drug is a chemical reformulation of the active compound in the medicine and thus the Indian Patent Office says that the company would have to establish that the compound for which it is seeking a patent is therapeutically more effective than the active compound.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/09/07/us-pfizer-india-patent-idUSKCN0R70UF20150907>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-09-07-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed as a small plane crashes in western Colorado.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<http://www.coloradoan.com/story/news/local/colorado/2015/09/07/plane-wreck-colorado-mountains/71840768/?hootPostID=641b61fcfc0935b2118fdeb5ddc9466d>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-09-07-3-1"></a>

Context: European refugee crisis.

**Archived source account.** The President of France François Hollande agrees to take 24,000 refugees out of the estimated 100,000 per month expected to arrive.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/latest-germany-budgets-66-billion-support-migrants-33578643>).

<a id="event-2015-09-07-3-2"></a>

Context: European refugee crisis.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of people, tired of waiting for promised transportation, broke out from Hungary's first migrant holding center near the Serbian border, past police overwhelmed by their numbers, to start the march north toward Budapest. The asylum seekers / migrants, now accompanied by groups of police, advanced along the edge of the main highway to the capital.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://globalnews.ca/news/2206924/migrants-break-through-hungary-police-lines-near-serb-border/>).

<a id="event-2015-09-07-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom House of Commons passes a bill to conduct a planned referendum on the United Kingdom's continued membership in the European Union.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/reuters/article-3225784/UK-lawmakers-pass-EU-referendum-legislation-upper-house.html>).

#### Law and Crime

<a id="event-2015-09-07-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Just before the Brooklyn, New York West Indian J'ouvert Labor Day Carnival, lawyer Carey Gabay is shot in the head and critically wounded, caught in crossfire between feuding gangs. Two others are wounded in shootings and one man is stabbed to death.,

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/Politics/gov-andrew-cuomos-1st-deputy-counsel-shot-brooklyn/story?id=33583786>); [Breitbart](<http://www.breitbart.com/big-government/2015/09/07/shootings-stabbings-leave-1-dead-4-wounded-in-annual-brooklyn-jouvert-festival/>).

<a id="event-2015-09-07-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Cass County, Missouri, a family of four is fired upon after they passed a slower vehicle, which then pulls up alongside and opens fire, hitting the father and a 2-year-old girl. Police believe the motive may have been road rage after flashing headlights.

Source citations (as archived): [KCTV5](<http://www.kctv5.com/story/29973972/father-young-child-injured-in-cass-county-highway-shooting>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-09-07-5-1"></a>

Context: Trinidad and Tobago general election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Trinidad and Tobago go to the polls for a House of Representatives election with the People's National Movement led by Keith Rowley returning to power.,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/09/07/us-trinidadtobago-election-idUSKCN0R70BV20150907>); [Miami Herald](<http://www.miamiherald.com/news/nation-world/world/americas/article34422543.html>).

<a id="event-2015-09-07-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** During U.S. Labor Day holiday activities in Boston, President Barack Obama announces a new executive order requiring federal government contractors to offer workers seven days of paid sick leave per year. On July 1st, Massachusetts became the third state, Connecticut and California being the others, with similar requirements.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-politics/wp/2015/09/07/in-boston-speech-obama-to-unveil-executive-order-for-more-paid-sick-leave/>); [Huffington Post](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/2014/11/04/massachusetts-sick-leave_n_6096580.html>).

<a id="event-2015-09-07-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** In an education scandal in Egypt, a top student, Mariam Malak, says she's a victim of corruption and fraud with the school or the examination board purposefully swapping her final exam papers with another pupil, while she is thus assigned "Zero"-grade for each of the seven subjects. 40,000 online rally for her via a Facebook support page while another top student reporting the same complaint.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/blogs-trending-34151528>).

<a id="event-2015-09-07-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hungary's Defense Minister Csaba Hende resigns amid the refugee crisis. Prime Minister Viktor Orbán immediately replaced Hende with a member of his Fidesz party, István Simicskó.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/09/07/Hungarys-defense-minister-resigns-amid-refugee-crisis/3421441648409/?spt=hts&amp;or=1>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-09-07-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bolide or meteor fireball explodes over the Thai city of Bangkok.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/asia/thailand/11848168/Mysterious-fireball-caught-on-camera-blazing-over-Bangkok.html>).

### 2015-09-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076186900](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20September%208&oldid=1076186900>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-09-08-0-1"></a>

Context: Turkey–PKK conflict.

**Archived source account.** Turkey bombs PKK sites in northern Iraq after a bombing yesterday in Hakkâri Province that killed at least 16 soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34183797>).

<a id="event-2015-09-08-0-2"></a>

Context: Turkey–PKK conflict.

**Archived source account.** A PKK bombing attack on a minibus in the eastern Iğdır Province near the Armenian border kills 14 Turkish police officers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/09/08/uk-mideast-crisis-turkey-pkk-idUKKCN0R80GE20150908>).

<a id="event-2015-09-08-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** U.K. Prime Minister David Cameron confirms that two ISIS militants, UK citizens, Reyaad Khan and Ruhul Amin, were killed in Syria when a British drone attack hit their car on August 21, 2015. Both Khan and Amin had appeared in an ISIS recruitment video last year. They are alleged to have been plotting a terrorist attack on the UK.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-wales-34183320>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/sep/07/british-isis-militants-killed-raf-drone-strike-syria-reyaad-khan-ruhul-amin>).

<a id="event-2015-09-08-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian government calls off airstrikes against rebel fighters due to a sandstorm affecting large parts of the Middle East.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/M/ML_MIDEAST_WEATHER?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

<a id="event-2015-09-08-0-7"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** The UN announces that it has grave concerns for around 96,000 children in Al Hudaydah, Yemen, who are starving due to the nearby fighting.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera English Online](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/09/100000-children-starving-yemen-al-hodeidah-150908191310445.html>).

<a id="event-2015-09-08-0-8"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** A Saudi-led air raid on Yemen's Al Hudaydah port reportedly kills 20 Indian nationals involved in oil smuggling.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/20-Indians-killed-in-Saudi-led-air-strike-in-Yemen-MEA-ascertaining-reports/articleshow/48874286.cms?>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-09-08-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** New Zealand temporarily bans the sale or lending of the book Into the River by Ted Dawe, pending a review which could see the book restricted long-term. This is the first time in 22 years that a book has been restricted to this extent in New Zealand.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/sep/07/new-zealand-bans-into-the-river-teenage-novel-outcry-christian-group>); [Radio New Zealand Online](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/news/national/283651/school-librarians-nonplussed-by-ban>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-09-08-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** German airline Lufthansa cancels 84 long-haul flights as pilots go on strike over a proposed restructure plan.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-09-07/lufthansa-truce-ends-as-pilot-strike-to-hit-key-long-haul-routes>).

<a id="event-2015-09-08-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jeff Smisek resigns as CEO of United Airlines due to allegations that he tried to improperly influence officials at the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/united-continental-ceo-jeff-smisek-departs-1441746428?mod=djemalertNEWS>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-09-08-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A massive sandstorm hits Lebanon and Syria as well as Jordan, Israel and Egypt. The Lebanese Health Ministry said the storm caused the deaths of two women, and sent hundreds to hospitals with breathing difficulties. Particularly hard hit were the 1.1 million Syrian refugees in Lebanon, many in flimsy tents in informal campsites.

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Eye](<http://www.middleeasteye.net/news/sandstorm-sweeping-middle-east-kills-two-lebanon-389450909#sthash.meKtY1pB.dpuf>); [AP](<http://www.ctvnews.ca/world/unseasonal-sandstorm-hits-lebanon-syria-1.2552302>); [Al Jazeera English Online](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/09/sandstorm-envelops-lebanon-syria-150908095341326.html>).

<a id="event-2015-09-08-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The VU University Medical Center in Amsterdam is fully evacuated after parts of the hospital were flooded because of a burst in a major water-pipeline.

Source citations (as archived): [DutchNews](<http://www.dutchnews.nl/news/archives/2015/09/burst-water-main-brings-chaos-to-amsterdam-zuid/>).

<a id="event-2015-09-08-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** British Airways Flight 2276, a Boeing 777 aircraft, suffers an uncontained engine failure and fire on take-off from McCarran International Airport, Las Vegas, Nevada, United States. Fourteen of the 172 on board are injured and taken to a nearby hospital.,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-34193767>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/business/travel/british-airways-jet-catches-fire-las-vegas-airport-14-injured-n423831>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-09-08-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** North and South Korea are to hold reunions for families divided by the Korean War from October 20 to October 26.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2015/sep/7/north-korea-south-korea-hold-reunions-war-divided-/>).

<a id="event-2015-09-08-4-2"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Sigmar Gabriel, the Vice Chancellor of Germany, says that Germany "can take 500,000 asylum seekers a year" while calling on other nations to take their fair share.

Source citations (as archived): [" (BBC)](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34185353#>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-09-08-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** During protests over a lack of mining jobs in South Africa's Limpopo province, demonstrators destroy 21 buses, a police station, and a municipal office as well as blocking roads from Lephalale to Marapong.

Source citations (as archived): [ENCA](<http://www.enca.com/south-africa/21-buses-police-station-torched-limpopo-chaos-escalates>).

<a id="event-2015-09-08-5-2"></a>

Context: Death of Freddie Gray.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. city of Baltimore, Maryland, agrees to a $6.4 million settlement with relatives over the death of Freddie Gray.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://news.yahoo.com/freddie-grays-family-settles-city-6-4m-145735914.html>).

<a id="event-2015-09-08-5-4"></a>

Context: Miller v. Davis.

**Archived source account.** Kim Davis, the county clerk of Rowan County in the U.S. state of Kentucky, is released from jail on contempt of court charges but she may not interfere with her deputy clerks issuing marriage certificates to same sex couples.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! politics](<https://www.yahoo.com/politics/huckabee-christie-cruz-weigh-in-on-kim-davis-128638521231.html>).

<a id="event-2015-09-08-5-6"></a>

Context: Matrimonial nullity trial reforms of Pope Francis.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34185559>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-09-08-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Shinzo Abe, the Prime Minister of Japan, is reelected (unopposed) President of the Liberal Democratic Party.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2015/09/07/world/asia/ap-as-japan-politics.html>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2015-09-08-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In football, Wayne Rooney becomes the highest goalscorer for the England national football team with a goal against Switzerland in a UEFA Euro 2016 qualifying match.

Source citations (as archived): [ITV](<http://www.itv.com/news/update/2015-09-08/wayne-rooney-breaks-england-goalscoring-record/>).

<a id="event-2015-09-08-7-1"></a>

**Editorial account; source review partial.** AFF reports the Malaysia-Saudi Arabia qualifier was abandoned on September 8 after crowd disorder, shortly before full time.

Editorial date: 2015-09-08. Checked: 2026-10-22. The federation reports the September 8 abandonment and crowd disorder. The opened passage does not explicitly identify the 2018 tournament cycle; that detail remains unverified in this scoped assessment.

Evidence: [ASEAN Football Federation](<https://www.aseanfootball.org/v3/malaysia-world-cup-qualifier-abandoned-officials/>).

Original source account: The 2018 FIFA World Cup qualifier between Malaysia and Saudi Arabia was abandoned due to crowd trouble just before full time. \{\{cn\|date=September 2015\}\}

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Syrian Civil War, Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant.

Context: 2015 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** In Japan, tens of thousands are forced to evacuate due to flooding and landslides caused by Tropical Storm Etau. So far, one person is reported as missing.,,,

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-09-10-5-1"></a>

Context: Homo naledi.

**Archived source account.** Elife publishes a discovery by scientists at the University of the Witwatersrand announcing a new species of hominid (Homo naledi) in the Rising Star Cave in South Africa. Although the remains have yet to be properly dated, they could be three million years old.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-34192447>); [Al Jazeera English Online](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/09/long-lost-relative-researchers-find-human-species-150910090000956.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Cross-Strait relations.

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-09-11-2-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** At least three people die, 27 are injured, and 26 people are missing, the majority of them in and around Jōsō city in Ibaraki Prefecture, as a result of floods and landslides in Japan after heavy rainfall caused by Tropical Storm Etau.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/09/11/weather-japan-floods-idUSL4N11H0FG20150911>); [The Independent-UK](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/asia/japan-floods-three-dead-and-dozens-missing-in-typhoon-etau-aftermath-10496069.html>).

Context: Incidents during the Hajj / Mecca crane collapse.

**Archived source account.** Strong winds cause a construction crane collapse at the Masjid al-Haram mosque killing 107 people and injuring 283 others. Most of the people killed were on the annual Islamic hajj (pilgrimage) to Mecca.,,,

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<http://www.rt.com/news/315082-crane-collapses-mecca-mosque/>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2015/09/11/many-deaths-reported-crane-collapse-meccas-grand-mosque/72069206/>); [AFP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-09-12/deaths-as-crane-crashes-into-meccas-grand-mosque/6770382>); [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-3231117/At-62-people-dead-crane-collapses-Grand-Mosque-Mecca.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-09-11-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The UN General Assembly votes in favor of flying the flags of non-member observer states outside the headquarters in New York City. Palestine will raise their flag on September 30, while Vatican City has made no plans yet.

<a id="event-2015-09-11-3-2"></a>

Context: United States–Cuban Thaw.

**Archived source account.** Cuba announces it will release more than 3,500 prisoners in a goodwill gesture ahead of next week's visit by Pope Francis.

Context: European migrant crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34216883>).

<a id="event-2015-09-11-4-0"></a>

Zubaydah has yet to be charged with any crime despite being held since 2002.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/09/government-blocks-release-cia-torture-details-150910231447965.html>); [Newsweek](<http://www.newsweek.com/cia-torture-abu-zubaydah-guantanamo-bay-371072>).

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.france24.com/en/20150911-japan-charges-bitcoin-exchange-ceo-with-embezzlement-jiji-press?ns_campaign=reseaux_sociaux&amp;ns_source=twitter&amp;ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_linkname=editorial&amp;aef_campaign_ref=partage_aef&amp;aef_campaign_date=2015-09-11&amp;dlvrit=66745>).

Arizona Department of Public Safety confirm that a man is being questioned.,

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-09-13-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russian cosmonaut Gennady Padalka's return from the ISS on Saturday sets a new record for time in space, breaking the one fellow countryman Sergei Krikalev set in 2005. Padalka totaled 879 days in space (2.41 years) over five flights.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2015/09/12/439810644/russian-cosmonaut-returns-from-record-breaking-space-mission>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-09-13-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Doctors at Salamanca University Hospital in Salamanca, Spain implant a 3-D printing-produced artificial titanium sternum (breastbone), and a portion of the ribs (as opposed to the current standard, a non-customized, flat piece of titanium, which can loosen over time) in a patient who had numerous cancerous tumors in that area, the first use of 3D printing technology to take the place of these specific body parts.

Source citations (as archived): [Quartz,](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150914161606/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/technology/doctors-have-implanted-a-3d-printed-ribcage-in-an-actual-human-being/ar-AAebQoe?ocid=ansmsnnews11>).

Context: 2015 US Open (tennis).

**Archived source account.** In tennis, Novak Djokovic of Serbia defeats Roger Federer of Switzerland 3 sets to 1 in the final of the men's singles.,

Source citations (as archived): [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.com/us-open-mens-final-2015-start-time-tv-channel-live-stream-info-roger-federer-vs-novak-2094229>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/sport/live/2015/sep/13/us-open-2015-novak-djokovic-v-roger-federer-mens-singles-final-live>).

<a id="event-2015-09-13-5-2"></a>

The New Zealander becomes the youngest person of either sex to win a professional major championship, at age \{\{age in years and days\|1997\|4\|24\|2015\|9\|13\}\}.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/golf/34239452>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-09-14-6-0"></a>

**Editorial account; source review complete.** LIGO records a September 14, 2015 detection, announced with Virgo on February 11, 2016, as the first confirmed gravitational-wave observation from colliding black holes.

Editorial date: 2015-09-14. Checked: 2026-10-22. The later announcement date is retained explicitly. This is retrospective context, not a claim that the discovery was public on the archival date.

Evidence: [LIGO Scientific Collaboration](<https://ligo.org/detections/gw150914/>).

Original source account: The first direct observation of gravitational waves was made on 14 September 2015 and was announced by the LIGO and Virgo collaborations on 11 February 2016. This was also the first observation of a binary black hole merger.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-09-14-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Preventive Services Task Force issues a recommendation stating that, in consultation with their doctor and pharmacist, and provided the risk of gastrointestinal bleeding and the very rare risk of certain hemorrhagic strokes do not outweigh the benefits in individual cases, that people aged 50 to 70 (especially those aged 50-60 and with a 10 percent risk or higher of cardiovascular disease, or CVD; mindful that the risk of bleeding, which can be dangerous, goes up as one ages) should take low-dose aspirin, for a period of at least 10 years, for preventive benefits against CVD and heart attack, as well as colorectal cancer. The evidence is inconclusive for those not at very high risk who are over 70, and below 40, and there is only weak evidence for prevention of lung cancer, breast cancer, and prostate cancer.,

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. Preventive Services](<http://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/Page/Document/draft-recommendation-statement/aspirin-to-prevent-cardiovascular-disease-and-cancer>); [NY Times Blogs](<http://well.blogs.nytimes.com/2015/09/14/in-a-first-aspirin-is-recommended-to-fight-a-form-of-cancer/?_r=0>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Source citations (as archived): [The Express Tribune](<http://tribune.com.pk/story/959024/militants-attack-pakistan-air-force-base-in-peshawar/>); [Reuters](<http://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/2015/09/18/taliban-gunmen-kill-17-attack-pakistan-air-force-base>).

<a id="event-2015-09-18-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Secretary of State John Kerry agrees to begin military to military talks with Russia concerning Russia's military activities in Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/09/19/world/europe/us-to-begin-military-talks-with-russia-on-syria.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2015-09-18-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** At least 26 people are killed following Syrian Arab Air Force air-raids on the Islamic State-held central Syrian city of Palmyra according to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/09/18/uk-mideast-crisis-syria-palmyra-idUKKCN0RI2GK20150918>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-09-18-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** European communications company Altice announces plans to buy US cable television company Cablevision for $17.7 billion.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<http://kvcrnews.org/post/cablevision-5th-largest-us-cable-firm-be-sold-177-billion-deal#stream/0>).

<a id="event-2015-09-18-1-2"></a>

Context: Volkswagen emissions violations.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency orders Volkswagen to fix nearly 500,000 VW and Audi diesel cars from model years 2009-2015 that include software that circumvents EPA emissions standards. The company's illegal use of so-called "defeat devices" threaten public health, in some cases releasing 40 times the pollution standard of nitrogen oxide emissions. The company faces possible U.S. fines of up to $37,500 per vehicle for the violations which could total more than $18 billion.,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2015/09/18/epa-says-vw-intentionally-violates-clean-air-standards/>); [EPA](<http://yosemite.epa.gov/opa/admpress.nsf/d0cf6618525a9efb85257359003fb69d/dfc8e33b5ab162b985257ec40057813b!opendocument>).

<a id="event-2015-09-18-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** In India, about 2.3 million people respond to the state of Uttar Pradesh's announcement of 368 low-level government jobs openings that pay 16,000 rupees ($240) a month. At least 255 of the applicants had a doctorate and over 200,000 had master's degrees.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/A/AS_INDIA_JOB_CRUSH?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

#### Health

<a id="event-2015-09-18-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A national alert is issued in the United Kingdom about a strain of gonorrhea that is highly drug resistant after 15 cases are reported in northern England.

Source citations (as archived): [AAP](<http://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/2015/09/18/drug-resistant-gonorrhoea-outbreak-uk>).

<a id="event-2015-09-18-2-3"></a>

Context: Ebola virus epidemic in West Africa / Ebola virus cases in the United States.

**Archived source account.** United States authorities announce mandatory Ebola screening will end for travelers from Liberia to five U.S. airports, effective September 21, 2015. Screening of travelers from Sierra Leone and Guinea will continue.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/2015/09/18/ebola-travel-airport-screening-liberia-sierra-leone-guinea-customs-border-protection/72398942/>).

<a id="event-2015-09-18-3-0"></a>

Context: Cuba–United States relations.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2015/09/18/cuba-obama-trade-restrictions-removed/72390194/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/09/18/us-cuba-usa-trade-idUSKCN0RI1EF20150918>).

#### Law and Crime

<a id="event-2015-09-18-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Baby Doe, a toddler who was found washed ashore Deer Island in Massachusetts in a trash bag, is identified as Bella Bond.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/09/18/us/boston-baby-doe-identified/>).

<a id="event-2015-09-18-4-2"></a>

Context: Phoenix freeway shootings.

**Archived source account.** Governor of Arizona Doug Ducey states that 21-year-old Leslie Allen Merritt Jr. is ballistically linked to four incidents and arrested in Glendale, Arizona after a SWAT raid. Merritt was previously charged twice in 2013, the first for failing to stop at the scene of a damaged vehicle, and the second for assault and criminal damage. Police state that he is known to hold anti-government and anti-police views. He is charged with four counts each of aggravated assault, criminal damage, disorderly conduct, discharging a firearm within city limits, carrying out a drive-by shooting, and intentional acts of terrorism; and his bail is set at $1 million.,,,,,,,,

Source citations (as archived): [ABC15](<http://www.abc15.com/news/region-phoenix-metro/central-phoenix/ducey-freeway-shooting-suspect-in-custody>); [KOB](<http://www.kob.com/article/stories/s3910893.shtml#.VfzQ4orF-nA>); [HEAVY](<http://heavy.com/news/2015/09/leslie-allen-merritt-arizona-highway-shooter-shootings-suspect-charged-arrested-phoenix-highway-10-shootings-sniper-gunman-swat-domestic-terrorism-bullets-cars-trucks-dps-ducey/>); [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/man-released-questioning-phoenix-freeway-shootings-33864489>); [Q13FOX](<http://q13fox.com/2015/09/18/we-got-him-suspect-arrested-in-i-10-shootings-in-phoenix-governor-says/>); [AZ Central](<http://www.azcentral.com/story/news/local/phoenix/breaking/2015/09/18/doug-ducey-phoenix-freeway-shootings-suspect-custody/72439462/>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/09/19/us/phoenix-arizona-i-10-shootings-arrest/>); [Yahoo News](<https://news.yahoo.com/phoenix-freeway-shooting-suspect-im-wrong-guy-184734525.html#>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/arizona-freeway-shooting-suspect-leslie-allen-merritt-held-1-million-n430196>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-09-19-0-1"></a>

<a id="event-2015-09-19-0-3"></a>

<a id="event-2015-09-19-0-5"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.ocregister.com/articles/yemen-683685-sanaa-airstrikes.html>); [Xinhuanet](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2015-09/19/c_134640220.htm>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-09-19-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis departs from Rome to begin his Apostolic Visit to Cuba. Francis will then visit the US. In the US, he will address a joint session of Congress (the first by an incumbent Pope), meet with President Obama, canonize Junípero Serra, tour a prison and the World Trade Center site, hold Masses in New York, Washington, and Philadelphia, and preside over the World Meeting of Families in Philadelphia.,,

Source citations (as archived): [Vatican](<http://w2.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/events/event.dir.html/content/vaticanevents/it/2015/9/19/cubausaonu.html>); [USCCB](<http://www.usccb.org/about/leadership/holy-see/francis/papal-visit-2015/index.cfm>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/09/19/world/europe/pope-francis.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-09-19-4-1"></a>

Context: Japanese Self-Defense Forces.

**Archived source account.** Japan's upper chamber of Parliament approves controversial legislation, which the lower chamber passed in July, that expands the role of the Japanese Self-Defense Forces overseas.,

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/09/18/asia/japan-military-constitution/>); [Mainichi Daily News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20150922101042/http://mainichi.jp/english/english/newsselect/news/20150919p2g00m0dm001000c.html>).

<a id="event-2015-09-19-4-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis, Croatia–Hungary relations.

**Archived source account.** Hungarian security forces confiscate a Croatian train carrying 1000 migrants and disarm 40 Croatian police officers accompanying the migrants. Hungarian authorities repatriate the officers.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1555206/hungary-confiscates-croatian-migrant-train>).

<a id="event-2015-09-19-4-4"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis, Croatia–Hungary relations.

**Archived source account.** Croatian prime minister Zoran Milanović says Croatia will 'force' Hungary to accept migrants by sending them to the Hungarian border. Hungary responded angrily calling Milanović "pathetic" and accused Croatia of human smuggling.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-34302285>).

<a id="event-2015-09-19-4-5"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis, Croatia–Hungary relations.

**Archived source account.** Croatia allows some asylum seekers to move on past its borders into Hungary and Slovenia.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/17000-asylum-seekers-stranded-in-croatia-with-nowhere-to-go/2015/09/19/ad6aae52-5c94-11e5-8475-781cc9851652_story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-09-19-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Egypt's new Cabinet is sworn in before President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi, a week after the previous administration resigned following a corruption scandal, and a month before parliamentary elections. The 33-member body has 16 new ministers, including two women. Sherif Ismail, petroleum minister in the last cabinet, is the new prime minister.,

Source citations (as archived): [Egyptian Streets](<http://egyptianstreets.com/2015/09/19/egypts-new-government-announced-with-16-new-ministers/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/09/19/us-egypt-government-idUSKCN0RJ06P20150919>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-09-19-5-1"></a>

Context: 1Malaysia Development Berhad scandal.

**Archived source account.** The Federal Bureau of Investigation launches an investigation of money laundering associated with the 1Malaysia Development Berhad sovereign wealth fund.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/fbi-probes-malaysia-development-fund-1442694963?mod=djemalertAsianews>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-09-19-6-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Rugby World Cup.

**Archived source account.** In what media called "the greatest shock in rugby history", Japan defeat two-time World Cup champion South Africa 34–32 in Brighton.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN (UK)](<http://en.espn.co.uk/scrum/rugby/story/275293.html>).

<a id="event-2015-09-19-6-2"></a>

Context: 2015 Rugby World Cup.

**Archived source account.** In another result viewed as a surprise, Georgia defeat Tonga 17–10 in Gloucester. In the match, Georgia's 18-year-old Vasil Lobzhanidze becomes the youngest player ever to appear in a Rugby World Cup match.

Source citations (as archived): [PA](<http://en.espn.co.uk/scrum/rugby/story/275225.html>).

<a id="event-2015-09-20-1-2"></a>

He holds a meeting with Cuban President Raúl Castro, and meets for a talk and exchange of gifts with former Cuban President Fidel Castro.,,,

Context: European migrant crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [RTE](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2015/0920/729049-migrants/>); [AP](<http://www.wsbtv.com/news/ap/top-news/greek-coast-guard-searching-for-26-missing-migrant/nnjZ8/>).

Context: European migrant crisis.

<a id="event-2015-09-20-4-2"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/austria-11000-new-migrants-24-hours-crisis-roundup/>).

### 2015-09-21

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-09-21-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis, on the second day of his journey in Cuba, leaves Havana for Holguin. He says a Mass at Revolution Plaza, blesses Holguin from the Loma de la Cruz area, arrives in Santiago de Cuba, flies to Santiago de Cuba, meets with the Cuban Bishops at Saint Basil the Great Seminary, and says a prayer with them at the Minor Basilica of the Basílica Santuario Nacional de Nuestra Señora de la Caridad del Cobre (Shrine of Our Lady of del Cobre).

<a id="event-2015-09-21-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** French regulator Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés (CNIL) rejects Google, Inc.'s appeal of their order that the company remove 'Right to be forgotten (RTBF)' search results worldwide. Failure to comply could subject Google to sanctions, from €300,000 (US$460,000) to 5 percent of global operating costs.,

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2015/sep/21/french-google-right-to-be-forgotten-appeal>); [PC World](<http://www.pcworld.com/article/2984524/privacy/france-rejects-googles-appeal-on-right-to-be-forgotten.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-09-21-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Auckland, New Zealand, an extradition hearing for Kim Dotcom, former owner of a file sharing website, for alleged copyright infringement, racketeering, and money laundering begins, seeking to bring him to the U.S.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-34311267>).

<a id="event-2015-09-21-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least eight people are killed and 45 wounded in shootings over the weekend across Chicago.

<a id="event-2015-09-21-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Denver, Colorado federal jury convicts Harold Henthorn of murder in the death of his wife Toni Henthorn, who fell off a cliff as they hiked in Colorado's Rocky Mountain National Park to celebrate their wedding anniversary. His previous wife had also died in suspicious circumstances.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/35d1792a22ec497e98d9b44807708ea2/man-guilty-pushing-wife-colorado-cliff-her-death>).

<a id="event-2015-09-21-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Peanut Corporation of America owner Stewart Parnell is sentenced to 28 years for Salmonella typhimurium-tainted peanut butter, the most severe punishment ever handed out to a producer in a foodborne illness case. In late 2008 and early 2009, nine people died and at least 714 people in 46 states, half of them children, fell ill. Parnell and his brother were convicted in September 2014 of 71 criminal counts. His brother Michael Parnell is sentenced to 20 years, and the plant's former quality control manager Mary Wilkerson is sentenced to five years.,

Source citations (as archived): [LA Times](<http://www.latimes.com/nation/nationnow/la-na-nn-salmonella-sentence-20150921-story.html>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/money/business/2015/09/21/peanut-executive-salmonella-sentencing/72549166>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-09-22-1-1"></a>

Context: Pope Francis%27 visit to the United States.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis arrives in the U.S. from his last stop in Cuba, Santiago de Cuba, at Joint Base Andrews (formerly, Andrews Air Force Base), near Washington D.C., to start his first tour of the United States. He is received by U.S. President Barack Obama, his wife, U.S. First Lady Michelle Obama, Malia and Sasha Obama, Marian Lois Robinson, U.S. Vice President Joseph R. Biden, his wife, U.S. Second Lady Dr. Jill Biden, two Biden granddaughters, the Apostolic Nuncio to the U.S. Archbishop Carlo Maria Vigano, military and base leaders, and Washington's Cardinal Donald Wuerl. He will be received tomorrow morning in a second arrival ceremony, at the White House, and will meet with the President there.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2015/sep/22/pope-francis-journeys-to-washington-dc-to-begin-historic-us-visit-live-updates>).

**Archived source account.** The coup is reversed. Interim President Michel Kafando and interim Prime Minister Yacouba Isaac Zida are reinstalled, and government soldiers are returned to their stations. Coup leader Gen. Gilbert Diendéré apologizes for the coup and the week-long unrest that killed at least 10 people. The Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) suggests that elections, originally scheduled for Oct. 11, be held Nov. 22, and that candidate eligibility rules be more inclusive.,,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/africa/soldiers-leave-capital-burkina-faso-returns-to-calm/2015/09/24/fff67d9c-631d-11e5-8475-781cc9851652_story.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/09/24/us-burkina-army-president-idUSKCN0RN0U120150924>); [Big News Network](<http://www.bignewsnetwork.com/news/237041027/coup-reversal-restores-calm-in-burkina-faso>).

Pope Francis, who spent last week in the U.S., asked Archbishop Carlo Maria Viganò, the Apostolic Nuncio to the United States, to intercede with the governor and request she commute Glossip's sentence.,

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/09/30/us/oklahoma-richard-glossip-midazolam-execution/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/09/30/us-usa-execution-oklahoma-court-idUSKCN0RU2O520150930>).

<a id="event-2015-09-30-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mexican authorities arrest American Paul Erven Jackson for kidnapping and torturing two women in Oregon after more than 24 years on the run.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-34397267>).


## October

### 2015-10-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1146307013](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20October%201&oldid=1146307013>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Gaza–Israel conflict.

**Archived source account.** In retaliation for the rocket fired on the Israeli city of Ashdod, the Israeli Air Force carries out airstrikes on suspected Hamas positions in Gaza. No casualties are reported.

Source citations (as archived): [The News Hub](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160305204352/https://www.the-newshub.com/general/israeli-airplanes-bomb-gaza>).

<a id="event-2015-10-01-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021) / Battle of Kunduz.

**Archived source account.** The government of Afghanistan claims to have recaptured the city of Kunduz.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-10-01/afghan-forces-retake-kunduz-from-taliban-says-government/6820028>).

<a id="event-2015-10-01-0-5"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Taliban forces take over the Warduj District of the Badakhshan Province as government forces retreat.

Source citations (as archived): [WVTM](<http://www.wvtm13.com/national/officials-afghans-retake-kunduz-from-taliban/35591354>).

<a id="event-2015-10-01-0-6"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A C-130J transport aircraft crashes in eastern Afghanistan as it approaches the airport in Jalalabad killing at least 11 people on board. A U.S. military spokesman says there were no reports of enemy fire at the time.,,

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/10/deadly-military-plane-crashes-afghanistan-151001234453423.html>); [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/us-130-aircraft-crashes-afghanistan/story?id=34188200>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/02/us-afghanistan-usa-crash-idUSKCN0RV5V020151002>).

<a id="event-2015-10-01-0-9"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Russian intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Russian air-strikes reportedly kill U.S.-backed Syrian rebels as Russian jets bomb rebel positions in rural areas of northern Syria, including the town of Jisr al-Shughour, which is currently held by Islamist militant groups including Al-Qaeda's branch in Syria, the Al-Nusra Front.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/europe/russia/11903702/Russias-Vladimir-Putin-launches-strikes-in-Syria-on-Isil-to-US-anger-live-updates.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-01-0-10"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Russian intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Hezbollah fighters and newly arrived Iranian troops are reportedly preparing for a 'major ground offensive' in northern Syria, backed by Russian air-strikes.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/01/us-mideast-crisis-syria-iranians-exclusi-idUSKCN0RV4DN20151001>).

<a id="event-2015-10-01-0-11"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Russian intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Iraq's prime minister Haider al-Abadi endorses Russian air-strikes against ISIS forces in Iraq while expressing 'disappointment' with the U.S.-led coalition.

Source citations (as archived): [Times Live](<http://www.timeslive.co.za/world/2015/10/01/Iraqi-PM-prepared-to-consider-Russian-air-strikes-on-IS-in-Iraq>).

<a id="event-2015-10-01-0-14"></a>

Context: Turkey–PKK conflict / 2015 PKK rebellion.

**Archived source account.** Four Turkish soldiers are killed in PKK attacks across southeastern Turkey. Turkish authorities impose a curfew in the city of Mardin due to escalating violence.

Source citations (as archived): [Today's Zaman](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151008022951/http://www.todayszaman.com/latest-news_four-turkish-soldiers-killed-seven-wounded-in-pkk-attacks-curfew-imposed_400345.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-01-0-15"></a>

**Archived source account.** Chinese authorities arrest a suspect in yesterday's 17 Liucheng County mail bomb explosions that killed at least seven people and wounded more than 50. The suspect is identified as 33-year-old quarry-worker, Wei Yinyong, from Dapu township also in Guangxi Province. There is another explosion this morning. While it's not clear if it is connected, authorities reportedly located 60 packages yesterday which were being examined by a bomb squad.,,,

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/10/02/world/asia/china-liucheng-guangxi-explosions.html?_r=0>); [Asia One](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151004024506/http://news.asiaone.com/news/asia/suspect-arrested-guangxi-package-bomb-blasts>); [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151001215712/http://www.voanews.com/content/suspect-sought-in-china-parcel-bombings/2987091.html>); [Al Arabiya](<http://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/asia/2015/10/01/Fresh-blast-rocks-southern-Chinese-town.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-01-0-17"></a>

Context: 2015 Umpqua Community College shooting.

**Archived source account.** A mass shooting at Umpqua Community College in Roseburg, Oregon kills nine people and leaves seven wounded. The shooter commits suicide when confronted by the police. The man's motives are unknown.,,,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/01/us-usa-shooting-oregon-idUSKCN0RV5EP20151001>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/10/01/us/oregon-college-shooting/index.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-34436373>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/02/us-usa-shooting-oregon-idUSKCN0RV5EP20151002>).

<a id="event-2015-10-01-0-18"></a>

Context: 2015 Umpqua Community College shooting.

**Archived source account.** The shooter is identified as 26-year-old Chris Harper-Mercer.,

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/oregon-community-college-shooting-umpqua-community-college-roseburg/>); [Palm Beach Post](<http://www.palmbeachpost.com/ap/ap/top-news/the-latest-multiple-casualties-reported-in-oregon-/nnsGc/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-01-0-19"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Israeli couple are murdered in a shooting attack on their car in the northern West Bank; four of the couple's children are in the vehicle at the time but are not hit by the gunfire. Hamas praises the "heroic attack" and calls for "more high-quality attacks.",,,

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/two-seriously-wounded-in-west-bank-terror-attack/>); [Israel National News](<http://www.israelnationalnews.com/News/News.aspx/201319>); [Breaking Israel News](<http://www.breakingisraelnews.com/50148/parents-gunned-down-in-front-of-children-in-horrifying-palestinian-terror-attack-judea-and-samaria/#xfH5SccaFUxx9H9H.97>); [VOA News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151003150002/http://www.voanews.com/content/israeli-couple-fatally-shot-in-west-bank/2988384.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-01-0-21"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Government forces and the Southern Resistance backed by coalition forces wrest control of the strategic strait of Bab Al Mandab and a small Mayoun Island in the Red Sea from Houthi militants.,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2015/10/01/fighting-rages-in-yemen-near-bab-al-mandab-strategic-red-sea-shipping-strait/>); [Gulf News](<http://gulfnews.com/news/gulf/yemen/yemeni-forces-regain-control-over-strategic-bab-al-mandab-strait-1.1593596>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/10/hadi-loyalists-claim-capture-key-yemen-strait-151001131134976.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-01-0-23"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Five girl bombers attack the Nigerian city of Maiduguri with at least 14 people, including the girls, killed and 39 injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-34423311>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-10-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The UAW at Fiat Chrysler Automobiles reject a four-year contract, setting the stage for at least localized strikes against the automaker.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/01/us-autos-uaw-idUSKCN0RV54F20151001>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-10-01-2-2"></a>

Context: 2015 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Joaquin.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Joaquin becomes a Category 4 hurricane with maximum sustained winds of 130 mph. Some additional strengthening is possible tomorrow. The storm, moving at just 6 mph, is predicted to drop 10 to 15 inches of rain in the central Bahamas with up to five inches expected for the rest of the archipelago.,

Source citations (as archived): [Nassau Tribune](<http://www.tribune242.com/news/2015/oct/01/rising-floodwaters-trap-residents-southern-bahamas/>); [NHC](<http://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCPAT1+shtml/012045.shtml>).

<a id="event-2015-10-01-2-3"></a>

Context: 2015 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Joaquin.

**Archived source account.** Joaquin, expected to pick up forward speed when it turns north tomorrow, could hit the East Coast this weekend. While forecasts of the storm's trajectory are still uncertain, nearly every state from North Carolina to Connecticut is in the so-called "cone of uncertainty." North Carolina and New Jersey join Virginia in declaring states of emergency.,

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2015/10/01/Hurricane-Joaquin-extremely-dangerous-category-4-130-mph-winds/1881443689925/?spt=hts&amp;or=2>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/01/us-storm-joaquin-idUSKCN0RV3NW20151001>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-10-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The World Health Organization (WHO) recommends everyone diagnosed with HIV immediately receive antiretroviral therapy and recommends preventative treatment for all at "substantial risk" of infection. Previously, the UN health agency had recommended to physicians that the threshold for patient intervention was the presentation of symptoms.,,

Source citations (as archived): [The Verge](<https://www.theverge.com/2015/9/30/9423119/who-hiv-antiretroviral-treatment>); [Time](<http://time.com/4056153/hiv-treatment-aids-who-world-health-organization/>); [WHO](<http://www.who.int/mediacentre/news/releases/2015/hiv-treat-all-recommendation/en/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-10-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bahrain recalls its ambassador to Iran and expels the Iranian acting chargé d'affaires who is declared persona non-grata, a day after Bahraini security forces discovered a large bomb-making factory in Nuwaidrat and arrested a number of suspects linked to Iran's Revolutionary Guards. Bahrain's decision to recall its ambassador comes "in light of continued Iranian meddling in the affairs of the kingdom of Bahrain in order to create sectarian strife and impose hegemony and control.",

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Star](<https://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/Middle-East/2015/Oct-02/317348-bahrain-withdraws-ambassador-from-iran.ashx>); [Gulf News](<http://gulfnews.com/news/gulf/bahrain/bahrain-withdraws-ambassador-from-tehran-1.1593728>).

#### Transportation

<a id="event-2015-10-01-5-0"></a>

**Editorial account; source review complete.** SGTrains dates the first C751C North East Line passenger train to October 1, 2015 and identifies SBS Transit operation.

Editorial date: 2015-10-01. Checked: 2026-10-22. The class introduction refers to its first train, not every vehicle entering service simultaneously.

Evidence: [SGTrains](<https://www.sgtrains.com/train-c751c.html>).

Original source account: The Alstom Metropolis C751Cs entered service on the North East MRT line, operated by SBS Transit Ltd.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

### 2015-10-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1104626728](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20October%202&oldid=1104626728>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-02-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Russian intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Russian Government says Russian jets bombed Syria for the third consecutive day, hitting 12 Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) targets. The UK-based Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reports that ISIL has no presence in the western and northern areas struck though Al-Qaeda's Syrian affiliate al-Nusra Front does. Russian planes also bombed Raqqah, the unofficial capital of ISIL.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-3257288/Two-children-killed-latest-Russian-airstrikes-U-S-general-accuses-Moscow-dropping-CLUSTER-BOMBS-obliterate-areas-size-football-fields-civilians.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-02-0-3"></a>

Context: Turkey–PKK conflict.

**Archived source account.** At least 17 PKK militants are reportedly killed following a Turkish military operation in the Kurdish-majority city of Silvan.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/317341-turkish-army-police-silvan/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-02-0-5"></a>

Context: War in Donbass, 2014-15 Russian military intervention in Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** OSCE observers who are monitoring a ceasefire in eastern Ukraine between the Ukrainian military and pro-Russian rebels, reported the presence of a new Russian weapons system in rebel-held territory this week, the 'TOS-1 Buratino' is a thermobaric multiple rocket launcher system which can destroy several city blocks in one strike and cause indiscriminate damage. Only Russia produces the system and it was not exported to Ukraine before the conflict broke out.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/10/02/uk-ukraine-crisis-russia-idUKKCN0RW0UP20151002>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-10-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Air France KLM will cut 2,900 jobs after talks with pilots unions are unsuccessful.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-34425191>).

<a id="event-2015-10-02-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Google completes its reorganization into Alphabet Inc., becoming its leading subsidiary. Sundar Pichai becomes CEO of Google.

Source citations (as archived): [Investor Relations - Google](<https://investor.google.com/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-10-02-2-1"></a>

Context: Aviastar Flight 7503.

**Archived source account.** Indonesia's Aviastar airline loses contact with an aircraft between Masamba-Makassar carrying 10 people.

Source citations (as archived): [DailyMail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/reuters/article-3257418/Indonesias-Aviastar-airline-loses-contact-small-passenger-aircraft.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-02-2-3"></a>

Context: Hurricane Joaquin.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Coast Guard is searching for a 735-foot (224-meter) cargo ship named 'El Faro,' with 33 people on board, that went missing near Crooked Island in the Bahamas during Hurricane Joaquin. Five Poles and 28 Americans make up the crew.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/northamerica/usa/11909023/Hurricane-Joaquin-cargo-ship-with-33-crew-on-board-missing-near-the-eye-of-the-storm.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/03/us-storm-joaquin-idUSKCN0RV3NW20151003>).

<a id="event-2015-10-02-2-4"></a>

Context: Hurricane Joaquin.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Joaquin attacked The Bahamas as a Category 4 hurricane and destroyed houses, cut communications and electric power, uprooted trees, and unleashed heavy flooding. So far, there are no reports of fatalities or injuries. The storm, which weakened to Category 3 status with 125 mph sustained winds, is expected to dump up to 25 inches (63.5 centimeters) of rain in some location before it moves away from the islands.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151008002751/http://www.sacbee.com/news/nation-world/article37293927.html>); [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/hurricane-joaquin-upgraded-category-four-us-forecasters-181105118.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-02-2-5"></a>

Context: Hurricane Joaquin.

**Archived source account.** Joaquin is slowly moving on an east/northeast trek lowering the possibility of a direct hit to the U.S. East Coast. However, unrelated storms have already drenched the eastern seaboard this week. Streets were underwater up and down the coast at this afternoon's high tide. Adding Joaquin's wind and rain could create deadly, unprecedented downpours, flooding, wind damage, and power outages..

Source citations (as archived): [WorldNetDaily](<http://www.wnd.com/2015/10/joaquin-shifting-eastward-but-stay-on-guard/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/03/us-storm-joaquin-idUSKCN0RV3NW20151003>); [AP](<http://www.pressherald.com/2015/10/02/east-coast-braces-for-more-heavy-rain-potential-for-hurricane/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-02-2-7"></a>

Context: 2015 El Cambray Dos landslide.

**Archived source account.** A Guatemalan hillside, loosened by heavy rains, collapses and sends tons of dirt and trees onto Santa Catarina Pinula on the edge of Guatemala City, killing at least 56 with as many as 600 people missing.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/03/us-guatemala-mudslide-idUSKCN0RW1Q620151003>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-34431285>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-10-02-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 15-year old boy shoots and kills a civilian NSW Police employee outside the NSW Police headquarters in Parramatta, Sydney. The incident is labelled as a terrorist attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Telegraph](<http://www.dailytelegraph.com.au/news/parramatta-shooting-multiple-shots-fired-outside-police-hq-on-charles-street/story-fni0cx4q-1227554454582?sv=de59bf553bfbf0e202db38f4fc15b1aa>).

<a id="event-2015-10-02-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hackers steal the personal information of about 15 million T-Mobile US customers and applicants. The breach is at a unit of the credit agency Experian.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-34420879>).

<a id="event-2015-10-02-3-3"></a>

Context: 2015 FIFA corruption case.

**Archived source account.** Longtime FIFA corporate sponsors -- Coca-Cola Co., McDonald's, Visa Inc., and Budweiser owner Anheuser-Busch InBev -- demand FIFA President Sepp Blatter step down immediately following last week's announcement of his criminal investigation by the Swiss attorney general. Blatter refused.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/02/us-soccer-fifa-coca-cola-idUSKCN0RW27F20151002>); [Irish Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/world-news/europe/defiant-blatter-rejects-fifa-sponsors-calls-to-quit-31578785.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-03-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Foreign involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Obama Administration weighs the option of using military force to protect the U.S.-backed rebels fighting the Assad regime.

Instead, other Syrian rebel groups, including the Western-backed Free Syrian Army, have been attacked. "Our evidence indicates they are dropping unguided munitions in civilian areas, killing civilians," Fallon added.,

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

Source citations (as archived): [MSF](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151006230131/http://www.doctorswithoutborders.org/article/afghanistan-msf-demands-explanations-after-deadly-airstrikes-hit-hospital-kunduz>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/doctors-without-borders-airstrike-hits-afghan-hospital-killing-3-staffers/2015/10/03/2ed13104-b50a-48ec-9eb9-92db8ee3a876_story.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/03/us-afghanistan-attack-idUSKCN0RW0HC20151003>).

<a id="event-2015-10-03-0-6"></a>

Context: Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant.

**Archived source account.** ISIL claims responsibility for the killing of a 65-year-old Japanese citizen in Bangladesh. This attack comes after the recent murder of an Italian, Cesare Tavella, in Bangladesh, which was also claimed by ISIL.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<http://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/asia/2015/10/03/ISIS-claims-killing-of-Japanese-citizen-in-Bangladesh.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-10-03-1-1"></a>

Context: Hurricane Joaquin.

**Archived source account.** As Hurricane Joaquin, still a Category 3 storm, heads northeast, a Tropical Storm Warning and a Hurricane Watch are in effect for Bermuda. Winds will begin to strengthen early Saturday with thunderstorms and more significant showers around midnight. Joaquin should turn toward the north-northeast Sunday and pass around \{\{Convert\|125\|nmi\|abbr=off\}\} west of Bermuda that evening.,,

Source citations (as archived): [WCVB5 Boston](<http://www.wcvb.com/weather/joaquin-strengthens-becoming-an-extremely-dangerous-category-4-storm/35599732>); [NHC](<http://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCPAT1+shtml/030837.shtml?>); [Bermuda Royal Gazette](<http://www.royalgazette.com/article/20151002/NEWS/151009905>).

<a id="event-2015-10-03-1-2"></a>

Context: Hurricane Joaquin.

**Archived source account.** Joaquin's eastward turn away from the United States could send the storm across the Atlantic Ocean toward the United Kingdom. Current weather models predict Joaquin, powered by the jet stream, will reach the British Isles on the October 10th weekend.,

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-3258281/UK-braced-storms-Hurricane-Joaquin-makes-dramatic-turn-away-heads-Britain.html#ixzz3nVEARTJ2>); [Daily Express](<http://www.express.co.uk/news/weather/609309/Hurricane-Joaquin-Britain-storm-track-path-UK>).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-coventry-warwickshire-34436360>).
