Context: 2015 Rugby World Cup.

**Archived source account.** England becomes the first host nation and first former finalist to be knocked out of the Rugby World Cup during the group stages following their defeat to Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/0/rugby-union/34413339>).

### 2015-10-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1351971839](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20October%204&oldid=1351971839>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-04-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Stabbing attacks carried out by Palestinians in Jerusalem's Old City kill two Israeli civilians and injures three others. As a result, Israel bans Palestinians from entering the Old City for two days unless they live there.,,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-34435197>); [Yahoo News](<https://news.yahoo.com/israel-bars-palestinians-jerusalem-old-city-2-days-054647300.html#>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/10/04/middleeast/jerusalem-violence/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-04-0-3"></a>

Context: Turkey–PKK conflict.

**Archived source account.** Turkey's air force launches a new wave of air-raids bombing PKK positions in northern Iraq and southeastern Turkey. Turkish warplanes destroy PKK fuel and ammunition depots in the Hakkari province on the border with Iraq, as well as, in the eastern Kars province, according to a military statement.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/turkey-launches-overnight-air-raids-against-pkk-army-003648366.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-04-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian President Bashar al-Assad says reforms in Syria are unlikely until all of the government’s armed opponents are vanquished. The country will continue to send representatives to peace negotiations sponsored by Moscow, but rule out negotiations with the Western-backed groups opposing his government.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/assad-says-no-peace-settlement-until-war-against-terrorists-is-won/2015/10/04/2ec11b7c-6914-11e5-bdb6-6861f4521205_story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-04-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Destruction of cultural heritage by ISIL.

**Archived source account.** The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant destroys a 2,000-year-old Roman-era Triumphal arch in Palmyra according to Syria's antiquities chief.,

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/palmyra-isis-destroys-roman-triumphal-arch-in-ancient-syrian-city-a6679526.html>); [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/M/ML_SYRIA_ISLAMIC_STATE_DESTROYING_HERITAGE?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

<a id="event-2015-10-04-0-9"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** The death toll from Saturday's airstrikes on the Doctors Without Borders' hospital in Kunduz, Afghanistan rises to at least 10 patients and 12 hospital staff in Doctors Without Borders, also known as Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF). Doctors without Borders issues a statement expressing its "clear assumption that a war crime has been committed," and announces that all staff have left the hospital and the city.,

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/10/04/Doctors-Without-Borders-staff-leave-Kunduz-hospital-death-toll-rises/4711443970653/>); [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.com/afghanistan-kunduz-airstrikes-are-nato-admission-war-crime-22-die-airstrikes-doctors-2126801>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-10-04-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Heavy flooding along the French Riviera in the southeast of France killls at least 17 people with four more still missing. Rail, road, and air traffic are all suspended, and 27,000 homes are without electricity. A major stretch of the French Riviera has been declared a natural disaster zone. According to local radio station France Bleu-Azur, more than 17cm of rain fell on the Alpes-Maritimes region in two hours, the same amount the region would usually expect over two months.,,

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/12-dead-heavy-flooding-french-riviera-officials-021738690.html>); [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1563567/flash-floods-on-french-riviera-up-to-16-dead>); [Euro News](<http://www.euronews.com/2015/10/05/french-riviera-declared-disaster-zone-after-deadly-flash-floods/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-04-1-2"></a>

Context: October 2015 nor'easter.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Barack Obama declares a state of emergency for South Carolina, after the state receives over two feet of rain in some areas. More than 250 roads across the state close. A low pressure area funnels heavy tropical moisture into the region, as well as, pulls in Hurricane Joaquin-related precipitation.,

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/10/04/us/east-coast-rain-flood/>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/weather/stay-your-house-officials-warn-residents-during-unprecedented-1000-year-n438306>).

<a id="event-2015-10-04-1-3"></a>

Context: October 2015 nor'easter.

**Archived source account.** Rain and flooding are expected to persist along the east coast tonight. Two deaths are reported in North Carolina. New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware, and Virginia are under coastal flood warnings.

Source citations (as archived): [Sydney Tenplay](<http://tenplay.com.au/news/national/october/seven-people-have-died-in-us-storm>).

<a id="event-2015-10-04-1-6"></a>

Context: 2015 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Joaquin.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Coast Guard searchers, looking for the 790-foot El Faro cargo ship missing since Thursday, locate multiple objects, including life jackets, life rings, containers, and an oil sheen in the waters off The Bahamas. Connection to El Faro is not immediately confirmed.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2015/10/03/cargo-ship-hurricane-joaquin-missing-coast-guard/73279228/>); [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/debris-field-found-search-us-cargo-ship-el/story?id=34236660>).

<a id="event-2015-10-04-1-7"></a>

Context: 2015 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Joaquin.

**Archived source account.** Bermuda, which suffered a glancing hit by then-Category 2 Hurricane Joaquin, reports scattered power outages with heavy rain, high wind, and waves. The center of Joaquin, now a Category 1 hurricane (max winds 85 mph), is moving north-northeast, and will clear Bermuda sometime Monday.,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151007011614/http://www.clickorlando.com/weather/power-outages-reported-as-hurricane-joaquin-lashes-bermuda/35652596>); [NHC](<http://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCPAT1+shtml/050232.shtml>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-10-04-2-1"></a>

Context: Portuguese legislative election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Exit polls show Portugal’s center-right government, in its first contest since tough austerity measures were launched to combat a debt crisis, is headed for victory, but, could lose its majority in parliament.,,

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/oct/04/portugal-election-ruling-centre-right-coalition-headed-for-victory>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/04/us-portugal-election-idUSKCN0RY00520151004>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/finance/economics/11902641/The-forgotten-man-of-the-euro-Indebted-Portugal-set-to-beat-off-Socialists-and-stick-with-austerity.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-04-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Minsk, about 1,000 opposition activists protest Russia's plans to establish a military air base in Belarus, saying it would turn the former Soviet republic into a Kremlin "vassal" and add to regional tensions. Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko has refrained from commenting on the initiative to establish the base.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2015/10/04/about-1000-belarusian-protesters-decry-planned-russian-air-base/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-04-2-4"></a>

Context: Kyrgyzstani parliamentary election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Kyrgyzstan go to the polls with the Social Democratic Party of Kyrgyzstan winning the most votes which will lead to a pro-Russian coalition.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/kyrgyzstan-goes-polls-parliamentary-vote-034905972.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-10-04-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In horse racing, Golden Horn wins the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. Two-time winner Treve finishes fourth.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/horse-racing/34438255>).

### 2015-10-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076184656](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20October%205&oldid=1076184656>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-05-0-1"></a>

Context: Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War, Spillover of the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Turkey says a Russian warplane violated its airspace near the Syrian border, prompting the Turkish Air Force to scramble two F-16 fighter jets to intercept it. The Foreign Ministry summoned Russia's ambassador to protest the violation and urged Russia to avoid repeating such a violation, or it would be held "responsible for any undesired incident that may occur".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/05/us-mideast-crisis-syria-turkey-russia-idUSKCN0RZ0FT20151005?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>).

<a id="event-2015-10-05-0-3"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** Car-bombings across Iraq kill at least 57 people. The attacks include a rare bombing in the southern Basra province leaving 10 people dead. The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant is suspected of being behind the attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/10/05/uk-mideast-crisis-iraq-violence-idUKKCN0RZ1YU20151005>).

<a id="event-2015-10-05-0-5"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Fighting rages between Houthi militants and Hadi loyalists backed-by Saudi-led coalition forces along Yemen's Red Sea coast for control over the strategic Bab-el-Mandeb strait. Houthi officials say that their forces have destroyed six opposing tanks and killed multiple pro-Hadi fighters. Also, the UAE announces another of its soldiers has died during fighting in Ma'rib.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<http://www.businessinsider.com/ap-fighting-rages-on-yemens-red-sea-coast-2015-10?IR=T>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-10-05-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Clothing manufacturer and retailer American Apparel files for bankruptcy. The company says that its 200+ retail stores will continue to operate without any interruptions.,

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/10/06/business/american-apparel-files-for-bankruptcy.html?smid=tw-bna>); [Forbes](<https://www.forbes.com/sites/laurengensler/2015/10/05/american-apparel-bankruptcy/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-05-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The World Bank estimates that 9.6 percent of the world’s population is living in extreme poverty this year, down from 12.8% in 2012. The bank also updated its global poverty line from $1.25 per day to $1.90 per day to reflect inflation and changes in purchasing power around the world; it was last adjusted in 2008.,

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/4060895/world-bank-extreme-poverty/>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/society/2015/oct/05/world-bank-extreme-poverty-to-fall-below-10-of-world-population-for-first-time>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-10-05-2-1"></a>

Context: October 2015 nor'easter.

**Archived source account.** Additional search and rescue efforts take place in the American city of Columbia, South Carolina.,

Source citations (as archived): [AccuWeather](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151005191812/http://www.accuweather.com/en/weather-news/live-rain-lashes-eastern-us-ma/52740263>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2015/10/05/unrelenting-rains-hammer-besieged-south-carolina/73365878/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-05-2-2"></a>

Context: October 2015 nor'easter.

**Archived source account.** In South Carolina, the death toll rises to nine people in weather-related incidents with millions remaining homebound. Rain is forecast to continue with parts of the state dealing with flooding for some time.,

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/10/05/us/south-carolina-east-coast-rain-flood/>); [AP](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/south-carolina-flooding-9th-storm-related-death-reported/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-05-2-4"></a>

Context: Hurricane Joaquin.

**Archived source account.** The El Faro, missing since Thursday, is categorized as sunk with 33 people on board during Hurricane Joaquin after a debris field is found.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/el-faro-hunt-debris-field-found-after-ship-vanishes-storm-n438466?cid=eml_nbn_20151005>).

<a id="event-2015-10-05-2-7"></a>

Context: 2015 Pacific typhoon season / Typhoon Mujigae.

**Archived source account.** At least nine people are dead as Typhoon Mujigae hits southern China in the midst of the country's weeklong National Day holiday. Mujigae also generates several strong tornadoes and leaves dozens of fishermen missing. Nearly 200,000 people had been evacuated before the storm made landfall. Neighboring Guangxi Zhuang region orders 12,700 fishing boats and 35,400 offshore workers to return to port.,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/81f7ebb372e34ddf954e1c656e9cc6f3/typhoon-heads-south-china-tens-thousands-evacuated>); [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.com/typhoon-mujigae-kills-8-south-china-leaves-dozens-missing-2126345>).

<a id="event-2015-10-05-2-8"></a>

Context: 2015 Pacific typhoon season / Typhoon Mujigae.

**Archived source account.** Tropical Storm Kabayan (local name for then-Tropical Storm Mujigae) leaves at least two dead in the Philippines with two injured and 63 persons missing. The system intensified as it leaves the Philippine Area of Responsibility heading toward China.,

Source citations (as archived): [Manila Sun Star](<http://www.sunstar.com.ph/manila/local-news/2015/10/04/kabayan-claims-2-lives-433910>); [Philippine Star](<http://www.philstar.com/headlines/2015/10/04/1507068/storm-kabayan-leaves-two-dead>).

### 2015-10-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076184572](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20October%206&oldid=1076184572>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-06-0-1"></a>

Context: October 2015 Aden missile attack.

**Archived source account.** A hotel where Vice President of Yemen and Prime Minister Khaled Bahah was staying in Aden which was also being used as a de facto military base by Arab coalition forces is hit by multiple explosions killing at least 15 coalition soldiers. Although the Houthis were first suspected and accused of being behind the attack, the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant has since claimed responsibility, marking the first attack on Arab coalition forces in Yemen by the extremist group.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/10/06/middleeast/yemen-violence/index.html>); [Al-Arabiyah News](<http://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2015/10/06/Yemen-s-VP-hotel-residence-attacked.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-06-0-2"></a>

Context: October 2015 Aden missile attack.

**Archived source account.** In the Houthi-controlled Yemeni capital, Sanaa, at least seven people are killed following a suicide-bomb attack on the al-Nour mosque.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/10/06/uk-yemen-security-aden-hotel-idUKKCN0S009H20151006>).

<a id="event-2015-10-06-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** NATO Secretary-General Jens Stoltenberg says Russia's pair of violations of Turkish airspace over the weekend do not look like accidents. Russia, which said it's looking into claims of a second violation, reported the first violation lasted a few seconds and was due to poor weather.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34453739>).

<a id="event-2015-10-06-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Russian warplanes bomb Islamic State positions in the central Syrian city of Palmyra and in the northern Aleppo province, releasing videos that show them destroying 20 vehicles and 3 weapons depots.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/10/06/uk-mideast-crisis-syria-strikes-idUKKCN0S010U20151006>).

<a id="event-2015-10-06-0-6"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Turkey says its jets patrolling the Turkish-Syrian border were directly threatened by a Russian MiG-29 and later by an anti-aircraft missile system which locked-radar on the Turkish jets.

Source citations (as archived): [Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/russia-in-syria-russian-radar-locks-on-to-turkish-fighter-jets-as-moscow-steps-up-air-strikes-a6683766.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-06-0-8"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** Russia says it would consider extending its air-strikes against Islamic State militants in Syria to Iraq if it receives such a request from the Iraqi government. Iraqi President, Fuad Masum has recently said he would welcome this assistance.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/06/us-mideast-crisis-syria-russia-matviyenk-idUSKCN0S00UH20151006?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>).

<a id="event-2015-10-06-0-10"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** A Boko Haram attack near Lake Chad kills at least 11 Chadian troops while 17 Boko Haram militants are also reportedly killed in the fighting following the pre-dawn strike on Chadian army positions.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/11-chadian-soldiers-killed-boko-haram-attack-security-093058479.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-10-06-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Court of Justice decides an international agreement, generally known as a Safe Harbor rule, used by thousands of companies for moving people’s digital data between the European Union and the United States is invalid, effective immediately. The decision throws into doubt how global technology giants like Facebook, Amazon and Google can collect, manage, and analyze online information from their millions of users in the 28-member bloc. Decisions by this court, the highest legal authority in the EU, cannot be appealed.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/10/07/technology/european-union-us-data-collection.html?_r=0>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/tech/2015/10/05/european-privacy-ruling-could-hurt-us-companies/73422412/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-34442618>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/06/us-eu-ireland-privacy-idUSKCN0S00NT20151006>).

<a id="event-2015-10-06-2-1"></a>

Context: Typhoon Mujigae (2015).

**Archived source account.** Sixteen campers are missing in south China's Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region following a flash flood in a camping reserve.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2015-10/06/c_134687131.htm>).

<a id="event-2015-10-06-2-3"></a>

Context: October 2015 nor'easter, Hurricane Joaquin.

**Archived source account.** Thirteen people are reported to have died during this storm, 11 in South Carolina and two in North Carolina. At least 18 dams have breached or failed since Saturday. Communities downstream face a mass of water working its way toward the low-lying coast.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/10/06/us/south-carolina-flooding/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-06-2-4"></a>

Context: October 2015 nor'easter, Hurricane Joaquin.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151009081746/http://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/sunny-forecast-south-carolina-ordeal-34274872>).

Context: 2015 El Cambray Dos landslide.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from Thursday's landslide in the Guatemalan village of El Cambray Dos increased to 152 with more than 300 people missing. No survivors have been found at the site. Search crews have found entire families who died huddled together and buried alive. The Guatemala’s National Disaster Reduction Commission, known as the Conred, declared the area uninhabitable.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-34440822>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/06/us-guatemala-mudslide-idUSKCN0RZ2AV20151006>); [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2015/10/06/432210/Guatemala-mudslide-Alejandro-Maldonado-Guatemala-City->).

<a id="event-2015-10-07-0-1"></a>

Context: Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant.

**Archived source account.** An FBI investigation has reportedly found that criminal networks specializing in nuclear smuggling in Eastern Europe, particularly in the nation of Moldova, have shipped radioactive material to 'Middle Eastern extremists', including the Islamic State (which in the recent past has threatened to unleash a nuclear holocaust to 'wipe the West off the face of the Earth').

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/nuclear-smugglers-shopped-radioactive-material-to-isis-terrorists_561470c1e4b021e856d2cfa0>).

<a id="event-2015-10-07-0-3"></a>

Context: Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Russia launches an intense bombing campaign in the Syrian governorates of Idlib and Hama. The Syrian Army is conducting a ground offensive in the same area.,

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/Heavy-Russian-strikes-hit-western-Syria-421137>); [Reuters](<http://ca.reuters.com/article/topNews/idCAKCN0S10BI20151007>).

<a id="event-2015-10-07-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Four Russian warships launch at least 26 cruise missiles at ISIS positions in Syria from the Caspian Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/317864-russian-warships-missiles-launch/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-07-0-5"></a>

Context: Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Russian airstrikes destroy the main weapons depots of a U.S.-trained rebel group, Liwa Suqour al-Jabal, in Syria's Aleppo province. Last week, Russian raids hit Liwa sites in western and northern Syria, areas where the Islamic State group has no significant presence.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/07/us-mideast-crisis-syria-rebels-idUSKCN0S111020151007>).

<a id="event-2015-10-07-0-7"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Boko Haram suicide bombers kill at least 15 people at a mosque in the northeastern Nigerian city of Damaturu.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/A/AF_BOKO_HARAM?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

<a id="event-2015-10-07-0-9"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Médecins Sans Frontières (Doctors without Borders) calls for activating the International Humanitarian Fact-Finding Commission – for the first time since its 1991 creation under the Geneva Conventions – to investigate the deadly U.S. bombing of MSF's hospital in Kunduz, Afghanistan. MSF says it does not trust internal military inquiries into the bombing that killed at least 22 people, which it considers a war crime.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/07/us-afghanistan-attack-msf-idUSKCN0S10SX20151007>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-34463608>).

<a id="event-2015-10-07-0-10"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** United States President Barack Obama telephoned MSF International President Joanne Liu to apologize for the U.S. bombing of the hospital in Afghanistan, express his condolences for the 22 people killed, commit to provide a transparent, thorough, and objective accounting of the facts and circumstances of the incident, and implement any changes to make tragedies like this one less likely to occur in the future.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/07/us-afghanistan-attack-msf-idUSKCN0S10SX20151007>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-politics/wp/2015/10/07/obama-apologizes-for-afghan-hospital-bombing/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-07-0-12"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Saudi-led airstrikes kill at least 30 people and wound 25 others in the southwestern Yemeni town of Sanabani at a wedding hosted by a tribal leader known to support the Houthis.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151010113155/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/yemen-forces-capture-rebel-outpost-key-province-34318572>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/10/08/world/middleeast/yemen-airsrike-said-to-kill-23-at-a-wedding.html>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/10/08/middleeast/yemen-violence/index.html>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-10-07-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The World Health Organization announces that, since the Ebola outbreak began in March 2014, last week marked the first week of no new cases worldwide.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/4065010/ebola-free-world-west-africa/?xid=gonewsedit&amp;google_editors_picks=true>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-10-07-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The High Court of Australia rules that the breast cancer gene BRCA-1 cannot be patented and the patent claimed by Myriad Genetics is invalid.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-10-07/breast-cancer-gene-cant-be-patented-high-court-rules/6833232>).

<a id="event-2015-10-07-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** China's Central Commission for Discipline Inspection announces their investigation of Fujian governor Su Shulin, the former chairman of China Petroleum and Chemical Corporation, on suspicion of serious disciplinary violations, the "euphemism for corruption." This follows the massive anti-corruption drive Communist Party general secretary Xi Jinping launched when he came to power more than three years ago. Su is the first sitting governor investigated since the campaign began.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/reuters/article-3264310/China-investigates-former-Sinopec-chairman-discipline-violations.html>); [South China Morning Post](<http://www.scmp.com/news/china/policies-politics/article/1865108/fujian-governor-under-investigation-anti-corruption>).

<a id="event-2015-10-07-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brazil's Federal Accounts Court (TCU), in a unanimous 8-0 decision, rules that President Dilma Rousseff's government manipulated its accounts in 2014 to disguise a widening fiscal deficit. The ruling, while not legally binding, is expected to be used by opposition lawmakers who are calling for impeachment proceedings.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/08/us-brazil-rousseff-idUSKCN0S124S20151008>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/31d1b806ce4c4d37b443ee028f4fd7a4/brazil-court-discusses-alleged-govt-accounting-violations>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2015-10-07-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tomas Lindahl, Paul L. Modrich and Aziz Sancar win the 2015 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their work in DNA repair.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-34464580>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2015-10-07-4-1"></a>

Context: 2015 FIFA corruption case.

**Archived source account.** Fédération Internationale de Football Association ethics committee recommends FIFA President Sepp Blatter be suspended, re: the Swiss attorney general's ongoing criminal investigation. The final decision will be made by Chairman of the Ethics Committee's adjudication chamber, Hans-Joachim Eckert.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/34468663>); [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/sport/sportsnews/article-3263820/Sepp-Blatter-provisionally-suspended-90-days-FIFA-ethics-committee.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-07-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Chicago Cubs beat the Pittsburgh Pirates 4-0 in the MLB National League Wild Card Game.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://espn.go.com/blog/chicago/cubs/post/_/id/34938/jake-arrieta-goes-the-distance-as-cubs-advance-to-nlds>).

### 2015-10-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076184450](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20October%208&oldid=1076184450>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-08-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present), Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Government forces and their allies, including troops from a Saudi Arabian-led coalition, capture the town of Sirwah, the last outpost of Houthi militants in the key Marib province.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/latest-news/yemen-forces-capture-last-rebel-outpost/story-fn3dxix6-1227561743328>).

<a id="event-2015-10-08-0-2"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present), Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Yemeni military forces backed by Houthi militants reportedly destroy a Saudi warship off the coast of Yemen in the strategic Bab-el-Mandeb strait.

Source citations (as archived): [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2015/10/07/432453/Yemen-Saudi-Ansarullah-warship-Taizz-Jizan-Hadi-UN>); [Fars News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151012224912/http://english.farsnews.com/newstext.aspx?nn=13940716000270>); [Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/saudi-led-air-strikes-kill-15-civilians-at-yemen-wedding-a6685586.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-08-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Foreign involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia and other Gulf Arab states are reportedly 'stepping up' arms supplies to at least three Syrian rebel groups in response to the recent Russian intervention in the civil war.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-34479929>).

<a id="event-2015-10-08-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Foreign involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian troops and allied militia backed by a fresh wave of Russian airstrikes and naval cruise missiles attacked rebel forces as the government extended an offensive to recapture territory in central and northwestern Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/09/us-mideast-crisis-syria-idUSKCN0S20J920151009>); [The Moscow Times](<http://www.themoscowtimes.com/opinion/news/article/syrian-general-says-russian-strikes-aid-ground-offensive/537926.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-08-0-6"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Foreign involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** At least four Russian cruise missiles fired at Syria from the Caspian Sea landed in Iran, according to US officials. Damage or casualties are not yet known. Russia and Iran rejected these reports.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/10/08/politics/russian-missiles-syria-landed-iran/index.html>); [Reuters](<http://www.albawaba.com/news/russian-missiles-aimed-syria-crash-iran-752700>).

<a id="event-2015-10-08-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Foreign involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Secretary General Jens Stoltenberg says NATO will double its high-readiness force to 40,000, and may send ground troops to Turkey as a result of the escalation of Russian military activities in Syria, including violations of Turkish airspace.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/news/world/europe/nato-to-double-force-after-russian-activity-in-syria-1.2384539>); [Hindustan Times](<http://www.hindustantimes.com/world/nato-prepared-to-send-troops-to-turkey-after-airspace-violations/story-mneT0ruNMmJn3dVfbMSzwM.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-10-08-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Belarusian author and journalist Svetlana Alexievich wins the 2015 Nobel Prize in Literature.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/books/live/2015/oct/08/nobel-prize-in-literature-follow-it-live>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-10-08-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fiat Chrysler Automobiles (FCA) and the United Auto Workers (UAW) reach a new tentative four-year labor agreement, averting a threatened strike of the automaker’s U.S. operations. The agreement must be ratified by a vote of FCA's 40,000 U.S. union workers, who rejected the previous proposal earlier this month. If ratified, the UAW intends to use the pact as a template for negotiations with General Motors Co. and Ford Motor Company.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/08/us-autos-uaw-idUSKCN0S11LV20151008>); [Detroit Free Press](<http://www.freep.com/story/money/cars/chrysler/2015/10/08/uaw-strike-2015-fca/73550246/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-10-08-3-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people are evacuated on the Japanese island of Hokkaido as Typhoon Choi-wan approaches from the east.

Source citations (as archived): [AAP](<http://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/2015/10/08/thousands-ordered-evacuate-japan>).

<a id="event-2015-10-08-3-3"></a>

Context: 2015 Southeast Asian haze.

**Archived source account.** The President of Indonesia Joko Widodo announces that he will seek help from other nations in putting out illegally lit forest fires that have caused the haze.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel News Asia](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/singapore/indonesian-president-asks/2177806.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-08-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ecuador's restive Cotopaxi volcano erupts.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2015/10/08/new-bursts-ash-and-gas-rise-from-ecuador-cotopaxi-volcano/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-10-08-4-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu prohibits all members of the Knesset (MKs) from visiting the Jerusalem site revered by Jews as the Temple Mount, and by Muslims as the Noble Sanctuary, in an attempt to calm several days of violence in the Old City. The prohibition applies to both Jewish and Muslim parliamentarians.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/religion/netanyahu-prohibits-israeli-parliament-from-visiting-temple-mount/2015/10/08/b78a915c-6df8-11e5-91eb-27ad15c2b723_story.html>); [Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Arab-Israeli-Conflict/Netanyahu-bars-Jewish-MKs-ministers-from-visiting-Temple-Mount-421247>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-10-08-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Spencer Stone, one of the individuals involved in stopping the gunman in the August 2015 Thalys train attack, is stabbed in downtown Sacramento. Police said the incident is not related to a terrorist act; the assault occurred near a bar. He is in stable condition at a hospital with what are believed to be non-life threatening wounds.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151010204457/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/us-hero-of-french-train-attack-stabbed-in-calif/ar-AAfexfe?li=AAa0dzB&amp;ocid=iehp>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-10-08-6-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The German state of Bavaria plans "emergency measures" in response to the migrant crisis, including deporting migrants back to Austria and closing the border. An estimated 225,000 migrants have arrived in the southern German state in less than five weeks.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo](<https://news.yahoo.com/bavaria-wants-send-refugees-back-austria-merkel-says-165617068.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-08-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. House Majority Leader Kevin McCarthy, who had been the favorite to replace outgoing House Speaker John Boehner, withdraws from the race.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2015/10/08/mccarthy-withdraws/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-10-08-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2015 FIFA corruption case: FIFA suspends Sepp Blatter, Michel Platini and Jérôme Valcke from all football-related activities for 90 days amid allegations of corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/0/football/34474231>).

### 2015-10-09

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1250276302](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20October%209&oldid=1250276302>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-09-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Battle of Aleppo (2012–2016).

**Archived source account.** Iranian state television says Revolutionary Guard brigadier general, Hossein Hamadani, has been killed on the outskirts of Syria's Aleppo by Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant militants. This is the latest in a string of high-ranking Iranian commanders killed in Iraq and Syria in the last six months.

Source citations (as archived): [Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/iranian-commander-brigadier-general-hossein-hamedani-killed-by-isis-while-advising-syrian-regime-a6687276.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-09-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Battle of Aleppo (2012–2016).

**Archived source account.** Islamic State militants launch an offensive north of Aleppo, seizing several rebel-held villages, as well as the strategic former Syrian Army base known as the 'Infantry Academy'.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2015/oct/9/islamic-state-group-seizes-syrian-villages-north-a/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-09-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Battle of Aleppo (2012–2016).

**Archived source account.** United Nations condemns the killing of Anadolu Agency Turkish photojournalist Saleh Mahmoud Laila in Thursday's ISIS suicide attack at a marketplace in Huraytan, north of Aleppo.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Sabah](<http://www.dailysabah.com/syrian-crisis/2015/10/09/un-condemns-killing-of-anadolu-agency-journalist-by-isis-bomb-attack-in-syria>); [Novinite](<http://www.novinite.com/articles/171245/Turkey%E2%80%99s+Anadolu+Agency+Photojournalist+Killed+in+Syria>).

<a id="event-2015-10-09-0-6"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Foreign involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** United States suspends its 500 million dollar Syrian rebel training program. The new strategy will shift toward supplying military aid "to a select group of vetted leaders and their units so that over time they can make a concerted push into territory still controlled by ISIL," a U.S. official said.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/10/09/politics/us-syria-rebels-arms-program-suspended/>); [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/pentagon-end-training-syrian-rebels-large-groups/story?id=34365905>).

<a id="event-2015-10-09-0-8"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Hamas' leader in Gaza, Ismail Haniyeh, declares an "Intifada" against Israel in the West Bank and says, "Gaza will fulfil its role in the Jerusalem intifada and it is more than ready for confrontation" with Israel. Over 20 stabbing attacks have happened in the last 24 hours in Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/middleeast/israel/11923095/Islamist-group-Hamas-calls-for-another-intifada-as-violence-spreads-to-Gaza-Strip.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/oct/09/hamas-leader-gaza-declares-intifada-deadly-attacks-continue>).

<a id="event-2015-10-09-0-9"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** An Israeli stabs and injures two Bedouin Arabs and two Palestinians in the southern city of Dimona. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu "strongly condemned the harming of innocent Arabs."

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/the-latest-israel-sets-age-limit-on-jerusalem-holy-site/2015/10/09/1d74107a-6e52-11e5-91eb-27ad15c2b723_story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-09-0-10"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israel Defense Forces kill six Palestinian protesters and wound 60 at the Gaza Strip border, according to Gaza medics. The protesters attempted to destroy the "border" fence between Gaza and Israel and IDF soldiers "responded with fire on the main instigators in order to prevent them progressing and to disperse the riot," according to the IDF.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2015/10/09/israel-palestinians-idINKCN0S319W20151009>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/10/09/middleeast/israeli-palestinian-violence/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-09-0-11"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Riyad Mansour, Palestinian ambassador to the UN, urges Security Council President Román Oyarzun to hold an emergency meeting on the latest tensions with Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151014172028/http://www.whdh.com/story/30222598/the-latest-palestinian-envoy-to-un-wants-emergency-meeting>).

<a id="event-2015-10-09-0-13"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** Iraqi police officials say at least 35 people have been killed following a mortar bombardment of villages near the eastern city of Baqubah, capital of the Diyala Governorate. Officials did not speculate on who may be responsible for the attack, however the Islamic State group has claimed responsibility for several recent attacks in the volatile province.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151010171948/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/iraq-officials-mortar-attack-diyala-province-kills-35-34362160>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-10-09-1-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Mina stampede.

**Archived source account.** A new tally by the Associated Press places the death count from the Mina stampede at 1,453 killed making it the deadliest disaster ever to occur during the Hajj.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151011182843/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/ap-exclusive-saudi-hajj-disaster-deadliest-to-ever-strike/ar-AAfh9z3?li=AAa0dzB&amp;ocid=iehp>).

<a id="event-2015-10-09-1-3"></a>

Context: 2015 Guatemala landslide.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the landslides in Guatemala rises to 253 with 374 people still missing.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.theage.com.au/world/death-toll-from-massive-landslide-in-guatemala-rises-to-253-hundreds-more-still-missing-20151009-gk5uh7.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-10-09-2-1"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations envoy for Libya, Bernardino León, proposes a government of national unity for Libya led by Fayez Sarraj as Prime Minister.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-34483137>).

<a id="event-2015-10-09-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Australia is to send refugees from Nauru and Manus Island to the Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [Sydney Morning Herald](<http://m.smh.com.au/federal-politics/political-news/coalition-government-in-talks-to-resettle-refugees-in-the-philippines-20151008-gk4u5m.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-09-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Tunisian National Dialogue Quartet wins the 2015 Nobel Peace Prize for its "decisive contribution to the building of a pluralistic democracy in Tunisia in the wake of the Jasmine Revolution of 2011." The Tunisian General Labour Union (UGTT), the Tunisian Confederation of Industry, Trade and Handicrafts (UTICA), the Tunisian Human Rights League (LTDH), and the Tunisian Order of Lawyers comprise the quartet.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34485865>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/10/09/world/nobel-peace-prize/index.html>); [Nobel Peace Prize](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151222204725/http://nobelpeaceprize.org/en_GB/laureates/laureates-2015/announce-2015/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-09-2-5"></a>

Context: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea.

**Archived source account.** China says it will "not stand for violations of its territorial waters in the name of freedom of navigation", following a statement from a Pentagon official, that the U.S. may consider sailing warships close to China's disputed artificial islands in the South China Sea within the next two weeks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/09/us-china-usa-southchinasea-idUSKCN0S30ND20151009>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-10-09-3-1"></a>

Context: School shootings.

**Archived source account.** One student is killed and three others wounded during an early morning shooting in a Northern Arizona University dorm in Flagstaff, Arizona. The suspected shooter was taken into custody.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/news/crime/1-dead-dorm-shooting-northern-arizona-university-article-1.2391149>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2015/10/09/447112533/shooting-at-northern-arizona-university-campus-1-dead-3-injured>).

<a id="event-2015-10-09-3-2"></a>

Context: School shootings.

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and another wounded, with a person in custody, in a shooting at an apartment complex near the Texas Southern University campus in southeast Houston, Texas. This is the second shooting involving TSU this week. A man is in serious, but stable, condition after being shot on the campus's Tiger Walk on Tuesday.

Source citations (as archived): [Houston Chronicle](<http://www.chron.com/houston/article/2-reportedly-shot-near-TSU-6561321.php>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/09/us-usa-shooting-texas-idUSKCN0S322O20151009>).

<a id="event-2015-10-09-3-3"></a>

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-10-09-4-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The southern German state of Bavaria threatens to take the Federal German government to court if it fails to take immediate steps to limit the flow of migrants to Germany. Over 200,000 migrants are estimated to have entered Germany since the beginning of September, the vast majority over the Austrian border into Bavaria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/10/09/uk-europe-migrants-germany-idUKKCN0S31I220151009>).

### 2015-10-10

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087275703](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20October%2010&oldid=1087275703>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-10-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Palestinian militants fire 3 rockets into Israel during the night after several violent riots throughout Israel and the West Bank.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-34493674>).

<a id="event-2015-10-10-0-2"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israeli security forces shoot dead two Palestinians aged 12 and 15 in protests along Gaza's border fence.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/10/us-israel-palestinians-idUSKCN0S319U20151010>).

<a id="event-2015-10-10-0-3"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from Friday's violence at the Gaza Strip border is now seven Palestinians. Of the 60 wounded, 10 were seriously injured. Massive riots managed to breach the border fence and enter Israeli territory and were dispersed by live fire.

Source citations (as archived): [Ynet News](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4708980,00.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-10-0-5"></a>

Context: 2015 Ankara bombings.

**Archived source account.** Twin bomb blasts in the Turkish capital Ankara near the main train station leave at least 97 people dead and over 400 wounded. The bombing occurred during a peace rally protesting the conflict between Turkey and the militant Kurdish PKK.,,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34495161>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/10/10/middleeast/turkey-ankara-bomb-blast/index.html?eref=edition>); [Sky News Australia](<http://www.skynews.com.au/news/top-stories/2015/10/10/twin-explosions-hit-rally-in-turkish-capital.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-10-0-7"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Five suicide bombers target a village in Chad that is home to thousands of Nigerian refugees who have fled Boko Haram, killing at least 36 people.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted2.ap.org/APDEFAULT/3d281c11a96b4ad082fe88aa0db04305/Article_2015-10-10-AF--Chad-Attacks/id-340b31ad2a5849128067ea04e9ffeb0c>).

<a id="event-2015-10-10-0-9"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Department of Defense will make payments to families of victims of last week's U.S. airstrike that struck a Médecins Sans Frontières (Doctors Without Borders) hospital in the Afghan city of Kunduz. At least 22 people were killed including 12 staff members and 10 patients, including three children. MSF says 33 people are still missing and presumed to have died in the fire.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/10/us-afghanistan-attack-msf-payments-idUSKCN0S40Y720151010>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/military/defense-dept-make-payments-after-strike-doctors-without-borders-hospital-n442296>); [AFP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-10-09/33-still-missing-after-kunduz-air-strike/6841734>).

<a id="event-2015-10-10-0-11"></a>

Context: Mali conflict.

**Archived source account.** Suspected jihadists attack Dioungani, a village in central Mali, killing a local official in front of his family.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/de072f12b6064be79efaf1be61b745b8/suspected-jihadists-attack-central-mali-kill-official>).

**Archived source account.** At least eight people have died in a major fire at a halting site for Irish travellers in the south of Dublin.

<a id="event-2015-10-10-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Indonesian chopper carrying five people lost contact with air traffic control during a flight on North Sumatra, Indonesia.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-10-10-2-1"></a>

Context: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea.

**Archived source account.** China completes the construction of two lighthouses on the disputed Spratly Islands in the South China Sea according to Chinese state media. The U.S. and the Philippines have opposed the construction efforts.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/oct/10/china-completes-construction-of-lighthouses-in-disputed-south-china-sea>).

<a id="event-2015-10-10-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** North Korea holds a massive military parade in its capital, Pyongyang, to celebrate the 70th anniversary of Workers' Party of Korea rule in the country. Liu Yunshan, the highest-ranking Chinese official to visit North Korea in three years, attends the parade.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-34493672>).

<a id="event-2015-10-10-2-4"></a>

Context: Egypt–France relations.

**Archived source account.** During a state visit to Cairo by French prime minister Manuel Valls, Egypt officially signs a deal with France to purchase the two Mistral-class helicopter carriers that were originally destined for Russia but France refused to deliver due to the Ukrainian crisis. Russia will sell Egypt the helicopters originally intended for the ships.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/Egypt-signs-deal-for-two-French-warships/articleshow/49302673.cms>).

**Archived source account.** Over 150,000 people protest in Berlin against the Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership accord between the European Union and the United States.,,,

### 2015-10-11

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1351971547](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20October%2011&oldid=1351971547>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-11-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israeli airstrikes targeting Hamas weapons facilities in the Gaza Strip result in an explosion that collapsed a nearby house, killing a 30-year old pregnant Palestinian woman and her two-year old daughter. Four others were wounded, including the woman's husband and son, the Gaza Health Ministry said. The Israeli military said the airstrike was in response to Saturday's pair of rocket launches from Gaza at Israel, as well as two large riots that succeeded in breaching the border fence.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/11/us-israel-palestinians-idUSKCN0S501720151011>); [AP](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2015/10/11/world/middleeast/ap-ml-israel-palestinians-the-latest.html?_r=0>); [AFP](<http://www.newindianexpress.com/world/Israeli-Strike-Kills-2-Palestinians-in-Gaza-as-Unrest-Spiral/2015/10/11/article3074391.ece>).

<a id="event-2015-10-11-0-2"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israeli traffic police stop a Palestinian woman transporting a small gas canister within Israeli territory near Jerusalem. She detonates the gas canister, lightly wounding a police officer and critically wounding herself.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.chron.com/news/world/article/The-Latest-Gaza-officials-say-airstrike-kills-6564490.php>); [AFP](<http://www.ndtv.com/world-news/palestinian-wounds-israeli-policeman-in-attempted-suicide-bombing-1230737>).

<a id="event-2015-10-11-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber targets a foreign forces convoy in the Joy Shir area of Kabul. Taliban insurgents claim responsibility. A statement from Afghanistan's Interior Ministry reported at least three civilians were wounded. There are no report of casualties among the foreign forces.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/south-asia/Explosion-rocks-Afghan-capital-Kabul-casualties-feared/articleshow/49308000.cms>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/11/us-afghanistan-attack-idUSKCN0S504A20151011>).

<a id="event-2015-10-11-0-5"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Five members of the NATO-led coalition die and five others are injured in a non-combat helicopter crash in Kabul. The Associated Press reported the chopper collided with a monitoring balloon on landing. Nationalities weren't identified by NATO's Resolute Support; the British said two were Royal Air Force personnel.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-34501878?ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_campaign=bbc_breaking&amp;ns_source=twitter&amp;ns_linkname=news_central>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/10/11/middleeast/helicopter-crash-in-afghanistan/>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2015/10/11/coalition-helicopter-crashes-afghanistan-kabul/73784674/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-11-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Following Russian airstrikes, the Syrian army and allied Lebanese Hezbollah militia take control of a highland area in Idlib province close to insurgent-held positions, according to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/11/us-mideast-crisis-syria-idUSKCN0S506F20151011>); [Malaysian Insider](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151012124536/http://www.themalaysianinsider.com/world/article/syrian-army-advances-in-west-after-russian-strikes>).

<a id="event-2015-10-11-0-9"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency in Cameroon.

**Archived source account.** At least eight people are killed following a suicide bomb attack in northern Cameroon's Sangueleri region near the Nigerian border. Boko Haram have previously carried out attacks in the region.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Standard](<http://www.business-standard.com/article/news-ians/eight-killed-in-cameroon-suicide-attack-115101100511_1.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-11-0-11"></a>

Context: Turkey–PKK conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Turkish Air Force launches a wave of airstrikes against PKK targets in northern Iraq and southeastern Turkey. Turkish security officials have also rejected a PKK ceasefire declared on Saturday shortly after the bombings in Ankara, saying "The PKK ceasefire means nothing for us. The operations will continue without a break".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/11/us-turkey-kurds-airstrikes-idUSKCN0S50B620151011>).

<a id="event-2015-10-11-0-12"></a>

Context: Turkey–PKK conflict.

**Archived source account.** Thousands gather in Ankara to pay their respects to those killed in Saturday's peace rally bombings. Marches and sit-ins protesting the attack were also held in Istanbul. No group has claimed responsibility. Turkey’s already polarized political parties traded accusations of responsibility for the attack. National elections are still scheduled for November 1, 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/world/europe/la-fg-turkey-bombings-aftermath-20151011-story.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/oct/11/thousands-gather-in-ankara-to-pay-respects-to-activists-killed-in-bombings>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/10/11/middleeast/turkey-ankara-bomb-blast/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-11-0-14"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** Iraq's military reports bombing a convoy possibly carrying Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant leader, Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi. The group was headed to a meeting in the western Al Anbar Governorate, close to the Syrian border. Eight senior ISIS figures were killed, but al-Baghdadi did not appear to be among them according to Iraqi officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/10/11/uk-mideast-crisis-iraq-baghdadi-idUKKCN0S50KJ20151011>); [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/news/world/top-isis-leaders-killed-iraqi-air-strike-not-baghdadi-article-1.2393228>).

<a id="event-2015-10-11-0-16"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** An Arab coalition airstrike on a prison in Yemen's central Al Bayda Governorate, reportedly kills 20 prisoners. The prison which held more than 100 prisoners was controlled by the Houthis.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo](<https://en-maktoob.news.yahoo.com/20-prisoners-killed-yemen-air-strikes-194818871.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-10-11-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** South Africa plans to leave the International Criminal Court (ICC) as the government faces criticism for, earlier this year, ignoring a court order to arrest Sudan's president.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2015/10/11/safrica-icc-idINKCN0S50I920151011>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-10-11-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iranian Students News Agency reports an undisclosed verdict has been reached in the espionage case of Washington Post reporter Jason Rezaian, who has been held by Iran for more than 14 months. The final closed door hearing on Rezaian's case was on August 10, 2015. By not disclosing details, the Post stated that it seems Tehran could be working a political angle. Last month at the UN, Iranian President Hassan Rouhani told journalists he would welcome quicker steps on mutual prisoner releases.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/iran-says-verdict-reached-on-washington-post-correspondent/2015/10/11/b69943ee-e5f5-4a86-9c35-64cd3496f332_story.html>); [Christian Science Monitor](<http://www.csmonitor.com/USA/2015/1011/Iran-sentences-Washington-Post-reporter-but-verdict-remains-unknown>); [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/10/11/uk-iran-usa-trial-idUKKCN0S50H420151011>).

<a id="event-2015-10-11-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A shooting at a house in Omeath, County Louth in the Republic of Ireland leaves two men dead, including an on-duty police officer.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-34501503>).

<a id="event-2015-10-11-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 15-hour protest about police-related deaths, in Thalang on Thailand's Phuket Island in the Andaman Sea, turned into a riot when the crowd attacked the Thalang Police Station with rocks and fire bombs. Two young men were killed in a motorcycle crash while being chased by police. Fourteen police were injured, nine cars were torched, 13 others and five motorcycles damaged. While numerous people were inconvenienced by the blockade, a heart attack patient died on his way to Thalang Hospital when the ambulance couldn't get through the crowd.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2015/10/11/angry-crowd-riots-on-thai-resort-island-phuket-to-protest-2-killed-during/>); [Celebcafe.org](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151013004131/http://celebcafe.org/angry-crowd-riots-on-phuket-after-2-killed-in-police-crash-6306/>); [Immortal.org](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151012052611/http://www.immortal.org/18570/phuket-police-crash-sparks-violent-riots/>); [PhuketWan Tourism News](<http://phuketwan.com/tourism/patient-died-phuket-protesters-forced-krabi-ambulance-turn-back-says-paramedic-23352/>).

Context: Belarusian presidential election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko won a fifth term by a landslide in today's election.,

Ballot counting started; the provisional outcome is not expected until the end of this week, an official said. Incumbent President Alpha Conde is expected to win reelection.

<a id="event-2015-10-12-2-1"></a>

Context: Syria Civil War, Foreign involvement.

**Archived source account.** European Union foreign ministers, gathered in Luxembourg to discuss the situation in Syria, release a statement urging Russia to stop its attacks in Syria and direct efforts towards a political solution.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Sabah](<http://www.dailysabah.com/europe/2015/10/12/eu-foreign-ministers-urge-russia-to-stop-attacks-on-moderate-syrian-opposition>); [Australian Broadcasting Corporation](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-10-13/eu-tells-russia-to-end-syria-attacks-or-risk-prolonging-conflict/6848710>); [European Council](<http://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2015/10/12-fac-conclusions-syria/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-10-12-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iranian State television reports that court spokesman Gholam-Hossein Mohseni-Eje'i clarified the Iranian-American reporter's verdict -- Washington Post's Jason Rezaian was convicted in a closed-door espionage trial that ended two months ago. Details remain unknown. Rezaian faced four charges; it's not clear whether he was convicted of all charges nor what sentence was imposed. Leila Ahsan, Rezaian’s lawyer, also had not received the verdict as of Sunday. Post executive editor Martin Baron says they will appeal.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/iranian-tv-says-post-correspondent-jason-rezaian-convicted/2015/10/12/b1652690-ee9e-11e4-8abc-d6aa3bad79dd_story.html>); [Payvand.com](<http://www.payvand.com/news/15/oct/1054.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-12-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** London police end their three-year long, round-the-clock guard outside the Ecuadorian Embassy waiting to arrest WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange. Officers have been stationed at this embassy since June 2012. Police said the operation cost 11.1 million pounds (17.6 million dollars) through April 2015. Assange is wanted for jumping bail in England and sexual assault allegations in Sweden. Assange denies the Swedish charges and suspects the real reason is to bring him to the U.S.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/police-guarding-julian-assange-londons-ecuadorian-embassy-are-withdrawn-n442801>); [AP](<http://www.newser.com/article/b5f47d7e04fd4f5fa75169aec647b58d/uk-police-remove-officers-from-outside-ecuadorean-embassy-where-julian-assange-is-holed-up.html>); [London Metropolitan Police](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151013145825/http://news.met.police.uk/news/covert-plan-at-ecuadorian-embassy-strengthened-after-removing-dedicated-guards-132799>).

<a id="event-2015-10-12-3-3"></a>

Context: Post 2011 Egyptian Revolution trials.

**Archived source account.** Cairo's criminal court orders the release of the sons of former Egyptian leader Hosni Mubarak, who are waiting for the Court of Appeal's decision in a financial corruption case. Each was sentenced to three years. The court ruled Gamal and Alaa Mubarak, who were initially detained in April 2011, had already served the requisite time in prison for the sentence.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/news/world/egyptian-court-orders-ex-prez-hosni-mubarek-sons-released-article-1.2394620>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/12/us-egypt-court-corruption-idUSKCN0S614620151012>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-10-12-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jioji Konrote is elected President of Fiji by the country's Parliament. Konrote, Fiji's Minister for Employment, Productivity and Industrial Relations, received 31 votes, defeating Epeli Ganilau, who garnered 14 votes.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand International](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/286749/fiji-parliament-elects-new-president>).

<a id="event-2015-10-12-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Vanuatuan Speaker of the Parliament, Marcellino Pipite, serving as acting President, pardons himself and 13 other MPs who had been found guilty of bribery on 9 October 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-10-11/convicted-vanuatu-acting-president-pardons-himself-13-others/6844372>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2015-10-12-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Angus Deaton wins the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences for his analysis of consumption, poverty, and welfare, helping redefine the way poverty is measured around the world, notably in India.

Source citations (as archived): [Huffington Post](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/2015-nobel-prize-economics_561b6395e4b0e66ad4c8660e>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/scottish-economist-angus-deaton-wins-nobel-economics-prize/2015/10/12/9dad5124-70d3-11e5-ba14-318f8e87a2fc_story.html>).

### 2015-10-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1245753738](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20October%2013&oldid=1245753738>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-13-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Russian involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Two shells hit the Russian embassy in Syria's capital Damascus, as hundreds of pro-government supporters rallied outside in support of Russian airstrikes. Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov described the shelling as "a terrorist act."

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-34515498>).

<a id="event-2015-10-13-0-3"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict, Palestinian political violence.

**Archived source account.** Two stabbing attacks take place in Ra'anana: one outside city hall in which one man is injured and the attacker is subdued by civilians; in a second incident, the attacker stabs civilians in front of a cafe, injuring one critically and three lightly until he is subdued by civilians.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Arab-Israeli-Conflict/Initial-report-Attempted-stabbing-attack-in-Raanana-423789>).

<a id="event-2015-10-13-0-4"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict, Palestinian political violence.

**Archived source account.** In Jerusalem two Palestinian men attempted to stab passengers on a bus before being shot; one person was killed and another wounded as a driver rammed into a crowd and the attacker reportedly stepped out of the crashed vehicle and attempted to stab the wounded before being subdued by police; in a separate incident two male passengers were killed and three others suffered gunshot wounds in a combined shooting and stabbing attack on a bus in the neighborhood of Armon Hanatziv in southern Jerusalem.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/series-of-stabbings-reported-in-jerusalem-near-tel-aviv/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-10-13-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jamaican author Marlon James wins the 2015 Man Booker Prize for his novel A Brief History of Seven Killings inspired by the attempted assassination of Bob Marley in the 1970s.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-34511049>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-10-13-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Dutch Safety Board releases their final report into the Malaysia Airlines Flight 17 (MH17) disaster that concludes that the flight from Amsterdam to Kuala Lumpur was shot-down by a Russian-made Buk missile system on 17 July 2014 killing 298 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://www.skynews.com.au/news/top-stories/2015/10/13/flight-mh17--investigators-to-publish-report.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34511973>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/indepth/features/2015/10/mh17-report-answer-questions-151012064226695.html>); [9News](<http://www.9news.com.au/world/2015/10/13/20/01/mh17-was-shot-down-by-russian-made-missile-investigation-reveals>).

<a id="event-2015-10-13-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 13 people are killed as a rockslide hits shanties in the Gulistan-i-Jauhar in the Pakistani city of Karachi.

Source citations (as archived): [Dawn](<http://www.dawn.com/news/1212779>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-10-13-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Anheuser-Busch InBev agrees to buy its main rival SABMiller for £68 billion ($104 billion) in the biggest beer deal ever.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2015/10/13/investing/ab-inbev-sabmiller-beer-merger/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-10-13-4-1"></a>

Context: Relocation of Marine Corps Air Station Futenma.

**Archived source account.** The Governor of the Japanese prefecture of Okinawa, Takeshi Onaga, revokes permission given by a predecessor for landfill work to replace a United States Marine Corps base.

Source citations (as archived): [Japan Times](<http://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2015/10/13/national/okinawa-revokes-predecessors-approval-u-s-base-relocation-work-henoko/#.VhxT_rKqpBd>).

<a id="event-2015-10-13-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran's Islamic Consultative Assembly approves the deal on its nuclear program agreed with six world powers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-34513363>).

<a id="event-2015-10-13-4-4"></a>

Context: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea.

**Archived source account.** The United States and Australia warn China they remain committed to freedom of navigation in the waters of the South China Sea and express strong concerns at China’s construction of artificial islands in the disputed waters.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel News Asia](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asiapacific/us-and-australia-warn/2191268.html>); [The New Daily](<http://thenewdaily.com.au/news/2015/10/14/china-lashes-australia-us-south-china-sea/>); [Time](<http://time.com/4072806/south-china-sea-us-islands-dispute/?xid=homepage>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-10-13-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Burkina Faso's presidential and parliamentary elections are deferred to November 29 due to a recent coup.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://news.yahoo.com/burkina-elections-delayed-until-november-29-candidates-184609953.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-10-13-6-1"></a>

Context: 2015 MLB postseason.

**Archived source account.** In the U.S., the Chicago Cubs defeat the St. Louis Cardinals 6–4 in Game 4 of their National League Division Series (NLDS), winning the best-of-five-game series 3–1. The Cubs, who clinched a postseason series at their home for nearly a century, Wrigley Field, for the first time ever, move on to the best-of-seven 2015 National League Championship Series. The series opens on October 17 at the home park of the winner of the other NLDS between the Los Angeles Dodgers and New York Mets.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://scores.espn.go.com/mlb/recap?gameId=351013116>).

<a id="event-2015-10-14-0-11"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** A Palestinian man wearing camouflaged clothing is shot dead at Jerusalem's Damascus Gate after charging at Israeli police with a knife; another Palestinian attacker stabs a 70-year old woman near Jerusalem's Central Bus Station before being shot dead by police.

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Arab-Israeli-Conflict/Attempted-stabbing-attack-by-Old-Citys-Damascus-Gate-in-Jerusalem-424936>); [The Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/terrorist-stabs-woman-70-outside-jerusalem-bus-station/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-14-0-13"></a>

Context: Taunsa Sharif bombing.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomb kills at least seven people and injures 13 others in Pakistan’s Punjab province inside the political office of Pakistan Muslim League MNA Sardar Amjad Farooq Khan Khosa, who was not present. Sardar Khosa, who is attending a meeting in Islamabad, said he did not receive any threat or alert prior to the blast. A Taliban splinter group, Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, claims responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The Express Tribune](<http://tribune.com.pk/story/972656/five-killed-many-wounded-in-blast-outside-mnas-residence-in-dg-khan/>); [India.com](<http://www.india.com/news/world/7-killed-in-suicide-attack-at-pakistan-lawmakers-outhouse-629979/>).
