Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2015/oct/15/parramatta-shooting-sydney-teenager-gun-supply-charges>); [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-10-15/man-to-be-charged-with-supplying-parramatta-shooters-gun/6857554>).

<a id="event-2015-10-15-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A cache of classified intelligence documents published from The Intercept, released by an anonymous whistleblower, highlight details surrounding post-September 11 attacks United States drone strikes in Afghanistan, Somalia, and Yemen, alleging that the United States conducts these strikes under extremely unreliable information and faulty pretenses.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Jazeera America](<http://america.aljazeera.com/articles/2015/10/15/new-leak-of-us-intelligence-highlights-contours-of-us-drone-program.html>); [U.S. News](<https://www.usnews.com/news/articles/2013/02/05/leaked-memo-outlines-policy-for-killing-americans-with-drones>); [Vice News](<https://news.vice.com/article/leaked-documents-show-the-us-used-drone-strikes-to-target-afghan-drug-lords>).

<a id="event-2015-10-15-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five individuals – four men and a teenage boy – are arrested in connection with the gang-rape of a 16-year-old girl at a Sydney, Australia, house party.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/10/15/asia/sydney-gang-rape-camera>).

<a id="event-2015-10-15-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scottish and U.S. prosecutors identify two Libyans as suspects in the Lockerbie bombing.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/10/15/europe/lockerbie-pan-am-flight-103/index.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2015/oct/15/lockerbie-bombing-two-libyans-suspects-pan-am-103>).

<a id="event-2015-10-15-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Nevada Gaming Control Board rules that daily fantasy sports leagues are a form of gambling that requires a license to operate in the state, including being offered to state residents. Due to Nevada's status as a major gambling center, the decision is seen as potentially influencing other U.S. states' stances on the leagues.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/daily-fantasy-sports-sites-ordered-to-shut-down-in-nevada/>); [ESPN](<http://espn.go.com/chalk/story/_/id/13897401/daily-fantasy-outlawed-nevada-gaming-control-board-being-unlicensed-gambling>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-10-15-6-1"></a>

Context: 2015 United Nations Security Council election.

**Archived source account.** Egypt, Senegal, Uruguay, Japan, and Ukraine are elected to two-year, non-permanent seats on the United Nations Security Council for 2016-17, replacing Chad, Chile, Jordan, Lithuania, and Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/10/16/world/ukraine-and-japan-among-latest-members-of-un-security-council.html?ref=world>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2015-10-15-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Astronomers say they have observed bizarre light patterns using the Kepler Space Telescope from a star that appears old, but is shrouded in debris like a much younger star, roughly 1,500 light-years away. This has led to speculation that these are an "artificial extraterrestrial mega-structure", orbiting the star known as KIC 8462852 in the Cygnus constellation. KIC 8462852 lies just above the Milky Way between the constellations Cygnus and Lyra. It first attracted the attention of astronomers in 2009 when the Kepler Space Telescope identified it as a candidate for having orbiting Earth-like planets.

Source citations (as archived): [Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/forget-water-on-mars-astronomers-may-have-just-found-giant-alien-megastructures-orbiting-a-star-near-a6693886.html>); [Discovery News](<http://news.discovery.com/space/alien-life-exoplanets/has-kepler-discovered-an-alien-megastructure-151014.htm>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-10-15-8-1"></a>

Context: 2015 MLB postseason.

**Archived source account.** In the U.S., the New York Mets defeat the Los Angeles Dodgers 3–2 in the deciding Game 5 of their National League Division Series. The Mets move on to face the Chicago Cubs in the best-of-seven 2015 National League Championship Series, which opens on October 17 at the Mets' home of Citi Field.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://scores.espn.go.com/mlb/recap?gameId=351015119>).

<a id="event-2015-10-16-2-4"></a>

Interstate 5, one of the state's major north-south arteries, is closed. The National Weather Service issues a flash flood watch today.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-10-16-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Rafe Esquith, a notable teacher in the Los Angeles, California, public school system files a $1 billion class action lawsuit against the LA Unified School District. Esquith, recently removed from teaching and subsequently fired, alleges on behalf of almost 2,000 individuals, certain age-discrimination tactics by the school system against older teachers.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/10/15/us/los-angeles-teacher-class-action-lawsuit-rafe-esquith/index.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-16-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A U.S. federal judge declines plaintiffs request for an emergency order requiring Texas issue birth certificates to U.S.-born children of immigrant families who entered the country illegally. The judge said Matrícula Consular cards issued by Mexican consulates to their citizens in the U.S. aren’t secure. The U.S. Constitution’s 14th Amendment guarantees the right of citizenship to children born in the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Miami Herald](<http://www.miamiherald.com/news/nation-world/national/article39557769.html>); [Washington Times](<http://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2015/oct/16/texas-can-refuse-to-issue-birth-certificates-to-il/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-10-16-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hawaii Governor David Ige declares a state of emergency to address homelessness as the state has seen an alarming increase in unsheltered individuals and families over the past two years, particularly on O'ahu. Hawaii has the highest per capita rate of homelessness among the 50 states at about 465 people per 100,000 citizens. This act "frees up" money for this problem.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Health_News/2015/10/17/Governor-of-Hawaii-declares-state-of-emergency-to-help-homeless/4711445124043/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/18/us-usa-hawaii-homelessness-idUSKCN0SC00P20151018>); [Hawaii](<http://governor.hawaii.gov/newsroom/governors-office-news-release-governor-ige-signs-emergency-proclamation-to-address-homelessness-statewide/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-10-18-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** As part of the weekend celebration of the 50th anniversary of the Synod of Bishops, during the 3-week-long Ordinary General Synod on the Family, Pope Francis canonizes the parents of the Doctor of the Church, Saint Therese of the Child Jesus of Lisieux, France (Saints Louis Martin and Marie-Azélie Guérin Martin, 1823–1894 and 1831–1877, respectively), the first married Catholic parents to be canonized at the same time. He also canonizes the religious superior general Saint María de la Purísima Salvat Romero (Mary of the Immaculate Conception), 1926–1998, and the diocesan priest and founder of a religious institute, Saint Vincenzo Grossi, 1845–1917.,,

Source citations (as archived): [The Vatican](<http://press.vatican.va/content/salastampa/it/bollettino/pubblico/2015/10/18/0796/01759.html#en>); [AP](<http://www.ctvnews.ca/world/pope-francis-canonizes-first-married-couple-in-modern-times-1.2615416>); [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151019123022/http://www.voanews.com/content/reu-pope-proclaims-new-saints-calls-for-humble-church-leadership/3012407.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-19-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict (2015).

**Archived source account.** 19-year-old soldier Omri Levy was killed and nearly a dozen injured in a shooting and stabbing attack in the central bus station in the southern city of Beersheba carried out by an Israeli Bedouin Arab, 21-year old Mohind al-Okbi, who was killed after a gun battle.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/sunday-stabbing-and-shooting-attack-in-negev-desert-leaves-two-dead/2015/10/19/79767c0e-7637-11e5-a958-d889faf561dc_story.html>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/attack-israeli-city-beersheba-leaves-one-dead-least-8-wounded-n446781>).

<a id="event-2015-10-19-0-2"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict (2015).

**Archived source account.** Israeli hospital officials announce an Eritrean migrant, Haptom Zerhom, mistakenly shot by an Israeli security guard and then attacked by bystanders who thought he was involved in the Beersheva bus station attack, has died of his wounds. Foreign Ministry spokesman Emmanuel Nahsho said this latest incident seemed to capture the current climate of ratcheted-up tensions. Police are looking to identify and locate members of the crowd who beat and fatally wounded the man; the security officer whose shot incapacitated the victim will not be investigated.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/8a5c6c91660643d68dc42590fd70f148/eritrean-dies-after-israeli-guard-shoots-him-mob-attacks>); [Yediot Ahronot – Ynet](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4713271,00.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-19-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021): Kunduz hospital airstrike.

**Archived source account.** Afghanistan’s acting defense minister has stated that the Médecins Sans Frontières hospital in Kunduz bombed on 3 October by U.S. forces was being used as a safe haven by insurgents. MSF has repeatedly denied the allegation, stating "Every staff member in Kunduz working for MSF has repeatedly reported to us that there were no armed people in the hospital at the time of the bombing".

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/A/AS_AFGHANISTAN?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT&amp;CTIME=2015-10-19-10-18-20>).

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The United States and Russia sign an agreement designed to avoid conflict between both countries' warplanes in Syria. The Pentagon said the agreement will remain secret; a hotline will enable both countries to directly communicate.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/russian-american-deal-on-syrian-air-space-expected-shortly/?google_editors_picks=true>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/10/20/US-Russia-sign-deal-to-avoid-conflict-between-warlanes-over-Syria/7661445365741/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-20-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, in tonight's speech to the World Zionist Congress on "the 10 big lies" told by Palestinians and their backers, said Haj Amin al-Husseini, the Grand Mufti of Jerusalem from 1922–1937, convinced Adolf Hitler and the Nazis to change their original plan of expelling Jews to the so-called Final Solution, i.e., the extermination of Jews. The Washington Post states this reinforces Netanyahu's position that Palestinian violence is caused by their old and intractable hatred of Jews, not Israel's 1948 creation.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/netanyahu-says-a-palestinian-gave-hitler-the-idea-for-the-holocaust/2015/10/21/0a36d7da-ee8b-4135-9726-968eceda4cc9_story.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-10-20-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Israel Defense Forces arrest senior Hamas leader Sheikh Hassan Yousef for alleged incitement to commit violence.

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/IDF-arrests-senior-Hamas-figure-Hassan-Yousef-in-West-Bank-427478>).

<a id="event-2015-10-20-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A French public prosecutor said charges against far-right leader Marine Le Pen should be dropped. Le Pen is being tried for comments she made five years ago comparing Muslim street prayers to Nazi occupation. Prosecutor Bernard Reynaud said, “Madame Le Pen in denouncing prayers in public space addressed not the entire Muslim community but a minority and was only exercising her freedom of expression.”

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://america.aljazeera.com/articles/2015/10/20/french-prosecutor-calls-to-drop-racism-charges-against-far-right-leader.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/20/us-france-politics-lepen-idUSKCN0SE1XS20151020>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-10-20-6-1"></a>

Context: Democratic Party presidential candidates, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Former Virginia Senator Jim Webb announces his withdrawal from the race for the Democratic presidential nomination during a press conference at the National Press Club. He added that he would consider his other options in the coming weeks. Webb's campaign said he is weighing an independent bid.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2016-election/jim-webb-quit-democratic-primary-n447736>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/b5d02ee2e7e0407c94748817f17d7c40/webb-considering-dropping-democratic-bid-president>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-politics/wp/2015/10/20/webb-exits-democratic-presidential-primary/>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2015-10-20-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Research from University of California, Los Angeles scientists indicates that life on earth may have started 4.1 billion years ago – 300 million years earlier than previously thought.

Source citations (as archived): [Economic Times](<http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/science/life-on-earth-may-have-started-4-1-billion-years-ago/articleshow/49464944.cms>).

<a id="event-2015-10-20-7-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Research by the University of Central Florida indicates a common UV-filtering compound, oxybenzone, found in sunscreen lotion is killing coral, especially among reefs frequented by recreational divers and snorkelers.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Science_News/2015/10/20/Sunscreen-chemicals-may-be-killing-coral-reefs-popular-with-tourists/1721445351385/?spt=hts&amp;or=4>); [Time](<http://time.com/4082272/coral-reefs-sunscreen-oxybenzone/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-10-20-8-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lamar Odom, who had been hospitalized in grave condition after ingesting, in a binge, herbal Viagra, alcohol, and other substances in a 3-day, $75,000 stay at a legal brothel in Nevada, comes out of his coma, improves, and is able to have conversations, though he is still on dialysis to deal with the renal damage he suffered. He is released from intensive care and Sunrise Hospital, to a hospital closer to his Los Angeles home.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151022164334/http://www.msn.com/en-us/sports/nba/lamar-odom-reportedly-released-from-las-vegas-hospital/ar-AAfDudF?li=BBgzzfc&amp;ocid=iehp>).

### 2015-10-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1126527463](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20October%2021&oldid=1126527463>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-21-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** The Taliban announced it overran Ghoryan in western Herat, the second district to fall in three days.

Source citations (as archived): [Long War Journal](<http://www.longwarjournal.org/archives/2015/10/taliban-seizes-another-district-in-western-afghanistan.php>).

<a id="event-2015-10-21-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** ISIL orders males aged 14 and older in Raqqa, its de facto Syrian capital, to register with the police, an action seen as the first step toward forced conscriptions in this region.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera America](<http://america.aljazeera.com/articles/2015/10/20/residents-in-isis-de-facto-capital-fear-military-conscription.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-21-0-5"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Rockets fired by Houthi forces reportedly kill 14 people in city of Taiz, southwestern Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/10/21/uk-yemen-security-idUKKCN0SF2VJ20151021>).

<a id="event-2015-10-21-0-7"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** According to a civilian vigilante, 20 people are killed after Boko Haram militants open fire on cars outside a village in Nigeria's restive northeast Borno state.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/20-shot-dead-suspected-islamists-ne-nigeria-witnesses-224347258.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-10-21-1-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from Tropical Storm Koppu that battered the Philippines' main island this weekend climbed to at least 39. Koppu forced more than 100,000 villagers into emergency shelters and destroyed rice fields ready for harvest.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/a6780727882643e38f1ecee125a19dd0/death-toll-tropical-storm-philippines-climbs-39>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-34590520>).

<a id="event-2015-10-21-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A U.S. F-18 fighter jet crashes into farmland near RAF Lakenheath in Suffolk county, England, killing the pilot.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1573566/pilot-killed-as-us-jet-crashes-in-huge-fireball>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-10-21-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The American Academy of Pediatrics calls for pregnant women to abstain completely from alcohol during the entire three trimesters of the pregnancy, saying no amount of any type of alcohol should be considered safe since the risks, to the baby in particular (such as fetal alcohol syndrome, among many others), are too great. This puts the U.S. alongside other Western developed countries- except Italy and the United Kingdom, which still allow occasional small amounts- in urging complete abstinence. The American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), the two other U.S. agencies that comment most about this issue, already recommend total alcohol abstinence.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/10/21/health/aap-no-alcohol-during-pregnancy/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-10-21-3-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The President of Syria Bashar al-Assad visits Moscow for talks with the President of Russia Vladimir Putin in an unannounced visit.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34590561#>).

<a id="event-2015-10-21-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei approves the nuclear deal between Tehran and world powers, and orders it to be implemented subject to certain conditions. The letter states the United States and European Union should clearly announce the elimination of sanctions against Iran. The imposition of sanctions at any level and under any pretext from any of the negotiating countries would violate the JCPOA.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/21/us-iran-nuclear-khamenei-idUSKCN0SF18720151021>); [Mehr News Agency](<http://en.mehrnews.com/news/111282/Leader-issues-important-orders-to-Rouhani-on-JCPOA>); [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/afp/article-3282784/Iran-leader-endorses-nuclear-deal-despite-ambiguities.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-21-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Vatican denies an Italian newspaper report that Pope Francis has a benign brain tumour, saying the 78-year-old pontiff is in good health, and denounces the article as utterly reprehensible.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2015/10/21/pope-tumor-denial-idINKCN0SF0I220151021>); [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151022184430/http://www.philly.com/philly/news/nation_world/20151021_ap_d5009b7f244a45caba8107267fd5b0db.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-21-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's speech yesterday that the Grand Mufti of Jerusalem persuaded the Nazis to adopt their Final Solution to exterminate 6 million Jews is reproached by Holocaust experts and survivors, historians, world leaders, etc. Palestine Liberation Organization's Saeb Erakat and Israel's Zionist Union party's Isaac Herzog both blasted Netanyahu's claim. German Chancellor Angela Merkel said, "All Germans know the history of the murderous race mania of the Nazis that led to... the Holocaust." Mehnaz Afridi, a Manhattan College professor who promotes Muslim-Jewish dialogue said, "this... really is a terrible statement to make at this time."

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/4080962/netanyahu-palestinians-holocaust/?xid=gonewsedit&amp;google_editors_picks=true>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/21/israel-netanyahu-hitler-germany-idUSB4N11U01120151021>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/10/21/middleeast/netanReactioyahu-hitler-grand-mufti-holocaust/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-10-21-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two Chinese consulate staff are killed and a consul general injured after a gunman opened fire on a restaurant in the city of Cebu, the "second city" of the Philippines. Various reports named the gunman as Chinese national Li Qingliang.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/asia/philippines/11945268/Two-Chinese-consulate-staff-killed-at-Philippine-restaurant.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-21-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** St. Louis' police chief announces officers are stepping up patrols following fires at six predominantly African-American churches in the past two weeks. No one has been injured in any of the fires. The reward for information leading to an arrest is now $4,000; the St. Louis Police Officers’ Association will match the $2,000 reward being offered by the St. Louis Regional Crime Stoppers and the ATF. The American Civil Liberties Union of Missouri and the Anti-Defamation League suggest the fires may be arson sparked by racist motivations.

Source citations (as archived): [St. Louis Post-Dispatch](<http://www.stltoday.com/news/local/crime-and-courts/st-louis-police-add-patrols-trying-to-crack-string-of/article_26d2eb76-f517-5394-9a21-f31ccfdc024a.html>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/six-fires-st-louis-churches-under-investigation-reward-offered-n447836>).

<a id="event-2015-10-21-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Wikileaks releases U.S. Central Intelligence Agency director John O. Brennan's personal information after the top spy's personal email account was allegedly hacked by a 13-year-old and information sent to Wikileaks. All of the documents predate Brennan's time in the Obama administration and reveal no classified data. Among the information released are Social Security numbers, an incomplete questionnaire for security clearance, and addresses of his family and associates.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-34597060>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/10/21/politics/john-brennan-hacked-cia-director/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-21-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A British lawyer and his wife are found dead by their gardener at their home on the Caribbean island of Tobago. The Trinidad and Tobago Police Service believe the couple were murdered during a suspected robbery.

Source citations (as archived): [Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/crime/british-lawyer-and-wife-murdered-during-suspected-robbery-at-caribbean-home-a6703671.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-10-21-5-1"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Vice President Joe Biden says that he will not be seeking the Democratic Party nomination.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times blog](<http://www.latimes.com/nation/politics/trailguide/la-na-trailguide-10212015-htmlstory.html>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/biden-decides-against-a-2016-presidential-bid/2015/10/19/bfb58df8-7089-11e5-8248-98e0f5a2e830_story.html>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2015-10-21-6-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Major League Baseball postseason.

**Archived source account.** In Major League Baseball, the New York Mets defeat the Chicago Cubs 8–3, completing a four-game sweep of the 2015 National League Championship Series, and advance to the 2015 World Series.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsday](<http://www.newsday.com/sports/baseball/mets/mets-reach-world-series-after-sweeping-chicago-cubs-in-nlcs-1.10994404>).

### 2015-10-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1290724174](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20October%2022&oldid=1290724174>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-22-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Associated Press reports that Kurds in Syria established a new administration in the Sunni-Arab town of Tal Abyad, which the Kurds wrestled from ISIS last June.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. News and World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2015/10/21/syrian-kurds-form-new-administration-in-semi-autonomous-area>).

<a id="event-2015-10-22-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reports at least a dozen people, including health-care workers, were killed when Russian aircraft attacked a field hospital in Sarmin, Idlib.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/russia-air-strike-field-hospital-kills-13-155302808.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-22-0-5"></a>

Context: Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant, American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–present):.

**Archived source account.** A joint early-morning raid conducted by Iraqi and US forces on an IS-run prison in Hawija, Kirkuk Province has freed 70 hostages. One U.S. Delta Force soldier was reported killed – the first American combat death since the start of the US-led intervention against IS.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/34607471>).

<a id="event-2015-10-22-0-7"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Taliban insurgents assassinate Mohammad Daud Sultanzoy, a district administrator in Afghanistan's eastern Ghazni province.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151022202038/http://www.voanews.com/content/taliban-kill-afghan-official/3018219.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-22-0-9"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Egypt's military says it has gained "full control" over the North Sinai areas of Arish, Rafah and Sheikh Zuweid after successful raids on terrorist strongholds and weapons caches.

Source citations (as archived): [Ahram Online](<http://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/64/161550/Egypt/Politics-/Egypt-gains-full-control-of-North-Sinai-Spokespers.aspx>).

<a id="event-2015-10-22-0-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 10 people are killed and 12 injured when a suicide-bomber attacks a Pakistani Shia Mosque and Imambargah during prayers in the District Bagh of Kachhi 300 Km from Quetta in Balochistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Pakistan Today](<http://www.pakistantoday.com.pk/2015/10/22/national/10-shia-worshipers-killed-in-bagh-imambargah-suicide-attack/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-10-22-1-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** The death toll for Typhoon Koppu (Lando) in the Philippines rises to 54 with more than 1.2 million affected.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/nation/110222-typhoon-lando-ndrrmc-toll-october-22>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/oct/22/typhoon-koppu-death-toll-reaches-54-as-philippines-battles-devastating-floods>).

<a id="event-2015-10-22-1-3"></a>

Context: 2015 Pacific hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Patricia strengthens to Category 4 ahead of making landfall in Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [The Weather Channel](<http://www.weather.com/storms/hurricane/news/tropical-depression-twenty-e-tropical-storm-hurricane-patricia-mexico>).

<a id="event-2015-10-22-1-5"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Human Rights Watch says unidentified armed men have been disabling boats carrying migrants and asylum seekers in the Aegean Sea traveling from Turkey toward the Greek islands. Witnesses have described eight incidents this month in which masked assailants intercepted and disabled the boats by damaging engines or fuel systems, and in the case of inflatable boats, attempting to puncture hulls.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/10/22/Report-Armed-attackers-disable-migrant-boats-in-Aegean-Sea/7931445524022/?spt=rln&amp;or=4>); [Human Rights Watch](<https://www.hrw.org/news/2015/10/22/greece-attacks-boats-risk-migrant-lives>).

<a id="event-2015-10-22-1-6"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** In a pair of incidents on Tuesday and Wednesday, two migrants were killed, 16 are missing, and 48 were rescued from boats heading to Greece from Turkey that capsized in the Aegean Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [Hürriyet Daily News](<http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/two-migrants-killed-16-missing-in-aegean-sea-for-two-days.aspx?pageID=238&amp;nID=90229&amp;NewsCatID=341>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-10-22-2-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Authorities in Slovenia say around 2,000 migrants from a refugee camp at the Croatian border are traveling in four trains toward Austria, three to the overloaded crossing at Šentilj and the other to Jesenice.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/the-latest-worried-police-open-slovene-austria-border/2015/10/22/83218f9e-7891-11e5-a5e2-40d6b2ad18dd_story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-22-2-2"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** U.N. human rights chief Zeid Ra'ad al-Hussein accuses the Czech Republic of committing systematic human rights violations by detaining refugees for up to 90 days and strip-searching them for money to pay for their own detention. Czech President Miloš Zeman rejected Zeid's criticism "of his stance against migration and Islam." \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/22/us-europe-migrants-czech-un-idUSKCN0SG14W20151022>); [NYSE Post](<http://nysepost.com/czech-president-rejects-un-united-nations-criticism-of-25047>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/oct/22/czech-republic-president-rejects-un-claims-refugees-rights-violations-migration>).

<a id="event-2015-10-22-2-4"></a>

Context: Kuril Islands dispute.

**Archived source account.** Russian Defence Minister Sergei Shoigu announces Russia plans to build a new military base on the Kuril Islands, a group of Pacific islands it seized from Japan at the end of World War II.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<http://uk.businessinsider.com/r-russia-says-to-build-military-base-on-contested-kurile-islands-2015-10?r=US&amp;IR=T>).

<a id="event-2015-10-22-2-6"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict (2015).

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry met today in Berlin with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu regarding the recent spate of violence between Palestinians and Israelis. Kerry will meet on Saturday with Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas and King Abdullah of Jordan in Amman.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/kerry-arrives-in-germany-for-talks-with-israeli-prime-minister/2015/10/22/53fc6e8a-7889-11e5-b9c1-f03c48c96ac2_story.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-10-22-3-1"></a>

Context: Trollhättan school attack.

**Archived source account.** Two teachers and a student are killed, and another student injured, in an attack at a school in Trollhättan, Sweden. The attacker was shot dead by police.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-34602621>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/oct/22/pupils-wounded-in-sword-attack-at-swedish-school>).

<a id="event-2015-10-22-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Chilean officers start to grant civil unions licences to both heterosexual and homosexual couples, marking the first time a same-sex relationship is officially recognized in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-34602629>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/oct/21/chile-same-sex-civil-unions-legal>).

<a id="event-2015-10-22-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A shooting late Thursday on the Tennessee State University campus in Nashville, Tennessee, U.S., injures three people, one critically. One of those wounded died later at a hospital. The victims were transported to Vanderbilt University Medical Center.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/news/crime/3-shot-critically-injured-shooting-tsu-reports-article-1.2408209>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/three-people-shot-tennessee-state-university-campus-n449756>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-10-22-4-1"></a>

Context: West Lothian question.

**Archived source account.** The UK House of Commons passes an "English votes for English laws" bill by 312 to 270 votes giving English MPs a greater say over legislation that only applies to England. The bill has been fiercely opposed by the opposition Labour Party and the Scottish National Party.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-34599998>).

<a id="event-2015-10-22-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Barack Obama vetoes the $612 billion annual defense authorization bill because of the way it would sidestep budget limitations for the military and because it would restrict the transfer of detainees being held at Guantanamo Bay. This is the President's fifth veto since 2009.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/economy/president-to-use-veto-for-only-fifth-time-to-reject-defense-authorization-bill/2015/10/22/58a455a6-78d4-11e5-bc80-9091021aeb69_story.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/22/us-usa-fiscal-defense-idUSKCN0SG2LF20151022>).

<a id="event-2015-10-22-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Paul Ryan announces that he will run to succeed outgoing Speaker of the United States House of Representatives John Boehner after receiving the support of a significant majority of members of the Republican Party.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC](<http://www.nbcnews.com/politics/congress/paul-ryan-says-hell-run-house-speaker-n449631?cid=eml_nbn_20151022>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-10-22-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Baruto Kaito, former sumo wrestler who once reached ōzeki, the sport's second-highest rank, announces he will compete in mixed martial arts and is set to make his debut at Rizin Fighting Federation.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyodo News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151022123117/http://www.kyodonews.net/news/2015/10/22/36373>).

### 2015-10-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131604328](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20October%2023&oldid=1131604328>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-23-0-1"></a>

Context: Boko Haram.

Source citations (as archived): [Dawn](<http://www.dawn.com/news/1215087>); [Samaa News](<http://www.samaa.tv/pakistan/2015/10/five-killed-in-jacobabad-blast/>).

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Islamic State fighters take control of a section of road running between the towns of Khanaser and Ithriya, southeast of Aleppo, according to a monitoring group. This threatens the Syrian army's only supply route into the city.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/23/us-mideast-crisis-syria-idUSKCN0SH2D520151023>).

**Archived source account.** At least nine people are killed and dozens injured in the eastern Libyan city of Benghazi after several mortar shells hit a protest against a UN proposal for a unity government to end the four-year long crisis in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/23/us-libya-security-idUSKCN0SH25O20151023>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-10-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Adele returns from a three-year hiatus with the new single "Hello" from the album 25.

Source citations (as archived): [Forbes](<https://www.forbes.com/sites/hughmcintyre/2015/10/23/adele-finally-returns-with-comeback-single-hello/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-34613748>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-10-23-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lockheed Martin embarks on corporate overhead cost cutting reviews, another initiative following business selloffs and personnel layoffs. In the face of U.S. budget constraints, Lockheed’s actions are in step with those of other major U.S. defense contractors.

Source citations (as archived): [Zacks](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151025191526/http://www.zacks.com/stock/news/194641/lockheed-martin-to-cut-overhead-costs-amid-tepid-budget>).

<a id="event-2015-10-23-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Imprimis Pharmaceuticals Inc. announces it will begin selling $1 doses of the antimalarial drug used for HIV patients, pyrimethamine (generic name for Daraprim), whose price was recently raised to $750 per pill by Turing Pharmaceuticals following Martin Shkreli's purchase of its marketing rights this year. Imprimis also plans to start making inexpensive versions of other generic drugs whose prices have skyrocketed.

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/business/ct-daraprim-imprimis-20151023-story.html>); [Toronto Star](<https://www.thestar.com/news/canada/2015/10/23/750-daraprim-pill-now-has-a-1-generic-alternative.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-10-23-3-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Pacific hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Patricia makes landfall at Playa Perula in Mexico's western Jalisco state. The storm strengthens into a powerful Category 5 hurricane with winds of 200 mph and gusts up to 245 mph. The NHC has called the storm "potentially catastrophic" for Mexico. Patricia is expected to produce total rainfall accumulations of 6 to 12 inches, with isolated maximum amounts of 20 inches, through Saturday. These rains could produce life-threatening flash floods and mud slides.,

Source citations (as archived): [National Hurricane Center](<http://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCPEP5+shtml/211140.shtml>); [Reuters](<http://www.trust.org/item/20151022183939-hmioy>); [AFP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-10-24/hurricane-patricia-makes-landfall-in-mexico/6881718>).

<a id="event-2015-10-23-3-2"></a>

Context: 2015 Pacific hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Patricia becomes the most intense hurricane ever recorded in the Western Hemisphere with winds of 200 mph (320 km/h).

Source citations (as archived): [NBC](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/weather/hurricane-patricia-races-mexicos-pacific-coast-potential-monster-n449731>).

<a id="event-2015-10-23-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Kuwait and France sealed a deal whereby the Gulf nation will upgrade its defense capabilities with $2.8 billion worth of military equipment. Defense experts cite the ongoing conflict in Iraqi Civil War, the June 2015 terror attack claimed by ISIS in Kuwait City, and a reluctance by the U.S. to supply Kuwait as reasons for the deal.

Source citations (as archived): [Vice News](<https://news.vice.com/article/kuwait-is-buying-a-bunch-of-weapons-to-protect-itself-from-the-islamic-state>).

<a id="event-2015-10-23-4-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/oct/22/zimbabwes-robert-mugabe-awarded-chinas-nobel-peace-prize>).

<a id="event-2015-10-23-5-5"></a>

Context: School shootings in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Nineteen-year old Cameron Selmon died during last night's shooting on the Tennessee State University campus when a fight erupted during a dice game, in which a player pulled out a gun and started firing. One of the three injured 18-year-old female students remains hospitalized. The suspect fled the scene on foot and is still at large. The school is closed today but will re-open with Monday classes.

### 2015-10-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076183052](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20October%2024&oldid=1076183052>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-24-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A series of bomb blasts targeting Shia Muslims in the Bangladeshi capital Dhaka kills at least one person and injures dozens more. Claims of responsibility by ISIS are discounted by Dhaka police who told AFP, "So far we have not found any link to any militant group."

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/10/24/uk-bangladesh-bomb-killed-idUKKCN0SI01F20151024?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=worldNews>); [Christian Science Monitor](<http://www.csmonitor.com/World/2015/1024/Officials-doubt-ISIS-claims-of-responsibility-for-bombing-in-Bangladesh>).

<a id="event-2015-10-24-0-2"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency, Egyptian parliamentary election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** A first lieutenant and two soldiers have been killed in an explosion which targeted a police armored vehicle in the northern Sinai city of Al-Arīsh.

Source citations (as archived): [NY Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2015/10/24/world/middleeast/ap-ml-egypt-explosion.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2015-10-24-0-3"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency, Egyptian parliamentary election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Two suspected militants riding a motorcycle shoot and kill Mostafa Abdelrahman, the ultraconservative Salafi Al-Nour Party secretary, and parliamentary candidate for Al-Arīsh. Arish residents say militants have threatened candidates, accusing them of cooperating with the government. Al‑Nour is the only prominent Islamist party to emerge unscathed after the military's 2013 crackdown on Islamists.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/24/us-egypt-election-militants-idUSKCN0SI0O520151024>); [AFP](<http://www.bangkokpost.com/news/world/742044/islamist-candidate-in-egypt-elections-shot-dead-in-sinai>).

<a id="event-2015-10-24-0-5"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict (2015).

**Archived source account.** Violence continues while talks persist looking for a peaceful resolution. A 16-year old Palestinian is shot dead after he tried to stab an Israeli security guard at a West Bank border crossing. A 25-year old Palestinian protester died of wounds suffered last week when he was shot by Israeli troops during a border clash near the Gazan town of Khan Yunis.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/24/us-israel-palestinians-idUSKCN0SI0E720151024>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/7c3d4c881c664d5c8de82be396b660ef/kerry-renews-push-ease-israeli-palestinian-tensions>).

<a id="event-2015-10-24-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Al-Nusra Front's (Al-Qaeda's branch in Syria) leader Abu Suleiman al-Masri is reportedly killed in the Aleppo province during clashes with the Syrian Army.

Source citations (as archived): [Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/leader-of-syrian-branch-of-al-qaeda-abu-suleiman-al-masri-reportedly-killed-fighting-against-syrian-a6707396.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-24-0-9"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** At least 40 people, including several fishermen, are reportedly killed following Saudi-led coalition airstrikes on two islands off Yemen's Red Sea coast. Local fisherman reported coalition aircraft and warships struck the Aqban and Kadman islands targeting Houthi forces but also destroyed several boats killing local fishermen.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/10/24/uk-yemen-security-idUKKCN0SI07C20151024>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-10-24-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Actress Maureen O'Hara dies in her sleep at her Boise, Idaho, home. "She passed peacefully surrounded by her loving family as they celebrated her life listening to music from her favorite movie, The Quiet Man," said her family's statement.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/315a033607844f42a14d9bd2b8944012/maureen-ohara-spirited-movie-star-dies-95>); [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/Entertainment/wireStory/maureen-ohara-spirited-movie-star-dies-95-34703112>).

<a id="event-2015-10-24-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Close to 300 landmarks in 60 countries, from the Pyramids in Egypt, to the Eiffel Tower in Paris, and the Empire State Building in New York, were lit up in blue — the official color of the United Nations — to commemorate the 70th anniversary of the world body.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2015/10/23/world/ap-un-united-nations-at-70.html?_r=0>); [UN](<http://www.un.org/apps/news/story.asp?NewsID=52346#.ViwB1G5BnYs>); [Blue photos UN](<https://www.flickr.com/photos/unicphoto/sets/72157657328013193>).

<a id="event-2015-10-24-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The three-week synod on the family convened by Pope Francis at the Vatican concludes with traditional Catholic orientations toward marriage and the family intact.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/10/25/world/europe/synod-makes-overture-to-the-divorced-but-rejects-gay-marriage.html?_r=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-10-24-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Union Pacific freight train derails in flooded North Texas, near Corsicana, where the tracks washed away. The two crewmen on board swam to safety.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/texas-floods-union-pacific-train-derails-as-rains-soak-state/>); [WFAA blog](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151025091008/http://www.wfaa.com/story/weather/2015/10/24/weather-blog-rain/74523686/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-24-2-2"></a>

Context: 2015 Pacific hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Patricia, which hit the Mexican coast as a Category 5 storm, appeared to leave remarkably little damage as it moved rapidly inland over mountainous western Mexico and is now a tropical depression (35 mph/55 kph). The storm is currently centered northeast of Zacatecas, Mexico, moving northeast at 24 mph/39 kph. While there are no reports of casualties or substantial widespread damage, authorities warn deadly floods and mudslides remain possible.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/hurricane-patricia-weakens-dumps-torrential-rain-mexico/story?id=34697707>); [CTV News](<http://www.ctvnews.ca/world/mega-storm-patricia-drenches-mexico-as-it-weakens-1.2625751>); [NHC](<http://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCPEP5+shtml/241432.shtml>).

<a id="event-2015-10-24-2-4"></a>

Context: 2015 Oklahoma State University homecoming parade crash.

**Archived source account.** A driver, arrested on suspicion of driving under the influence (DUI), plows into the Oklahoma State Homecoming parade in Stillwater, Oklahoma, killing four people and injuring 34 with eight in critical condition. The homecoming game with Kansas was played at 2:30 p.m. CT as scheduled. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaaf/big12/2015/10/24/fatal-car-crash-kills-two-at-oklahoma-state-homecoming-parade/74532230/>); [KOCO](<http://www.koco.com/news/several-hurt-in-crash-at-osu-parade/36027322>); [AP](<http://www.wflx.com/story/30341007/the-latest-on-parade-crash-34-injured-after-fatal-crash>); [Stillwater News Press](<http://www.stwnewspress.com/news/stillwater-pd-driver-arrested-on-suspicion-of-driving-under-influence/article_0c33c3dc-7a78-11e5-a4ff-5f1575654c10.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-24-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Costa Rica's restive Turrialba Volcano erupts.

Source citations (as archived): [The Tico Times](<http://www.ticotimes.net/2015/10/24/turrialba-volcano-launches-ash-800-meters-sky>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-10-24-3-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict (2015).

**Archived source account.** Israel and Jordan agree to take steps to quell violence at the Al-Aqsa Mosque in Jerusalem which includes round-the-clock monitoring of new security cameras there. Israel reaffirms Jordan's historic role as formal custodian of what is known to Jews as the Temple Mount and as Haram al-Sharif to Muslims. Yesterday, Israeli authorities lifted restrictions that had banned men aged under 40 from praying at al-Aqsa.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.trust.org/item/20151024154737-9peqk>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-34626425>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/kerry-travels-to-jordan-in-quest-to-stop-violence-in-israel/2015/10/24/a6c1dbe2-d518-46cd-b71d-355aee59bfc5_story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-24-3-3"></a>

Context: 2015 anti-government protest in Montenegro.

**Archived source account.** Thousands protest and clash with police in Montenegro's capital Podgorica, demanding the immediate resignation of Prime Minister Milo Đukanović. Đukanović has rejected calls to resign and has accused the opposition of trying to prevent the country's NATO membership, saying he is convinced Russia is behind the unrest.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/tear-gas-thousands-demand-montenegro-pm-quits-213339710.html>).

**Archived source account.** At least five people are dead, one missing, and 21 rescued, from a tour boat carrying 27 people that sinks west of Vargas Island, off the coast of Tofino on Vancouver Island, British Columbia, Canada. The RCMP is responsible for the missing person now that the search has been called off.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV](<http://bc.ctvnews.ca/fatalities-reported-after-tour-boat-sinks-off-tofino-b-c-1.2627096>); [CNN](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-10-26/four-dead-after-whale-watching-boat-sinks-off-canada/6884952>); [Canadian Broadcasting Corporation](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/british-columbia/tour-vessel-sinks-off-tofino-with-fatalities-1.3288191>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-10-25-3-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Eleven European and Balkan leaders meet about the migrant crisis at an emergency summit in Brussels, Belgium; Turkey did not attend. The Prime Minister of Slovenia says the EU will ‘start falling apart’ within weeks if the migrant crisis continues unchecked. Huge divisions remain among EU states over how to deal with the influx of hundreds of thousands of migrants.

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/nationworld/ct-europe-migrants-20151025-story.html>); [Radio New Zealand](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/news/world/288016/emergency-eu-talks-on-migrant-crisis-begin>); [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-3289223/EU-weeks-away-falling-apart-Dire-warning-countries-battle-cope-influx-migrants.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-25-3-2"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Balkan and European leaders agree to work together implementing a 17-point action plan that includes United Nations-aided accommodation for 100,000 places in reception centers along the route from Greece towards Germany, half in Greece and half in the countries to the north. Some of the other measures: within a week, deploy 400 police officers to Slovenia; step up efforts to return migrants not needing international protection; and, reinforce support of the bloc’s border agency, Frontex', role in securing external borders between Bulgaria, Turkey, Greece, Macedonia, and Albania.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/26/us-europe-migrants-plan-idUSKCN0SJ12L20151026>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/oct/26/eu-and-balkan-leaders-agree-migration-plan>).

<a id="event-2015-10-25-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** United States military and intelligence sources cite concerns about Russian activities near undersea cables that suggest plans to intercept or cut communication over these vital links.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/10/26/world/europe/russian-presence-near-undersea-cables-concerns-us.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-25-5-1"></a>

Context: Polish parliamentary election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Official results show Poland's conservative Law and Justice (PiS) party, led by eurosceptic Jarosław Kaczyński and the new PM Beata Szydło, won more seats than any other party in today's general elections. Kaczyński is the twin brother of the late President Lech Kaczyński, who died in a 2010 jet crash. Prime Minister Ewa Kopacz has conceded defeat.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/e2c6f764f2cc4f5d98aea1d7a7b85527/democrat-john-bel-edwards-heads-louisiana-governor-runoff>).

Context: Haitian presidential election, 2015, Haitian parliamentary election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Unlike the first round of the Haitian parliamentary elections when balloting was cancelled in 22 constituencies, voting appeared orderly, and largely peaceful, with a large turnout in Sunday's presidential and parliamentary second round elections. Electoral officials said there might be partial results in 10 days but final results would not be ready until late November. Haitians faced lengthy ballots featuring 54 presidential hopefuls and significant numbers of legislative and municipal candidates. An expected runoff between the top two presidential candidates is scheduled for December 27.

With 80 percent of polling places reporting, opposition, Republican Proposal (PRO) candidate Mauricio Macri, and ruling party, Justicialist Party (PJ) candidate Daniel Scioli each have 35 percent of the votes.

<a id="event-2015-10-26-0-2"></a>

<a id="event-2015-10-26-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs reports at least 120,000 people have been displaced in Syria this month because of fighting. These displaced Syrians need tents, basic household items, food, water and sanitation services. The agency's humanitarian partners are scaling up their response.

Alleged Russian Defence Ministry official added that the special forces, who are "akin to the Delta Force of the United States", had been operating in pro-Russian rebel held areas of Ukraine before being called off to Syria.

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-10-26-2-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Hindu Kush earthquake.

**Archived source account.** An earthquake measuring 7.5 on the Moment magnitude scale (MMS) strikes in the Hindu Kush mountain range in northeastern Afghanistan, 158 miles from Kabul, in the remote province of Badakhshan, one of Afghanistan’s most inaccessible regions. Tremors reached as far as New Delhi, India. At least 263 are dead in Afghanistan and nearby northern Pakistan with more than 1,000 injured. The death toll will likely climb since communications in much of the affected areas are cut, and rescue teams had not yet reached districts closest to the epicenter, including some that are controlled by Taliban insurgents.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-34636269>); [Financial Express](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151028154638/http://www.financialexpress.com/article/miscellaneous/earthquake-hits-delhi/156913/>); [USGS](<https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/us10003re5#general_summary>); [Dawn](<http://www.dawn.com/news/1215519/75-magnitude-earthquake-strikes-pakistan-at-least-31-dead>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/26/earthquake-afghanistan-idUSL3N12Q3C520151026>); [L.A. Times](<http://www.latimes.com/world/afghanistan-pakistan/la-fg-afghan-earthquake-20151026-story.html>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/f92c69a9afaa45c698d9b3892a02996f/latest-strong-afghan-earthquake-felt-across-south-asia>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-10-26-3-1"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabia–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabian ambassador to the United Kingdom Prince Mohammed bin Nawaf bin Abdulaziz, in an op-ed piece in the The Daily Telegraph, warns of "potentially serious repercussions" for the two countries' relationship unless a more respectful discourse developed. At issue is London's withdrawal from a £5.9m (US$9.1m) prison deal with Saudi Arabia which has been linked to London's concerns about a death penalty case and a case involving Karl Andree, a 74-year-old Briton who faces 350 lashes. Today, the Saudi Supreme Court confirmed Sheikh Nimr al-Nimr's death sentence.

The aircraft uses Lockheed Martin technologies -- including avionics -- and as such requires permission under the U.S. Arms Export Control Act for its sale to other countries.

### 2015-10-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1181388643](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20October%2027&oldid=1181388643>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-27-0-1"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** A Yemeni hospital in Saada run by Médecins Sans Frontières (Doctors Without Borders) is destroyed by several Saudi-led coalition airstrikes overnight. The director of the hospital, Ali Mughli, reported "The air raids resulted in the destruction of the entire hospital with all that was inside - devices and medical supplies - and the moderate wounding of several people". Another airstrike hit a nearby girls school and damaged several civilian homes according to local media. UNICEF said the Saada hospital was the 39th health center hit in Yemen since March. The Saudi-led coalition denies that its planes had hit the hospital.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/10/27/uk-yemen-security-idUKKCN0SL0WE20151027>).

<a id="event-2015-10-27-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Destruction of cultural heritage by ISIL.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reports the Islamic State, on Sunday, executed three detainees in the ancient Syrian city of Palmyra by strapping them to pillars and blowing them up with the antiquities. ISIL has yet to tell locals the identities of the three individuals or say why they had been killed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-34647186>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2015/10/27/report-isil-blows-up-prisoners-antiquities/74670628/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-27-0-5"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–2021), American-led intervention in Syria.

**Archived source account.** United States Defense Secretary Ashton Carter says the U.S. will begin "direct action on the ground" against the ISIL forces in Iraq and Syria, aiming to intensify pressure on the militants as progress against the militants remains elusive. The U.S. has done some special operations raids in Syria, e.g., last week's rescue operation with Kurdish forces in northern Iraq to free hostages held by ISIL. Carter also said the U.S. would intensify the air campaign against ISIL with heavier airstrikes and will focus on Raqqa, the group's declared capital in Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/sec-carter-direct-u-s-action-ground-iraq-syria-n452131>); [Al Jazeera](<http://america.aljazeera.com/articles/2015/10/27/usa-to-step-up-airstrikes-ground-raids-against-isil.html>); [AP](<https://www.bostonglobe.com/news/nation/2015/10/27/obama-weighs-moving-troops-closer-front-lines-syria-ira/COeqfPBwQZZnoYrZTL6L8H/story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-27-0-7"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A Libyan helicopter carrying cash for a local bank on the way out and returning to Tripoli with passengers is shot down near the coastal Almaya area west of the capital city, killing at least 14 of its 23 passengers including senior officers Hosein Bodaya and Duhain Al-Rammah, officials with Libya’s Dawn militias.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151028121152/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/helicopter-shot-libya-14-killed-34767113>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-34651249>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/10/27/Libya-At-least-12-people-killed-in-helicopter-crash-near-Tripoli/3921445968995/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-27-0-9"></a>

Context: Israeli-Palestinian conflict (2015).

**Archived source account.** Three Palestinians are shot dead after attacking Israeli soldiers with knives in the occupied West Bank. Jerusalem's Hadassah Hospital reports that 76-year old American-Israeli Richard Lakin, who was critically injured in a bus attack on October 13, 2015, died of his injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/27/us-israel-palestinians-idUSKCN0SL1QY20151027>); [Israel Hayom](<http://www.israelhayom.com/site/newsletter_article.php?id=29251>).

<a id="event-2015-10-27-0-11"></a>

Context: War in North-West Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** Pakistan says seven of its soldiers have been killed in the South Waziristan tribal region by fire from across the border with Afghanistan. The soldiers belonged to the Frontier Corps; the attack targeted a checkpoint northeast of the border village of Angoor Adda.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/10/27/Cross-border-firing-from-Afghanistan-kills-seven-Pakistani-soldiers/4211445982953/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_int>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-34647241>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-10-27-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In a plea bargain with U.S. federal prosecutors, Rohit Bansal, a former Goldman Sachs banker accused of using private information leaked by source inside the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, has agreed to plead guilty. The leaked information was said to have given Goldman an undue advantage regarding client advisement. Goldman also faces fines from the New York State’s Department of Financial Services.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/10/27/business/dealbook/criminal-charges-and-50-million-fine-expected-in-goldman-new-york-fed-case.html?ref=business>).

<a id="event-2015-10-27-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Walgreens Boots Alliance agrees to buy Rite Aid for US$9.4 billion in a move which will create a retail pharmaceutical giant with 13,000 stores.

Source citations (as archived): [Dow Jones](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151028040725/http://www.foxbusiness.com/markets/2015/10/27/walgreens-boots-to-buy-rite-aid-in-172-billion-deal/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-27-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Northrop Grumman, the developer of the Air Force's current bomber, the B-2, beats out the Boeing-Lockheed Martin team and is awarded the Pentagon contract to build a fleet of stealthy planes known as the Long Range Strike Bomber (LRS-B).

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/economy/pentagon-to-award-long-range-strike-bomber-contract-tuesday/2015/10/27/7f299748-7cc3-11e5-beba-927fd8634498_story.html>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/10/27/politics/long-range-strike-bomber-northrop-grumman/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-10-27-2-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Hindu Kush earthquake.

**Archived source account.** Rescuers continue a search for survivors of the earthquake in Afghanistan and Pakistan including in areas controlled by the Taliban. The death toll from the earthquake is 339 with many thousands injured.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-10-27/rescuers-search-rubble-for-survivors-of-massive-south-asia-quake/6889008>); [Himalayan Times](<http://thehimalayantimes.com/world/death-toll-reaches-339-in-quake-hit-pakistani-afghan-areas/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-27-2-2"></a>

Context: 2015 Hindu Kush earthquake.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban, which effectively controls some of the worst-affected areas across multiple provinces, urged charity organizations not to hold back in delivering aid to Afghan victims of the quake, saying militants in the affected areas were ordered to provide "complete help."

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/27/us-earthquake-afghanistan-idUSKCN0SL08I20151027>); [Daily Star](<https://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/World/2015/Oct-27/320411-taliban-vow-to-help-afghanistan-after-deadly-quake.ashx>).

<a id="event-2015-10-27-2-4"></a>

Context: 2015 Southeast Asian haze.

**Archived source account.** Indonesian forest fires have advanced into dense forest on Borneo and now threaten one third of the world’s remaining wild orangutans, say conservationists.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<http://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/1872835/indonesias-forest-fires-spread-third-worlds-wild-orangutans>); [ABC news](<http://abcnews.go.com/US/thousands-orangutans-threatened-indonesia-wildfires/story?id=34765173>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-10-27-3-1"></a>

Context: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea, China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** A United States Navy ship, the USS Lassen, sails near the Spratly Islands, challenging Beijing's claim that the islands are Chinese territory. China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs strongly condemned the actions of the United States in the South China Sea, saying “China will firmly react to this deliberate provocation".

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/u-s-navy-ship-sails-near-islands-claimed-by-china-1445908192?mod=djemalertNEWS>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2015/10/26/452074317/u-s-destroyer-nears-disputed-islands-in-south-china-sea>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/10/28/world/asia/south-china-sea-uss-lassen-spratly-islands.html?partner=rss&amp;emc=rss&amp;smid=tw-nytimes&amp;smtyp=cur>).

<a id="event-2015-10-27-3-2"></a>

Context: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea, China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Chinese Vice Foreign Minister Zhang Yesui summons US ambassador Max Baucus to protest a US naval patrol close to Beijing's man-made islands in the South China Sea. Zhang called the US patrol "extremely irresponsible" and urged Washington to cease actions that harm China's sovereignty and security.

Source citations (as archived): [Hong Kong Standard](<http://www.thestandard.com.hk/news_detail.asp?we_cat=3&amp;art_id=162583&amp;sid=45453823&amp;con_type=3&amp;d_str=20151028&amp;fc=2>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/oct/27/us-warship-lassen-defies-beijing-sail-disputed-south-china-sea-islands>).

<a id="event-2015-10-27-3-3"></a>

Context: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea, China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Greg Poling, a director at the Center for Strategic and International Studies in Washington, says the U.S. operation was aimed at testing control of the seas, not sovereignty over the disputed islands, to force a clarification of China's claims. Under maritime law, artificial islands were not usually afforded the 12-mile territorial zone, and that the U.S. Navy deliberately chose to send the destroyer near Subi Reef for this reason.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/10/27/asia/us-china-south-china-sea/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-27-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Humanitarian International Services Group, an NGO founded by evangelical Christian Kay Miramine, was part of a secret Pentagon program devised by Lt. Gen. William Boykin used to spy on North Korea, according to an investigation by the online publication The Intercept. The program, which started in 2004, was shut down in 2012 by now-retired Admiral William McRaven, concerned with pushback if this became public. Some current and former American NGO staff with experience in North Korea have expressed doubts about key claims in the report.

Source citations (as archived): [The Intercept](<https://theintercept.com/2015/10/26/pentagon-missionary-spies-christian-ngo-front-for-north-korea-espionage/>); [Christian Post](<http://www.christiantoday.com/article/pentagon.used.christian.aid.group.to.spy.on.north.korea/68848.htm>); [NK News](<http://www.nknews.org/2015/10/doubts-surface-about-n-korea-missionary-spies-intel-program/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-27-3-6"></a>

Context: Vienna Conference on Syria, Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Iran is invited to attend the next round of talks over Syria's future, along with the representatives from the United States, Russia, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Britain, France, Germany, Jordan, the United Arab Emirates, and the United Nations mediator for Syria, Staffan de Mistura. The next round of the "Vienna II" meeting is expected to start tomorrow and continue Friday in Vienna, Austria.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Examiner](<http://www.irishexaminer.com/world/iran-invited-to-next-round-of-syria-talks-us-361729.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/27/us-mideast-crisis-syria-talks-idUSKCN0SL2OH20151027>); [Sputnik News](<http://sputniknews.com/middleeast/20151028/1029205056/iran-syria-civil-war-talks.html>); [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/10/28/world/middleeast/iran-is-invited-to-join-us-russia-and-europe-for-talks-on-syrias-future.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-27-3-7"></a>

Context: Vienna Conference on Syria, Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** United Nations humanitarian chief Stephen O'Brien tells the Security Council the worsening conflict in Syria has left 13.5 million people in need of aid and some form of protection, including more than six million children.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/5210f48c1ef8455a9860e862c509893a/un-says-135-million-syrians-need-aid-and-protection>); [Arab News](<http://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/news/826721>).

<a id="event-2015-10-27-3-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations General Assembly overwhelmingly condemns the U.S. embargo of Cuba in its first vote on the matter since the start of normalization of relations between the two countries. The largely symbolic tally on the unenforceable resolution was 191 to 2 (U.S., Israel).

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2015/10/27/UN-condemns-US-embargo-of-Cuba/2131445968548/?spt=hts&amp;or=3>); [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151028135013/http://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/us-oppose-resolution-condemning-cuba-embargo-34764735>).

<a id="event-2015-10-27-3-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** President Benigno Aquino III says the Philippines doesn't have the capacity to permanently house Manus Island refugees from Australian-run detention camps.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/philippines-studying-australian-plan-to-send-refugees/2015/10/27/42d7af80-7c89-11e5-bfb6-65300a5ff562_story.html>); [Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/world/philippines-says-has-no-capacity-to-resettle-asylum-seekers-held-by-australia-on-nauru-or-manus-island-20151027-gkk5vy.html>).

**Archived source account.** Guatemala arrests 11 in a public hospital, medicine-buying kickback scheme. Two others remain at large, including Gustavo Alejos Cambara, the former private secretary to ex-President Álvaro Colom. A U.N. commission set up to tackle criminal networks in Guatemala participated in the investigation.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-10-27-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Britain is reviewing the powers of the House of Lords after the unelected peers stalled legislation yesterday that would have eliminated some tax allowances for the nation’s poor. Senior Conservatives say the upper chamber of Parliament stepped out of their usual roles as technical overseers of legislation. However, Conservative MP David Davis warned that such a move was “bully politics” that would “disgust” the public.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-34647544>); [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/uk-reviews-powers-of-house-of-lords-after-tax-vote/2015/10/27/7de24570-7c9f-11e5-bfb6-65300a5ff562_story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-27-5-2"></a>

Context: Ivorian presidential election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Partial results from Sunday's election give Ivory Coast's President Alassane Ouattara an overwhelming lead (83.18 percent) on the way to a second five-year term. This weekend's vote was judged to be peaceful and transparent by observers, making it the first in Côte d'Ivoire’s history not to be marred by serious rights violations or irregularities.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/28/us-ivorycoast-election-idUSKCN0SL2VI20151028>); [Financial Times](<http://www.ft.com/cms/s/0/6d5d7084-7c91-11e5-98fb-5a6d4728f74e.html#axzz3ppfjCGEj>); [Abidjan.net](<http://www.abidjan.net/ELECTIONS/presidentielle/2015/resultats.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-28-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Taliban insurgents seize the Darqad District in the northeast Takhar Province near the border with Tajikistan. At least six Afghan troops are killed in the fighting.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/28/us-afghanistan-quake-idUSKCN0SM0JH20151028?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>); [AP](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/ap/article-3293022/Taliban-overrun-remote-northern-district-Afghanistan.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-28-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Michael Fallon, Secretary of State for Defence for the United Kingdom, announces that over 400 troops will remain in Afghanistan through 2016. The military personnel will train Afghan toops and support NATO operations in Kabul.

Source citations (as archived): [Military Times](<http://www.militarytimes.com/story/military/2015/10/27/britain-keep-450-troops-afghanistan-through-2016/74672412/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-28-0-4"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Suspected Boko Haram militants kill 14 civilians in the southeast Diffa Region of Niger near the Nigerian border. The Nigerien government recently approved a law prolonging a 15-day state of emergency for the Diffa region by three months in a bid to boost security.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/28/us-nigeria-boko-haram-idUSKCN0SM13920151028?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=worldNews>).

<a id="event-2015-10-28-0-6"></a>

Context: 2015 Ankara bombings.

**Archived source account.** Ankara's Chief Prosecutor's office says it has "strong evidence" that an Islamic State group — based in Gaziantep, near the Syrian border — is behind the bombings at this month's Ankara peace rally that killed 102 people, as well as four previous attacks in Turkey since May that have mainly targeted supporters of a pro-Kurdish party.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/8b5b07e7a39b47e387865f352d2a6812/prosecutors-local-cell-behind-ankara-peace-rally-attacks>); [AFP](<http://www.ndtv.com/world-news/ankara-bombings-were-ordered-by-islamic-state-turkish-prosecutors-1237404>).

<a id="event-2015-10-28-1-2"></a>

Context: 2015 Hindu Kush earthquake.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from Monday's quake rises to 385.

<a id="event-2015-10-28-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A military JLENS blimp from the United States Army broke loose from its moorings at the Aberdeen Proving Ground in Maryland, and drifted over 16,000 ft above Pennsylvania. F-16 Fighter jets were scrambled to track the blimp that has since deflated, causing widespread power outages from a long cable it dragged along the ground.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/fighter-jets-track-military-blimp-drifting-over-pennsylvania-n453106>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/the-switch/wp/2015/10/28/the-army-lost-control-of-a-giant-unmanned-surveillance-blimp/>).
