Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Greek coastguard says they rescued 242 migrants whose wooden boat sank north of the island of Lesbos, but at least three drowned, including two small boys.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/28/us-migrants-greece-shipwreck-idUSKCN0SM2MI20151028>); [AP](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/at-least-3-dead-242-rescued-after-migrant-boat-capsizes-off-greece/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-10-28-2-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Slovenia's prime minister, Miro Cerar says Slovenia is ready to build a fence on its border with Croatia if an EU plan to stem the flow of migrants across the Balkans fails.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151029131606/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/latest-sweden-asylum-centers-secret-34786612>).

<a id="event-2015-10-28-2-2"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Austrian Chancellor Werner Faymann, when discussing management of the flow of migrants with the press, talks about "technical security" measures but insists there will be "no fence" at the Slovenian border. This, in contrast to Interior Minister Johanna Mikl-Leitner who earlier spoke of plans for a "fence" on the border to Slovenia. Austria has been one of the more vocal countries criticizing Hungary's decision to build a fence along its border with Serbia.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/ebe3ccdeca96427885e37713a88d8e73/latest-sweden-keep-asylum-centers-secret>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34657187>).

<a id="event-2015-10-28-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Government of Japan invalidates a decision by Takeshi Onaga, governor of Okinawa, to halt the expansion of a U.S. military base on the island.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg Business](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-10-27/japan-overturns-move-to-block-expansion-of-u-s-base-in-okinawa>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-10-28-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The World Health Organization reports tuberculosis has surpassed human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), as the leading cause of global death, despite the death rate from tuberculosis having been cut in half over the last 25 years. Most deaths from tuberculosis could be prevented, researchers said, but detection and treatment aren't happening fast enough.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Health_News/2015/10/28/WHO-Tuberculosis-passes-HIV-as-leading-global-cause-of-death/7391446056825/?spt=hs&amp;or=hn>).

<a id="event-2015-10-28-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC), the cancer agency of the World Health Organization (WHO), has evaluated the carcinogenicity of the consumption of red meat and processed meat. After thoroughly reviewing the accumulated scientific literature, a Working Group of 22 experts from 10 countries convened by the IARC Monographs Programme classified the consumption of red meat as probably carcinogenic to humans (Group 2A), based on limited evidence that the consumption of red meat causes cancer in humans and strong mechanistic evidence supporting a carcinogenic effect. This association was observed mainly for colorectal cancer, but associations were also seen for pancreatic cancer and prostate cancer. Processed meat was classified as carcinogenic to humans (Group 1), based on sufficient evidence in humans that the consumption of processed meat causes colorectal cancer.

Source citations (as archived): [Science Daily](<http://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2015/10/151027135116.htm>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-10-28-4-1"></a>

Context: Censorship in Turkey.

**Archived source account.** Turkish police storm and shut down both Kanaltürk TV and Bugün, TV stations that have been critical of the ruling Justice and Development Party (AKP) ahead of a general election on November 1. Baris Yarkadas, a lawmaker with the main-opposition Republican People's Party (CHP), said “We are witnessing the police entering news organizations, delivering declarations and taking over journalists’ seats—just like junta periods, this is called a police state”.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/turkey-police-raid-tv-stations-of-government-critics-1446038925>); [Today's Zaman](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151028201824/http://www.todayszaman.com/national_police-forcibly-cut-broadcast-of-bugun-tv-and-kanalturk-after-seizure-of-koza-i-pek_402784.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-28-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Aberdeen, Scotland, one student has died of injuries, and another has been arrested, after a stabbing at Cults Academy

Source citations (as archived): [Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/aberdeen-school-attack-pupil-seriously-injured-at-cults-academy-a6712201.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-28-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Dennis Hastert, former United States Speaker of the House of Representatives (1999–2007), pleaded guilty to a federal financial crime in a hush money case stemming from sexual misconduct allegations. The sentencing hearing is scheduled for February 29, 2016. The crime carries a sentence of up to five years in prison and $250,000 fine. Prosecutors recommend zero to six months imprisonment.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/28/us-usa-crime-hastert-idUSKCN0SM17Z20151028>); [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151029140235/http://abcnews.go.com/Politics/wireStory/timeline-events-dennis-hasterts-life-career-34799633>).

Context: Ivorian presidential election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Official results from the presidential election held on Sunday show that President of the Ivory Coast Alassane Ouattara has been reelected.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/afp/article-3293043/Ivory-Coasts-Ouattara-tough-minded-economist-president.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-28-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the Netherlands, the Undersecretary for Infrastructure and Environment Wilma Mansveld resigns following the publication of a damning report about the problems with the international high-speed rail service Fyra.

Source citations (as archived): [DutchNews](<http://www.dutchnews.nl/news/archives/2015/10/junior-transport-minister-resigns-over-damning-rail-report/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-28-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Members of the Republican party in the United States House of Representatives nominate Paul Ryan of Wisconsin to replace John Boehner of Ohio as Speaker of the House. There will be a formal vote Thursday on the House floor.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/10/29/us/politics/republicans-paul-ryan-house-speaker.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-28-5-5"></a>

Context: Tanzanian general election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Tanzania's opposition Chadema party presidential candidate Edward Lowassa calls for a recount of Sunday's election for the presidency before official results are announced tomorrow. Meanwhile, the election commission chief of semi-autonomous Zanzibar nullifies their results, which opposition presidential candidate Seif Sharif Hamad of the Civic United Front announced he won on Monday. The United States said it's "gravely alarmed" and called for reversal of the annulment.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151029153012/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/official-nullifies-results-zanzibar-presidential-poll-34788022>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2015/10/28/tanzania-election-idINKCN0SM1J020151028>); [Mail &amp; Guardian Africa](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151029161137/http://mgafrica.com/article/2015-10-28-zanzibar-vote-annulled-in-tanzania-elections>).

<a id="event-2015-10-28-5-7"></a>

Context: Myanmar general election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** A United Nations rights investigator raises concern whether Myanmar's election, scheduled for November 8, 2015, could be considered free and fair because dozens of candidates have been disqualified and hundreds of thousands of people denied the right to vote.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/28/us-myanmar-election-un-idUSKCN0SM2W420151028>); [Council on Foreign Relations](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151029151417/http://blogs.cfr.org/asia/2015/10/28/will-irregularities-and-fraud-spoil-myanmars-election/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-28-5-9"></a>

Context: Elections in Nepal.

**Archived source account.** The Nepalese Parliament elects the country's first female president, Communist Party of Nepal (Unified Marxist–Leninist) vice-chairperson Bidhya Devi Bhandari, by a vote of 327 to 214.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/oct/28/nepalese-parliament-first-female-president-bidhya-devi-bhandari>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2015-10-28-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Cassini probe makes a close flyby of Saturn's sixth-largest moon, Enceladus, coming within approximately 49 km of the surface and passing through the icy plume above the south pole. The transit of the plume was the deepest to date. Photographs and other data from the mission are expected within 48 hours.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Online](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-34593944>); [JPL Press Release](<http://saturn.jpl.nasa.gov/news/newsreleases/newsrelease20151028/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-28-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** An article published in Nature reports high levels of molecular oxygen found by the Rosetta space probe on comet 67P/Churyumov-Gerasimenko. This discovery could have implications for theories of the origin of the solar system.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand Online](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/news/world/288301/comet-gives-clues-to-earth%27s-beginning>); [BBC Online](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-34660576>); [Nature Press Release](<http://www.nature.com/news/rosetta-sniffs-oxygen-around-comet-67p-1.18658#/b1>); [Nature Article Synopsis](<http://www.nature.com/nature/journal/v526/n7575/full/nature15707.html>).

### 2015-10-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1173936935](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20October%2029&oldid=1173936935>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-29-0-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** The death toll from a rocket attack on a camp containing members of an Iranian opposition group next to Baghdad International Airport rises to 23.

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/Death-toll-in-Baghdad-attack-reportedly-climbs-to-23-430540>).

#### Art and culture

<a id="event-2015-10-29-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Adele's "Hello" beats Miley Cyrus's "Wrecking Ball" as the fastest video on Vevo to reach 100 million views and is also certified as the official Vevo Record holder.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/tvshowbiz/article-3294769/Adele-s-Hello-smashes-Miley-Cyrus-Vevo-record-Wrecking-Ball-new-music-video-viewed-100m-times-FIVE-days.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-29-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabian blogger Raif Badawi, who has been sentenced to 1,000 lashes and 10 years in jail for insulting Islam and for cyber crime, wins the European Union's prestigious Sakharov Prize for Freedom of Thought. The Sakharov award ceremony will be held in Strasbourg, France on December 16, 2015 while the laureate remains imprisoned.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/29/us-eu-rights-badawi-idUSKCN0SN1FT20151029>); [Al Jazeera](<http://america.aljazeera.com/articles/2015/10/29/jailed-saudi-blogger-raif-badawi-awarded-rights-prize.html>); [EU](<http://www.europarl.europa.eu/news/en/news-room/content/20151023STO99024/html/European-Parliament-awards-Sakharov-Prize-to-Raif-Badawi>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-10-29-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The largest lender in Europe’s most robust economy, Deutsche Bank AG, will cut 35k jobs in an effort to counter falling profits.

Source citations (as archived): [WSJ](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/deutsche-bank-posts-6-6-billion-loss-1446104427>).

<a id="event-2015-10-29-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sony announces $278.2 million in net profits for the quarter ending Sept. 30, beating market expectations.

Source citations (as archived): [WSJ](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/sony-bullish-on-playstation-as-it-swings-to-profit-1446100105>).

<a id="event-2015-10-29-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Google announces that Project Loon – to provide wireless access to four billion unconnected people around the globe in rural and remote areas via Internet-beaming helium balloons in the stratosphere – will be tested in Indonesia in 2016. Currently, one in three Indonesians are connected to the web, mostly via slow connections, in this 17,508-island archipelago of over 250 million people (and about 319 million mobile phones). The company, which also tested Loon-delivered internet in Chile, New Mexico (U.S.), and Sri Lanka, hopes to deliver LTE-speed to more than 100 million unconnected Indonesians in five years.

Source citations (as archived): [ZDNET](<http://www.zdnet.com/article/google-balloon-fleet-to-broadcast-internet-to-17000-indonesian-islands/>); [AFP](<http://www.khmertimeskh.com/news/17285/google----loon----internet-balloons-set-for-indonesian-skies/>); [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151030111146/http://www.chicagotribune.com/bluesky/technology/sns-bc-us--alphabet-internet-balloons-20151028-story.html>); [Google](<https://googleblog.blogspot.com/2015/10/indonesia-loon-internet.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-10-29-3-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** An extensive search is underway in the northeastern Aegean Sea off the Greek island of Lesbos for at least 34 people missing from a boat that sank yesterday. Some 242 people were rescued but eight died, five children, two men and a woman.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/29/us-europe-greece-migrants-idUSKCN0SN1BA20151029>); [AP](<http://www.ekathimerini.com/202947/article/ekathimerini/news/greece-raises-death-toll-to-8-from-capsized-boat>).

<a id="event-2015-10-29-3-2"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Britain's Ministry of Defence says the Royal Navy has rescued 541 people this week as they scoured the Mediterranean Sea in operations to counter refugee smugglers. The HMS Enterprise, a survey vessel, rescued 439 migrants, and HMS Richmond, a Type 23 frigate, rescued 102 migrants. The asylum-seekers were transferred to the Norwegian support ship Fiem Pilote.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.chron.com/news/crime/article/The-Latest-Dozens-missing-after-migrant-boat-6597515.php>).

<a id="event-2015-10-29-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A series of blasts at an ammunition depot in Svatove, Luhansk region of eastern Ukraine leaves four dead and eight injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyiv Post](<http://www.kyivpost.com/content/ukraine/international-committee-of-red-cross-hundreds-of-people-affected-by-explosion-of-ammunition-depot-401077.html>); [Interfax](<http://en.interfax.com.ua/news/general/301051.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-29-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** An engine burst into flames on a Dynamic International Airways Boeing 767 passenger jet bound for Caracas, Venezuela, while taxiing for takeoff at Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (Florida, U.S.). A Broward Sheriff Fire Rescue spokesman said 15 people were taken to the hospital after the fire. There were 110 people, including crew, on board.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/29/us-florida-dynamic-idUSKCN0SN2CJ20151029>); [AP](<http://lompocrecord.com/news/national/the-latest-injured-in-florida-plane-fire-burned/article_baf86de2-1c00-5e00-b253-ee5557fae25b.html>).

#### International Relations

<a id="event-2015-10-29-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Amnesty International accuses Australian border protection officials of illegally paying people smugglers and endangering lives in a bid to prevent boats of asylum seekers from reaching the country via Operation Sovereign Borders. Australia's government rejects Amnesty's report and denies any wrongdoing.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2015/10/29/human-rights-group-accuses-australia-paying-smugglers-to-turn-refugee-boats-around/>); [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.com/australia-paid-people-smugglers-turn-back-refugee-boats-committed-transnational-crime-2161546>); [AI](<https://www.amnesty.org/en/press-releases/2015/10/australia-damning-evidence-of-officials-involvement-in-transnational-crime-uncovered/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-29-4-2"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabia–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** British Foreign Secretary Philip Hammond says 74-year old Karl Andree, who was facing 350 lashes in Saudi Arabia after being caught with homemade wine in his car, will be released within a week.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1577750/karl-andree-saudi-to-release-man-facing-lashes>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/uknews/11960683/British-grandfather-Karl-Andree-to-be-released-from-Saudi-Arabia-prison.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-29-4-4"></a>

Context: South Sudanese Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A long-awaited report released by an African Union investigative team led by former Nigerian President Olusegun Obasanjo describes atrocities and the discovery of mass graves in South Sudan, citing government forces and their allies as responsible parties.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera America](<http://america.aljazeera.com/articles/2015/10/28/report-mass-graves-rape-cannibalism-in-south-sudan.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-29-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Union narrowly votes (285–281) to recommend that its 28 member nations drop criminal charges against Edward Snowden and protect him from U.S. extradition and to recognize him as a defender of human rights because of his revelations regarding U.S. and British spying.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/10/29/EU-to-member-states-Drop-charges-protect-human-rights-defender-Snowden-from-US/2301446163234/>); [Foreign Policy](<https://foreignpolicy.com/2015/10/29/eu-parliament-calls-for-snowden-to-get-asylum/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-29-4-7"></a>

Context: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea, China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** As a result of talks between U.S. Chief of Naval Operations Admiral John Richardson and Chinese Commander of the People's Liberation Army Navy Admiral Wu Shengli about a U.S. warship's transit with 12 nautical miles of China's man-made islands in the South China Sea, the United States and China agree to maintain dialogue and follow Code for Unplanned Encounters at Sea protocols, according to a U.S. official.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/30/us-southchinasea-usa-china-idUSKCN0SM2ER20151030>); [The International News](<http://www.thenews.com.pk/Todays-News-1-348445-Top-US-Chinese-naval-officers-hold-video-talks>).

<a id="event-2015-10-29-4-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lockheed Martin vice president of air and missile defense Mike Trotsky tells the National Press Club in Washington, D.C., that the United States and South Korea are holding both formal and informal discussions on THAAD (Terminal High Altitude Area Defense System) deployment. South Korea's Defense Ministry and the U.S. Department of Defense deny the report.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/10/29/South-Korea-says-it-has-no-plans-to-discuss-THAAD-deployment/8791446169312/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_int>); [Yonhap News](<http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/national/2015/10/30/0301000000AEN20151030000253315.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-29-4-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** The carrier USS Ronald Reagan, during a military exercise with South Korea in the Sea of Japan's international waters, scrambled four fighter jets to intercept approaching Russian warplanes, according to the U.S. Navy. IHS Jane's Defence Weekly said encounters such as these were common during the Cold War, subsided with its end but picked up again under current Russian President Vladimir Putin.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/29/us-usa-russia-defense-idUSKCN0SN20E20151029>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/10/29/politics/us-aircraft-carrier-russian-plane-encounter/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-10-29-5-1"></a>

Context: One-child policy.

**Archived source account.** China has decided to end its controversial one-child policy after 36 years. It is to be replaced by a new two-child policy.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-34665539>); [Al Jazeera English](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/10/china-child-policy-151029110647826.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-29-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Oklahoma Department of Corrections says a drone carrying mobile phones, drugs, and hacksaw blades crashed at the Oklahoma State Penitentiary in McAlester before inmates could grab the contraband. This is fourth reported drone-attempt in the United States; the others were at prisons in Ohio, Maryland, and South Carolina.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1578220/drone-carrying-hacksaw-blades-crashes-at-prison>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Odd_News/2015/10/28/Drone-recovered-at-Oklahoma-prison-carrying-drugs-hacksaw-blades/5131446040903/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-10-29-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House of Representatives passes, by a vote of 266 to 167, a two-year federal budget that is both amenable to the White House and expected to pass in the Senate.

Source citations (as archived): [Defense News](<http://www.defensenews.com/story/defense/policy-budget/budget/2015/10/28/house-passes-federal-budget-deal/74769392/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-29-6-2"></a>

Context: Speaker of the United States House of Representatives election, October 2015.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House of Representatives elects Paul Ryan of Wisconsin as the 62nd Speaker of the House replacing John Boehner of Ohio.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/10/30/us/politics/paul-ryan-set-to-take-over-as-speaker-hoping-to-manage-the-chaos.html?hp&amp;action=click&amp;pgtype=Homepage&amp;module=first-column-region&amp;region=top-news&amp;WT.nav=top-news&amp;_r=0>).

<a id="event-2015-10-29-6-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of Moldova passes a no-confidence vote against pro-EU incumbent prime-minister Valeriu Streleț's cabinet amidst growing political turmoil in the country.

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-10-29-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Astronaut Scott Kelly sets another record; this time for the single-longest spaceflight (216 days) by an American. His ISS year long mission is a scientific research project to study the health effects of long term spaceflight. Astronaut Michael López-Alegría spent 215 consecutive days as Expedition 14 commander in 2006. Both are nowhere close to Valeri Polyakovs 437 days record.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/tech/tech-news/astronaut-scott-kelly-sets-another-record-time-space-n453876>); [NASA](<https://www.nasa.gov/feature/scott-kelly-becomes-us-astronaut-to-spend-the-most-time-living-in-space>).

<a id="event-2015-10-29-7-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations' World Meteorological Organization (WMO) announces that, earlier this month, the Antarctic ozone hole widened to one of its largest sizes on record. A colder than usual stratosphere widened the hole to a peak of 28.2 million square km (10.9 million square miles).

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<http://www.wtsp.com/story/news/2015/10/29/antarctic-ozone-hole-expands-near-record-size/74842060/>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2015/10/29/us-environment-ozone-idINKCN0SN1R920151029>).

**Archived source account.** In artistic gymnastics, Simone Biles of the United States becomes the first female gymnast to win three successive all-around championships at the 2015 World Artistic Gymnastics Championships held in Glasgow.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/29/us-gymnastics-world-idUSKCN0SN2TR20151029>); [NBC News](<http://olympics.nbcsports.com/2015/10/29/simone-biles-gabby-douglas-gymnastics-world-championships-all-around-olympics/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-30-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** At least 65 people are killed and 250 injured in Syrian government airstrikes targeting a marketplace in the city of Douma, Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [WSJ](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/at-least-50-syrians-killed-in-government-attack-1446205919>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/30/us-mideast-crisis-syria-missile-idUSKCN0SO0W020151030?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>); [Al Jazeera](<https://en-maktoob.news.yahoo.com/syrians-killed-government-jets-hit-market-douma-085636034.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-30-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / American-led intervention in Syria.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Barack Obama is set to send Special Operations forces to regions in northern Syria under Kurdish control to help local forces fight the Islamic State.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/10/31/world/obama-will-send-forces-to-syria-to-help-fight-the-islamic-state.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/30/us-mideast-crisis-syria-usa-idUSKCN0SO1VD20151030>).

<a id="event-2015-10-30-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Andrew Parker, head of British security agency MI5, states that ISIS terrorists are planning attacks in Great Britain and current terror threat levels are the highest he's witnessed in his career.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/uknews/terrorism-in-the-uk/11962037/Islamic-State-planning-mass-attack-on-Britain-warns-head-of-MI5.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-30-0-6"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict (2015).

**Archived source account.** Two assailants are shot dead by Israeli police after knife-wielding Palestinians attacked Israelis in Jerusalem and in the West Bank. Another four people, including a Palestinian assailant, are injured in incidents at an Israeli checkpoint outside the West Bank city of Nablus and at a tram station in East Jerusalem.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2015/10/30/israeli-palestinians-idINKCN0SO1HX20151030>); [Al Jazeera](<http://america.aljazeera.com/articles/2015/10/30/palestinian-killed-as-stabbings-and-clashes-continue.html>).

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** The Iranian-funded Shi'ite Al-Mukhtar Army claims responsibility for Thursday's deadly rocket attacks near the Baghdad International Airport that killed 23 members of an exiled Iranian opposition group, the People's Mujahedin of Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/30/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-iran-idUSKCN0SO14B20151030>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-10-30-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Happy Days actor Al Molinaro dies at 96.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/entertainment/tv/al-molinaro-character-actor-on-happy-days-and-odd-couple-dies-at-96/2015/10/30/b59dfe54-7f75-11e5-afce-2afd1d3eb896_story.html>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-10-30-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Quebec-based Valeant Pharmaceuticals International cut all ties with Philidor Rx Services. This comes in the wake of recent revelations that Valeant was looking to acquire Philidor, a relationship that raised questions from various quarters. Valeant is the subject of U.S. federal investigations.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/10/31/business/valeant-pharmaceuticals-philidor.html?ref=business>).

<a id="event-2015-10-30-2-1"></a>

Context: Quebec-based Valeant Pharmaceuticals International cut all ties with Philidor Rx Services. This comes in the wake of recent revelations that Valeant was looking to acquire Philidor, a relationship that raised questions from various quarters. Valeant is the subject of U.S. federal investigations..

**Archived source account.** America's two largest pharmacy benefit managers, CVS Health Corp. and Express Scripts, drop Philidor from their networks after an audit showed the company's "noncompliance" with its provider agreement. Bloomberg reports Philidor had written instructions to, in some cases, change codes on prescriptions so it would appear physicians required or patients desired Valeant’s brand-name drugs – not less expensive generic versions.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.businessinsider.com/r-cvs-express-scripts-drop-valeants-philidor-stock-dives-2015-10>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-10-29/philidor-said-to-modify-prescriptions-to-boost-valeant-sales>).

<a id="event-2015-10-30-2-3"></a>

Context: Volkswagen emissions scandal.

**Archived source account.** U.K. transport secretary Patrick McLoughlin says Volkswagen has to start financially addressing this problem by compensating motorists with, the estimated total is £600m (US$925 million).

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1578856/vw-drivers-could-get-600m-compensation>); [Bitterwallet](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151031125857/http://www.bitterwallet.com/vwcompensation-for-emissions-scandal-also-linked-to-deaths/88802>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-10-30-3-1"></a>

Context: Colectiv nightclub fire.

**Archived source account.** At least 27 people are killed and more than 180 hospitalized with injuries after a fire in a nightclub in the Romanian capital Bucharest. Officials say a heavy metal band's pyrotechnical show sparked a fire inside the Colectiv nightclub.

Source citations (as archived): [Sputnik News](<http://sputniknews.com/europe/20151031/1029367926.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34684973>); [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2015/10/30/26-reportedly-killed-in-explosion-fire-at-romanian-nightclub/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-30-3-3"></a>

Context: 2015 North Indian Ocean cyclone season.

**Archived source account.** Cyclone Chapala intensifies in the Arabian Sea as it heads towards Yemen and Oman which rarely experience tropical cyclones. The cyclone is expected to dump two years worth of rain on the normally arid Arabian Peninsula in two days.

Source citations (as archived): [Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.watoday.com.au/environment/weather/rare-tropical-cyclone-yemen-oman-expect-eight-years-of-rain-in-two-days-as-chapala-forms-in-arabian-sea-20151030-gkmyjl.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-30-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** One construction worker dies and at least one more is under the rubble from the collapse of a building being demolished to make way for a Starwood Hotels and Resorts Worldwide luxury boutique hotel in New York City.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151030224123/http://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/building-demolished-partially-collapses-nyc-dead-34853556>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/30/us-new-york-collapse-idUSKCN0SO20520151030>).

<a id="event-2015-10-30-3-6"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Greek prime minister Alexis Tsipras lashes out at European "ineptness" in handling the continent's massive immigration crisis. The Associated Press reports 31 more people — mostly children — drowned in shipwrecks in the Mediterranean Sea near the islands of Kalymnos and Rhodes. Turkey's state-run agency says four children drowned and two others are missing after two new accidents with boats headed to Greece's Lesbos and Samos islands. The death toll in the Aegean Sea over the past three days is at least 50. The Greek coast guard says they rescued 600 people in the past 24 hours, while thousands more made it safely from Turkey to Greece's southeastern islands.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/greece-capsized-boat-kills-22-migrants-in-aegean-sea_56336464e4b063179911ea8e>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/30/us-europe-migrants-greece-tsipras-idUSKCN0SO11A20151030>).

<a id="event-2015-10-30-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Storms hit the American state of Texas causing at least two deaths with one person reported missing. Rivers overflowed as more than a foot of rain fell in some areas while tornadoes ripped through buildings outside San Antonio.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/weather/possible-tornadoes-damage-buildings-across-south-texas-officials-n454441>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/30/us-texas-tornado-idUSKCN0SO1O220151030>).

<a id="event-2015-10-30-3-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** A building collapse in Henan province in central China leaves 17 workers dead and 23 injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<https://web.archive.org/web/20190909181328/http://www.icrosschina.com/news/2015/1031/20539.shtml>).

<a id="event-2015-10-30-3-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Virginia (U.S.) school bus overturns after being struck by a van, sending 28 students to local hospitals with five seriously injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Inside Edition](<http://www.insideedition.com/headlines/12699-28-students-injured-five-of-them-seriously-hurt-when-virginia-school-bus-overturns>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-10-30-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Shaker Aamer, the last British resident held at the Guantanamo Bay detention camp, is released. Aamer faces no charges in Britain; Scotland Yard detectives questioned him for three days during his detention.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-34675324#>); [AP](<http://www.seattletimes.com/nation-world/guantnamo-detainee-shaker-aamer-freed-after-13-years/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-30-4-2"></a>

Context: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea.

**Archived source account.** The European Union sides with the United States over Tuesday's U.S.-Chinese patrolling incident in the South China Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/30/us-southchinasea-usa-eu-idUSKCN0SO22G20151030>).

<a id="event-2015-10-30-4-4"></a>

Context: Syria peace talks in Vienna, Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Representatives from about 20 countries meet in Vienna, Austria, seeking a political solution to Syria's four-year civil war that has killed more than 250,000 people, including dozens more today. For the first time Iran is at the table, where diplomats seek peace through a ceasefire plan followed by a transitional government.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2015/10/30/fresh-bloodshed-syria-envoys-seek-peace-vienna/74865354/>); [Payvand.com](<http://www.payvand.com/news/15/oct/1160.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-10-30-5-1"></a>

Context: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea.

**Archived source account.** The Permanent Court of Arbitration in The Hague rules it has jurisdiction to hear the Philippines' case against China over maritime disputes in the South China Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [The Diplomat](<http://thediplomat.com/2015/10/philippines-v-china-court-rules-favorably-on-jurisdiction-case-will-proceed/>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-34671504>).

<a id="event-2015-10-30-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. Army judge Col. James Pohl denies Guantanamo detainee Walid bin Attash's request to drop his legal counsel clearing the way for the trial's continuation.

Source citations (as archived): [Military Times](<http://www.militarytimes.com/story/military/2015/10/29/judge-wont-let-sept-11-suspect-fire-lawyer-case-advances/74819100/>).

<a id="event-2015-10-30-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Polish Judge Dariusz Mazur rules the law forbids film director Roman Polanski's extradition to the United States where he pleaded guilty nearly four decades ago to having sex with a minor. The prosecutors can appeal the ruling.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1579002/polanski-us-extradition-request-rejected>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34675672>).

### 2015-10-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1246115973](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20October%2031&oldid=1246115973>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-10-31-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, American-led intervention in Syria.

**Archived source account.** A newly formed U.S.-backed Syrian rebel alliance, Democratic Forces of Syria, launches an offensive against Islamic State forces in the northeast province of Hasaka.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/31/us-mideast-crisis-syria-idUSKCN0SP0EA20151031?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=newsOne&amp;google_editors_picks=true>); [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.com/democratic-forces-syria-battles-islamic-state-rebel-group-announces-first-offensive-2163878>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-10-31-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Vodafone Group Plc announces criminals accessed customer account details, including phone numbers and some bank details. The British multinational telecommunications company of over 400 million subscribers says it is contacting about 1,800 affected customers. This is the second recent hacking of a U.K. phone carrier. Last week, TalkTalk Telecom Group Plc said its systems had been attacked.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-10-31/vodafone-says-some-u-k-customers-accounts-accessed-by-hackers>); [Financial Times](<http://www.ft.com/intl/cms/s/0/ca560af4-7ff6-11e5-84dc-31c8b3b18e5f.html#axzz3qB3hxtxQ>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-10-31-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fifteen people are killed and 11 injured in a fire at the public markets at Zamboanga City in the Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://cnnphilippines.com/regional/2015/10/31/15-killed-11-injured-in-Zamboanga-City-Public-Market-fire.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-31-2-2"></a>

Context: Kogalymavia Flight 9268.

**Archived source account.** A Russian Kogalymavia Airbus A-321 airliner crashes in Egypt's Sinai Peninsula with 224 passengers on board travelling from Sharm el-Sheikh to St Petersburg.

Source citations (as archived): [The News Hub](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160305211221/https://www.the-newshub.com/international/russian-airplane-crashes-224-possibly-dead>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-34687139?ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_campaign=bbc_breaking&amp;ns_source=twitter&amp;ns_linkname=news_central>).

<a id="event-2015-10-31-2-3"></a>

Context: Kogalymavia Flight 9268.

**Archived source account.** The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant affiliate in the Sinai claims responsibility for shooting down the aircraft, but the claim is disputed.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/group-egypt-claims-downed-russian-airliner-141443087.html;_ylt=AwrC0wyczTRW8hoAh5PQtDMD;_ylu=X3oDMTByOHZyb21tBGNvbG8DYmYxBHBvcwMxBHZ0aWQDBHNlYwNzcg-->).

<a id="event-2015-10-31-2-4"></a>

Context: Kogalymavia Flight 9268.

**Archived source account.** The wife of co-pilot Sergei Trukachev says, in a call with their daughter before the flight, he complained that the technical condition of the aircraft left much to be desired. According to Egyptian officials, while in the air, the pilot told traffic controllers the aircraft was experiencing technical problems and he intended to try and land at the nearest airport. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.njherald.com/story/30399604/the-latest-co-pilots-wife-he-complained-about-plane>).

<a id="event-2015-10-31-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A second round of storms and strong winds moves east across Texas in the American Southwest, with three radar-confirmed tornadoes damaging homes and causing injuries in the Houston area that got up to eight inches of rain since Friday night. Six people have been killed.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2015/10/31/storms-possible-tornadoes-lash-texas/74937852/>); [AP update](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/84324a168fb348abb4a3d2699fe66878/search-2-missing-central-texas-floods-continue>).

<a id="event-2015-10-31-2-7"></a>

Context: Colectiv nightclub fire.

**Archived source account.** Romanian Prime Minister Victor Ponta declares three days of national mourning.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/31/us-romania-blast-idUSKCN0SP0KM20151031>); [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/world/romania-nightclub-fire-1.3298237>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-10-31-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu retracts controversial comments he made about Nazi policies during World War 2, saying he never meant to claim that an Islamic leader Amin al-Husseini persuaded Adolf Hitler to adopt a policy to kill European Jews.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/10/31/world/netanyahu-hitler-grand-mufti-holocaust/index.html>).

<a id="event-2015-10-31-3-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Syria peace talks in Vienna.

**Archived source account.** U.N. Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon says new talks aimed to help end Syria's war shouldn't be held up by wrangling over whether President Bashar Assad stays or goes.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/c7ecd30e37a5445da99b76bffa159dc5/ban-talks-syria-shouldnt-be-held-over-assads-future>).

<a id="event-2015-10-31-3-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / American-led intervention in Syria.

**Archived source account.** At the International Institute for Strategic Studies Manama Dialogue security conference in Bahrain, Deputy Secretary of State Antony Blinken announces the United States will contribute $100 million (£64.7 million) in fresh aid to support the Syrian opposition.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/5d0c063fb347430a9a7ddc64002bb617/saudi-fm-assads-future-among-sticking-points-syria-deal>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-10-31-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Presidential Palace and the Philippine Senate investigate an extortion scam involving Ninoy Aquino International Airport.

Source citations (as archived): [Manila Bulletin](<http://www.mb.com.ph/uproar-over-naia-bullet-mess-widens/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-34671118>).

<a id="event-2015-10-31-4-2"></a>

Context: Attacks on secularists in Bangladesh.

**Archived source account.** Faisal Abedin Deepan, a publisher of secular books, is hacked to death in Dhaka.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/oct/31/faisal-abedin-deepan-bangladesh-secular-publisher-hacked-to-death>).

<a id="event-2015-10-31-4-3"></a>

Context: Attacks on secularists in Bangladesh.

**Archived source account.** In a separate incident, another publisher and two writers are stabbed and shot in Dhaka.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/oct/31/faisal-abedin-deepan-bangladesh-secular-publisher-hacked-to-death>).

<a id="event-2015-10-31-4-4"></a>

Context: Attacks on secularists in Bangladesh.

**Archived source account.** A group identifying itself as Ansar al-Islam – Bangladesh chapter of al-Qaeda Indian Subcontinent (AQIS) – claimed responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Star](<http://www.thedailystar.net/frontpage/free-thinking-mauled-again-165493>).

<a id="event-2015-10-31-4-5"></a>

Context: Attacks on secularists in Bangladesh.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations condemned the attacks expressing deep concerns over these threats to free speech.

Source citations (as archived): [Prothom Alo](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151102004931/http://www.en.prothom-alo.com/bangladesh/news/84543/UN-condemns-Faisal-killing>).

<a id="event-2015-10-31-4-7"></a>

Context: October 2015 Colorado Springs shooting.

**Archived source account.** A man marching down a street in Colorado Springs, Colorado, shot and killed three people before being fatally shot in a gun battle with police.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/f35617bd68f14caab110659eeb9e6bbd/4-dead-including-suspected-gunman-colorado-springs>); [Colorado Springs Gazette](<http://gazette.com/man-shot-by-police-after-multiple-shootings-in-downtown-colorado-springs/article/1562310>).

<a id="event-2015-10-31-4-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least eleven people are killed in Pakistan in fighting between rival parties as voters go to the polls for local elections in Sindh province.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.smh.com.au/world/at-least-11-killed-as-pakistanis-vote-in-election-20151031-gkntjn.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-10-31-5-1"></a>

Context: Guinean presidential election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Guinea's constitutional court validates President Alpha Condé's October 11, 2015, re-election victory. The court dismissed complaints lodged by opposition candidates.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/10/31/us-guinea-election-idUSKCN0SP17220151031>); [Channel NewsAsia](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/guinea-s-constitutional-c/2230956.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-10-31-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A large asteroid 2015 TB145, thought to be a dead comet, passes close to the earth.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/4095503/nasa-halloween-comet-skull/?xid=homepage>).

<a id="event-2015-10-31-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** According to a new NASA (U.S.) study, ice sheet gains outweigh losses on the continent of Antarctica. An increase in snow accumulation that began 10,000 years ago outweighs increased losses from the continent's thinning glaciers. In 2013, Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change findings suggested gains were not keeping up with losses. NASA glaciologist Jay Zwally said, "We’re essentially in agreement with other studies... (except) ice gain in East Antarctica and the interior of West Antarctica exceeds losses in the other areas."

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Science_News/2015/10/31/NASA-study-Net-gains-for-Antarctic-ice-sheets/9711446321864/?spt=mps&amp;or=1>); [NASA](<http://www.nasa.gov/feature/goddard/nasa-study-mass-gains-of-antarctic-ice-sheet-greater-than-losses>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-10-31-7-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Rugby World Cup Final.

**Archived source account.** In rugby union, New Zealand defeat Australia 34–17 to win the 2015 Rugby World Cup.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/rugby-union/34671255>).

<a id="event-2015-10-31-7-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap News](<http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/news/2015/10/31/0200000000AEN20151031002251315.html>).

**Archived source account.** In horse racing, U.S. Triple Crown winner American Pharoah completes his racing career with a win in the 2015 Breeders' Cup Classic, becoming the first-ever "grand slam" winner in American horse racing.,

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/11/01/sports/american-pharoah-ends-career-with-win-at-breeders-cup.html>); [ESPN](<http://espn.go.com/horse-racing/blog/_/name/ehalt_bob/id/13033587/american-pharoah-ushers-grand-slam-era>).


## November

### 2015-11-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076999390](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20November%201&oldid=1076999390>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** Islamist al-Shabaab militants attack a hotel in Mogadishu resulting in at least 12 deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/explosions-heavy-gunfire-mogadishu-hotel-attack-afp-035122541.html>); [Reuters](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-11-01/al-shabaab-militants-attack-hotel-in-somalia/6903432>).

<a id="event-2015-11-01-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Islamic State fighters seize control of Mahin, a town in Syria's central Homs province, following clashes with government forces which left about 50 dead. Fighting was also reported to be taking place on the outskirts of Sadad, a nearby town mostly populated by Christians.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/11/01/uk-mideast-crisis-syria-is-idUKKCN0SQ1I620151101>).

<a id="event-2015-11-01-0-5"></a>

Context: Israeli-Palestinian conflict (2015).

**Archived source account.** One Palestinian is killed and three Israeli soldiers injured in two attacks in the West Bank. According to the Israeli army, the Palestinian was shot dead after attempting to stab soldiers at a military checkpoint near the Beit Einun village in Hebron. In a second incident in the same area, a driver rammed and injured three Israeli paramilitary border policemen with his car before fleeing the scene. None of the three were injured seriously.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Star](<http://www.dailystar.com.lb/Article.aspx?id=321129&amp;link=News/Middle-East/2015/Nov-01/321129-3-israelis-police-hurt-in-west-bank-car-ramming-attack-police.ashx>); [Al Jazeera](<http://america.aljazeera.com/articles/2015/10/31/israeli-forces-shoot-palestinian-who-allegedly-wielding-knife.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-01-0-6"></a>

Context: Israeli-Palestinian conflict (2015).

**Archived source account.** Since the beginning of October, nine Israeli citizens, 67 Palestinian and an Arab Israeli have been killed in this wave of violence.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/3-israeli-police-reported-hurt-west-bank-car-180154542.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-01-0-7"></a>

Context: Israeli-Palestinian conflict (2015).

**Archived source account.** The fate of slain Palestinians is fueling a new feud with Israeli authorities. The Israeli defense minister says Israel is refusing to return the bodies of Palestinian terrorists killed during this month-old surge of violence unless the Palestinian side agrees to keep their funerals "modest."

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/01/us-israel-palestinians-idUSKCN0SQ21H20151101>).

<a id="event-2015-11-01-0-8"></a>

Context: Israeli-Palestinian conflict (2015).

**Archived source account.** An Israel Defense Forces inquiry concludes the death of a Palestinian woman at a checkpoint in Hebron last month was unnecessary, finding the teenager could have been detained and not killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/.premium-1.683193>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-11-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Navy sends a remotely operated underwater craft to investigate a wreck which they believe is the remains of the \{\{SS\|El Faro\}\} which disappeared on October 1 near the Bahamas during Hurricane Joaquin with 33 people on board.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/10/31/us/el-faro-search/index.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-01-1-2"></a>

Context: Kogalymavia Flight 9268.

**Archived source account.** Airlines including Emirates, Lufthansa and Air France refuse to fly over the Sinai Peninsula until the cause of the crash is known.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151101143646/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/latest-emirates-halts-flights-egypts-sinai-34887526>).

<a id="event-2015-11-01-1-3"></a>

Context: Kogalymavia Flight 9268.

**Archived source account.** Russian air transport chief Alexander Neradko says Flight 9268 broke apart at high altitude and scattered plane parts over a wide swath of Egyptian desert. Neradko added it was too soon to determine what caused Saturday's horrific crash.

<a id="event-2015-11-01-1-4"></a>

Context: Kogalymavia Flight 9268.

**Archived source account.** Russia observes a nationwide day of mourning for victims of the plane crash in Egypt.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2015/11/01/russia-observes-nationwide-day-mourning-for-victims-plane-crash-in-egypt/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-01-1-5"></a>

Context: Kogalymavia Flight 9268.

**Archived source account.** The bodies of more than 140 of those killed in the air crash have been flown back to St Petersburg.

Context: Colectiv nightclub fire.

**Archived source account.** Three other victims of the nightclub fire die at hospital, bringing the death toll to 30.

#### International relations

Context: China–Japan–South Korea trilateral summit.

**Archived source account.** The leaders of the People's Republic of China, South Korea and Japan hold their first summit in three years.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/11/02/world/asia/china-japan-and-south-korea-conduct-first-trilateral-meeting-in-3-years.html>).

**Archived source account.** Japan and China agree to restart mutual visits of their foreign ministers, to hold bilateral high-level economic dialogue early next year, and to work toward early implementation of communication mechanisms between their military forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/01/us-japan-china-idUSKCN0SQ1SY20151101>).

<a id="event-2015-11-01-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Switzerland Named World’s Most Positive Country For 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [China.org.cn](<http://www.china.org.cn/top10/2015-11/05/content_36985363.htm>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-11-01-3-1"></a>

Context: School shootings in the United States.

**Archived source account.** A campus shooting at around 1:20 AM at Lot W, near Wilson Hall and Gleason-Hairston Terrace, at the Main Campus of Winston-Salem State University, in Winston-Salem, North Carolina, kills at least one person and wounds at least one- the two are believed to be students; the suspected gunman, Jarrett Jerome Moore, is not believed to be a student, and is believed to be still at large.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/winston-salem-state-university-shooting-leaves-1-dead/vi-BBmGL0j?ocid=iehp>); [University note](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151104021232/http://www.wssu.edu/about/featured-stories/advisory-notification.aspx>); [Winston-Salem Journal](<http://www.journalnow.com/news/local/shooting-on-wssu-campus-leaves-dead-injured-police-still-looking/article_bfe3bfe0-8090-11e5-8313-d3af20a430e8.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-11-01-4-1"></a>

Context: Turkish general election, November 2015.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan's ruling Justice and Development Party (AKP) wins Sunday's snap election with more than 49 percent of the vote. AKP, projected to get 316 seats in the 550-seat parliament, regains single-party rule just five months after losing it.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/turkey-votes-in-election-viewed-as-referendum-on-erdogan/2015/11/01/81cc0ab8-8005-11e5-b575-d8dcfedb4ea1_story.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34694420>); [Al Jazeera](<http://america.aljazeera.com/articles/2015/11/1/turkey-votes-in-election-in-the-midst-of-surging-violence.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-01-4-2"></a>

Context: Turkish general election, November 2015.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Ahmet Davutoğlu calls on all of Turkey's political parties to work together on a new constitution to replace the 1982 constitution written during the military junta of 1980-1983. The document has been amended 17 times revising 113 of the 177 articles.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/01/us-turkey-election-davutoglu-speech-idUSKCN0SQ2GH20151101>); [Kuwait News Agency](<http://www.kuna.net.kw/ArticleDetails.aspx?id=2469026&amp;language=en>); [ODATV](<http://odatv.com/n.php?n=177-maddeden-113u-degisti-hangi-82-anayasasi-1110111200>).

<a id="event-2015-11-01-4-3"></a>

Context: Turkish general election, November 2015.

**Archived source account.** Protesters clashed with police outside the headquarters of the People's Democratic Party (HDP) in the Kurds' main city of Diyarbakır in southeastern Turkey as it became evident President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan and the AKP were getting a solid majority and would return to power. The tumult spread to other major cities and towns in the Kurdish heartland. The HDP won 10.7 percent of the vote; the party holds 59 of its 80 seats in the parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Ahram](<http://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/2/8/162420/World/Region/Clashes-in-Turkeys-main-Kurdish-city-after-vote.aspx>); [Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/angry-kurds-police-clash-as-vote-bolsters-turkish-president-1446427280>).

<a id="event-2015-11-01-4-5"></a>

Context: Azerbaijani parliamentary election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Azeri voters go to the polls for a parliamentary election, which Azerbaijan President Ilham Aliyev's ruling New Azerbaijan Party is widely expected to win since the The Müsavat (Equality) Party and other Azerbaijani mainstream opposition parties are boycotting. The Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe (OSCE) is not monitoring the election because the restrictions imposed by the authorities make credible poll monitoring impossible.

Source citations (as archived): [TASS](<http://tass.ru/en/world/833248>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/01/azerbaijan-election-idUSL8N12W03W20151101>).

<a id="event-2015-11-01-4-7"></a>

Context: Attacks on secularists in Bangladesh.

**Archived source account.** Teachers, writers and students lead a protest rally in Dhaka against the recent killings and attacks on secular authors and publishers in Bangladesh.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.straitstimes.com/asia/south-asia/bangladesh-teachers-students-rally-against-latest-attacks-on-secular-writers-and>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-11-01-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Smart Sheriff, the most widely used child surveillance mobile app in South Korea, is pulled from the market after specialists raised serious concerns about the program's safety. Security experts say its programming left the door wide open to hackers and put the personal information of some 380,000 users at risk. The country's April 2015 law requires all new smartphones sold to those 18 and under have software parents can use to monitor their kids' social media activity.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.usnews.com/news/business/articles/2015/11/01/apnewsbreak-south-korea-pulls-plug-on-child-monitoring-app>).

<a id="event-2015-11-01-6-4"></a>

**Editorial account; source review complete.** NASCAR retrospectively identifies Gordon as a four-time champion whose 2015 Martinsville win was his 93rd career victory and earned Championship 4 entry.

Editorial date: 2015-11-01. Checked: 2026-10-22. The source means the 93rd overall career victory, not the 93rd win at Martinsville; NASCAR records nine wins there.

Evidence: [NASCAR](<https://www.nascar.com/news-media/2018/10/25/jeff-gordon-2015-martinsville-win-lookback/amp/>).

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: 2015 Nepal fuel crisis.

**Archived source account.** Nepali police shoot dead an Indian citizen at a border checkpoint as they attempt to clear protesters whose blockade has crippled Nepal's fuel supplies and badly damaged relations between the neighboring countries.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/02/us-nepal-india-idUSKCN0SR0IU20151102>).

<a id="event-2015-11-02-0-3"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** At least 15 Somalia army soldiers are killed in an Al-Shabaab ambush near the town of Wanlaweyn in the Lower Shebelle region.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/3c457a74c0e6421e93e8901bc4e44134/somali-extremists-kill-15-government-soldiers-ambush>).

<a id="event-2015-11-02-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Palestinian terrorist stabs an 80-year-old woman and two men in the Israeli town of Rishon Letzion, and another Palestinian attacks a 71-year-old man and critically wounds him in Netanya.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/3-hurt-2-seriously-in-rishon-lezion-stabbing-attack/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-11-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** New Australian Prime Minister Malcolm Turnbull announces knights and dames will no longer be part of the nation’s honors system. He said Queen Elizabeth signed off on the decision.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/4096027/malcolm-turnbull-australia-honors/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/02/us-australia-britain-idUSKCN0SR04K20151102>).

<a id="event-2015-11-02-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the United States, the hacking group Anonymous starts releasing names and information about alleged members of the Ku Klux Klan (KKK), a white-supremacist terrorist group originally founded after the Civil War by former Confederate soldiers. Prominent individuals listed deny the allegations. The group says they also infiltrated KKK-affiliated websites, and warned of more action culminating on November 24, the anniversary of the Ferguson, Missouri grand jury's decision not to indict.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/policy/cybersecurity/258832-anonymous-kicks-off-alleged-kkk-unmasking>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2015/11/02/reports-hacktivist-groud-anonymous-publishes-names-alleged-ku-klux-klan-members/75039282/>); [Anonymous](<http://anonhq.com/opkkk-anonymous-unmasks-kkk-reveals-identities-of-prominent-members/>).

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/11/02/asia/china-new-c919-passenger-jet/index.html?eref=edition>).

Context: Volkswagen emissions scandal.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) and California's CARB are widening the Volkswagen investigation into several more expensive VW, Porsche, and Audi automobiles with 3.0-liter diesel engines in model years 2014 through 2016. Volkswagen says it installed no defeat device software on its 3.0 litre V6 diesel cars and is cooperating with the agency to fully investigate the matter.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2015/11/02/volkswagen-usa-epa-idINKCN0SR28620151102>); [Consumer Affairs](<http://www.consumeraffairs.com/news/epa-more-vw-diesels-have-defeat-device-software-110215.html>).

If granted, the delay (according to Reuters) would almost certainly mean the decision on the project will be made by a future president.

Source citations (as archived): [The Globe and Mail](<https://www.theglobeandmail.com/report-on-business/transcanada-requests-suspension-of-keystone-xl-permit-wsj/article27073904/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/03/us-transcanada-keystone-idUSKCN0SR2J320151103>).

<a id="event-2015-11-02-3-3"></a>

Context: \{\{SS\|El Faro\}\}.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/wreckage-east-bahamas-sunken-cargo-ship-el-faro-ntsb-confirms-n455871?cid=sm_tw&amp;hootPostID=e560fa53c44150d9870627cb28749612>).

<a id="event-2015-11-02-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Planes have been left stranded at airports throughout the United Kingdom as the "Great Fog" descends. Heathrow Airport said around 45 flights had been cancelled there while London City Airport was closed for several hours. Other affected airports include Manchester, Leeds Bradford, Glasgow, Belfast, Southampton and Cardiff.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-34695577>).

<a id="event-2015-11-02-3-6"></a>

Context: 2015 North Indian Ocean cyclone season.

**Archived source account.** At least one person is killed after Cyclone Chapala hits Yemen's Socotra island in the Indian Ocean with flooding reported in Hadibu, the provincial capital. The severe cyclone is expected to cause considerable damage when it makes landfall on Yemeni mainland.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-34698709>).

<a id="event-2015-11-02-3-8"></a>

Context: Kogalymavia Flight 9268.

**Archived source account.** U.S. intelligence analysts conclude the Russian plane was not brought down by surface-to-air missile. An American infrared satellite detected a heat flash at the same time and same place over the Sinai as the plane, but no evidence a missile was involved. Analysts believe it could have been some kind of explosion on the aircraft itself, either a fuel tank or a bomb. U.S. officials do not rule out that ISIL could have been responsible for bringing down the flight.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/russian-plane-crashes-in-the-sinai/satellite-shows-heat-flash-when-russian-metrojet-plane-crashed-no-n456161>); [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/officials-rule-isis-involvement-russian-plane-crash/story?id=34919692>).

<a id="event-2015-11-02-3-9"></a>

Context: Kogalymavia Flight 9268.

**Archived source account.** The Russian Air Transportation Ministry says the flight recorders are recovered with only "minor" damage. The ministry also said charter airline Metrojet's assertion that technical failure or human errors have been ruled out pointing to "external" reasons for the crash, is "premature and not based on any real facts."

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151103170510/http://www.voanews.com/content/crash-victims-bodies-return-to-russia/3032663.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/02/us-egypt-crash-russia-airline-fault-idUSKCN0SR12O20151102>).

The two countries haven't met in over three years. Expected topics include trade ties, North Korea's pursuit of nuclear bombs, and long-running disputes over Japanese wartime aggression and behavior.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/2cb6dda7896749a9a122551ed5b0f9b8/leaders-s-korea-japan-and-china-meet-rare-summit>); [Nikkei Asian Review](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151101204203/http://asia.nikkei.com/Politics-Economy/International-Relations/Japanese-South-Korean-top-diplomats-meet-ahead-of-leaders-1st-talks>).

"That's the right amount to make it regular but not a constant poke in the eye," the official said.

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-11-02-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** French national public television broadcaster France Télévisions fires France 2 TV channel's weatherman Philippe Verdier, who has been suspended since mid-October. Verdier, known as “Monsieur Météo” (Mr Weather), has been promoting his recently published book, Climat Investigation (Climate Investigation), in which he throws doubt on the global warning findings of leading climate scientists and political leaders. France Télévisions said its rules, "prevent anyone using their professional status … to push forward their personal opinions."

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/news/world/europe/french-weatherman-sacked-over-climate-change-book-1.2414582>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/nov/02/french-weatherman-fired-for-promoting-book-sceptical-of-climate-change>).

<a id="event-2015-11-03-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least seven people are dead and 35 others are injured as a bus overturns near Tula, Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/320567-russian-bus-tula-crash/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-03-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 30 people are killed and 35 injured after an overcrowded bus carrying passengers inside and on its roof veered off a mountain road in northwest Nepal.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2015/11/03/nepal-bus-accident/75080208/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-03-2-3"></a>

Context: 2015 Southeast Asian haze.

**Archived source account.** Scientists report fires raging in Indonesia have hit Borneo's orangutans particularly hard. Borneo is home to about 30 percent of the world's wild orangutans, an endangered species. Smoke has already displaced many orangutans and caused health problems related to smoke inhalation, according to the Borneo Orangutan Survival Foundation (BOSF).

Source citations (as archived): [Live Science](<http://www.livescience.com/52677-borneo-fires-hurt-orangutans.html?google_editors_picks=true>).

<a id="event-2015-11-03-2-6"></a>

Context: 2015 North Indian Ocean cyclone season / Cyclone Chapala.

**Archived source account.** "Ravaged by months of war, Yemen now gets battered by the first tropical storm on record to make landfall." Extremely Severe Cyclonic Storm Chapala slams into Yemen's central coast, with maximum sustained winds of around 140 kph (85 mph) -- the equivalent of a Category 1 hurricane. The storm floods coastal areas, brings down electricity lines and destroys houses, with severe threat of mudslides. Chapala is expected to pour over two or three years worth of rain, up to 300 millimeters (12 inches), in a single day.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/11/03/middleeast/yemen-tropical-cyclone-chapala/>); [Abu Dhabi Media](<http://www.thenational.ae/world/middle-east/enormous-damage-as-yemen-hit-by-worst-cyclone-in-decades>).
