<a id="event-2015-11-03-3-1"></a>

Context: China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** In a Peking University speech in Beijing, US Pacific Command commander, Admiral Harry Harris, says the U.S. Navy’s freedom-of-navigation patrols in the South China Sea are routine operations intended to demonstrate respect for international law principles. Harris reiterated they should not be construed as a threat to any country while emphasizing America's common ground with China.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<http://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy-defence/article/1875156/regular-not-poke-eye-us-navy-plans-two-or-more-patrols>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-11-03/south-china-sea-patrols-no-threat-u-s-admiral-says-in-beijing>).

<a id="event-2015-11-03-3-3"></a>

Context: Libyan Crisis (2011–present).

**Archived source account.** The New General National Congress (Libya Dawn) which controls the capital Tripoli, and much of western Libya, threatens to send 'hundreds of thousands' of refugees to Europe unless the European Union recognizes the Islamist-led government.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-3301468/Libya-weaponizes-migrants-Nation-warns-send-hundreds-thousands-Europe-world-does-not-recognise-self-appointed-Islamist-government.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-03-3-5"></a>

Context: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea, Japan–Vietnam relations.

**Archived source account.** Japan has delivered two more ships to Vietnam that will be refurbished into patrol boats. The ships, which arrived in the port city of Da Nang, are the second delivery of a 2014 deal in which Tokyo is to provide Vietnam with six used fishing vessels that will be converted into patrol boats for Vietnam's coast guard in the South China Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151106055735/http://www.voanews.com/content/japan-donates-patrol-boats-to-vietnam-south-china-sea-tensions/3035300.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-03-3-7"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** German Chancellor Angela Merkel announces a plan to register and distribute incoming refugees evenly throughout the European Union. Refugees would be stopped at EU borders, have their application processed, and then, if accepted, sent to one of the Union's 28 member states.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/11/03/Germanys-Merkel-announces-plan-to-distribute-refugees-throughout-EU/1601446575770/?spt=mps&amp;or=2>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-11-03-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pakistani journalist Zaman Mehsud is shot dead by two motorcycle-riding gunmen in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province, near the country's northwestern tribal region. According to a 2014 report, at least 56 journalists have been killed in Pakistan since 1992.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/11/03/Pakistani-journalist-killed-by-militants-near-northwestern-tribal-region/6641446587055/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_int>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2015-11/03/c_134780340.htm>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-11-03-5-2"></a>

Context: U.S. elections: / Gubernatorial.

**Archived source account.** In Kentucky, Republican Matt Bevin defeats Democrat Jack Conway and independent Drew Curtis with 52 percent of the vote to succeed term-limited Democrat Steve Beshear.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2015/11/03/republican-matt-bevin-elected-governor-kentucky-2nd-republican-governor-in-4/>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/41cc5dfd7f7d4e7ea0cb7f3a3dc9cd18/republican-matt-bevin-elected-governor-kentucky-0>).

<a id="event-2015-11-03-5-3"></a>

Context: U.S. elections: / Gubernatorial.

**Archived source account.** In Mississippi, incumbent Republican Phil Bryant easily wins re-election over Democratic, truck driver Robert Gray. according to the Associated Press.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/phil-bryant-wins-reelection-mississippi_5637e18be4b027f9b969c3bf>).

<a id="event-2015-11-03-5-5"></a>

Context: U.S. elections: / State, city.

**Archived source account.** Former five-term Bridgeport mayor Joe Ganim wins election to a sixth term as mayor of Connecticut's largest city, topping the six other candidates in the poll. Ganim is, in American parlance, an "ex-con;" i.e., a convicted felon. In 2003, he was convicted by a federal jury on 16 felony counts for racketeering, bribery, conspiracy, mail fraud, and tax evasion in an operation that also led to convictions of 10 of his associates. Ganim served seven years in federal prison; he was released from a Hartford halfway house in 2010.

Source citations (as archived): [Hartford Courant](<http://www.courant.com/community/bridgeport/hc-bridgeport-ct-joe-ganim-mary-jane-foster-1104-20151103-story.html>); [AP](<http://newyork.cbslocal.com/2015/11/03/bridgeport-mayor-race-election-day/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-03-5-6"></a>

Context: U.S. elections: / State, city.

**Archived source account.** Newcomer, businesswoman, and clinical psychologist Karen Weaver tops incumbent Dayne Walling in the non-partisan, Flint, Michigan, Mayor's election. Flint, which is dealing with lead in drinking water, has been under State financial management for close to four full years, and is in the final stage where control will be returned to city officials.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/9e4d7ad8d8884799a69fb07c815672a9/voters-oust-flint-mayor-amid-citys-water-problems>); [Detroit News](<http://www.detroitnews.com/story/news/local/michigan/2015/11/03/flint-mayor-water-problems/75126158/>); [MLive Media](<http://www.mlive.com/news/flint/index.ssf/2015/09/flint_mayoral_challenger_calls.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-03-5-8"></a>

Context: U.S. elections: / Ballot initiatives, referendums.

**Archived source account.** In Ohio, a ballot initiative that would have established a legal oligopoly for the sale of recreational and medicinal marijuana is resoundingly defeated by voters, according to AP.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/nation/la-na-ohio-marijuana-results-20151103-story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-03-5-9"></a>

Context: U.S. elections: / Ballot initiatives, referendums.

**Archived source account.** In Texas, the Equal Rights Ordinance that would have established nondiscrimination protections for gay and transgender people in Houston fails to win approval from voters.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/religion/latest-voters-reject-houston-lgbt-nondiscrimination-measure/2015/11/03/b62bcdfe-82a1-11e5-8bd2-680fff868306_story.html>); [Texas Tribune](<https://www.texastribune.org/2015/11/03/houston-anti-discrimination-ordinance-early-voting/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-03-5-10"></a>

Context: U.S. elections: / Ballot initiatives, referendums.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Denver's suburban Jefferson County recall, by 64 to 36 percent, three conservative school board members who worked to weaken the local teachers union while boosting funding for charter schools and pushing through other market-driven policy changes. In Fall 2014, the conservative-led majority drew national attention when they wanted the AP U.S. history course to focus on citizenship and patriotism, while condemning civil disobedience and strike actions.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/education/conservative-school-board-members-ousted-in-bitter-colorado-battle/2015/11/04/a0b640ca-82a2-11e5-8ba6-cec48b74b2a7_story.html>); [AP](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/jefferson-county-recall_5637869be4b063179912fb82>).

<a id="event-2015-11-03-5-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Department of Education’s Office for Civil Rights (OCR) issues a two-year investigative report finding the Palatine, Illinois, school district unfairly denied a transgender teenager — who was undergoing hormone therapy but had not undergone gender reassignment surgery — access to school facilities in violation of Title IX, that bars discrimination in federally funded education programs, causing her “isolation,” “ostracism” and at least one “tearful breakdown.” The school district has 30 days to reach an agreement with authorities or risk losing up to $6 million in federal funding and case-referral to the Department of Justice. The Washington Post report called this "The Palatine standoff".

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/morning-mix/wp/2015/11/03/feds-say-illinois-school-district-broke-law-by-banning-trans-student-from-girls-locker-room/>); [Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/ct-transgender-student-federal-ruling-met-20151102-story.html>); [DOE report](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/ct-doe-report-on-district-211-20151102-htmlstory.html>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2015-11-03-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Australian horse racing, Prince of Penzance wins the 2015 Melbourne Cup becoming the first 100-1 winner since World War II; Michelle Payne becomes the first female jockey to ride the winning horse.

Source citations (as archived): [Melbourne Age](<http://www.theage.com.au/sport/horseracing/melbourne-cup-2015-prince-of-penzance-the-first-1001-winner-since-world-war-ii-20151103-gkprwa.html>); [Huffington Post](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com.au/2015/11/02/prince-of-penzance-melbourne-cup_n_8457998.html?ncid=edlinkauhpmg00000001>).

### 2015-11-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1317334680](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20November%204&oldid=1317334680>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-04-0-1"></a>

Context: Kogalymavia Flight 9268.

**Archived source account.** Flights between the United Kingdom and the Egyptian city of Sharm el-Sheikh are suspended due to concerns of the British government that the crash was caused by an "explosive device".

Source citations (as archived): [ITV](<http://www.itv.com/news/story/2015-11-04/egypt-crash-flights-from-sharm-el-sheikh-to-uk-delayed-over-bomb-fears/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-04-0-2"></a>

Context: Kogalymavia Flight 9268.

**Archived source account.** CNN reports that intelligence sources suggest that the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant or an affiliate organisation planted explosives on the plane.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/11/04/africa/russian-plane-crash-egypt-sinai/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-04-0-3"></a>

Context: Kogalymavia Flight 9268.

**Archived source account.** Egypt's Sharm El Sheikh International Airport chief Abdel-Wahab Ali is replaced; he is now an assistant to Adel Mahgoub, chairman of the country's air transport service.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/5a37254fd9734557bc5382e4f8664638n/latest-33-victims-plane-crash-egypt-identified>).

<a id="event-2015-11-04-0-5"></a>

Context: Kunduz hospital airstrike, Afghanistan War.

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of Defense says that last month's airstrikes in Kunduz hit three locations, mistakenly including the Médecins Sans Frontières (Doctors Without Borders) (MSF) hospital where at least 30 were killed. Afghan commanders, whose forces were actively engaged with the Taliban, requested the attacks. The Washington Post reports a warehouse and a mansion in two densely populated residential areas were "pulverized" without loss of civilian lives. According to residents, earlier their neighborhoods had been conflict zones, but no militants were there the time of the attacks. "Together, the three attacks raise questions about the quality and reliability of the intelligence that Afghan security forces are providing to their American partners, as well as U.S. decisions to act on that intelligence," writes the Post.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/us-airstrikes-in-kunduz-destroyed-more-than-a-hospital/2015/11/04/99ef78ff-468a-4113-ae05-086c3450f065_story.html?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_evening>).

<a id="event-2015-11-04-0-6"></a>

Context: Kunduz hospital airstrike, Afghanistan War.

**Archived source account.** Médecins Sans Frontières held memorials around the globe Tuesday, the one month anniversary of the bombing, to reaffirm their request for an independent investigation. U.S. officials resist an independent probe, pledging that the three investigations underway, by the Pentagon, NATO, and Afghan officials, will be thorough and transparent. Thomas Nierle, head of MSF Switzerland, told AFP that he had little hope the inquiries would ultimately see any wrongdoers punished.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/policy/defense/258970-doctors-without-borders-marks-month-since-hospital-bombing-by-us>); [DW Akademie](<http://www.dw.com/en/doctors-without-borders-demands-justice-over-kunduz-airstrike/a-18824819>); [AFP](<https://en-maktoob.news.yahoo.com/msf-staff-honour-colleagues-killed-us-raid-kunduz-154230621.html>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-11-04-1-1"></a>

Context: Keystone XL Pipeline.

**Archived source account.** The United States State Department formally denies Calgary-based TransCanada Corporation's request, made Monday, to pause the review of the proposed Keystone XL oil pipeline. Reuters states this is expected to lead to the project's rejection by the Obama administration.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/05/us-transcanada-keystone-state-idUSKCN0ST2VX20151105#gXh4FQJj1sYTyrLK.97>); [AP](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/nationworld/ct-keystone-xl-pipeline-20151104-story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-04-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Whole Foods, the Texas-based food retailer, announces that it will buy back $1 billion of its shares, and increases its dividend.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/04/us-whole-foods-mrkt-buyback-idUSKCN0ST2WM20151104#w2r3VIHyTDcAQMAt.97>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-11-04-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ash from Indonesia's Mount Rinjani volcano closes Bali's Ngurah Rai International Airport, the country's third busiest. Nearly 700 flights are cancelled. Officials will re-evaluate the situation tomorrow. Mount Rinjani started spewing ash last weekend.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/04/us-indonesia-volcano-airport-idUSKCN0ST0LR20151104#ESFc86PW5SKoCcQM.97>); [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.com/mount-rinjani-eruption-indonesia-leads-bali-airport-closure-several-flights-cancelled-2168332>).

<a id="event-2015-11-04-2-2"></a>

Context: 2015 Juba plane crash.

**Archived source account.** A cargo plane crashes shortly after takeoff from Juba International Airport in Juba, South Sudan. 41 people have reportedly died. The five Armenian crew members were killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters Africa](<http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFKCN0ST0QX20151104>); [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/320710-antonov-plane-crash-landing/>); [Al Jazeera English](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/11/dead-south-sudan-plane-crash-151104081236346.html>); [AFP](<http://www.rappler.com/world/regions/africa/111721-south-sudan-air-crash>); [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-3303160/Russian-plane-crashes-taking-airport-South-Sudan-killing-10-people.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-04-2-4"></a>

Context: 2015 Lahore factory disaster.

**Archived source account.** A building collapses in the Pakistani city of Lahore resulting in at least 18 deaths, at least 75 injured and around 150 people still trapped.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.france24.com/en/20151104-pakistan-deadly-factory-collapse-near-lahore?ns_campaign=reseaux_sociaux&amp;ns_source=twitter&amp;ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_linkname=editorial&amp;aef_campaign_ref=partage_aef&amp;aef_campaign_date=2015-11-04&amp;dlvrit=66745>); [Al Jazeera English](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/11/dead-factory-collapses-pakistan-lahore-151104145754335.html>); [BBC Online](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-34729589>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-11-04-3-1"></a>

Context: Cross-Strait relations, Ma–Xi Meeting.

**Archived source account.** The presidents of China and Taiwan are scheduled to meet in Singapore on November 7th, the first such meeting since the Chinese Communist Revolution.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/11/04/world/asia/leaders-of-china-and-taiwan-to-meet-for-first-time-since-1949.html?_r=0>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-34711923>).

<a id="event-2015-11-04-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) meeting in Malaysia fails to agree on a joint communique following disagreement between China and other nations over the South China Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/A/AS_SOUTHEAST_ASIA_CHINA?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

<a id="event-2015-11-04-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** South Korea and China agree to establish an emergency navy and military hotline.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/11/04/South-Korea-agrees-to-military-hotline-with-China/4351446662720/?spt=rln&amp;or=5>).

<a id="event-2015-11-04-3-5"></a>

Context: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea, China–United States relations, Malaysia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of Defense Ashton Carter and his counterpart from Malaysia, Hishammuddin Hussein, will visit the USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) as it cruises in the South China Sea, this in the wake of China’s dismay over a U.S. Navy ship's sailing in the vicinity of artificial islands constructed by China in the Spratly Islands.

Source citations (as archived): [Stars and Stripes](<http://www.stripes.com/news/pacific/carter-malaysian-counterpart-to-visit-uss-theodore-roosevelt-1.376887>).

<a id="event-2015-11-04-3-7"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** European Union president Donald Tusk and Swedish Prime Minister Stefan Löfvén, in a joint news conference, announce Sweden will ask to transfer some migrants to other European countries under an EU relocation plan. Sweden has taken the highest number of asylum-seekers per capita in the 28-member bloc.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/ba9be5b6235c42f3a2cb222e58f81a9b/latest-1st-group-relocated-greece-luxembourg>); [The Local](<http://www.thelocal.se/20151104/sweden-steps-up-push-for-eu-refugee-help>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-11-04-4-1"></a>

Context: University of California, Merced stabbing attack.

**Archived source account.** Police, at the University of California, Merced campus, shoot and kill a male student who went on a terrorist stabbing rampage that wounded four people. The University closed its campus, except for housing, and cancelled classes for Wednesday and Thursday. The school reported all of the wounded are expected to recover.

Source citations (as archived): [KGO](<http://abc7news.com/news/4-students-stabbed-at-uc-merced-campus-under-lockdown/1067847/>); [UC Merced](<http://emergency.ucmerced.edu/>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-uc-merced-stabbing-20151104-story.html>); [AP](<http://www.chron.com/news/crime/article/The-Latest-5-stabbed-suspect-killed-at-6610411.php>).

<a id="event-2015-11-04-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police have the gunman in custody and San Diego International Airport flights resume. The airport closed after police encountered a man with a gun shooting in a Bankers Hill apartment complex, east of the approach path to the airport. Also known as Lindbergh Field, the airport is frequently cited as one of the scariest because of its downtown location.

Source citations (as archived): [AP update](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/fe3ac41a949f4d78bc75ae0335415eb4/landings-halted-san-diego-airport-due-nearby-shooter>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/04/us-california-shooting-idUSKCN0ST2Q020151104#TXv3KE9G2e77tXWD.97>); [Airfare Watchdog](<http://www.airfarewatchdog.com/pages/11876890/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-04-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Mexican Supreme Court, in a 4–1 decision, rules that people have the right to grow and distribute marijuana for their personal use. The decision challenges the country’s current substance abuse laws. Fox News Latino and The New York Times point out the ruling only covers the plaintiffs in one case, a group that wants to form a "Pot Club." A precedent will be established if the court approves five similar petitions.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News Latino](<http://latino.foxnews.com/latino/news/2015/11/04/mexican-supreme-court-opens-door-to-recreational-marijuana-use-with-new-ruling/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/04/us-mexico-drugs-idUSKCN0ST2TY20151104>).

<a id="event-2015-11-04-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** James Tran of Sacramento County is arrested on suspicion of attempted homicide in the October 8 stabbing of Airman Spencer Stone near a bar in Sacramento California. Stone had helped foil the 2015 Thalys train attack but officials believe it was just a drunken bar fight.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151106035223/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/man-arrested-in-california-stabbing-of-french-train-hero/ar-BBmQclf>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-11-04-5-1"></a>

Context: Colectiv nightclub fire.

**Archived source account.** Romanian Prime Minister Victor Ponta and his government resigns after tens of thousands took to the streets to protest over the Colectiv nightclub fire that killed 32 people. Mircea Dușa has been proposed to be installed as Acting Prime Minister.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/2015/11/04/romania-s-prime-minister-victor-ponta-to-resign-today-following-protests-over/>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34720183>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/nov/04/romanian-government-resigns-nightclub-fire-victor-ponta>).

<a id="event-2015-11-04-5-3"></a>

Context: Canadian government.

**Archived source account.** Justin Trudeau is sworn in as the new Prime Minister of Canada along with his ministry.

Source citations (as archived): [Toronto Star](<https://www.thestar.com/news/canada/2015/11/04/watch-live-justin-trudeau-and-new-government-sworn-in-today.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-04-5-4"></a>

Context: Canadian government.

**Archived source account.** Trudeau announces an ethnically diverse cabinet which for the first time is equally balanced between men and women (15 each).

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/nov/04/canada-cabinet-gender-diversity-justin-trudeau>).

<a id="event-2015-11-04-5-6"></a>

Context: Belizean general election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Belize go to the polls with the United Democratic Party led by Dean Barrow hoping for a third consecutive term.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151107005647/http://www.voanews.com/content/belize-awaits-outcome-of-election/3037719.html>).

### 2015-11-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1262045131](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20November%205&oldid=1262045131>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-05-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Syrian Kurdish–Islamist conflict (2013–present).

**Archived source account.** Canada's Department of Foreign Affairs says it's aware of reports that a Canadian national, John Robert Gallagher, has died while fighting in Syria. According to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights, John Robert Gallagher was killed while fighting alongside the Syrian Democratic Forces against Islamic State militants in the northeast Al-Hasakah Governorate. Gallagher was a former Canadian Forces member served with the Princess Patricia's Canadian Light Infantry.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/canadian-john-robert-gallagher-reportedly-killed-while-fighting-isis-in-syria-1.3304815>); [Chatham Daily News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160304124142/http://www.chathamdailynews.ca/2015/11/06/former-wheatley-resident-killed-by-isis-suicide-bomber>).

<a id="event-2015-11-05-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian rebels seize control of Murak, a town located north of the city of Hama on a strategic highway that is crucial to control of western Syria, following clashes with pro-government forces. Murak was the scene of heavy fighting last year when government forces took control of the town in October 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/11/05/uk-mideast-crisis-syria-idUKKCN0SU0YC20151105>).

<a id="event-2015-11-05-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Russia sends antiaircraft missile systems to Syria, where more than 50 Russian aircraft are stationed and its bombing campaign in support of the Assad regime has been in progress since late September.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe](<http://www.rferl.org/content/russia-antiaircraft-missiles-syroia/27346585.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-05-0-7"></a>

Context: Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** British Prime Minister David Cameron, under pressure from Labour Party leader Jeremy Corbyn and the Foreign Affairs Committee, will not ask for a vote by Parliament to join the U.S. airstrikes in Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Military.com](<http://www.military.com/daily-news/2015/11/05/in-blow-to-obama-cameron-drops-plans-to-join-us-syria-airstrikes.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-05-0-8"></a>

Context: Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** France announces that it will deploy its aircraft carrier Charles de Gaulle to the eastern Mediterranean to boost its efforts against the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant in Iraq and Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/france-deploys-aircraft-carrier-to-fight-isis-in-syria-and-iraq-a6722671.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-11-05-1-1"></a>

Context: Minas Gerais dam disaster.

**Archived source account.** An iron ore tailings dam bursts in the Brazilian state of Minas Gerais flooding a valley, causing mudslides in the nearby village of Bento Rodrigues and causing up to 17 deaths and 45 missing. The dam is operated by Samarco Mineração, a joint venture between BHP Billiton and Vale.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-11-05/samarco-says-dam-in-brazil-burst-teams-are-working-on-site>); [Reuters](<http://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/2015/11/06/16-reported-killed-45-missing-dam-burst-brazilian-bhp-mine>); [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/least-17-dead-dam-bursts-brazil-mining-waste-022224741.html;_ylt=AwrXoCD1EjxWoAQAVqfQtDMD;_ylu=X3oDMTByb2lvbXVuBGNvbG8DZ3ExBHBvcwMxBHZ0aWQDBHNlYwNzcg-->); [Al Jazeera English](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/11/dam-burst-mining-site-devastates-brazilian-town-151106022548631.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-11-05-2-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Greek police say they came under fire on the country’s northeastern border with Turkey during the arrest of two suspected migrant smugglers who had just ferried 22 people across the Evros river that runs along the Greek-Turkish border. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://neurope.eu/wires/the-latest-greek-police-come-under-fire-as-they-arrest-suspected-migrant-smugglers/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-05-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** NetCracker and Computer Sciences Corporation agree to pay fines amounting to over $12 million, settling a Justice Department investigation into the firms’ sub-contracting of computer coding work to Russian sources. The programs were subsequently installed on secure U.S. government computer networks.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Beast](<http://www.thedailybeast.com/articles/2015/11/04/pentagon-farmed-out-its-coding-to-russia.html#>).

<a id="event-2015-11-05-2-4"></a>

Context: University of California, Merced stabbing attack.

**Archived source account.** The Merced County Sheriff identifies the attacker of four students at the University of California, Merced as freshman Faisal Mohammad.

Source citations (as archived): [Merced Sun Star](<http://www.mercedsunstar.com/news/local/education/uc-merced/article43126323.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-05-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** ExxonMobil says that it is preparing a response to the subpoena from the Attorney General of New York pursuant to an investigation into whether Exxon has misled the public about climate change.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/06/us-exxon-mobil-climatechange-idUSKCN0SU30D20151106#WwU25FkYk4WLQ57y.97>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-11-05-3-1"></a>

Context: Belizean general election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Belizean Prime Minister Dean Barrow wins a record third term in Wednesday's snap general election in the Central American nation as his United Democratic Party (UDP) gains a clear majority in parliament. The UDP won 19 constituencies and Francis Fonseca's People's United Party (PUP) took 10, with two constituencies yet to report. Belize is a parliamentary constitutional monarchy with Queen Elizabeth II, the symbolic head of state.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/05/us-belize-election-idUSKCN0ST1VE20151105#hLWpFMhRXc31M0xR.97>); [Newsweek](<http://europe.newsweek.com/belize-pm-dean-barrow-wins-record-third-consecutive-term-336042>).

<a id="event-2015-11-05-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The President of the Maldives, Abdulla Yameen, declares a state of emergency suspending civil rights and giving sweeping powers to security forces.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/nov/04/maldives-declares-state-of-emergency>).

<a id="event-2015-11-05-3-3"></a>

Context: The President of the Maldives, Abdulla Yameen, declares a state of emergency suspending civil rights and giving sweeping powers to security forces..

**Archived source account.** The United States, Amnesty International, and the Maldivian Democratic Party (MDP), the country's main opposition party, sharply criticize the state of emergency, concerned it might lead to a new crackdown on dissent. MDP had scheduled a protest rally for this Friday, demanding the release of its jailed leader, and former Maldivian President, Mohamed Nasheed. The government order cancels that action.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/us-amnesty-criticize-maldives-state-of-emergency/2015/11/05/4a3584bc-837a-11e5-8bd2-680fff868306_story.html>); [AP](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2015/11/04/maldives-president-declares-state-of-emergency>).

<a id="event-2015-11-05-3-5"></a>

Context: Myanmar general election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Myanmar opposition leader and Nobel Laureate Aung San Suu Kyi says she would be "above the president" if her National League for Democracy party (NLD) gets the expected win in the Sunday, November 8, 2015, election. The 2008 constitution, drafted by the military without NLD participation, bars her from becoming President.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/05/us-myanmar-election-idUSKCN0SU0AR20151105#V1RhmsAzSFIRFzvW.97>); [Time](<http://time.com/4101057/aung-san-suu-kyi-burma-myanmar-elections-nld/>).

### 2015-11-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076182225](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20November%206&oldid=1076182225>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-06-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict (2015).

**Archived source account.** Israeli forces shoot and kill a 72-year-old woman in Halhul, a town near Hebron. The soldiers say she attempted to wound them with her car. Her son denies this, saying his mother was on her way to lunch with her sister. Later, three Israelis are shot and wounded, one seriously, in two incidents in Hebron.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera English](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/11/israeli-forces-shoot-dead-72-year-palestinian-woman-151106155250695.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/nov/06/three-israelis-wounded-as-violence-in-hebron-escalates>); [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/.premium-1.684619>).

<a id="event-2015-11-06-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Organization for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons inspectors conclusively identify mustard gas as the toxic agent used in the battle between Islamic State (IS) insurgents and an anti-Assad rebel group in the Syrian town of Mare' in the northern Alleppo province on August 21, 2015. This is the first confirmation of its use by non-state actors in Syria’s four-year-old conflict.

Source citations (as archived): [Christian Science Monitor](<http://www.csmonitor.com/World/Global-News/2015/1106/Mustard-gas-was-used-in-August-attack-on-Syrian-town-says-weapons-group>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/weapons-inspectors-determine-syrian-insurgents-used-mustard-gas/2015/11/06/7865d4e0-84b0-11e5-8bd2-680fff868306_story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-06-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Ajnad al-Sham and other rebel forces recapture the village of Atshan and surrounding areas in Hama province, consolidating significant advances made the day before at the expense of pro-government forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2015/11/06/syrian-activists-rebels-recapture-village-in-country-west-as-major-fighting/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/06/us-mideast-crisis-syria-village-idUSKCN0SV0VH20151106>).

#### Art and culture

<a id="event-2015-11-06-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints (Mormon) new policy states those in a same-sex marriage are to be considered apostates, and children living in a same-sex household may not be blessed as babies, or baptized until they are 18.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/acts-of-faith/wp/2015/11/05/mormon-church-to-exclude-children-of-same-sex-couples-from-getting-blessed-and-baptized-until-they-are-18/>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/0b92c9d24c44431ab3221608e98bd633/gay-mormon-church-members-say-new-rules-are-devastating>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-11-06-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** India has cancelled Greenpeace India's license to operate and gave the group 30 days to close down, citing financial fraud and falsification of data, the environment watchdog said on Friday.

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<http://www.ndtv.com/india-news/greenpeace-india-claims-its-registration-cancelled-slams-intolerance-1240860>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/06/india-greenpeace-modi-charity-idUSKCN0SV1OT20151106#ChEWuD1IeoMKODi6.97>).

<a id="event-2015-11-06-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. job growth for October 2015 saw the biggest gains since December 2014, fueling hopes that the Federal Reserve Board will increase near-zero interest rates at its December meeting.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/06/us-usa-economy-idUSKCN0SV0HQ20151106>).

<a id="event-2015-11-06-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Barack Obama announces that the State Department has rejected TransCanada's application to complete the Keystone XL pipeline.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/11/07/us/obama-expected-to-reject-construction-of-keystone-xl-oil-pipeline.html>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2015/11/06/455007054/president-obama-expected-to-reject-keystone-xl-plan-friday>); [Al Jazeera English](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/11/obama-rejects-construction-canada-proposed-pipeline-151106183617333.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-11-06-3-1"></a>

Context: Kogalymavia Flight 9268.

**Archived source account.** Russia has ordered the suspension of all flights to Egypt following indications that the crash near Sharm el-Sheikh was caused by a bomb.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34743216>).

<a id="event-2015-11-06-3-3"></a>

Context: Minas Gerais dam disaster.

**Archived source account.** Thursday's flooding and devastating mudslides at the BHP-Vale mine in Minas Gerais involved two dams, not one as initially reported. Brazilian officials report the mud flow is eight kilometers (five miles) long and 2.5 meters deep. Those rescued – and emergency services – are being decontaminated; mining spoils being treated as toxic. There is no official information on the number of casualties or the cause of the incident. The company that runs the mine says it detected seismic activity right before the breach. Both BHP and Vale shares declined over five percent. Brazilian prosecutors have opened a criminal investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [Mashable](<http://mashable.com/2015/11/06/brazil-mining-dams-collapse/#_rymXWsoIaqm>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-11-05/samarco-says-dam-in-brazil-burst-teams-are-working-on-site>); [CCTV](<http://www.cctv-america.com/2015/11/06/search-for-victims-continues-after-dams-burst-in-brazil>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-11-06-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Researchers at Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania's Carnegie Mellon University (CMU) successfully use a 3-D printer (specifically, a fused deposition modeling (FDM) printer) to produce hair-like strands, inspired by the use of a hot glue gun to produce gossamer strands. Also, using certain materials (like collagens, alginates, and fibrins), with a 3-D printer and special bioprinting techniques, another team at CMU produced human coronary arteries and small, embryonic-like human hearts.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<http://www.msn.com/en-us/video/wonder/3-d-printers-can-now-make-hair/vi-BBmMUt3?ocid=iehp>); [CMU](<http://www.cmu.edu/news/stories/archives/2015/october/3-D-printer-hair.html>); [CMU](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151029004030/http://engineering.cmu.edu/media/feature/2015/10_23_feinberg_paper.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-06-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Food and Drug Administration approves a new, all-in-one pill to treat HIV patients that includes a new version of the drug tenofovir, which researchers think will help reduce side effects from the multi-drug regimens used for HIV.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Health_News/2015/11/06/FDA-approves-single-pill-HIV-treatment/7411446837667/?spt=mps&amp;or=4>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-11-06-5-1"></a>

Context: Indonesia–Philippines relations.

**Archived source account.** Indonesia and the Philippines discuss their borders after the Indonesian Navy sinks four Filipino fishing vessels off the coast of the Philippines triggering a diplomatic dispute.

Source citations (as archived): [Business World](<http://bworldonline.com/content.php?section=Nation&amp;title=border-talks-with-indonesia-after-sinking-of-4-phl-vessels&amp;id=118199>).

<a id="event-2015-11-06-5-3"></a>

Context: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea, China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. officials say the U.S. Navy deliberately avoided military drills or other actions that could have further inflamed tensions with Beijing during the USS Lassen's patrol in the South China Sea last week. For instance, the Lassen turned off its fire-control radars while transiting within 12 nautical miles of Subi Reef. On its part, the Chinese destroyer following the Lassen was, "very cordial the entire time … before and after the Spratly Islands transit," said the Lassen's commanding officer, Commander Robert Francis.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/06/us-southchinasea-usa-passage-idUSKCN0SV2QK20151106#2bhxDuJSu1BpgQBT.97>); [New York Post](<https://nypost.com/2015/11/06/chinese-warship-to-us-destroyer-hope-to-see-you-again/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-06-5-5"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Reuters reports the Obama Administration will be opening new screening centers for Syrian refugees in Iraq and Lebanon to speed up the process for getting vetted individuals to the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/06/us-mideast-crisis-syria-usa-idUSKCN0SV2SE20151106#U8xPwWVi1wq5MQ5E.97>).

<a id="event-2015-11-06-5-7"></a>

Context: Turkey–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The U.S Air Force deploys six F-15C fighter jets to Turkey's Incirlik Air Base to help defend Turkish airspace against potential intruders.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/e6b19611dfcc415b8ab5f8108b41a990/us-deploys-6-f-15-jets-turkish-air-base>).

<a id="event-2015-11-06-5-9"></a>

Context: Egypt–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Egypt receives the final four of its order of 20 Lockheed Martin F-16 Block 52 multi-role fighters, according to the Defense Ministry. The United States had delayed delivery following the 2013 coup d'état.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Business_News/Security-Industry/2015/11/06/Egypt-receives-final-delayed-F-16-delivery/8101446837393/?spt=hs&amp;or=si>).

<a id="event-2015-11-06-5-11"></a>

Context: Japan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Okinawa Governor Takeshi Onaga says he "cannot comply with the recommendation" from Tokyo's Land Minister Keiichi Ishii, and will not retract his revocation of a U.S. military base relocation permit.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/11/06/Okinawa-governor-refuses-to-back-down-on-US-base-relocation/1571446836720/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_int>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-11-06-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House passes the 2016 National Defense Authorization Act by a vote of 370-58. In addition to funding the U.S. military, the bill contains provisions for sweeping personnel reforms. The previous version of the bill was vetoed by President Barack Obama. Some sources expect swift passage by the U.S. Senate while other sources are not so optimistic.

Source citations (as archived): [Defense News](<http://www.defensenews.com/story/defense-news/2015/11/05/house-votes-approve-2016-defense-policy-bill/75211122/>); [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/policy/defense/259250-dems-block-defense-spending-bill-for-third-time>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-11-06-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Federal Communications Commission rejects privacy advocacy group Consumer Watchdog's petition to make it illegal for Internet companies like Google, Facebook and ad providers to ignore "Do Not Track" browser settings.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/tech/internet/fcc-we-cant-force-google-facebook-stop-tracking-you-online-n458856?cid=par-time_20151106>).

### 2015-11-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1191243089](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20November%207&oldid=1191243089>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-07-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Assyrian Human Rights Network (AHRN) reports Islamic State militants released 37 Syrian Christians, mostly women, who were among more than 200 people from the Assyrian minority group abducted in February.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/931518fdadbf4e0c81e8a009452551da/activists-say-group-releases-37-syrian-christian-captives>).

<a id="event-2015-11-07-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights says the death toll from an airstrike on an IS-controlled eastern city near the border with Iraq rose from 25 to 71.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/931518fdadbf4e0c81e8a009452551da/activists-say-group-releases-37-syrian-christian-captives>).

<a id="event-2015-11-07-0-4"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** Bombs in and around Baghdad kill at least nine people, police and medical sources say. There is no immediate claim of responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/07/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-violence-idUSKCN0SW0IW20151107#URyD0m250bsGOj70.97>).

#### Art and culture

<a id="event-2015-11-07-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The University of Sydney's Australian Archaeological Mission, excavating at a UNESCO World Heritage Site on the southwest coast of the Mediterranean island of Cyprus, discover Cyprus's oldest theatre. Located in the ancient city of Nea Paphos (capital of Cyprus at the time), it is a Hellenistic-Roman structure believed to have been in use for about six and a half centuries, from c. 300 B.C. until its final destruction in the earthquakes of A.D. 365. The Roman columns are made of granite from quarries in Troad, Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP,](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151109210220/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/archaeologists-uncover-2300-year-old-theatre-on-cyprus/ar-CC2Pvz?li=AAa0dzB&amp;ocid=iehp>).

<a id="event-2015-11-07-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Egyptian Ministry of Antiquities says infrared thermography indicates a hidden chamber in the tomb of King Tutankhamen, findings consistent with early theories his tomb included two concealed doorways and with the theory presented in archaeologist Nicholas Reeves' paper this summer.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Science_News/2015/11/07/Infrared-scans-point-to-hidden-chamber-in-King-Tuts-tomb/4881446914226/?spt=mps&amp;or=3>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-11-07-2-1"></a>

Context: Takata Defective airbag recalls (2013-present).

**Archived source account.** Nissan Motor Co. says it will not use airbag inflators made by Japanese auto parts supplier Takata Corp. in its cars, joining Toyota Motor Corp. and Honda Motor Co.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/07/us-nissan-airbag-takata-idUSKCN0SW06220151107#6JzJyRCbMy8HjCZG.97>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-11-07-3-1"></a>

Context: Metrojet Flight 9268.

**Archived source account.** A sudden noise immediately before the "black box" flight data recorder went dark indicates the plane was brought down by a bomb, according to unnamed sources. Officially, Ayman el-Muqadem says the Egyptian investigative team is "considering all possible scenarios for the cause of the accident" and has not yet reached any conclusions.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34753464>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2015/11/07/egypt-tourists-russian-plane-crash/75359338/>); [The Mirror](<https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/russian-plane-black-box-recording-6782860>).

<a id="event-2015-11-07-3-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Greek coast guard and the European Union border agency Frontex, in six separate operations, rescue a total of 383 migrants attempting to sail from Turkey to the eastern Greek islands.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/5e9628e3da104de48364cd7f0a782abb/latest-arson-fire-sweden-destroys-refugee-building>).

<a id="event-2015-11-07-3-5"></a>

Context: Minas Gerais dam disaster.

**Archived source account.** As rescue teams labor to reach isolated communities, state officials are taking precautions to contain the environmental fallout from the burst dams. A state public prosecutor based in Mariana says he will seek 500,000 Brazilian reais (US$130,000) in personal damages for each of about 200 families most affected by the dam burst.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/07/us-brazil-damburst-idUSKCN0SW0ET20151107#bJvkm1CrbikvXKPw.97>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-11-07-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Iraq, a cholera outbreak prompts United Nations agencies UNICEF and the World Health Organization to launch a prevention and treatment campaign. So far, around 2,200 cases have been confirmed, and some infections have occurred in neighboring countries.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera English](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/11/launches-campaign-tackle-iraq-cholera-outbreak-151106142858671.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-07-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The WHO declares Sierra Leone free from Ebola transmissions.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20151107-sierra-leone-be-declared-free-ebola-world-health-organisation>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-34755170>); [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/11/08/world/africa/sierra-leone-declared-free-of-ebola-transmissions.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-11-07-5-1"></a>

Context: Cross-Strait relations, 2015 Ma–Xi Meeting.

**Archived source account.** Mainland China's leader Xi Jinping and Taiwan's leader Ma Ying-jeou meet in Singapore, the first meeting between a Chinese and Taiwanese leader since the Chinese Communist Revolution.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/11/07/asia/china-taiwan-summit/index.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-07-5-3"></a>

Context: China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States and China hold joint naval exercises in the Atlantic Ocean near Naval Station Mayport, Jacksonville, Florida. The United States missile destroyer USS Mason and guided missile cruiser USS Monterey along with other ships in the Atlantic, conduct drills with China's guided-missile frigate Yiyang, guided-missile destroyer Jinan, and oil tanker Qiandao Hu.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/11/09/US-China-conduct-joint-drills-near-Florida-naval-base/6211447082444/?spt=rln&amp;or=5>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-11-07-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A manhunt is underway for a gunman who shot and seriously wounded presiding Travis County, Texas State District Judge Julie Kocurek at the driveway of her home in West Austin, Texas. It was unclear whether she and/or her family members were targeted (they were arriving home) or if it was a botched robbery. She was listed in serious condition at University Medical Center Brackenridge in Austin but is expected to recover.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today,](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160304072230/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/crime/manhunt-underway-after-texas-judge-shot-outside-her-home/ar-CC4wxu?li=AAa0dzB&amp;ocid=iehp>).

<a id="event-2015-11-07-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Louisiana, United States, two law enforcement officers are arrested and charged with homicide of a six-year-old and attempted homicide of his father.

#### Politics and elections

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-08-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Houthi forces regain several positions across southern Yemen after launching a fresh offensive against loyalist and coalition forces. In Lahij province, which borders Aden, Houthi forces are now positioned on a hill overlooking the strategic Al Anad Air Base, which houses Sudanese forces. The Houthis also retook the Damt District in the Dhale province after besieging it for hours, at least 16 people were killed in the clashes.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/iran-backed-huthi-rebels-retake-positions-south-yemen-112620896.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-11-08-6-1"></a>

Context: Croatian parliamentary election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Early official results show the Croatian Democratic Union (HDZ), the country's largest opposition party, has a slim lead over Prime Minister Zoran Milanović’s ruling Social Democrats (SDP) in today's elections. With 32 percent counted, the HDZ, has 61 of parliament’s 151 seats and the SDP is second with 53. The third place Most (Bridge of Independent Lists) party is likely to have the balance of power in the parliament. After the votes were counted, HDZ had 59 seats and SDP 56, and with 3 additional seats from the regional IDS party, SDP amounted to 59 seats. The greatest surprise was MOST, who won 19 seats and will be the key in formation of the government. If MOST refuses coalition with the two main parties, the country will have to repeat the elections in January 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/croatia-holds-first-general-election-since-joining-eu-1446978876>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-11-08/croatian-general-election-results-in-tie-exit-poll-shows>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2015/nov/09/myanmar-elections-aung-san-suu-kyi-hints-at-victory>); [EUROPP](<http://blogs.lse.ac.uk/europpblog/2015/11/10/croatian-parliamentary-elections-2015-expert-reactions/>).

Early indication is an 80 percent turnout of the more than 30 million people eligible to vote.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/world/asia/la-fg-voters-head-to-polls-in-former-military-dictatorship-of-myanmar-20151107-story.html>); [Ahmedabad Mirror](<http://www.ahmedabadmirror.com/news/world/Myanmar-vote-count-begins-on-Suu-Kyis-day-of-destiny/articleshow/49716295.cms>).

**Archived source account.** Megh is expected to cross the Yemen coast Tuesday at 9:00 a.m. Arabia Standard Time (6:00 a.m. UTC). In the Gulf of Aden, the storm has maximum sustained winds of 111 km/h (69 mph), gusting to 130 km/h (81 mph). Its strength will significantly erode once it makes landfall and continue to decay after it moves inland into the dry and rugged terrain of Western Yemen. It is not expected to track back over water.
