#### Sport

<a id="event-2015-11-09-8-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A World Anti-Doping Agency investigation into a Russian doping scandal recommends the suspension of Russian athletes from international competition and lifetime bans for five athletes, four coaches and an administrator. Among the athletes are London Olympic medalists Mariya Savinova-Farnosova and Ekaterina Poistogova.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151112204514/http://abcnews.go.com/Sports/wireStory/latest-pound-state-supported-doping-russia-35071845>).

### 2015-11-10

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076182016](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20November%2010&oldid=1076182016>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-10-0-1"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Egypt's Interior Ministry announces the death of a senior figure in the Islamic State’s “Sinai province.” Ashraf Ali Hassanein al Gharabli, killed in a Cairo shootout with police, was also linked to other extremist groups and terrorist activities.

Source citations (as archived): [The Long War Journal](<http://www.longwarjournal.org/archives/2015/11/islamic-state-sinai-province-commander-killed-in-cairo-egyptian-government-says.php>); [ARAnews](<http://aranews.net/2015/11/egypt-police-kill-leading-isis-militant-in-cairo/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-10-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Aleppo offensive (October–November 2015).

**Archived source account.** Syrian Army troops break an Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant siege of the Kweires airbase in the Aleppo Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.timesofoman.com/article/71503/World/Middle-East/Blasts-kill-23-in-Syrian-city-of-Latakia-as-state-TV-says-Syrian-army-has-not-reached-besieged-air-base>).

<a id="event-2015-11-10-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A mortar attack on the coastal city of Latakia kills at least 23 and injures 65.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2015/11/10/Militant-mortar-attack-on-Latakia-Syria-kills-dozens/5681447170445/>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-11-10-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Technology news website Re/code reports Dell Incorporated's $67 billion offer to buy data storage company EMC Corporation could be derailed by a tax bill of up to $9 billion if key aspects of the deal do not qualify for the sort of tax treatment the companies consider essential for the transaction.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/10/us-emc-us-m-a-dell-idUSKCN0SZ25420151110#WM0YkmOOjPEv7b85.97>); [Economic Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151113014641/http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/business/dell-emc-deal-could-fall-apart-on-tax-concerns/articleshow/49740856.cms>); [Re/code](<http://recode.net/2015/11/10/dells-emc-deal-could-unhinge-on-tax-rule/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-11-10-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** All nine people aboard a Hawker H25 business jet are killed after the plane crashes into an apartment complex in the American city of Akron, Ohio. The NTSB in October 2016 concluded First Officer Renato Marchese improperly set the aircraft's flaps and failed to maintain a proper speed

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2015/11/10/plane-crashes-in-residential-area-ohio/>); [WOIO](<http://www.wnem.com/story/30484097/2-killed-after-plane-crash-into-akron-house>); [Source](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/ntsb-decide-probable-cause-ohio-jet-crash-043501431.html>); [ABC News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20161019143624/http://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/ntsb-decide-probable-ohio-jet-crash-42872179>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-11-10-3-1"></a>

Context: Pollution in China.

**Archived source account.** Chinese state news agency Xinhua joins critics of Shenyang's handling of serious pollution problems. "The city of Shenyang has failed to apply emergency measures that could have reduced smog, and didn't provide advisories to residents to stay indoors," Xinhua wrote. The BBC reported pollution readings in the northeastern Chinese city have been 50 times higher than levels considered safe by the World Health Organization (WHO).

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/11/10/Anger-simmers-in-China-over-worst-ever-air-pollution/3041447177028/?spt=hts&amp;or=6>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-11-10-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** British Prime Minister David Cameron sets out his four-point EU re-negotiation agenda, including a demand to end Britain's obligations to EU's "ever closer union".

Source citations (as archived): [Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2015/nov/10/david-cameron-prepares-for-battle-with-eu-allies-over-resolvable-aims>).

<a id="event-2015-11-10-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Myanmar tops the 2015 Charities Aid Foundation's World Giving Index which measures each country's charitable behavior. Individuals indicate whether they have donated money, volunteered, or helped a stranger in the past month. The United States, which tied with Myanmar last year, is second, followed by New Zealand, Canada, Australia, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Sri Lanka, Ireland, and Malaysia.

Source citations (as archived): [Market Watch](<http://www.marketwatch.com/story/america-is-the-second-most-generous-country-in-the-world-2015-11-10>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/voluntary-sector-network/gallery/2015/nov/10/the-10-most-generous-nations-in-the-world-in-pictures>); [CAF 2015 Report](<https://www.cafonline.org/docs/default-source/about-us-publications/caf_worldgivingindex2015_report.pdf?sfvrsn=2>).

<a id="event-2015-11-10-4-3"></a>

Context: Syria peace talks in Vienna, Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Reuters reports Russia's eight-point proposal, drafted prior to this week's international talks on Syria, wants the Syrian government and the opposition to agree on launching a constitutional reform process of up to 18 months, followed by early presidential elections.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/10/us-mideast-crisis-syria-draft-idUSKCN0SZ2F720151110#akoQILJwz4vtHo1U.97>).

<a id="event-2015-11-10-4-5"></a>

Context: Iran, P5+1 &amp; European Union Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action.

**Archived source account.** Iran stops dismantling decommissioned centrifuges in two uranium enrichment plants, according to state media reports. This comes days after Iran's conservative lawmakers complained to President Hassan Rouhani that the process was too rushed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/10/us-iran-nuclear-deal-idUSKCN0SZ1Z720151110#yo8KAoW02OuryRs1.97>).

<a id="event-2015-11-10-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** French media reports that a planned lunch for November 17 between Iranian president Hassan Rouhani and French president François Hollande is scrapped after Rouhani asked that all wine be pulled from the menu.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2015/11/11/iran-president-french-lunch-canceled-after-wanted-wine-free-menu-reports-claim/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-11-10-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** New York Attorney General Eric Schneiderman sends cease and desist letters to DraftKings and FanDuel ordering them to stop operating in the state because they violate New York laws against illegal gambling.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/n-y-attorney-general-orders-fantasy-sports-sites-draftkings-fanduel-n461051>); [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/sports/football/new-york-ag-orders-draftkings-fanduel-shut-state-article-1.2430225>).

<a id="event-2015-11-10-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States FBI foils an alleged plot by white supremacists in Virginia who were planning a reign of terror — shooting or bombing religious institutions, robbing jewelers and armored cars, purchasing land, stockpiling weapons, and training for the "coming race war."

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/public-safety/feds-white-supremacists-plotted-to-shoot-or-bomb-black-churches-jewish-synagogues/2015/11/10/2a0abbcc-87cf-11e5-be39-0034bb576eee_story.html>); [WTVR](<http://wtvr.com/2015/11/09/fbi-foils-alleged-plot-by-chesterfield-white-supremacists-to-incite-race-war/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-10-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Kenyan police arrest Daily Nation senior reporter John Ngirachu who wrote about corruption at the Interior Ministry. Reports alleging outrageous spending by civil servants has raised pressure on President Uhuru Kenyatta.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/11/us-kenya-corruption-idUSKCN0SZ2GK20151111#IJYoyeoXo8ZQMLO6.97>).

<a id="event-2015-11-10-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia suspends district court judge Richard Leon's ruling yesterday that found the U.S. National Security Agency's phone data collection program is unconstitutional. Leon's decision barred the agency from further collection of data on the plaintiffs in the case -- California attorney J.J. Little and his law firm -- but did not have sufficient authority to outlaw the practice against all Americans. The government plea for the injunction said it will take "at least several weeks" for the NSA to implement a technical change that would prevent collection of Little's data and therefore the entire program would have to shut down early based on Leon's order.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2015/11/10/Appeals-court-halts-judges-order-against-NSAs-phone-surveillance-program/2021447198109/?spt=rln&amp;or=2>).

<a id="event-2015-11-10-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Obama administration will ask the Supreme Court to overturn yesterday's ruling by the New Orleans, Louisiana, federal Court of Appeals that blocks the deferred deportation of millions of undocumented immigrants who entered the United States as children.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2015/11/10/Obama-to-appeal-immigration-ruling-to-Supreme-Court/2261447149554/?spt=hts&amp;or=2>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-11-10-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former West German chancellor Helmut Schmidt (1974 to 1982) dies at the age of 96.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/nov/10/helmut-schmidt-former-west-german-chancellor-dies-aged-96>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2015-11-10-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lamine Diack, who is provisionally suspended as an honorary member of the International Olympic Committee (IOC) in connection with suspected involvement in the Russian doping scandal cited in yesterday's World Anti-Doping Agency report, resigns as president of the Monaco-based International Athletics Foundation (IAF), according to the International Association of Athletics Federations (IAFF). Diack stepped down as president of the IAAF in August. The 82-year-old native of Senegal is under investigation in France on suspicion of corruption and money-laundering.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/10/us-athletics-corruption-diack-idUSKCN0SZ2UZ20151110#GdORZmmvUFWh8YPI.97>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/athletics/34782521>).

### 2015-11-11

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087273625](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20November%2011&oldid=1087273625>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-11-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Spillover of the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Air Force reportedly conducts an airstrike near Damascus International Airport, in Syria's capital, the target apparently a weapons shipment reportedly intended for Lebanese terrorist organization Hezbollah, according to Syrian opposition groups.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/syria-says-israeli-airstrikes-hit-near-damascus-airport/>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Middle-East/Syrian-media-reports-Israeli-airstrike-near-Damascus-airport-432733>).

<a id="event-2015-11-11-0-3"></a>

Context: Turkey–PKK conflict, 2015 PKK rebellion.

**Archived source account.** Turkish security forces backed up by tanks and combat helicopters launch a large-scale operation against PKK militants in the mainly Kurdish town of Silvan, which has been under a punishing curfew for nine days. At least five people are killed in the fighting, including a Turkish soldier.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/five-dead-pkk-attacks-turkey-fighting-rages-193033058.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-11-0-5"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Carrying coffins holding the beheaded bodies of seven ethnic Hazara, thousands of demonstrators from Afghanistan's different ethnic groups - Pashtun, Tajik, Uzbek, and Hazara - march on the Presidential Palace in Kabul, urging the government to take action against the rising violence against Afghan civilians. The murders, which the United Nations denounced as a potential war crime, have fueled a growing sense of insecurity since the Taliban briefly seized control of Kunduz in late September.

Source citations (as archived): [RAWA News](<http://www.rawa.org/temp/runews/2015/11/11/afghans-protest-beheadings-of-ethnic-hazara-by-isil.html>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2015/11/11/afghanistan-hazara-idINKCN0T00G120151111>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-11-11-1-1"></a>

Context: Metrojet Flight 9268.

**Archived source account.** Tourism bookings in Egypt’s main Red Sea resort of Sharm el-Sheikh plunge in the wake of the plane crash with some 80% of reservations cancelled and at least 40% of the tourists leaving the resort since the crash.

Source citations (as archived): [The Globe And Mail](<https://www.theglobeandmail.com/news/world/egypts-tourist-reservations-plunge-in-wake-of-russian-plane-crash/article27210809/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-11-11-2-2"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis / Slovenian border barrier.

**Archived source account.** Slovenia's army begins erecting a razor wire fence along parts of its southern border with Croatia in order to stop a tide of illegal migrants entering the country. Around 180,000 people, mainly from Syria and Afghanistan have streamed into Slovenia since mid-October after trekking northwards along a Balkan corridor from Greece, most of them bound ultimately for Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/11/us-europe-migrants-slovenia-idUSKCN0T00I120151111>).

<a id="event-2015-11-11-2-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Sweden is imposing temporary border controls to stem a record inflow of refugees. The Nordic nation pleads with the rest of Europe for help.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-11-11/sweden-resorts-to-temporary-border-controls-amid-refugee-crisis>); [Newsweek](<http://europe.newsweek.com/sweden-introduces-border-checks-control-refugee-flow-336427>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-11-11-3-1"></a>

Context: Anti-corruption campaign in China.

**Archived source account.** Beijing Deputy Communist Party Secretary Lü Xiwen and Shanghai vice mayor Ai Baojun are placed under investigation by the top anti-graft body of the Communist Party of China, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/11/12/world/asia/china-crackdown-corruption-beijing-shanghai-ai-baojun-lu-xiwen.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2015-11-11-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Constitutional Court of Spain agrees to hear an appeal by the national government against a bid for independence by Catalonia suspending legal bids for secession.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/11/us-spain-catalonia-court-idUSKCN0T02CF20151111>).

<a id="event-2015-11-11-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three aircraft, a Southwest Airlines 737, a Virgin America A319, and a private plane, were all struck by a laser coming from the same direction as they were about to land at Dallas's Love Field, according to the U.S. FAA.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2015/11/12/3-airplanes-hit-by-laser-heading-toward-dallas-airport-faa-says/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-11-11-4-1"></a>

Context: Myanmar general election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** With 45 percent of the Pyithu Hluttaw (House of Representatives) results announced from Sunday's election, Aung San Suu Kyi's National League for Democracy (NLD) moves closer to an absolute majority in the country's parliament, winning over 90 percent (135 of 149 seats) in the country's lower house. The NLD also has taken over 85 percent in the upper house and regional assemblies. The NLD needs to win more than two-thirds of seats that were contested in parliament to form Myanmar's first democratically elected government since the early 1960s.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/11/us-myanmar-election-idUSKCN0SW0TP20151111#TZdzAMkJp5jOPYS2.97>).

<a id="event-2015-11-11-4-2"></a>

Context: Myanmar general election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Twenty-five percent (25%) of the seats in the legislature are not elected; they are reserved for military appointees, taken from Myanmar Armed Forces (Tatmadaw) personnel, and officially known as "Army Representatives." \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Channel 3000](<http://www.channel3000.com/news/myanmar-vote-suu-kyi-predicts-majority/36358008>).

<a id="event-2015-11-11-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pro-independence Catalan leaders vowed to continue their efforts to secede from Spain, defying a ruling by the Madrid-based constitutional court that suspended a law defining a path for independence.

Source citations (as archived): [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.com/catalonia-independence-after-defying-madrid-catalan-leaders-vow-ignore-constitutional-2180979>); [Time](<http://time.com/4109615/catalonia-spain-independence-court/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-11-11-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Astronomers announce the discovery of V774104, the most distant object yet found in the Solar System, a dwarf planet orbiting at three times the distance of Pluto.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2015/11/11/455643251/astronomers-spot-most-distant-object-in-the-solar-system>).

### 2015-11-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1253342581](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20November%2012&oldid=1253342581>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-12-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israeli agents, disguised as Arabs escorting a woman in labor, raids a hospital in Hebron, West Bank, seizing a Palestinian suspected of stabbing and shooting dead his cousin.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/11/13/world/middleeast/israel-west-bank-hospital-raid.html>); [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/.premium-1.685622>).

<a id="event-2015-11-12-0-4"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017), Military intervention against ISIL / American-led intervention.

**Archived source account.** Kurdish forces, backed by U.S. airstrikes, capture several villages in an offensive to retake the Iraqi town of Sinjar from Islamic State militants, who overran it more than a year ago. The operation aims to cordon off the town, take control of Islamic State supply routes, and establish a buffer zone to protect the town from artillery, according to the Kurdish national security council.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/12/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-sinjar-idUSKCN0T10AL20151112#wYoUOyYq66LDChsq.97>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/isis-terror/kurds-launch-offensive-retake-isis-held-iraqi-town-sinjar-n461846>).

<a id="event-2015-11-12-0-6"></a>

Context: 2015 Beirut bombings:.

**Archived source account.** Lebanese Interior Minister Nouhad Machnouk reports at least 43 people were killed and more than 239 wounded as two, simultaneous suicide bomb blasts hit a Shi'ite community center and a nearby bakery in the Beirut suburb of Bourj el-Barajneh, a section of the Lebanese capital controlled by Hezbollah. The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant claims responsibility for the attack. Machnouk said a third suicide bomber had been killed by one of the explosions before he could detonate his own bomb. The bombers struck as Lebanese lawmakers held a legislative session for the first time in over a year.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Star](<https://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/Lebanon-News/2015/Nov-12/322792-two-blasts-heard-in-south-beirut-suburb-of-burj-al-barajneh-witnesses.ashx>); [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1586551/at-least-20-killed-in-beirut-bomb-attacks>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/12/us-syria-crisis-hezbollah-blast-idUSKCN0T121P20151112#bEyVysSfB7EraMuE.97>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-11-12-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** French-American Florent Groberg receives the Medal of Honor, becoming the first foreign-born Medal of Honor recipient of the War in Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/11/12/politics/florent-groberg-medal-of-honor/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-11-12-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mario Draghi, head of the European Central Bank, tells the European Parliament in prepared testimony that the outlook for inflation is "weakening." The comment was taken to suggest the ECB will soon take a more stimulative stance on interest rates or money quantity.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-11-12/draghi-says-inflation-weakening-as-december-policy-choice-nears>).

<a id="event-2015-11-12-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The city of Montreal in Canada begins dumping 2 billion gallons of raw sewage into the Saint Lawrence River, an action the mayor, Denis Coderre, says is necessary to make repairs and improvements to the city's wastewater system. The move has caused outrage among residents and environmentalists, while the hashtag "\#flushgate‬" is being used on social media sites to voice opposition to the dumping effort.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/11/12/americas/canada-montreal-wastewater-dump/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-11-12-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Valletta Summit on Migration concludes with European leaders setting up a fund to promote development in African countries, in return for help in the European migrant crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Malta](<http://www.timesofmalta.com/articles/view/20151112/local/watch-valletta-summit-concluding-press-conference.591885>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-11-12-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The World Health Organization (WHO) announced that maternal deaths will have fallen 44% between 1990 and 2015; although, this falls short of the United Nations' Millennium Development Goal of 75% reduction.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34796833>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-11-12-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two nephews of Venezuelan First Lady Cilia Flores, who were arrested in Haiti by U.S. authorities on Tuesday, are indicted in New York for conspiring to smuggle cocaine into the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2015/11/12/2-nephews-venezuelan-first-lady-face-us-drug-smuggling-charges-ny/75639058/>); [Venezuelanalysis.com](<http://venezuelanalysis.com/news/11682>).

<a id="event-2015-11-12-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** More than a dozen alleged ISIS-linked, terrorist members of Rawti Shax, a European offshoot of the Iraqi Kurdish jihadist network Ansar al-Islam, are arrested in a coordinated, multi-nation sweep by police across Europe. The operation dismantled an integrated cell in Italy, the United Kingdom, Norway, Finland, Switzerland, and Germany. The group is accused of radicalizing fighters, planning attacks targeting Norwegian and British diplomats in the Middle East, and planning to establish a caliphate in Iraq's Kurdistan region.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/isis-uncovered/16-isis-linked-suspects-held-europe-wide-sweep-italy-officials-n461931>); [The Local](<http://www.thelocal.it/20151112/italy-announces-swoop-on-jihadist-network>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/11/12/europe/europe-terror-plots-arrests/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-12-5-3"></a>

Context: Human rights in Uzbekistan.

**Archived source account.** Uzbek political prisoner Murod Juraev is finally released after being imprisoned for 21 years.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/11/13/world/asia/uzbekistan-releases-political-prisoner-after-21-years.html>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2015-11-12-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russian Sports Minister Vitaly Mutko says there will be no boycott of next year's Olympics in Rio de Janeiro, and that he is ready to own up to some of the charges leveled in the World Anti-Doping Agency commission's massive report on doping, the Associated Press reports.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/9733dfa146214fe2ad8df024c039f20a/russian-sports-minister-mutko-rules-out-olympic-boycott>).

### 2015-11-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1166917936](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20November%2013&oldid=1166917936>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-13-0-1"></a>

Context: Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant.

**Archived source account.** The United States conducts airstrikes targeting Kuwaiti-British militant Jihadi John. Later, the U.S. says it is "reasonably certain" a drone strike in Syria killed Jihadi John, né Mohammed Emwazi.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-34805924>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/13/us-mideast-crisis-syria-islamic-state-idUSKCN0T20RT20151113#yuridKTMIVTMzyTj.97>).

<a id="event-2015-11-13-0-4"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017) / November 2015 Sinjar offensive.

**Archived source account.** Kurdish Peshmerga forces backed by U.S. airstrikes seize control of Sinjar in northern Iraq. Sinjar has been under Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant occupation since August 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/11/13/uk-mideast-crisis-iraq-sinjar-idUKKCN0T10BS20151113>).

<a id="event-2015-11-13-0-5"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** Multiple bombings in Baghdad targeting Iraqi Shiites kills at least 26 people. The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://news.yahoo.com/iraq-officials-suicide-bombing-baghdad-kills-17-121729470.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-13-0-7"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** French police report multiple blasts and gunfire in Paris with at least 26 dead in a restaurant in the 10th arrondissement and an explosion near the Stade de France.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Beast](<http://www.thedailybeast.com/cheats/2015/11/13/explosion-and-gunfire-reported-in-paris.html>); [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/E/EU_FRANCE_PARIS_SHOOTINGS?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT&amp;CTIME=2015-11-13-16-16-27>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/french-police-report-shootout-and-explosion-in-paris/2015/11/13/3288452e-8a4c-11e5-bd91-d385b244482f_story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-13-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** A day of mourning is held in Lebanon following two suicide attacks in the capital Beirut which killed at least 43 people.

<a id="event-2015-11-13-0-14"></a>

Context: Central African Republic Civil War (2012–present).

**Archived source account.** At least 22 people are killed this week in a string of raids on villages in the Central African Republic. The escalation of violence threatens to derail a visit by Pope Francis and crucial elections scheduled for December 27, 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/13/us-centralafrica-violence-idUSKCN0T21S120151113#0oxJ8yp3Sh1zLXKh.97>).

<a id="event-2015-11-13-0-16"></a>

#### Arts and culture

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/11/14/books/anne-frank-has-a-co-as-diary-gains-co-author-in-legal-move.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2015-11-13-1-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/13/us-chi-xcanada-m-a-nasdaq-idUSKCN0T22M020151113#tmC4wgdpvCFMAprR.97>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-11-13-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The bodies of eight babies are found wrapped in towels and inside plastic bags in an apartment in the town of Wallenfels in Germany's state of Bavaria. Authorities are looking for the apartment's most recent occupant, Andrea G, a 45-year-old woman.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/11/13/europe/germany-babies-bodies-found/>); [Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/news/world/europe/german-police-search-for-woman-after-dead-babies-discovered-1.2429255>).

#### International Relations

<a id="event-2015-11-13-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. diplomats, amid growing international concern the violence could spiral into an ethnic conflict, push for peace talks in Burundi. The European Union advises non-essential staff to evacuate the Central African nation amid rising violence and an uptick in political rhetoric. The head of the opposition UPRONA group urges the United Nations to send peacekeepers quickly. Yesterday, the UN Security Council called on the Burundi Government to protect human rights and cooperate with regional African mediators to immediately convene "an inclusive and genuine inter-Burundian dialogue" to find a peaceful resolution of the crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://america.aljazeera.com/articles/2015/11/13/us-urges-dialogue-in-burundi-as-dangerous-rhetoric-threatens-more-violence.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/13/us-burundi-unrest-idUSKCN0T20ZJ20151113#Yku8TkjMRXTFmpEE.97>); [UN](<http://www.un.org/apps/news/story.asp?NewsID=52538#.VkZzhF5BnYs>).

<a id="event-2015-11-13-4-2"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** German Chancellor Angela Merkel asserts she still isn't prepared to name an upper limit to the number of refugees who can come to Germany, despite mounting domestic political pressure.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/00d5817deb6d48c58ebad590a2f27b2d/latest-german-police-say-3-teens-assaulted-refugee>).

<a id="event-2015-11-13-4-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Oxfam's Belgrade Center for Human Rights reports migrants coming through Bulgaria have faced beatings, threats and other abuses by police, though the country's own refugee agency said it had received no such complaints.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/13/us-europe-migrants-bulgaria-idUSKCN0T20RJ20151113#wyh6zHMmhAVedDvW.97>).

<a id="event-2015-11-13-4-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War peace process.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry meets in Vienna, Austria, with the foreign ministers of Turkey and Saudi Arabia, as well as the U.N. special envoy for Syria, ahead of Saturday's next round of international summits on the Syrian Civil War. The talks, aimed toward a cease-fire in Syria's devastating war and a political transition to a post-war government, will include senior officials from 19 nations/groups and, as in October, Iran will participate.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/d183d47cee8249978e4e1588916cb4f0/kerry-vienna-critical-syria-meeting>).

<a id="event-2015-11-13-4-7"></a>

Context: Metrojet Flight 9268.

**Archived source account.** As a temporary security measure, effective Saturday, Russia bans incoming flights by Egypt's state-owned airline, EgyptAir, two weeks after an apparent terrorist bomb downed a Russian jet in the Sinai.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/13/us-egypt-crash-russia-egyptair-idUSKCN0T21MY20151113#3qMrTtu926zZVfXg.97>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-11-13-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in the Dominican Republic raid a mansion owned by 30-year-old Francisco Flores de Freites, one of the two nephews of Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro facing charges for allegedly trying to traffic 800 kg of cocaine into the U.S., and found more than 280 pounds of cocaine and 22 pounds of heroin hidden inside the nephew's posh Casa de Campo property and a 135-foot yacht named "The Kingdom" docked behind it.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://latino.foxnews.com/latino/news/2015/11/13/dominican-police-raid-mansion-yacht-venezuelan-president-kin-find-280lb-cocaine/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-11-13-6-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Myanmar general election.

**Archived source account.** Aung San Suu Kyi's National League for Democracy (NLD) wins an absolute majority with 348 seats taken in the country's parliament, 19 seats more than the required 329, marking Myanmar's first democratically-elected government since the 1962 Burmese coup d'état.

Source citations (as archived): [The Economist](<https://www.economist.com/news/asia/21678474-its-official-miss-suu-kyis-national-league-democracy-will-choose-next-president-not>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/nov/13/aung-san-suu-kyi-wins-myanmar-landmark-election>).

<a id="event-2015-11-13-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Colombia plans to legalize medical marijuana in a further shift in drug policy after suspending aerial fumigation of illicit crops. A decree approving the therapeutic use of marijuana will be signed in the coming days. Growing, distributing and selling cannabis will remain illegal.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/13/us-colombia-drugs-idUSKCN0T22J420151113#gI3tAhkwJXqu4H5H.97>); [teleSUR](<http://www.telesurtv.net/english/news/Medical-Marijuana-Set-to-Be-Legal-in-Colombia-20151113-0017.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks, Spillover of the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the terrorist attacks in Paris stands at 129.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/14/us-france-shooting-idUSKCN0T22IU20151114?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>).

<a id="event-2015-11-14-0-2"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks, Spillover of the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Michel Cadot, the head of the Paris Police Prefecture, says that all the attackers are believed to be dead.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2015/nov/13/shootings-reported-in-eastern-paris-live#block-56469c90e4b0ced428cb2822>).

<a id="event-2015-11-14-0-3"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks, Spillover of the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** French President François Hollande announces the cancellation of his participation at the G-20 Antalya summit in order to focus on the attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/france-s-hollande-cancels/2259848.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-14-0-4"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks, Spillover of the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Thousands are turning to social media (\#PorteOuverte/Twitter) to check-in on loved ones in the area, many using Facebook's "Safety Check" feature.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/paris-attack-survivors-use-facebook-safety-check-porteouverte/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-14-0-5"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks, Spillover of the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant releases an official statement and video, claiming responsibility for the attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/International/ISIS-claims-responsibility-for-Paris-terror-attacks-433023>).

<a id="event-2015-11-14-0-6"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks, Spillover of the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A Syrian passport is found near the body of one of the gunmen who died in Friday's attacks in Paris. The holder passed through the Greek island of Leros on October 3 as a refugee, according to Greek officials. A Greek police source said the passport's owner was a young man who had arrived in Leros with a group of 69 refugees and had his fingerprints taken by authorities there. Police declined to give his name.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/14/us-france-shooting-greece-idUSKCN0T312W20151114>); [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-11-15/details-emerge-about-paris-attackers-syrian-passport-found/6941864>).

<a id="event-2015-11-14-0-7"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks, Spillover of the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Poland's recently elected government led by Law and Justice (PiS), declares it will no longer accept EU-mandate quotas for refugees following the terrorist attacks in France.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/322051-poland-rejects-refugee-quota/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-14-0-9"></a>

Context: Military intervention against ISIL, Libyan Civil War (2014–present).

**Archived source account.** A U.S. airstrike on a compound in the Libyan port city of Derna is said to have killed Wisam al Zubaidi, also known as Abu Nabil al-Anbari, who commands the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant's branch in Libya. A Pentagon official, speaking on condition of anonymity to discuss details of the operation, said the airstrike involved F-15 aircraft and was believed to have killed Zubaidi. He said the attack had been planned for some time.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/us-officials-leader-of-islamic-state-in-libya-believed-killed-in-us-airstrike/2015/11/14/b42cb714-8af0-11e5-be39-0034bb576eee_story.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-34823466>).

<a id="event-2015-11-14-0-11"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017), Persecution of Yazidis by ISIL.

**Archived source account.** Kurdish Peshmerga forces discover a mass grave believed to contain the remains of more than 70 members of Iraq's Yazidi minority, mostly women, east of the recently liberated town of Sinjar.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/mass-grave-of-yazidis-unearthed-near-iraqs-sinjar_56475c97e4b08cda348907e2>).

<a id="event-2015-11-14-0-14"></a>

Context: Spillover of the Syrian Civil War, Turkey–ISIL conflict / Turkish forces engage Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) militants along the Syrian border:.

**Archived source account.** Turkish troops kill four Islamic State militants in Turkey's southeastern Gaziantep Province when two cars with ISIS passengers advanced on a Turkish armored vehicle near a border post in Oğuzeli.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Sabah](<http://www.dailysabah.com/politics/2015/11/14/security-forces-kill-4-isis-members-detain-13-in-southeast-turkey>).

<a id="event-2015-11-14-0-15"></a>

Context: Spillover of the Syrian Civil War, Turkey–ISIL conflict / Turkish forces engage Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) militants along the Syrian border:.

**Archived source account.** During a raid on a suspected ISIL hideout in the city of Gaziantep (Antep), a suicide bomber fires on Turkish police before he explodes, wounding five police officers, one seriously.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://america.aljazeera.com/articles/2015/11/15/suicide-bomb-in-turkey-injures-5-police-officers.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-11-14-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Geological Survey reports a magnitude 6.7 earthquake struck off the southwest coast of Japan. The quake occurred 119 miles (191 km) west-southwest of Kagoshima. No reports of major damage or injuries. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-11-14-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scott N. Johansen, a Utah Juvenile Court judge, reverses his original order to remove a foster child from same sex-parents. The state Division of Child and Family Services and foster parents all filed motions asking for the reconsideration and promising an appeal. The new decision eliminates the phrase, "It is not in the best interest of children to be raised by same-sex couples" and strikes an order for the child to be placed with a non-same-sex couple.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/11/14/us/utah-lesbian-couple-foster-child-ruling.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-14-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in South Korea fire tear gas and water cannons at anti-government protesters in Seoul. Around 70,000 people took part in the protests, the largest in Seoul since the 2008 US beef protest in South Korea..

Source citations (as archived): [Christian Science Monitor](<http://www.csmonitor.com/World/Asia-Pacific/2015/1114/Tens-of-thousands-anti-government-protesters-march-through-South-Korea-s-capital>).

<a id="event-2015-11-14-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Paris prosecutor François Molins says three jihadist cells, apparently multinational teams with links to the Middle East, Belgium, and possibly Germany, as well as France, staged coordinated attacks at bars, a concert hall, and a soccer stadium, killing 132 people and injuring 350, including around 90 who are in a serious condition.

<a id="event-2015-11-15-0-11"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / France-led coalition intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** France launches a series of airstrikes on Raqqa, the Islamic State's de facto capital in Syria, destroying a jihadi training camp and a munitions dump.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/E/EU_FRANCE_PARIS_ATTACKS_THE_LATEST?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT&amp;CTIME=2015-11-15-14-28-24>).

<a id="event-2015-11-15-0-13"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / American-led intervention in Syria.

**Archived source account.** A government official says the United States made a fresh delivery of ammunition to Syrian Arab Coalition fighters battling Islamic State in northern Syria, pushing ahead with a strategy that initially unnerved ally Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/15/us-mideast-crisis-ammunition-exclusive-idUSKCN0T412O20151115#5kLpChkyGDMjHAoD.97>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-11-15-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Daily fantasy sports companies DraftKings and FanDuel, who are fighting New York's cease-and-desist order that their industry is gambling in the U.S. state, apparently are OK with that label in the United Kingdom. DraftKings obtained a British gambling license in August and FanDuel applied for one earlier this month.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/U/US_DAILY_FANTASY_SPORTS_OVERSEAS?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT&amp;CTIME=2015-11-15-08-10-47>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-11-15-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The death toll from a landslide on Friday in China's Zhejiang province rises to 16 with 21 still missing.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2015/11/14/world/asia/ap-as-china-landslide.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-15-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Heavy rain leads to warnings of floods in mid and north Wales.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-wales-34822699?ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_campaign=bbc_wales_news&amp;ns_source=twitter&amp;ns_linkname=wales>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-11-15-3-1"></a>

Context: 2015 G-20 Antalya summit.

**Archived source account.** The leaders of nations with the top 20 economies vow to use all their policy resources to bolster a sagging global economic environment. While the European migrant crisis and terrorism were high on the agenda of this economic summit the terror attacks in Paris dominate conversations and meetings. In the wake of the attacks and during ongoing investigation, French President François Hollande remains in Paris.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/11/15/uk-g20-turkey-communique-idUKKCN0T40N420151115>); [CNN Money](<http://money.cnn.com/2015/11/15/news/economy/paris-attack-g20-summit/index.html>); [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/11/15/us/politics/paris-attacks-to-dominate-agenda-at-g-20-conference-in-turkey.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-15-3-2"></a>

Context: 2015 G-20 Antalya summit.

**Archived source account.** United States President Barack Obama and Russian President Vladimir Putin, in a G20 working lunch meeting, traded views on Syria's civil war: where they agreed, i.e. UN negotiations, cease-fire, and Syrian-led political transition; and where they disagreed, i.e. President Bashar al-Assad's future role. Obama reiterated his support for the full implementation of the Minsk agreements on Ukraine, including Ukraine's control of its borders.,,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/ba265c3816d344e6a18e3ce31fea18fb/obama-putin-huddle-sidelines-g-20-summit>); [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/322199-putin-obama-g20-summit/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/15/us-g20-turkey-idUSKCN0T409Y20151115#THuWoeUQXtI6GhXZ.97>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/paris-terror-attacks/obama-putin-go-head-head-g20-sidelines-n463821>).

<a id="event-2015-11-15-3-4"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** The top of Dubai's Burj Khalifa, the world's tallest skyscraper, is lit up in the blue, white and red of the French flag, in tribute to France and those killed in the attacks in Paris. Other landmark buildings in the United Arab Emirates, including the sail-shaped Burj Al Arab building, also paid tribute.,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/E/EU_FRANCE_PARIS_ATTACKS_THE_LATEST?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT&amp;CTIME=2015-11-15-14-28-24>); [Arabian Business](<http://www.arabianbusiness.com/uae-extends-solidarity-france-with-solemn-tribute-on-burj-khalifa-612407.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-15-3-6"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Swedish police increase checks of asylum facilities in the country's southwest amid reports refugees are leaving to avoid being registered by immigration officials.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/E/EU_EUROPE_MIGRANTS_THE_LATEST?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT&amp;CTIME=2015-11-15-13-57-35>).

<a id="event-2015-11-15-3-8"></a>

Context: Japan–Philippines relations.

**Archived source account.** Reuters reports Japanese Prime Minister Shinzō Abe and Philippine President Benigno Aquino are set to agree on a deal paving the way for Tokyo to directly supply Manila with used military equipment. An announcement is expected this week during the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Manila.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/16/us-japan-philippines-military-idUSKCN0T508W20151116#JrDPwsriVKpLk1Fc.97>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-11-15-4-1"></a>

Context: Myanmar general election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Aung San Suu Kyi holds talks with parliament's outgoing chairman, Shwe Mann, seeking his help in an orderly democratic transition to the newly-elected National League for Democracy (NLD) government. Mann, who was ousted as head of the Union Solidarity and Development Party in August, lost his house seat in the November 8 vote. The current parliament will have at least one more session.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/15/us-myanmar-election-idUSKCN0T40BN20151115#p3QQxFZgSrptsjVQ.97>).

<a id="event-2015-11-15-4-2"></a>

Context: Myanmar general election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Myanmar's President Thein Sein promises a smooth transfer of power following the National League for Democracy winning a majority of parliamentary seats in last week's elections.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/11/15/Myanmars-president-vows-smooth-transition-after-election-defeat/6711447641303/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_int>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2015-11-15-5-1"></a>

Context: UFC 193.

**Archived source account.** Holly Holm defeats Ronda Rousey in a women's bantamweight title match at Etihad Stadium in the Australian city of Melbourne, Victoria.

Source citations (as archived): [News Limited](<http://www.news.com.au/sport/ufc/ufc-193-live-coverage-of-ronda-rousey-v-holly-holm-in-melbourne/story-fnkjww7x-1227609587797>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/sports/boxing/la-sp-sn-ufc-193-live-updates-ronda-rousey-vs-holly-holm-20151114-story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-15-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In a suit filed by two former American professional football (NFL) players, the Ohio Supreme Court upholds a lower court ruling that Cleveland's formula for taxing visiting professional athletes, the so-called "jock tax," violates players' due process rights. A spokesman says the city will begin issuing refunds to players.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/b13eb77d818d479e9550e4b885303e82/cleveland-begin-refunding-players-jock-tax>).

<a id="event-2015-11-15-5-4"></a>

Context: 2015 Fed Cup.

**Archived source account.** In tennis, the Czech Republic retains the Fed Cup defeating Russia 3-2 in the final played at the O2 Arena in Prague. This is the Czech Republic's fourth title in five years.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo News](<https://news.yahoo.com/sharapova-beats-kvitova-russia-leads-2-1-fed-135547908.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-15-5-7"></a>

Context: 2015 NFL season / November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** Several NFL teams hold moment of silence before their games for victims of the Paris attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS Sports](<https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/nfl-holding-moment-of-silence-before-games-for-paris-attack-victims/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-15-5-9"></a>

Context: 2015 NFL season / 2015 Green Bay Packers season.

**Archived source account.** For the first time since 1991, the Detroit Lions defeated the Green Bay Packers at Lambeau Field with an 18-16 victory.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS Sports](<https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/for-the-first-time-since-1991-the-lions-beat-the-packers-in-green-bay/>).

### 2015-11-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076181702](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20November%2016&oldid=1076181702>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-16-0-1"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** Authorities search for Belgium-born French national Salah Abdeslam, one of three brothers suspected of involvement in the attacks. Raids are reported to have taken place in Grenoble, Toulouse, Jeumont and the Paris suburb of Bobigny. This contradicts previously published official information that all the perpetrators of the attacks were dead.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/11/15/world/paris-attacks/index.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2015/nov/16/paris-attacks-france-airstrikes-isis-raqqa-syria-live>).

<a id="event-2015-11-16-0-2"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** Mohamed Abdeslam, brother of suspect fugitive Salah Abdeslam, and Ibrahim Abdeslam, a suicide bomber in the attacks, is released by authorities after questioning this weekend. His attorney told reporters, her client "hadn't made the same life choices."

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/france-attacks-mohamed-abdeslam-salah-abdeslam-fleeing-suspect-bataclan-a6736871.html>); [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2015/11/16/french-jets-target-isis-in-raqqa/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-16-0-3"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** Abdelhamid Abaaoud, a leading Belgian jihadist who is one of the most active ISIS operators in Syria, is the suspected head organizer behind the Paris massacre. He is also linked to thwarted attacks on a Paris-bound high-speed train and a church near the French capital, earlier this year.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/paris-terror-attacks/paris-attacks-belgian-abdelhamid-abaaoud-reportedly-mastermind-n464081>).

<a id="event-2015-11-16-0-4"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** Hacktivist group Anonymous declares war on ISIS taking down 2,000 related Twitter accounts as well as some donation groups for the terrorists on the Dark Web. The group also criticized the lack of similar actions by Western governments.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151119044845/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/anonymous-declares-war-on-isis-after-paris-attacks/ar-BBn3FZy?li=AAa0dzB&amp;ocid=iehp>).

<a id="event-2015-11-16-0-5"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** A U.S. official states that intelligence sources detect increased chatter encouraging terrorist attacks on the U.S. but lacks credible or actionable information. This, following reports that Iraqi intelligence sources warned anti-ISIS coalition members of attacks one day before the attacks. The information from Iraq also lacked specific information.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<http://www.military.com/daily-news/2015/11/16/officials-no-credible-threats-target-us-after-paris-attacks.html>); [Associate Press](<http://www.militarytimes.com/story/military/2015/11/15/iraq-warned-of-attacks-before-paris-assault/75833046/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-16-0-6"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** The governors of the U.S. states of Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Louisiana, Maine, Michigan, Mississippi, Massachusetts, Nebraska, New Hampshire, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas and Wisconsin say they will not accept Syrian refugees in response to the Islamic terror attacks in Paris. Twenty-three of the 24 governors are Republican with the other being Democrat (New Hampshire).

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2015/11/16/alabama-refuses-syrian-refugees-paris-terror-attack/75857924/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-16-0-8"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Yemeni security officials, who are neutral in the conflict, say Saudi-led airstrikes and clashes have killed over 40 Houthi militants and 4 civilians over the past 24 hours, with most of the airstrikes taking place in the southwestern Ibb Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/yemen-officials-say-airstrikes-clashes-kill-some-40-rebels/2015/11/16/9137c40c-8c7a-11e5-934c-a369c80822c2_story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-16-0-10"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Egypt's security forces shoot dead at least 24 ISIS militants as they hid inside a cave in a mountainous area in central Sinai, not far from the crash site of Metrojet Flight 9268, a Russian airliner the group says it brought down.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/16/us-egypt-crash-islamic-state-idUSKCN0T51QC20151116>); [Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/russian-plane-crash-egypt-kills-24-isis-militants-70km-from-crash-site-a6736626.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-11-16-1-1"></a>

Context: Economy of Japan.

**Archived source account.** The Japanese economy goes into recession for the second time since the election of Prime Minister Shinzo Abe.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News Australia](<http://www.skynews.com.au/business/business/world/2015/11/16/japan-sinks-into-recession.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-16-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Marriott International announces it has agreed to buy Starwood Hotels &amp; Resorts in a $12.2 billion deal that would create the world’s largest hotel company.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/capitalbusiness/marriott-to-buy-starwood-creating-the-worlds-largest-hotel-company/2015/11/16/acb40a20-8c6f-11e5-acff-673ae92ddd2b_story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-16-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the United States, federal and state authorities announce Education Management Corp., a company that enrolls more than 100,000 students at North American for-profit trade schools and colleges, agrees to pay $95.5 million to settle claims it illegally paid recruiters and exaggerated the career-placement abilities of its schools. EDMC also agreed to forgive $102.8 million in loans made to more than 80,000 former students.

Source citations (as archived): [AP Via Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/lifestyle/us-reaches-955m-settlement-in-for-profit-education-case/2015/11/16/5c2a0cc2-8c7d-11e5-934c-a369c80822c2_story.html>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/business/la-fi-for-profit-college-settlement-20151116-story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-16-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** American, British-based telecommunications and television company Liberty Global announces a £3.5bn (US$5.3bn) deal to buy British multinational telecommunications company Cable and Wireless Communications (CWC).

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/finance/newsbysector/mediatechnologyandtelecoms/telecoms/11999530/Liberty-Global-snaps-up-Cable-and-Wireless-in-3.6bn-deal.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-11-16-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The death toll from a landslide in a village in China's Zhejiang province rises to 25 with 12 people still missing.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/b22c74da3c144afc810f8fe572f1e8c4/14-bodies-found-after-landslide-china-hits-village>).

<a id="event-2015-11-16-2-2"></a>

Context: 2015 North Indian Ocean cyclone season.

**Archived source account.** Floods in Sri Lanka and the southern Indian state of Tamil Nadu cause over 70 deaths with the city of Chennai worst affected.

Source citations (as archived): [Thomson Reuters](<http://www.trust.org/item/20151116175728-ybkm1/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-16-2-4"></a>

Context: 2015 Atlantic hurricane season, Hurricane Joaquin.

**Archived source account.** The United States National Transportation Safety Board announces it has completed its search of the sunken El Faro, but did not find the voyage data recorder, i.e., the black box.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/4115471/investigators-end-search-of-el-faro-without-finding-black-box/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-11-16-3-1"></a>

Context: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea, China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The USS Stethem visits Shanghai, signaling that relations between the two countries continue despite tensions over the recent USS Lassen cruise near artificial islands constructed by China. The navies of the two nations plan combined maritime exercise as well.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151117152306/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/us-navy-ship-visits-china-wake-recent-tensions-35225756>).

<a id="event-2015-11-16-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nicaragua deploys its military to help close its southern border in a dispute with Costa Rica over the passage of Cuban migrants on their way to the United States. Nicaragua’s government said Costa Rica’s decision to grant seven-day transit visas to 1,200 Cuban migrants who entered the country through Panama, “violated national sovereignty”. Nicaraguan troops and riot police fired tear gas at people attempting to enter in what Costa Rica called a "humanitarian crisis".

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-11-16/cuban-migrant-wave-prompts-nicaraguan-military-to-seal-border>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-11-16-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six people, including a child, have been found dead on private property in Anderson County, southeast of Dallas, Texas, USA. The victims are members of two different families. One person, unrelated to the victims, is charged with one count of murder. More charges are expected.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS DFW](<http://dfw.cbslocal.com/2015/11/16/family-confirms-6-killed-at-anderson-county-campsite/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-11-16-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** United States President Barack Obama, in Antalya, Turkey, says America will continue to accept refugees from Syria and elsewhere, though, "Only after subjecting them to rigorous screening and security checks." Responding to calls to admit Christians but not Muslims into the country, he said, "We don’t have religious tests to our compassion."

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-politics/wp/2015/11/16/obama-calls-idea-of-screening-syrian-refugees-based-on-religion-shameful-defends-white-house-strategy/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-16-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Cambodian opposition leader Sam Rainsy delays his return home from South Korea as tension comes to a head between his supporters and those of Prime Minister Hun Sen. Friday, a Cambodian court issued an arrest warrant related to an old defamation case for which Sam had already received a royal pardon. Today, Parliament stripped him of immunity protection.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/16/us-cambodia-politics-idUSKCN0T52LH20151116#mUcMM0qBeuwbOPO2.97>).

### 2015-11-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1262044881](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20November%2017&oldid=1262044881>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-17-0-1"></a>

Context: Metrojet Flight 9268.

**Archived source account.** Russia's Federal Security Service announces that the plane was destroyed by a bomb.,

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/nov/17/egypt-plane-crash-bomb-jet-russia-security-service>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/17/us-egypt-crash-russia-blast-idUSKCN0T60PS20151117>).

<a id="event-2015-11-17-0-2"></a>

Context: Metrojet Flight 9268.

**Archived source account.** In a broadcast meeting from The Kremlin, Russian President Vladimir Putin vows retribution to those responsible for last month’s downing of the aircraft. Putin orders the Russian Navy to coordinate military operations in Syria with the French Navy. Russia's Federal Security Service offers a $50 million bounty for the bombers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/17/us-egypt-crash-russia-blast-idUSKCN0T60PS20151117#Hx23lyRXlafjcZZA.97>).

<a id="event-2015-11-17-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Russian military launches cruise missile strikes from the Mediterranean on ISIS positions in Al-Raqqah, the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant's de facto capital in Syria, Aleppo, and Idlib. A U.S. official confirms that Russia has conducted a significant number of strikes in Syria using both sea-launched cruise missiles and long-range bombers. Russian President Vladimir Putin has pledged to escalate his military campaign in Syria after it was confirmed that a bomb brought down Metrojet Flight 9268 over Egypt's Sinai Peninsula.,

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/322413-russia-missiles-raqqa-mediterranean/>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/russia-launches-cruise-missiles-at-isis-stronghold-of-raqqa-in-syria-a6737631.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-17-0-6"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** A blast at a market in the northeastern Nigerian city of Yola, kills at least 32 people and wounds 80 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/17/us-nigeria-blast-idUSKCN0T62NC20151117>).

<a id="event-2015-11-17-0-8"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** Two Air France flights bound for Paris from the United States are diverted for several hours on following anonymous bomb threats.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2015/11/18/france-shooting-airfranceair-france-klm-idINKCN0T70CP20151118>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-11-17-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** American actor Charlie Sheen confirms he has HIV.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS](<http://www.cbsnews.com/pictures/celebrities-with-hiv-aids/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-34845630>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-11-17-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 6.5-magnitude earthquake strikes southwest of Ioannina in Greece, at a depth of 6.2 mi killing at least two people. The quake damages the main road in the southwestern part of Lefkada.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/322385-powerul-quake-strikes-greece/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-17-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the United States, the National Weather Service issues a blizzard warning for northeastern Colorado and western Kansas with an expected snowfall by midday of 12 inches in Denver, Colorado. Denver International Airport cancels 143 arriving and departing flighits. Several tornadoes occur overnight in northern Texas, western Kansas, and southern Nebraska.,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/17/us-usa-storm-idUSKCN0T610M20151117#1KCTDhlHB7vd5wTS.97>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2015/11/17/storm-blasting-denver-cancels-flights-closes-roads/75916616/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-17-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the Pacific Northwest region of the United States, a windstorm with gusts as high as 119 mph kills 4 people and leaves more than 1 million without electricity; some rivers in Western Washington also experience moderate to severe flooding. Washington Governor Jay Inslee declares a state of emergency after the storm, requesting federal assistance with cleanup efforts.,

Source citations (as archived): [The Weather Channel](<http://www.weather.com/news/weather/news/northwest-high-winds-rain-snow-impacts>); [The Seattle Times](<http://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/weather/high-winds-to-hit-puget-sound-area-flooding-downed-trees-landslides-possible/>); [KIRO-TV](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151122002825/http://www.kirotv.com/news/news/thousands-remain-without-power-after-violent-storm/npQJm/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-17-2-4"></a>

Context: 2015-16 Australian bushfire season.

**Archived source account.** Bushfires burning near Esperance on the coast of Western Australia may have killed four people.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-11-17-3-1"></a>

Context: APEC Philippines 2015.

**Archived source account.** Human Rights Watch says that the Philippine government is detaining street children and homeless people harshly and involuntarily as part of preparations for an international summit. The government denies that the people concerned are being abused and such moves were part of a regular and year-round outreach program.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/11/17/world/asia/philippines-rounding-up-homeless-before-apec-summit-human-rights-watch-says.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-11-17-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Israeli government outlaws the northern branch of the Islamic Movement in Israel, declaring it "an illegal organization". The northern branch of the Islamic Movement is led by Raed Salah, who has been convicted in court of numerous activities, including funding Hamas, contacting an Iranian agent, assaulting a police officer, and leading a violent protest.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Arab-Israeli-Conflict/Israel-outlaws-northern-branch-of-Islamic-Movement-434343>).

<a id="event-2015-11-17-4-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/17/us-japan-okinawa-base-idUSKCN0T60BN20151117#sWbrWbG5dqS8zYUe.97>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-11-17-5-1"></a>

Context: Refugees of the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** More than half of the state governors in the United States reject accepting asylum seekers from Syria after the attacks in Paris. All except one of them are Republicans.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/11/16/world/paris-attacks-syrian-refugees-backlash/index.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-17-5-2"></a>

Context: Refugees of the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Obama administration officials hold a conference call with 34 governors to assure them, "refugees would undergo the most rigorous screening and security vetting of any category of traveler to the United States." A spokesperson for Michigan Gov. Rick Snyder said that he has asked federal officials for "more robust data" and an "enhanced flow of information.",

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.trust.org/item/20151118015212-z9u0v>); [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151119053703/http://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/white-house-plans-call-governors-syrian-refugees-35262385>).

<a id="event-2015-11-17-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The president of the Czech Republic, Miloš Zeman, marks the 26th anniversary of the Velvet Revolution by attending an anti-Islam rally in Prague with the "Bloc against Islam" group which supports the president. The rally is also attended by observers from the German protest movement, PEGIDA (Patriotic Europeans Against the Islamisation of the Occident) and Tommy Robinson, a prominent British anti-Islam activist. Zeman tells the crowd of several thousand that they aren't extremists for advocating closing the Republic’s borders to Muslim migrants.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151118151658/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/czech-president-attends-addresses-rally-muslims-35252147>).
