#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-11-19-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The World Economic Forum in its annual Global Gender Gap Report says that it would take 118 years before women and men have equal pay for similar occupations, such as white collar jobs.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34842471>); [The Huffington Post](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/there-are-27-countries-better-at-gender-equality-than-the-us_564cb447e4b031745cef15d8>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/lifeandstyle/2015/nov/18/women-will-get-equal-pay-in-118-years-wef-gender-parity>).

<a id="event-2015-11-19-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The New York State Department of Financial Services fines Barclays $150m (£98.2m) for the way it treated its foreign exchange customers.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/2015/nov/18/barclays-fined-150m-over-forex-trading-by-new-york-regulator>).

<a id="event-2015-11-19-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Most of the employees of the Reserve Bank of India, that country's central bank, go on strike demanding better pension benefits. The RBI acknowledges "some interruptions" in its clearing and settlement functions.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-34875968>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-11-19-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In connection with World Toilet Day, the United Nations reports that 2.4 billion people lack adequate sanitation, and nearly one billion have no toilet facilities and are forced to relieve themselves in areas without facilities.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/a7cafd7a2f7a42bfa925945b193ae4f6/un-spotlights-24-billion-people-without-adequate-sanitation>).

<a id="event-2015-11-19-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. clears genetically-modified Atlantic salmon, made by Massachusetts-based AquaBounty Technologies, for human consumption.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/19/us-aquabounty-technologies-fda-idUSKCN0T826T20151119>).

<a id="event-2015-11-19-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The American Medical Association urges Congress and/or the FDA to ban direct-to-consumer advertising of prescription drugs and medical devices. The AMA says that the ads increase demand for inappropriate, expensive treatments even if cheaper ones have the same potentials.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/morning-mix/wp/2015/11/19/american-medical-association-urges-ban-on-tv-drug-ads/?uid=0ef76ca8-45d6-11e0-a478-1231380f446b&amp;wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_mix>); [The Science Times](<http://www.sciencetimes.com/articles/7736/20151119/medical-doctor-group-ama-seeks-ban-ads-prescription-drugs.htm>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-11-19-4-1"></a>

Context: APEC Philippines 2015.

**Archived source account.** Asia-Pacific leaders, in the Philippines for the 2015 Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meeting, which has been overshadowed by the concurrent Paris attacks, call on governments to urgently increase cooperation in the fight against terrorism.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/f7365f863de64f9eb8955abee29d6e76/apec-leaders-urgent-need-cooperate-against-terrorism>).

<a id="event-2015-11-19-4-2"></a>

Context: APEC Philippines 2015.

**Archived source account.** Local labor and farmer groups protest in Manila over talks on inclusive growth during the APEC meeting.

Source citations (as archived): [The Economic Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151120224319/http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/world-news/behind-pomp-of-asia-pacific-economic-cooperation-summit-crushing-poverty-endures/articleshow/49843988.cms>).

<a id="event-2015-11-19-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Pew Research Center report finds, from 2009 to 2014, more Mexicans, including unauthorized immigrants, are leaving the United States than entering it. An increasing share of Mexicans says life north of the border is neither better nor worse than life in Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/19/us-usa-immigration-mexico-idUSKCN0T82F220151119#xEluMKZPTa0ZmMER.97>).

<a id="event-2015-11-19-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations General Assembly humanitarian committee adopts, by a 112–19 vote (with 50 abstentions), a resolution that condemns North Korea for gross violations of human rights and supports referring the country and its leaders to the International Criminal Court in The Hague. The resolution will be sent to the full General Assembly, where it is expected to pass, given the committee vote.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/united-nations-human-rights-councils-commission-of-inquiry-condemns-north-korea-for-gross-human/>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/11/19/UN-committee-denounces-North-Korea-human-rights-violations/1891447986491/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-19-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Obama Administration through the United States State Department expresses deep frustration over the lack of democratic progress in Thailand after last year's military coup, saying a new constitution there won't pass the "smell test" unless civil society helps to draft it.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/822373ce280b4c9b83418d75a6d90461/us-voices-frustration-over-democracy-progress-thailand>); [US Dept of State](<http://www.state.gov/j/drl/rls/rm/2015/249788.htm>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-11-19-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court sentences former restaurant spokesperson Jared Fogle to over 15 years imprisonment for sex with minors and the possession of child pornography.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2015/11/19/456622271/jared-fogle-to-learn-sentence-for-sex-with-minors-child-pornography>).

<a id="event-2015-11-19-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Convictions for sex offenses against minors accounts for the largest group of military inmates in U.S. military prisons.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151122194144/http://www.startribune.com/opaque-military-justice-system-shields-child-sex-abuse-cases/351291701/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-19-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israeli agent Jonathan Pollard, a former U.S. intelligence analyst convicted and sentenced to a life imprisonment for providing top secret classified information to Israel, will be released by the Obama Administration on parole tomorrow after serving 30 years in a U.S. federal prison. He will be given an ankle monitor while he completes five years of parole in America.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/11/19/us/jonathan-pollard-israel-spy-release/index.html>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/39e8e3dad0154301b64f66f57b3b8439/freedom-nears-american-convicted-spying-israel>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Diaspora/Jonathan-Pollard-to-be-released-November-20-410419>).

<a id="event-2015-11-19-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Kuwaiti authorities announce they arrested six members of an extremist network suspected of supplying funds and weapons, including rockets, to Daesh (Islamic State) militants. Four others are still being sought outside of the country. The group includes a Lebanese, an Egyptian, five Syrians, two Australians, and a Kuwaiti national.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2015/11/19/kuwait-security-idINKCN0T82M320151119>); [Time](<http://time.com/4121728/kuwait-detained-weapons-isis-terrorism/>); [The Gulf News](<http://gulfnews.com/news/gulf/kuwait/kuwait-busts-multi-national-daesh-cell-1.1623170>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-11-19-6-1"></a>

Context: 2015 United Nations Climate Change Conference.

**Archived source account.** A mass rally due to be held on November 29, 2015 in Paris on the eve of climate change talks is called off due to the threat of terrorism.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-11-19/paris-climate-protests-cancelled/6955650>).

<a id="event-2015-11-19-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Peter Robinson announces he will step down as Northern Ireland's First Minister and as leader of the Democratic Unionist Party, corresponding with recent tensions in the area and a murder linked with the Irish Republican Army.

Source citations (as archived): [ITV News](<http://www.itv.com/news/update/2015-11-19/robinson-to-step-down-as-northern-irelands-first-minister/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-19-6-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House of Representatives, defying a veto-threat by President Barack Obama, overwhelmingly passes legislation to suspend the Obama administration's program to admit 10,000 Syrian and Iraqi refugees into the country. The bill will now face a vote in the U.S. Senate.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/19/us-paris-shooting-congress-idUSKCN0T82PG20151119#VOb0FVgT5ovpVKZS.97>).

### 2015-11-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076181211](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20November%2020&oldid=1076181211>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-20-0-1"></a>

Context: Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** Cyprus offers France the use of its airbase facilities to bomb the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant in Syria. Cypriot airbases are already being used by British and Canadian air forces for military operations.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2015/nov/19/paris-attacks-police-investigate-isis-mastermind-dead-st-denis-raid-live>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-0-3"></a>

Context: Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Russian warships launch cruise missiles from the Caspian Sea against Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant positions in Syria's eastern Deir ez-Zor. Russian Defense Minister, Sergey Shoigu, reported over 600 terrorists were killed in the strikes. Video footage also emerged of Russian ground crew servicemen writing the words "For Paris" on bombs to be dropped on ISIL targets in a show of solidarity with France in the wake of the November 13 terror attacks that left 130 people dead in Paris.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/322881-russia-cruise-missiles-isis/>); [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1591362/video-shows-russia-firing-cruise-missiles-at-is>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-0-5"></a>

Context: 2015 Bamako hotel attack.

**Archived source account.** Ten gunmen storm the five-star Radisson Blu Hotel in the Malian capital Bamako, taking 170 hostages with at least 27 people killed. The grenade-toting assailants free captives who are able to recite the Quran. The hotel is "often used" by Air France staff. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<http://www.france24.com/en/breaking/20151120-gunfire-breaks-out-luxury-hotel-malian-capital-bamaka-no-word-casualties-yet/?ns_campaign=al_en&amp;ns_mchannel=email_marketing&amp;ns_source=AL_20151120_0947&amp;ns_linkname=20151120_breaking_news&amp;ns_fee=0&amp;f24_member_id=1080960490882>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/gunmen-take-170-hostage-radisson-hotel-bamako-mali-n466831?cid=eml_nbn_20151120>); [The New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/news/world/shooting-reported-mali-hotel-article-1.2441291>); [Reuters](<https://news.yahoo.com/least-27-dead-islamists-seize-luxury-hotel-malis-163200618--finance.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-0-6"></a>

Context: 2015 Bamako hotel attack.

**Archived source account.** Mali security forces launch an assault on the gunmen and all surviving hostages are freed.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/11/20/Gunmen-storm-Mali-hotel-killing-three-80-hostages-released/1521448013051/?spt=hts&amp;or=1>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-34879955#>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-0-7"></a>

Context: 2015 Bamako hotel attack.

**Archived source account.** Mali declares a 10-day state of emergency following the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [i24 News](<http://www.i24news.tv/en/news/international/africa/93013-151120-hostages-taken-in-shooting-attack-at-radisson-hotel-in-mali>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-0-8"></a>

Context: 2015 Bamako hotel attack.

**Archived source account.** African militant jihadist organization Al-Murabitoun and al-Qaeda in the Islamic Maghreb (AQIM) claim responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/11/20/africa/mali-shooting/>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2015/11/21/mali-attacks-idINKCN0T90SI20151121>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-0-10"></a>

Context: Xinjiang conflict.

**Archived source account.** Chinese security forces have killed 28 members of a supposed terrorist group in the mainly ethnic Uyghur Xinjiang region.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-34876365>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-0-12"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** Officials report three people died in the Saint-Denis raid. The body of a second woman is found at the apartment where a woman and Paris attacks ringleader Abdelhamid Abaaoud were killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1591146/paris-siege-third-body-found-at-scene>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-0-13"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** The French Senate approves President François Hollande's request to extend the state of emergency until the end of February 2016. The National Assembly passed the three-month extension yesterday.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/dc34d503e24544acbfd58492741d7975/latest-france-demands-urgent-action-border-security>); [Radio France Internationale](<http://www.english.rfi.fr/france/20151119-french-parliament-extends-state-emergency-after-paris-attacks>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-0-14"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** Fugitive ISIS gunman Salah Abdeslam called three friends saying he is hiding in the Brussels area and is desperately trying to get to ISIS territory in Syria. He said local ISIS members are unhappy with him since he failed to detonate his suicide vest. His brother Mohamed Abdeslam has publicly pleaded with Salah to turn himself in.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/friends-isis-paris-fugitive-called-desperate-hiding-brussels/story?id=35330776>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-0-15"></a>

**Archived source account.** A newly released ISIS video threatens attacks on the White House in the U.S., monuments in France, U.S. President Obama, French President François Hollande, and targets in Italy.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/19/us-france-shooting-usa-video-idUSKCN0T831K20151119#bXToIeV735C8TPe6.97>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/11/18/us/new-york-isis-video-threat/index.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-0-17"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Two attacks on security checkpoints by ISIS militants in Yemen's historic Shibam town and Al Qatn District in the central Hadhramaut Governorate leave at least 15 pro-Hadi government soldiers dead.

Source citations (as archived): [The National](<http://www.thenational.ae/world/middle-east/isil-militants-kill-15-yemeni-government-soldiers>).

#### Art and culture

<a id="event-2015-11-20-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A New York City businesswoman, who wanted to bring a "grander scale" to her yearly charitable giving, bought a toy store's entire inventory to donate to homeless kids.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Odd_News/2015/11/20/New-York-woman-buys-out-entire-toy-store-for-homeless-kids/9661448035784/?spt=hs&amp;or=on>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The world’s second-largest diamond of gem quality, Karowe AK6, is found in the Karowe mine located north of the Botswanan capital Gaborone by the Lucara Diamond Corp. The 1,111-carat diamond is second only to the 3,106-carat Cullinan diamond (Star of Africa) found in South Africa in 1905.

Source citations (as archived): [Forbes](<https://www.forbes.com/sites/trevornace/2015/11/20/1111-carat-diamond-worlds-second-largest-found-botswana/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-11-20-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Britain's National Union of Journalists announces a strike against the Financial Times, protesting the changes in pension arrangements since the acquisition of the FT by a Japanese media group, Nikkei.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-34871497>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-11-20-3-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Macedonia, Serbia, Croatia, and Slovenia shut their borders to so-called economic migrants, those not coming from war-torn countries such as Syria, Afghanistan, or Iraq, leaving thousands stranded at Balkan border crossings. Around 500 migrants from Iran, Morocco, and Algeria gather on the border between Greece and Macedonia to protest the closure.

Source citations (as archived): [The Irish Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/world-news/europe/balkan-chaos-as-borders-shut-to-economic-migrants-only-34218315.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-3-2"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** European Union ministers, in light of the attacks in Paris last week, gather in Brussels for an emergency security summit on the need to strengthen border checks on travelers.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.ndtv.com/world-news/european-union-ministers-to-discuss-border-controls-after-paris-attacks-1245516>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-3-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** French Prime Minister Manuel Valls said some of the Paris attackers exploited Europe's refugee crisis to "slip in" to France unnoticed. Valls warns the passport-free Schengen zone is at risk if Europe fails to "take responsibility" over border controls.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1590914/paris-killers-used-refugee-crisis-to-slip-in>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-3-5"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** North Korea and South Korea agree to hold talks next week. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap](<http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/news/2015/11/20/0200000000AEN20151120004700315.html?input=www.tweeter.com>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-11-20-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sweden's national security service Säpo are questioning terrorist suspect Moder Mothama Magid, a 22-year-old Iraqi, who is accused of planning to launch a terror attack on the Swedish capital Stockholm.

Source citations (as archived): [Local](<http://www.thelocal.se/20151119/sweden-terror-suspect-held-after-police-raid>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The family of Swedish diplomat Raoul Wallenberg, who saved tens of thousands of Jews from the Holocaust only to languish in a Russian prison, have asked authorities to officially declare him dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/raoul-wallenbergs-family-seek-to-have-him-declared-dead/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States releases on parole convicted Israeli spy Jonathan Pollard, a former U.S. intelligence analyst, who served 30 years in federal prison. His parole, approved on July 28, 2015, is for five years during which time he has to remain in the United States. A supporter said Pollard will have a curfew and will wear a GPS unit.

Source citations (as archived): [The Globe and Mail](<https://www.theglobeandmail.com/news/world/israeli-spy-jonathan-pollard-released-from-us-prison/article27385323/>); [The Globe and Mail-2](<https://www.theglobeandmail.com/news/world/israeli-spy-to-face-parole-restrictions-after-30-years-in-us-prison/article27379948/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-4-3"></a>

Context: The United States releases on parole convicted Israeli spy Jonathan Pollard, a former U.S. intelligence analyst, who served 30 years in federal prison. His parole, approved on July 28, 2015, is for five years during which time he has to remain in the United States. A supporter said Pollard will have a curfew and will wear a GPS unit..

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Pollard’s lawyers, two Democratic members of Congress from New York, Eliot Engel and Jerrold Nadler, and others have requested Pollard be able to travel immediately to Israel so he can live with his family. The White House has said it has no intention of altering the conditions of Pollard’s parole.

Source citations (as archived): [The Globe and Mail](<https://www.theglobeandmail.com/news/world/israeli-spy-jonathan-pollard-released-from-us-prison/article27385323/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Justice Department files criminal charges against three individuals and three companies--Black Elk, Grand Isle Shipyard and oil field services company Wood Group--in connection with a 2012 oil platform incident in the Gulf of Mexico that left three workers dead. The charges range from manslaughter to violations of the federal Clean Water Act.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Business_News/Energy-Industry/2015/11/20/Federal-charges-filed-for-deadly-2012-oil-rig-blast/6451448024137/?spt=rln&amp;or=2>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** USPlabs and S.K. Laboratory are indicted following a U.S. Department of Justice investigation finds synthetic ingredients manufactured in China were added to workout boosters and weight-loss products the firms claimed to be natural. Supplements from these companies were previously implicated in consumer illnesses and death. Several other defendants from the companies face additional charges.

Source citations (as archived): [Military Times](<http://www.militarytimes.com/story/military/2015/11/19/jack3d-oxyelite-pro-manufacturers-face-criminal-charges/76043058/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-11-20-5-1"></a>

Context: New Zealand flag referendum.

**Archived source account.** The first stage of the voting process to potentially select a new flag of New Zealand starts.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-34876354>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-11-20-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASA orders its first commercial crew mission from private company SpaceX.

Source citations (as archived): [The Verge](<https://www.theverge.com/2015/11/20/9772564/spacex-iss-nasa-astronaut-crewed-mission-announced>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A jury in a Texas federal court finds for Apple Inc., in a lawsuit brought against Apple by a subsidiary of Pendrell Corporation. Pendrell has charged that Apple infringed patents on techniques that help restrict the use of web content to authorized persons, i.e. anti-piracy software.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/20/us-apple-pendrell-verdict-idUSKCN0T92UU20151120#wfrvArEbawOuVHw6.97>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2015-11-20-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russian pole vaulter Yelena Isinbayeva, who has two Olympic gold medals and 30 world records, told Sky News she is going to fight for what she believes to be her right to compete at the 2016 Olympics. She calls on the IAAF, at the world governing track and field organization's annual meeting on 26 November, to rescind their ban on clean Russian athletes.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1590919/russian-athlete-i-will-fight-to-compete>).

<a id="event-2015-11-20-7-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In association football, Corinthians win their sixth Campeonato Brasileiro Série A title with four games remaining of the season.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\!](<https://sports.yahoo.com/news/wagner-love-seals-sixth-brazilian-title-corinthians-112422590--sow.html>).

### 2015-11-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1166337017](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20November%2021&oldid=1166337017>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-21-0-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Brussels lockdown.

**Archived source account.** Belgium raises its terror alert level to the highest level in the capital Brussels and deploys soldiers on the streets of major Belgian cities such as Brussels, Antwerp and Ghent. As part of the emergency measures, the Belgian government is advising people in the Brussels area to avoid crowded places, which includes concerts, train stations, airports, public transportation, and busy shopping streets, warning of an "imminent threat".

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151121021606/http://www.france24.com/en/20151121-belgium-raises-terror-alert-highest-level-brussels-statement>); [BNO News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151122173246/http://bnonews.com/news/index.php/news/id2692>).

<a id="event-2015-11-21-0-2"></a>

Context: 2015 Brussels lockdown.

**Archived source account.** The Brussels Metro is closed as part of the state of alert.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: 2015 Nepal fuel crisis.

**Archived source account.** Nepalese police open fire on groups, who were protesting the new constitution proposals by blockading a highway. Two protesters were killed and at least 28 were hurt, including 15 police officers. A third protester was killed in Rajbiraj, the headquarters of the Saptari District.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151125224423/http://wtop.com/news/2015/11/2-ethnic-protesters-killed-dozens-injured-in-south-nepal/>); [Singapore Today Online](<http://www.todayonline.com/world/asia/nepal-police-kill-3-protesters-clashes-over-constitution>).

<a id="event-2015-11-22-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Belgian authorities announce 16 more arrests in anti-terror raids. Neither weapons nor explosives were discovered during the raids. Tomorrow, a judge will decide whether these people will continue to be detained.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2015/11/22/belgian-authorities-arrest-six-in-anti-terror-raids/>); [Reuters](<https://news.yahoo.com/belgium-maintains-maximum-security-alert-status-brussels-093047636.html>).

**Archived source account.** The Canadian government announces its embassy in Brussels will be closed "until further notice" and will only be providing emergency consular services.

All 256 passengers and crew are safe. The flight (Turkish Airlines TYH2/TK2) left JFK International Airport at 9 p.m. Saturday and landed just before 1 a.m. Sunday at Halifax Stanfield International Airport. The Royal Canadian Mounted Police is investigating.

Context: A Turkish Airlines plane flying from New York City (U.S.) to Istanbul, Turkey, is diverted to Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada, after authorities received information of a bomb threat. All 256 passengers and crew are safe. The flight (Turkish Airlines TYH2/TK2) left JFK International Airport at 9 p.m. Saturday and landed just before 1 a.m. Sunday at Halifax Stanfield International Airport. #### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-11-22-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nola, a 41-year-old female northern white rhino, dies at the San Diego Zoo Safari Park. She was euthanized after her health took a turn for the worse. Nola was rescued from violent poaching in the southern savanna woodlands of Sudan and came to the park in 1989. Only three animals of this endangered species are known left in the world.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151123032256/http://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/endangered-white-rhino-dies-san-diego-zoo-35357190>); [San Diego Union Tribune](<http://www.sandiegouniontribune.com/news/2015/nov/22/northern-white-rhino-dies-at-sd-zoo-safari-park/>); [F&amp;F Photography-2014](<https://featherandfurphotography.wordpress.com/2014/03/30/only-7-northern-white-rhinos-remain-on-planet-earth/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-11-22-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In motorsport, Kyle Busch wins the 2015 Ford EcoBoost 400 at Homestead–Miami Speedway to become the 2015 NASCAR Sprint Cup Series champion. He missed the first 11 races of the season with a broken leg and foot, becoming the first champion not to start the complete season since 1971. 4-time champion Jeff Gordon, who has scored the third-most NASCAR Cup wins of all-time, finishes in 6th position in his final race before retirement.

Source citations (as archived): [USA TODAY](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/nascar/2015/11/22/kyle-busch-wins-sprint-cup-championship/76230752/>).

### 2015-11-23

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-23-0-1"></a>

Context: Maguindanao massacre.

**Archived source account.** Human rights activists and families of the victims decry the lack of justice six years after the murder of around 58 people, including journalists and politicians, in Maguindanao, Mindanao. They criticize the regime of Philippines President Benigno Aquino III for the lack of convictions in the trial.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151124162926/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/hope-fading-justice-philippines-worst-massacre-35368912>); [Voice of America](<http://m.voanews.com/a/justice-elusive-in-2009-philippines-massacre/3069781.html>); [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2015/11/23/families-victims-killed-in-philippines-worst-massacre-losing-hope-seeing/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-23-0-3"></a>

Context: Israeli-Palestinian conflict (2015).

**Archived source account.** A Palestinian kills a 20 year-old Israeli and wounds two women in a stabbing attack at a gas station near the town of Modi’in; the Palestinian assailant is shot and killed by an officer at the scene.

Source citations (as archived): [Ynet News](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4729699,00.html>); [Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/israeli-man-killed-woman-hurt-in-stabbing-at-west-bank-gas-station/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-23-0-4"></a>

Context: Israeli-Palestinian conflict (2015).

**Archived source account.** Two Palestinian teenage girls, ages 14 and 16, use scissors to stab a 70-year-old Palestinian man whom they misidentified as an Israeli, and other Israeli civilians, near Jerusalem’s Mahane Yehuda market; one of the attackers is killed and the other wounded while being subdued, and an Israeli civilian is wounded by police gunfire.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/watch-palestinian-girls-stab-elderly-arab-man-in-jerusalem/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-11-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** American pharmaceutical companies Pfizer and Allergan, Plc announce plans to merge to form the world's largest drug company. The merger is subject to approval from regulators in the U.S., European Union and elsewhere as well as approval by shareholders of both companies. If approved, the deal will reduce tax revenue paid to the U.S. by approximately $930 million.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/merger-of-pfizer-and-allergan-would-create-worlds-biggest-drug-maker/2015/11/22/05ea4260-915e-11e5-a2d6-f57908580b1f_story.html>); [AP](<http://www.denverpost.com/business/ci_29157701/160b-deal-combine-pfizer-and-allergan-raises-outcry>).

<a id="event-2015-11-23-1-1"></a>

Context: American pharmaceutical companies Pfizer and Allergan, Plc announce plans to merge to form the world's largest drug company. The merger is subject to approval from regulators in the U.S., European Union and elsewhere as well as approval by shareholders of both companies. If approved, the deal will reduce tax revenue paid to the U.S. by approximately $930 million..

**Archived source account.** A Washington University in St. Louis (U.S.) international tax law expert says this deal is the biggest merger involving tax inversion, i.e., relocation of a corporation's legal domicile to a lower-tax nation, usually while retaining operations in its higher-tax country. "None of the special anti-inversion laws and regulations issued by the federal government will apply to Pfizer post-merger," Professor Adam Rosenzweig, JD, said. Rosenzweig believes this deal will encourage more U.S. companies to follow Pfizer's approach in future mergers.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington University](<http://news.wustl.edu/news/Pages/Rosenzweig-Pfizer-tax-inversion.aspx>).

Context: Hong Kong local elections, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong's pro-democracy movement gets a boost with Umbrella Soldiers winning at least four seats in Sunday's election although the distribution of political power over the district council seats remains broadly the same vis-a-vis the Hong Kong local elections, 2011.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/23/us-hongkong-politics-election-idUSKCN0TA0WL20151123#XOO6IdHeYSDgGPot.97>); [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/umbrella-soldiers-seats-hong-kong-elections-040136004.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-11-23-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A new United Nations report finds 90 percent of the thousands of disasters over the last two decades are weather-related. The majority have been caused by floods, storms, heatwaves and droughts. Researchers with the United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNISDR) suggest the cost has been between $250 and $350 billion per year, i.e., total of $5 trillion/$7 trillion. The report concurs with findings of previous studies that weather disasters are on the rise compared to previous decades. Flooding, in particular, is becoming more frequent and more devastating as sea levels continue to rise.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Science_News/2015/11/23/UN-study-Vast-majority-of-world-disasters-caused-by-weather/6091448310499/?spt=hs&amp;or=sn>).

<a id="event-2015-11-23-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Blue Origin launches the unmanned rocket New Shephard to the edge of space (100.5 km) and lands safely upright on its original launch pad in Texas, becoming the first organization to do so.

Source citations (as archived): [press release](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151125051400/https://www.blueorigin.com/news/news/blue-origin-makes-historic-rocket-landing>); [WSJ](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/blue-origin-succeeds-in-vertically-landing-spent-rocket-back-at-texas-launch-site-1448372666>).

### 2015-11-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131605299](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20November%2024&oldid=1131605299>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-24-0-2"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency / November 2015 Sinai attack.

**Archived source account.** A day after the second round of parliamentary elections closes, militants attack a hotel housing election judges in the provincial capital of al-Arish in Egypt's North Sinai. At least seven people are killed and 12 others injured, including two judges. The Islamic State's Wilayat Sinai branch claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/24/us-egypt-bomb-idUSKBN0TD0BC20151124#LdtqKjp34tSTQJDC.97>); [Eyewitness News](<http://ewn.co.za/2015/11/24/Twin-bombs-explode-outside-Egyptian-hotel>).

<a id="event-2015-11-24-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War, 2015 Russian Sukhoi Su-24 shootdown.

**Archived source account.** Turkish F-16 fighter jets shoot down a Russian Sukhoi Su-24 aircraft that had allegedly infringed its airspace near the Syrian border. Russia's Ministry of Defence denies the Su-24 entered Turkish airspace and initially said it was shot down by ground fire over Syria's Latakia Governorate. A video emerged of one pilot killed as local rebel Turkmen fighters shot at him while he was parachuting and a video of his body, while the fate of the other pilot is unknown but is presumed dead. A combat search and rescue mission by Russian forces failed to reach them. It is the first time a NATO member has shot down a Russian plane since the 1950s.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/world-news/middle-east/turkey-shoots-down-russian-fighter-jet-near-syrian-border-34228526.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-34907983#>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/middleeast/syria/12013212/Turkey-shoots-down-Russian-military-plane-on-Syria-border-live.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-24-0-5"></a>

Context: Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War, 2015 Russian Sukhoi Su-24 shootdown.

**Archived source account.** A Russian military helicopter is destroyed on the ground by a U.S. TOW missile used by Syrian rebels after it was forced to make an emergency landing in northern Latakia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/24/us-mideast-syria-crisis-helicopter-idUSKBN0TD1KQ20151124>).

<a id="event-2015-11-24-0-6"></a>

Context: Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War, 2015 Russian Sukhoi Su-24 shootdown.

**Archived source account.** A Russian marine is killed by rebel gunfire while on a mission to rescue the crew of the downed Su-24 near the Syrian-Turkish border, Russia's Defence Ministry confirms.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-34917485>).

<a id="event-2015-11-24-0-7"></a>

Context: Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War, 2015 Russian Sukhoi Su-24 shootdown.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin says there will be “serious consequences” for Russia–Turkey relations following Turkey's actions, and describes the incident as a "stab in the back by the accomplices of terrorists”. Russian government agencies began limiting Russian tourists from traveling to Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/vladimir-putin-warns-of-serious-consequences-following-turkey-shooting-down-russian-jet-a6746836.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-24-0-8"></a>

Context: Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War, 2015 Russian Sukhoi Su-24 shootdown.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan warns everyone to "respect the right of Turkey to defend its borders," says that the reason why worse incidents have not taken place in the past regarding Syria is because of the "cool-headedness of Turkey" and stresses that Turkey's actions are fully in line with the new rules of engagement that the country adopted after Syria shot down a Turkish jet in 2012.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-34912581>).

<a id="event-2015-11-24-0-9"></a>

Context: Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War, 2015 Russian Sukhoi Su-24 shootdown.

**Archived source account.** Turkish Prime Minister Ahmet Davutoğlu defends the action saying Turkey has the right "to take all kinds of measures" against border violations as a "national duty," but that it did not amount to an aggression against any foreign territory and the country called for NATO to hold an extraordinary meeting later in the day.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://tribune.com.pk/story/997532/nato-calls-extraordinary-meeting-after-turkey-downs-russian-jet/>).

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/11/25/us/politics/medal-of-freedom-awarded-to-a-class-act-group-of-17.html?_r=0>).

Context: LGBT rights in Vietnam.

**Archived source account.** The National Assembly of Vietnam unanimously passes the law, which will take effect in 2017 as part of the revised civil code, that recognizes and allows gender reassignment surgery.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151126142436/http://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/vietnams-transgender-law-paves-surgeries-35406933>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-11-24-2-1"></a>

Context: Ebola virus epidemic in West Africa.

**Archived source account.** A 15-year-old boy from Liberia's Paynesville district, who tested positive for Ebola last week, dies of the disease at a treatment center near the capital, Monrovia, just over 11 weeks after the World Health Organization (WHO) declared the country free of the virus. The boy's father and brother, who also tested positive, are at the center; his mother and two other siblings were admitted for observation. In addition, 160 people who came in direct contact with the boy, are being monitored.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/25/us-health-ebola-liberia-idUSKBN0TE0TM20151125#4ZVUa5Z6Rs7ZfuCQ.97>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-34909949>); [AP](<http://abcnews.go.com/Health/girl-fights-rare-case-breast-cancer-age/story?id=35392011>).

<a id="event-2015-11-24-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. federal health officials are investigating an outbreak of deadly E. coli bacteria that has sickened 19 people in California, Colorado, Missouri, Montana, Utah, Virginia, and Washington. Preliminary evidence suggests that rotisserie chicken salad made and sold in Costco Wholesale stores is the likely source. This follows a totally unrelated outbreak earlier this month connected to Chipotle Mexican Grill restaurants. Those restaurants have been cleaned, new ingredients ordered, and have been reopened. The Costco E. coli 157 strain, which has caused five people to be hospitalized- two of which developed hemolytic uremic syndrome (HUS; which can readily lead to acute renal failure and sepsis), is more dangerous than the Chipotle E. coli 026 strain, though there have been no deaths yet.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151128034914/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/e-coli-tied-to-costco-more-dangerous-than-chipotle-outbreak/ar-BBnr89W?li=BBnbfcL>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/to-your-health/wp/2015/11/24/costco-chicken-salad-linked-to-e-coli-outbreak-in-7-states-cdc-says/?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_evening>); [Washington Post-2](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/to-your-health/wp/2015/11/03/major-foodborne-outbreaks-in-u-s-have-tripled-in-last-20-years/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-11-24-3-1"></a>

Context: United Kingdom withdrawal from the European Union.

**Archived source account.** According to an opinion poll, a majority of British citizens now want the United Kingdom to leave the European Union as voter anxiety rises over the bloc's handling of a crisis provoked by an influx of migrants into Europe. A referendum on the United Kingdom's EU membership is scheduled to take place before the end of 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/11/24/uk-britain-eu-poll-idUKKBN0TD0FY20151124>).

<a id="event-2015-11-24-3-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Sweden will introduce tighter border controls and asylum rules in a bid to reduce the number of asylum seekers entering the country. Sweden expects up to 190,000 asylum seekers to reach its borders this year and says its reception system cannot cope. "The situation is untenable", according to Swedish prime minister Stefan Löfven who told reporters, "to put it bluntly, more people will have to seek asylum and get protection in other European countries".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/24/us-europe-migrants-sweden-idUSKBN0TD1SC20151124>).

<a id="event-2015-11-24-3-4"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Germany starts deporting unsuccessful asylum seekers to the Balkans.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.trust.org/item/20151124175709-2r1xi>).

<a id="event-2015-11-24-3-6"></a>

Context: Israel–United States relations, Palestine–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** United States Secretary of State John F. Kerry holds separate talks with Israeli and Palestinian leaders, his first on their home turf in over a year since Israeli-Palestinian negotiations broke down in the spring of 2014, in a bid to curb the persistent wave of violence that erupted two months ago.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/world/middleeast/la-fg-israel-palestinians-kerry-20151124-story.html>).
