<a id="event-2015-11-24-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A military court in Bangkok charges two men, Adem Karadag and Yusufu Miefaili, with offences related to the 2015 Bangkok bombing.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/11/thai-military-court-charges-bangkok-blast-suspects-151124041245335.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-24-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bomb blast at the Hellenic Business Federation offices in central Athens, Greece, damages the Cypriot Embassy across the street. While there is yet no claim for responsibility the authorities suspect a domestic guerrilla group set off the blast.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/24/us-eurozone-greece-blast-idUSKBN0TD06T20151124>).

<a id="event-2015-11-24-4-3"></a>

Context: Shooting of Laquan McDonald.

**Archived source account.** Chicago, Illinois police officer Jason Van Dyke is charged with first-degree murder for the October 2014 shooting death of Laquan McDonald, a 17-year-old boy armed with a 3-inch knife. The charge comes shortly before the release of the police video showing the shooting. Chicago Mayor Rahm Emanuel meets with community leaders to discuss the video’s release and the potential ramifications for the city.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/11/24/us/laquan-mcdonald-chicago-shooting-video/index.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-24-4-5"></a>

Context: 2015 Roubaix shootings.

**Archived source account.** At least one person is killed after a group of armed men took people hostage in the northern French town of Roubaix near the Belgian border. The hostages are thought to be a bank director and his family. French police say the incident may be related to a robbery and not to the November 2015 attacks in Paris.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/world-news/europe/hostagetaker-killed-and-other-suspects-at-large-as-hostages-moved-to-secure-place-34231357.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-24-4-7"></a>

Context: Recordings of JFK Assassination.

**Archived source account.** Gayle Nix Jackson, granddaughter of Orville Nix who filmed U.S. President John F. Kennedy’s assassination, sues the government to get the original copy of her grandfather’s movie back — or to get paid for it. A former FBI analyst said, “The film is a mirror image of the Zapruder film from the other side of Dealey Plaza."

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/morning-mix/wp/2015/11/24/lawsuit-seeks-return-of-missing-jfk-assassination-footage/?uid=0ef76ca8-45d6-11e0-a478-1231380f446b&amp;wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_mix>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-34907705>); [Document on Scribd.com](<https://www.scribd.com/doc/290879705/JFK-Film-Lawsuit>).

<a id="event-2015-11-24-4-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Minneapolis, Minnesota (U.S.) police arrest three men suspected of involvement in Monday's shooting of five people, with non-life-threatening gunshot injuries, who had been protesting the recent police killing of Jamar Clark, a 24-year-old African-American man. Protesters, who had been told to watch out for white supremacists wearing masks or camouflage clothing, said that the shooting occurred after a group of people — three men and a woman, all wearing ski masks — were seen filming the protest. The two officers involved in Mr. Clark's shooting are on paid leave during the investigations, including one by the Justice Department's civil rights division.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/morning-mix/wp/2015/11/24/five-people-shot-near-minneapolis-protest-cops-searching-for-3-white-male-suspects/?uid=0ef76ca8-45d6-11e0-a478-1231380f446b&amp;wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_mix>); [Washington Post update](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-nation/wp/2015/11/24/minneapolis-police-arrest-two-people-after-shooting-injures-five-near-protests/?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_evening>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-11-24-5-1"></a>

Context: U.S. reactions to November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** The American Civil Liberties Union of Indiana sues Indiana Governor Mike Pence over his decision to block Syrian refugees from resettling in the state. The ACLU, on behalf of Indianapolis-based nonprofit Exodus Refugee Immigration, accuses Pence of violating the Equal Protection Clause of the Constitution by accepting refugees from other countries but not those from Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151125155701/http://www.miamiherald.com/news/nation-world/article46183315.html>); [Indianapolis Star](<http://www.indystar.com/story/news/politics/2015/11/23/gov-mike-pence-sued-halting-syrian-refugee-resettlement-indiana/76279528/>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/2015/11/18/indiana-bound-syrian-refugees-redirected-connecticut/75988858/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-24-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** António Costa, the leader of the Socialist Party, is named as the Prime Minister of Portugal.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/24/portugal-government-premier-idUSP4N12801720151124>).

<a id="event-2015-11-24-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Echoing criticisms of the U.S. intelligence community in the wake of the 9/11 terrorist attacks, Derek Harvey, a former U.S. intelligence official, says that the U.S. intelligence community is failing in its assessments of the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant. Another unnamed source says the U.S. intelligence community is “playing catch up“ regarding efforts to monitor ISIL activities in the U.S. These, following reports that U.S. Central Command intelligence analysts were instructed to give favorable spin on anti-ISIL efforts.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/northamerica/usa/12013132/US-intelligence-officials-have-underestimated-Isils-plan-to-attack-the-West.html>); [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2015/11/23/emails-show-dod-analysts-told-to-cut-it-out-on-isis-warnings-ig-probe-expands.html>).

### 2015-11-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087273100](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20November%2025&oldid=1087273100>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-25-0-1"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir.

**Archived source account.** Insurgents attack an Indian Army base in northern Kashmir. At least three attackers are killed.

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<http://www.ndtv.com/india-news/firing-at-army-camp-in-jammu-and-kashmirs-tanghdhar-sector-1247318>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2015/11/25/india-kashmir-terrorists-idINKBN0TE0BN20151125>).

<a id="event-2015-11-25-0-3"></a>

Context: Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Russian Defense Minister, Sergey Shoigu, says Russia will deploy its S-400 defense missile system at the Khmeimim Air Base in Syria's Latakia Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/323379-s400-russia-syria-airbase/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-25-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Several trucks are left burning at a rebel-run border crossing on the Syrian-Turkish border after a Russian airstrike hit what was reported to be an aid convoy in the town of Azaz. At least seven people are reportedly killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/11/25/uk-mideast-crisis-syria-trucks-idUKKBN0TE22S20151125>); [Daily Sabah](<http://www.dailysabah.com/syrian-crisis/2015/11/25/russian-airstrikes-target-aid-convoy-in-northwestern-syrian-town-of-azaz-seven-reportedly-killed>).

<a id="event-2015-11-25-0-6"></a>

Context: Balochistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Unidentified gunmen abduct 22 passengers from a coach in Kandasool near the city of Pasni.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Times](<http://www.dailytimes.com.pk/national/25-Nov-2015/22-passengers-abducted-in-pasni>).

<a id="event-2015-11-25-0-8"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present).

**Archived source account.** The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant claim responsibility for yesterday's attack on Tunisia's presidential guard in Tunis that killed 14 people.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/76196a3930424a33989d3e4d5f85859c/tunisia-explosion-death-toll-rises-13>).

<a id="event-2015-11-25-0-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Germany will deploy up to 650 troops to Mali as part of the U.N. peacekeeping mission in Mali (MINUSMA).

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Star](<https://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/World/2015/Nov-25/324546-germany-to-send-up-to-650-soldiers-to-mali-for-peacekeeping-mission.ashx>).

<a id="event-2015-11-25-0-11"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** The United Arab Emirates has recruited several hundred Central and South American mercenaries to fight the Houthis in Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/11/26/world/middleeast/emirates-secretly-sends-colombian-mercenaries-to-fight-in-yemen.html?hp&amp;action=click&amp;pgtype=Homepage&amp;clickSource=story-heading&amp;module=second-column-region&amp;region=top-news&amp;WT.nav=top-news>).

<a id="event-2015-11-25-0-13"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** The French Senate votes 325-0 to extend the fight against the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/482ba6ff2b5b4359a80bc230a02ec917/latest-eu-chief-defends-visa-free-travel>).

<a id="event-2015-11-25-0-15"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Several American personnel are suspended after an official report finds that human error was to blame for an airstrike on a Doctors without Borders hospital in the Afghan city of Kunduz in October that killed 30 people. No criminal charges were filed.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/11/25/politics/afghanistan-kunduz-doctors-without-borders-hospital/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-11-25-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An 18th-century pink Indian diamond worth at least $5 million and a Cartier diamond tiara are discovered in the jewelry recovered from Imelda Marcos.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/nov/24/philippines-revalues-jewellery-seized-from-imelda-marcos-in-1986>).

<a id="event-2015-11-25-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Gambia bans female genital mutilation with President Yahya Jammeh saying it is not required in Islam.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-34921135>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-11-25-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The new 20 euro note, the third in the Europa series, enters into circulation today. The European Central Bank says the banknote has a “refreshed look and more vibrant colours,” and includes a new kind of security feature: a “portrait window” near the top of the hologram stripe which becomes transparent when seen against the light.

Source citations (as archived): [Sofia Globe](<http://sofiaglobe.com/2015/11/25/new-20-euro-note-goes-into-circulation-on-november-25/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-11-25-3-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 Australian bushfire season.

**Archived source account.** A bushfire burns out of control near the South Australian town of Wasleys with authorities warning of significant risk to lives and property. Two deaths have been confirmed with another person feared dead.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-11-25/residents-describe-terror-of-mallala-bushfire/6974200>); [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-11-26/interstate-fire-crews-to-join-fight-against-deadly-sa-blaze/6974372>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-11-25-4-1"></a>

Context: Russia–Ukraine gas disputes.

**Archived source account.** Russia's Gazprom halts gas supplies to Ukraine until the Ukrainian government pays in advance for future supplies to replenish the current supplies of gas that it has used up; Ukraine says it has stopped buying from Gazprom because it can get cheaper gas from Europe. Roughly 15% of the gas used in Europe travels through Ukraine, and a previous cut-off of gas supplies in 2009 caused serious disruptions in shipments to EU countries at the height of winter.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1593946/russias-gazprom-halts-ukraine-gas-supplies>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34920207>).

<a id="event-2015-11-25-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ukraine bans all Russian planes from using its airspace.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34920207>).

<a id="event-2015-11-25-4-4"></a>

Context: Pope Francis's 2015 visit to North America.

**Archived source account.** A one-year old baby girl with an apparently incurable illness, who was kissed by Pope Francis during his visit to Philadelphia in September, gets MRI results showing her brain tumor has shrunk significantly. Some friends and family call it the "Miracle on Market Street."

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/pope-francis-visits-america/divine-moment-baby-kissed-pope-philadelphia-sees-brain-tumor-shrink-n469751>); [Philadelphia Daily News](<http://www.philly.com/philly/news/pope/20151123_Miracle_on_Market__Tot_s_tumor_shrinks_weeks_after_encounter_with_Pope_Francis.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-25-4-6"></a>

Context: Pope Francis's visit to Kenya.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis makes his first official visit to Africa.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/25/us-pope-africa-idUSKBN0TD37620151125>).

<a id="event-2015-11-25-4-7"></a>

Context: Pope Francis's visit to Kenya.

**Archived source account.** Francis encourages Kenyans to work for peace and forgiveness amid a wave of extremist violence on the continent which has threatened to disrupt his trip. His six-day pilgrimage will also take him to Uganda and the Central African Republic.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.sltrib.com/home/3228771-155/pope-francis-urges-kenyans-to-work>).

<a id="event-2015-11-25-4-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Associated Press reports that Russia's crackdown on Muslims is fueling their exodus to ISIS. For example, Russia's southernmost republic of Dagestan keeps devout Muslims under surveillance, routinely raids their homes, and hauls them to police stations to give DNA samples and fingerprints. Regional police say nearly a third of the estimated 3,000 Russians who are believed to have gone to fight alongside IS militants in Syria are from Dagestan. The AP added, "Few efforts are made by Russian authorities to stop young men from leaving."

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/a1a8d401a82442cb9151b09acb0e8ae7/russian-crackdown-muslims-fuels-exodus-islamic-state>).

<a id="event-2015-11-25-4-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Treasury Department sanctions Syrian businessman George Haswani who "serves as a middleman" for oil purchases by the Syrian government from the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant. His company, an engineering and construction firm, is also sanctioned.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/25/us-mideast-crisis-usa-sanctions-idUSKBN0TE23P20151125#5yqAeylT8l59tsIx.97>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-11-25-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former world cruiserweight boxing champion O'Neil Bell is shot to death in a robbery in the American city of Atlanta.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-3334014/Former-boxing-champion-O-Neil-Supernova-Bell-dies-shot-stabbed-armed-robbery-Atlanta.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-25-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sergey Mironov, leader of the Russian opposition party, A Just Russia, submits a bill to the State Duma on holding to account anyone who denies that the 1915 mass killings of Armenians by Ottoman Turkish forces was a "genocide".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/25/us-turkey-armenia-russia-bill-idUSKBN0TE1WL20151125>).

<a id="event-2015-11-25-5-3"></a>

Context: General Motors ignition switch scandal.

**Archived source account.** U.S. District Judge Jesse Furman rules General Motors Co., and its outside law firm King &amp; Spalding, do not have to turn over lawyer-client documents from previously settled ignition switch lawsuits to plaintiffs’ lawyers in pending cases.

Source citations (as archived): [The Detroit News](<http://www.detroitnews.com/story/business/autos/general-motors/2015/11/25/judge-require-gm-law-firm-produce-documents/76385550/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-11-25-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian marathon runner Tetyana Hamera-Shmyrko is given a four-year ban for a doping offence.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/fe94bf5de2a44a28aa4e96226c5427fd/olympic-marathoner-shmyrko-banned-doping-ukraine>).

<a id="event-2015-11-25-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The family of U.S. National Football League star Frank Gifford, who died last August at age 84, announces that he suffered from chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE), a brain disease linked to head injuries commonly found in American football.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/11/25/health/frank-gifford-cte-concussion-chronic-traumatic-encephalopathy/index.html>); [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/11/26/sports/football/frank-gifford-had-cte-family-says.html?hp&amp;action=click&amp;pgtype=Homepage&amp;clickSource=story-heading&amp;module=second-column-region&amp;region=top-news&amp;WT.nav=top-news>).

### 2015-11-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076180808](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20November%2026&oldid=1076180808>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-26-0-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Russian Sukhoi Su-24 shootdown.

**Archived source account.** The Turkish military releases what it says are a series of audio recordings of warnings issued to a Russian jet before it was shot down near the Syrian border.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-11-26/turkish-military-releases-recording-warning-sent-to-russian-jet/6976156>).

<a id="event-2015-11-26-0-3"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict (2015).

**Archived source account.** The Palestinian Ministry of Health says a 21 year-old man has died in clashes with Israeli Army soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/ad8007d6fd35404c9ac49a84f01d5aaf/palestinian-dies-clashes-israeli-troops-west-bank>).

<a id="event-2015-11-26-0-5"></a>

Context: Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** British Prime Minister David Cameron, in a speech to the House of Commons says that Islamic extremists have already threatened citizens of the United Kingdom and UK military airstrikes against ISIL in Syria will serve only to make the UK safer. Cameron also says that the UK cannot outsource its security and must stand by France in the wake of the November 2015 Paris attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-34927939>).

<a id="event-2015-11-26-0-6"></a>

Context: Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** Jean-Yves Le Drian, the French Minister of Defence, calls on the United Kingdom to join France in bombing ISIL.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/nov/26/france-appeals-britain-join-syrian-war-against-isis-french-defence-minister-le-drian?CMP=share_btn_tw>).

<a id="event-2015-11-26-0-7"></a>

Context: Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** Following meetings with French President François Hollande at the Kremlin, Russian President Vladimir Putin says he is ready to coordinate strikes against the Islamic State with the United States and its allies, but warns acts like the Turkish downing of a Russian jet could destroy any chance of collaboration.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/russia-targets-turkish-economy-in-retaliation-for-downing-of-warplane/2015/11/26/b0fb7fac-9433-11e5-a2d6-f57908580b1f_story.html?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_evening>).

<a id="event-2015-11-26-0-9"></a>

Context: 2015 Brussels lockdown, Paris attack aftermath.

**Archived source account.** Belgian authorities reduce the threat level in Brussels from its highest level of four to three. The escalation to level four came after suspects in the ISIL attacks in Paris were linked to the city. Suspected Paris gunman, Salah Abdeslam, who lived in Brussels for several years, remains at large.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34933500>).

<a id="event-2015-11-26-0-10"></a>

Context: 2015 Brussels lockdown, Paris attack aftermath.

**Archived source account.** A suspicious powder feared to be anthrax found at a Brussels mosque, close to the European Union headquarters, is a false alarm. Testing determines it is flour.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/26/us-france-shooting-belgium-mosque-idUSKBN0TF1GT20151126?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>); [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.com/belgian-officials-say-potential-anthrax-brussels-mosque-false-alarm-raids-are-2201495>).

<a id="event-2015-11-26-0-12"></a>

Context: Islamist insurgency in West Africa.

**Archived source account.** At least 18 people are killed and over 100 homes torched after Boko Haram militants attacked a village near the commune of Bosso in Niger's southern Diffa Region.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/18-killed-boko-haram-attack-southeast-niger-134025219.html>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-11-26-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Martin Shkreli's Turing Pharmaceuticals is reneging on its pledge to cut the $750-per-pill price for Daraprim, a medication that has been marketed for 62 years. Instead, the biotech company is reducing what it charges hospitals, by up to 50 percent, for this parasitic infection treatment. Imprimis Pharmaceuticals, a pharmacy that compounds prescription drugs for individual patients, started selling a custom-made version of Pyrimethamine, the chemical name for Daraprim, for 99 cents per capsule. Impris reports orders are pouring in from doctors.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/economy/turing-reneges-on-drug-price-cut-rivals-version-sells-well/2015/11/25/d2c22bd8-93cd-11e5-b5e4-279b4501e8a6_story.html?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_evening>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-11-26-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 15 people are killed after a Russian Mi-8 transport helicopter carrying oil workers crashes in eastern Siberia near the Yenisei River. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/russian-helicopter-crashes-siberia-killing-10-35426968>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2015/11/26/russia-helicopter-crash-idINL8N13L0JC20151126>).

<a id="event-2015-11-26-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A sinkhole the size of a football field swallows a large section of beach on Australia's North Stradbroke Island. Local authorities have warned beach-goers to stay away from Jumpinpin beach due to fears the sinkhole could grow even larger.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2015/nov/26/sinkhole-size-of-football-field-swallows-part-of-beach-on-queensland-island>).

<a id="event-2015-11-26-2-3"></a>

Context: 2015-16 Australian bushfire season.

**Archived source account.** A New South Wales Rural Fire Service firefighter dies while fighting an out of control bushfire near Cessnock in the Hunter Valley.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Telegraph](<http://www.dailytelegraph.com.au/news/nsw/sydney-weather-temperatures-to-reach-38c-severe-fire-danger-warning-in-place/story-fni0cx12-1227623366887>).

<a id="event-2015-11-26-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least eleven people have died and 70 injured after two buses carrying tourism workers collide in the eastern Dominican Republic.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/4d69f06e6bae42a58ad8b02f523c2b8f/dominican-officials-say-least-11-dead-bus-collision>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-11-26-3-1"></a>

Context: Pope Francis's visit to Kenya.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis condemns the way young people have been "radicalized in the name of religion to sow discord and fear," during a talk in Nairobi, Kenya.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/pope-francis-condemns-radicalization-of-youth-in-name-of-religion/2015/11/26/3e1bfe0e-915d-11e5-befa-99ceebcbb272_story.html?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_headlines>).

<a id="event-2015-11-26-3-2"></a>

Context: Pope Francis's visit to Kenya.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis celebrates a historic Mass in Kenya before delivering a stern environmental warning to the world. "It would be sad, and I dare say even catastrophic, were particular interests to prevail over the common good and lead to manipulating information in order to protect their own plans and projects," the Pope said, urging nations to reach agreement over curbing fossil fuel emissions.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/11/26/africa/kenya-pope-francis-trip-main/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-26-3-4"></a>

Context: 2015 United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP21).

**Archived source account.** France is deploying more than 10,000 personnel to provide security for the two-week UN Climate Change Conference that opens in Le Bourget in Paris on Monday, November 30, 2015. Around 150 heads of state or government are expected to attend COP21's opening day.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua News Agency](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/video/2015-11/26/c_134858311.htm>).

<a id="event-2015-11-26-3-6"></a>

Context: Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting 2015.

**Archived source account.** Queen Elizabeth II (U.K.) arrives in Malta for the Commonwealth summit what begins tomorrow. The then-future Queen and the Duke of Edinburgh lived on the island from 1949-51. The Commonwealth is a group of 53 nations; most member states were once part of the British Empire, and 16 retain the Queen as head of state.

Source citations (as archived): [Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/uknews/queen-elizabeth-II/12019780/Queen-in-Malta-Melancholy-on-what-is-likely-to-be-monarchs-last-trip-to-her-former-island-home.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-26-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Song Tao is named head of the International Liaison Department of the Communist Party of China, a key post responsible for relations with other communist parties, replacing Wang Jiarui.

Source citations (as archived): [SCMP](<http://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy-defence/article/1883544/former-minister-appointed-key-point-man-chinas>).

### 2015-11-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1345011860](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20November%2027&oldid=1345011860>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-27-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and several injured in clashes between police and Papua New Guinea Defence Force soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-11-27/clash-between-png-police-and-military-leaves-one-dead/6981252>).

<a id="event-2015-11-27-0-2"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** France holds a memorial service for the 130 victims of the attacks two weeks ago.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34940427?ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_campaign=bbc_breaking&amp;ns_source=twitter&amp;ns_linkname=news_central>).

<a id="event-2015-11-27-0-4"></a>

Context: 2015 Russian Sukhoi Su-24 shootdown.

**Archived source account.** Turkey's president Recep Tayyip Erdoğan warns Russia not to "play with fire" and says Russia is supporting the "state terrorism" of the Bashar al-Assad regime in Syria that has "killed 380,000 people". Relations between the former Cold War antagonists have been severely damaged after Turkey shot down a Russian Sukhoi Su-24 near the Syria–Turkey border on November 24, 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1595566/turkey-warns-russia-not-to-play-with-fire>).

<a id="event-2015-11-27-0-6"></a>

Context: 2015 Bamako hotel attack.

**Archived source account.** Malian forces arrest two men in their early 30s linked to a cell phone found at the scene of last week's deadly hotel attack. No details are provided on what their exact role was.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/11/27/africa/mali-hotel-attack-arrest/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-27-0-8"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict (2015).

**Archived source account.** Two Palestinian drivers drive their vehicles into groups of Israeli soldiers in two separate attacks in the occupied West bank. Both drivers are shot dead. In this current wave of violence that began in October, 19 Israelis, one U.S. citizen, and 93 Palestinians have died.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/27/us-israel-palestinians-idUSKBN0TG0EN20151127>).

<a id="event-2015-11-27-0-9"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict (2015).

**Archived source account.** The Israeli cabinet authorizes the Israeli Army to close the village of Beir Ummar near Hebron to search for suspects.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/.premium-1.688778>).

<a id="event-2015-11-27-0-11"></a>

Context: Piracy in the Gulf of Guinea.

**Archived source account.** Pirates attack a Polish-owned cargo ship off the coast of Nigeria, kidnapping its captain and four crew. Polish Foreign Minister, Witold Waszczykowski, said the as yet unidentified kidnappers have made no demands so far and Poland was currently liaising with Nigerian authorities.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/27/us-poland-nigeria-pirates-idUSKBN0TG13O20151127>).

<a id="event-2015-11-27-0-13"></a>

Context: Islamist insurgency in West Africa.

**Archived source account.** A suicide-bomb attack on a Shia Muslim procession in Nigeria's northern Kano state leaves at least 21 people dead.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-34946233>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-11-27-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Archaeologists discover four prehistoric Ichma culture tombs in the centre of the Peruvian capital Lima.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-11-27/four-pre-inca-tombs-found-in-peru/6980744>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-11-27-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** China's Shanghai index closed down 5.5%, a drop of almost 200 points in what was its largest single-day decline in three months.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/11/28/business/china-shanghai-stock-market.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-27-2-2"></a>

Context: Greek government-debt crisis.

**Archived source account.** A new study shows Greece's six-year austerity program is even affecting prostitution. Gregory Laxos, a sociology professor at the Panteion University in Athens, told the Times of London the going rate for sex with a prostitute was 50 euros ($53) when the economic crisis began. Now, it’s fallen to as low as two euros ($2.12) for a 30-minute session, or to a cheese pie, a sandwich because they are hungry.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/young-greek-women-selling-sex-for-the-price-of-a-sandwich-new-study-shows/2015/11/27/c469695e-94d9-11e5-b5e4-279b4501e8a6_story.html?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_evening>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-11-27-3-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 Australian bushfire season.

**Archived source account.** At least 87 homes have been lost in the fires that started in Pinery, South Australia which also claimed two lives and hospitalised 90 with five people in a critical condition.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-11-27/sa-fires-87-homes-lost-premier-says/6981240>).

<a id="event-2015-11-27-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Floodwaters in the North Texas area of the United States claim at least three lives on Thursday and today with another person missing.

Source citations (as archived): [Dallas Morning News](<http://www.dallasnews.com/news/metro/20151127-floodwaters-claim-3-another-person-missing-as-rain-pounds-d-fw.ece>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-11-27-4-1"></a>

Context: Pope Francis's visit to Kenya.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis, speaking in the Kenyan shantytown Kangemi, a sprawling slum filled with tin-roofed homes, lashes out at the elite in a neighborhood that feels largely disenfranchised. He describes injustices against the poor, such as unfair distribution of land, and lack of access to infrastructures and basic services, as "new forms of colonialism."

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/11/27/africa/africa-pope-francis-trip/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-27-4-2"></a>

Context: Pope Francis's visit to Kenya.

**Archived source account.** Francis, at a Nairobi sports center, says education and jobs will prevent young people from being radicalized and heading off to join militant groups. At the Kasarani Stadium, the Pope urges attendees to resist the temptation of corruption. “It’s in all the institutions, including in the Vatican..."

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2015/11/27/pope-francis-kenya-visit/76440712/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-27-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Patricia Scotland, Baroness Scotland of Asthal, is appointed as the sixth Secretary-General of the Commonwealth of Nations. She will become the first woman to hold the position from April 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [NYSE Post](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151201034246/http://nysepost.com/baroness-scotland-is-new-commonwealth-secretary-general-58487>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-11-27-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Saenuri Party member of the South Korean National Assembly Cho Hyun-ryong is jailed for five years for accepting bribes.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151207201854/http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/news/2015/11/27/0200000000AEN20151127003600315.html?input=www.tweeter.com>).

<a id="event-2015-11-27-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The appellate prosecutors office in the Polish city of Kraków decides not to appeal a decision against extraditing filmmaker Roman Polanski to the United States to face prosecution for historic child sex offences.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/27/us-poland-polanski-idUSKBN0TG0KY20151127>).

<a id="event-2015-11-27-5-3"></a>

Context: Colorado Springs Planned Parenthood shooting.

**Archived source account.** An active shooter in a Planned Parenthood facility in the American city of Colorado Springs, Colorado shoots at least four members of the Colorado Springs Police Department with one officer later dying. Two civilians were also killed, and six were injured. The shooter later surrendered.

Source citations (as archived): [Denver Post](<http://www.denverpost.com/news/ci_29172660/colorado-springs-firefighters-respond-active-shooter-at-planned>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/27/us-colorado-shooter-idUSKBN0TG27D20151127>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/report-active-shooter-near-planned-parenthood-colorado-springs-n470431?cid=eml_nbn_20151127>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/11/27/us/colorado-shooting-probe/index.html>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2015-11-27-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Detroit, a city in which property values are among the lowest in the United States, is looking to reverse this. The Detroit Land Bank Authority is demolishing structures that are beyond repair and auction (bids start at $1,000) ones that are salvageable.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/realestate/detroit-tries-unconventional-approach-to-restoring-its-housing-market/2015/11/26/a98db95a-7670-11e5-b9c1-f03c48c96ac2_story.html?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_headlines>).

<a id="event-2015-11-27-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** China's paramount leader Xi Jinping announced a major overhaul of China’s military to make the world’s largest army more combat ready and better equipped to project force beyond the country’s borders. Under the reorganization, all branches of the armed forces would come under a joint military command. The Chinese Communist leader said the reform aimed to "build an elite combat force" and called on the officials to make "breakthroughs" on establishing the joint command by 2020, Xinhua said.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-11-26/china-announces-military-overhaul-to-make-army-more-combat-ready>).

<a id="event-2015-11-27-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Yu Weiguo becomes the acting Governor of Fujian province, replacing Su Shulin, who had been detained on suspicion of corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [SCMP](<http://www.scmp.com/news/china/policies-politics/article/1884033/china-confirms-fujian-veteran-provinces-acting-governor>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-11-27-7-1"></a>

Context: Retreat of glaciers since 1850.

**Archived source account.** Scientific studies confirm more than 90 percent of the world’s glaciers are retreating, and many of the smaller ones — like the alpine ice sheets of Glacier National Park in the U.S. — are rapidly disappearing. On the other side of world, at Khumbu Glacier near Mount Everest in the Himalayas, expanding ponds are merging and forming larger bodies of water. This could threaten settlements downstream if they overflow. Thawing glaciers account for about 20 percent of the sea-level rise recorded in the past century, adding to the meltwater coming from polar ice caps and ice sheets.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/sf/national/2015/11/26/ice-worlds/?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_headlines>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-34928569>); [Radio New Zealand](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/national/programmes/ourchangingworld/audio/201780508/antarctic-glacier&#x27;s-past-rapid-retreat>).

### 2015-11-28

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-28-0-0"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/2015/11/28/mali-un-peacekeepers-base-attacked-by-unidentified-gunmen/>); [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/jihadist-group-ansar-dine-claims-deadly-attack-un-184641376.html;_ylt=AwrC1Cl9.VlWCXEAMlLQtDMD;_ylu=X3oDMTByOHZyb21tBGNvbG8DYmYxBHBvcwMxBHZ0aWQDBHNlYwNzcg-->).

<a id="event-2015-11-28-0-2"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Egypt.

**Archived source account.** At least four Egyptian police officers are killed in a drive-by shooting in Saqqara, south of Cairo. An Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant affiliate claims responsibility.,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-34952937?ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_campaign=bbc_breaking&amp;ns_source=twitter&amp;ns_linkname=news_central>); [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2015/11/29/islamic-state-affiliate-claims-killing-4-egyptian-police-on-cairo-outskirts/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-28-0-4"></a>

Context: Turkey–PKK conflict.

**Archived source account.** Tahir Elçi, a pro-Kurdish lawyer, is shot dead at a press conference in the city of Diyarbakir as clashes break out between Turkish security forces and PKK militants.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<http://www.watoday.com.au/world/top-prokurdish-lawyer-shot-dead-in-turkeys-southeast-20151128-glam0c.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-28-0-6"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** U.K. Prime Minister David Cameron, despite deep uncertainty over how many Labour MPs will back him, is planning to stage a parliamentary vote on British military action against ISIL in Syria this week.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2015/nov/29/cameron-to-risk-commons-vote-on-syria>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-11-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Egyptologists announce that radar scans indicate an empty space behind King Tutankhamun's tomb. British archaeologist Dr. Nicholas Reeves speculates if a second chamber exists, it could be Queen Nefertiti's long-lost burial place. Antiquities Minister Mamdouh Eldamaty says work inside the tomb will not begin until all the data from the radar and infrared devices are carefully analyzed by Japanese experts.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1596180/secret-chamber-likely-behind-king-tuts-tomb>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/11/28/africa/possible-clue-nefertiti-tomb-egypt/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-11-28-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A slow moving wintry storm system is responsible for more than a dozen deaths in the U.S. states of Texas, Oklahoma and Kansas.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted2.ap.org/APDEFAULT/3d281c11a96b4ad082fe88aa0db04305/Article_2015-11-28-US--Severe%20Weather/id-c9bd42e42d2142648e87f9b9e9b27fb7>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-11-28-3-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Russian Sukhoi Su-24 shootdown, Russia–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** A day after Turkey's president Recep Tayyip Erdoğan had harsh words for Russia, Turkish Prime Minister Ahmet Davutoğlu, in an essay in the London Times, says the downing of the Russian jet, "was not -- and is not -- an act against a specific country.... While the measures to defend our territory will remain in place, Turkey will work with Russia and our allies to calm tensions."

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/11/27/middleeast/syria-turkey-russia-warplane-shot-down/>); [Times of London](<http://www.thetimes.co.uk/tto/opinion/thunderer/article4624985.ece>).

<a id="event-2015-11-28-3-2"></a>

Context: 2015 Russian Sukhoi Su-24 shootdown, Russia–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin signs a decree imposing economic sanctions on Turkey. The sanctions include a ban on charter flights from Russia to Turkey, that Russian tour operators should stop selling trips to Turkey, and that imports of some Turkish products are to be halted. All work visas for Turkish citizens are cancelled.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/news/world/europe/russia-announces-economic-sanctions-against-turkey-1.2447665>).

<a id="event-2015-11-28-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** South Korea's Yonhap news agency reports North Korea appears to conduct a submarine-launched ballistic missile test that ended in failure with no indication that the missile successfully ejected from the vessel and took off.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/28/us-northkorea-missile-idUSKBN0TH09M20151128>).

<a id="event-2015-11-28-3-5"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis, Macedonian border crisis.

**Archived source account.** Macedonia's Army begins erecting a metal fence on its southern border with Greece. Around 250 migrants later clash with Macedonian police on the border.,

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2015/11/28/macedonian-army-starts-building-fence-on-greek-border.html>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/babcfa8e41074c189aae9d765845bd6c/migrants-clash-macedonian-police-greek-border>).

<a id="event-2015-11-28-3-7"></a>

Context: Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting 2015.

**Archived source account.** The Commonwealth Heads of Government meeting in Malta calls for an ambitious and legally binding outcome at the 2015 United Nations Climate Change Conference.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/commonwealth-wants-ambitious-legally-binding-cop21-result-193050489.html;_ylt=AwrC1DESAlpWJzUAuXnQtDMD;_ylu=X3oDMTByOHZyb21tBGNvbG8DYmYxBHBvcwMxBHZ0aWQDBHNlYwNzcg-->).

<a id="event-2015-11-28-3-8"></a>

Context: Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting 2015.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom will host the next CHOGM meeting in 2018 as Vanuatu, which was to host the meeting, had its infrastructure damaged by Cyclone Pam earlier in the year.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/britain-host-next-commonwealth-summit-2018-194149814.html;_ylt=AwrC1CoqDlpWxQUA0cvQtDMD;_ylu=X3oDMTByOHZyb21tBGNvbG8DYmYxBHBvcwMxBHZ0aWQDBHNlYwNzcg-->).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-11-28-4-1"></a>

Context: Colorado Springs Planned Parenthood shooting.

**Archived source account.** Colorado Springs Police Chief Peter Carey says all nine of the injured – five police officers and four civilians – are listed in good condition at area hospitals.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/28/us-colorado-shooter-idUSKBN0TH05O20151128#T5vcCjGiSYTQvpAQ.97>).

<a id="event-2015-11-28-4-3"></a>

Context: Whaling in Japan.

**Archived source account.** Japan advises the International Whaling Commission that it plans to resume hunting minke whales for scientific research in the Antarctic Ocean by the end of March 2016. The United Nations' International Court of Justice (ICJ) ruled in March 2014 that Japan's decades-old whale hunt in the Antarctic should stop, prompting Tokyo to cancel the bulk of its whaling for the 2014/2015 season. ICJ decisions were binding and cannot be appealed.,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/asia/japan/12022369/Japan-to-resume-Antarctic-whale-hunt-despite-ICJ-ruling.html>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/11/28/Japan-to-resume-whaling-in-Antarctic-ignores-World-Court-ruling/6601448711159/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-11-28-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom's Minister of State for International Development, Grant Shapps, resigns amid claims he failed to act on allegations of in-party bullying of a young Conservative Party activist who committed suicide in September.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-34952981>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2015-11-28-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tyson Fury of the United Kingdom defeats Ukrainian boxer Wladimir Klitschko in a title fight in Düsseldorf winning the WBA Super, IBF and WBO heavyweight titles.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/live/boxing/34014640#>).

<a id="event-2015-11-28-6-2"></a>

Context: 2015–16 Premier League.

**Archived source account.** Leicester City's Jamie Vardy scores in a record eleven consecutive Premier League matches after scoring against Manchester United in a 1-1 draw at the King Power Stadium, breaking former Manchester United player Ruud van Nistelrooy's record.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/0/football/34953098>).

### 2015-11-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076180612](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20November%2029&oldid=1076180612>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-29-0-1"></a>

Context: Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reports Russian airstrikes kill at least 18 civilians and wound dozens more in the town of Ariha in Syria's northwestern Idlib province. Idlib is controlled by the Army of Conquest, a rebel alliance of mainly Islamist groups, including al-Qaeda affiliate al-Nusra Front.,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/29/us-mideast-crisis-syria-ariha-idUSKBN0TI07K20151129#X8PpXhvjaS6Cv1CE.97>); [AFP](<http://tribune.com.pk/story/1000636/at-least-18-civilians-killed-in-syria-airstrikes-monitor/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-11-29-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire in the South African city of Cape Town leaves two people dead and four thousand people homeless.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times Live](<http://www.timeslive.co.za/local/2015/11/29/Two-dead-4-000-homeless-after-Cape-Town-fire>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-11-29-2-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Russian Sukhoi Su-24 shootdown.

**Archived source account.** Turkish Prime Minister Ahmet Davutoğlu says the body of the pilot from the Sukhoi Su-24 jet downed this past Tuesday will be handed over to Russia. The body is being treated in accordance with the Orthodox tradition. Russia's military attaché is going to Hatay in southern Turkey as part of the procedures to recover the remains. Turkish officials refused to comment on how they came to be in possession of the body.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/29/us-mideast-crisis-turkey-russia-pilot-idUSKBN0TI07T20151129#iXJQ5S70L28htAcT.97>).

<a id="event-2015-11-29-2-3"></a>

Context: Pope Francis' 2015 visit to Africa.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis arrives in the Central African Republic, the last stop of his six-day African tour, becoming the first modern pope to enter an active war zone as the country is in a state of civil war.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/nov/29/pope-francis-arrives-central-african-republic-historic-war-zone-visit>).

<a id="event-2015-11-29-2-5"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** Iran Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei calls the recent Paris attacks “blind terrorism,” according to IRNA, the country's official news agency. The Iranian government condemned the attacks immediately after they occurred.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/irans-top-leader-calls-paris-attack-blind-terrorism/2015/11/29/9d9170c4-96be-11e5-aca6-1ae3be6f06d2_story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-29-2-7"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Turkey agrees with leaders of the European Union to help stem the flow of migrants to Europe in return for cash and visas, and renewal of talks on joining the EU. A key element is 3 billion euros ($3.2 billion) in EU aid for the 2.2 million Syrians now in Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/30/us-europe-migrants-turkey-idUSKBN0TI00520151130#B0hdAvewQROd0mWX.97>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-11-29-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Conservative MP Philip Davies calls for a crackdown after it was announced up to 100 prisoners serving life sentences in British prisons will be let out of jail at Christmas for a five-day break with their families. Last year a total of 1,347 prison inmates, including 93 lifers, were given leave. The scheme has been defended by Justice Minister MP Andrew Selous but has caused outrage among justice campaigners.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sunday Express](<http://www.express.co.uk/news/uk/622803/prison-lifers-prisoners-allowed-to-leave-for-Christmas-Philip-Davies-Andrew-Selous>).

<a id="event-2015-11-29-3-2"></a>

Context: European migration crisis.

**Archived source account.** A mass brawl breaks out in a refugee shelter in Berlin with a hundred police required to restore order.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Star](<http://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/World/2015/Nov-29/325110-german-police-tackle-mass-brawl-at-berlin-refugee-shelter.ashx>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-11-29-4-1"></a>

Context: Burkinabé general election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Burkina Faso go to the polls to elect a new parliament and president after a year of turmoil.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-34956830>).

<a id="event-2015-11-29-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Labour deputy leader Tom Watson demands party leader Jeremy Corbyn, who opposes PM David Cameron's (Conservative) proposed air strikes on Syria, to ensure MPs are given a free vote on the proposal this Tuesday.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/tom-watson-warns-jeremy-corbyn-you-must-back-down-over-opposing-uk-air-strikes-on-isis-in-syria-a6753146.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-29-4-4"></a>

Context: 2015 United Nations Climate Change Conference.

**Archived source account.** About 20,000 pairs of empty shoes lay around Paris, symbolizing the absent marchers who would have joined this weekend's worldwide climate change protests pressing for a bold international agreement at the upcoming climate summit there. The capital city was planned to be the center for demonstrations but French police banned large protests following the terrorist attacks this month.,

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/climate-change-protests-take-place-around-the-world-on-eve-of-summit/2015/11/29/9172b6ca-9530-11e5-befa-99ceebcbb272_story.html>); [The Daily Mirror](<https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/paris-turned-sea-shoes-climate-6922670>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2015-11-29-5-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Davis Cup.

**Archived source account.** In tennis, the Great Britain Davis Cup team wins their tenth title in the Davis Cup and their first since 1936 defeating Belgium 3–2 in the final in Ghent. Andy Murray won all of their games he played with two singles wins and teaming with his brother Jamie Murray to win the doubles.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/11/30/sports/tennis/andy-murray-propels-britain-to-victory-in-the-davis-cup.html?partner=rss&amp;emc=rss>).

<a id="event-2015-11-29-5-3"></a>

Context: 2015–16 NBA season.

**Archived source account.** In basketball, American star Kobe Bryant of the Los Angeles Lakers announces he will retire at the end of the season.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://espn.go.com/nba/story/_/id/14254236/kobe-bryant-los-angeles-lakers-announces-retire-season>).

### 2015-11-30

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-11-30-0-1"></a>

Context: Paris attack aftermath.

**Archived source account.** French intelligence services are reportedly operating under the theory that Paris-attacks suspect Salah Abdeslam has escaped to Syria despite country-wide martial law in 3 different countries.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/11/30/europe/paris-terror-attacks/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-30-0-3"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War, Military intervention against ISIL, American-led intervention in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** With the support of Combined Joint Task Force – Operation Inherent Resolve, Iraqi Armed Forces have launched operations to retake Ramadi from ISIL.

Source citations (as archived): [The Military Times](<http://www.militarytimes.com/story/breaking-news/2015/11/26/iraqis-offensive-retake-ramadi-islamic-state-isis-isil/76411738/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-30-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reports that at least 50 United States military instructors have deployed to northern Syria from Turkey and Iraq to train Kurdish forces ahead of an assault on ISIL's de facto capital Al-Raqqah.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/us-soldiers-reportedly-arrive-in-syria-to-train-kurds-fighting-islamic-state/a-18878930?maca=en-RSS_en_Flipboard-9487-xml-media>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/30/us-yemen-security-saudi-idUSKBN0TJ19R20151130>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-11-30-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Responding to reports, the American Tribune Publishing Co. states it is not in talks to sell the company.

Source citations (as archived): [The Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/business/ct-tribune-publishing-1201-biz-20151130-story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-30-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Canadian BlackBerry Limited announces plans to shut down operations in Pakistan at year's end because it cannot comply with the Pakistani government's monitoring orders which would result in a massive invasion of user privacy.

Source citations (as archived): [CNET](<http://www.cnet.com/au/news/blackberry-leaves-pakistan-after-refusing-to-compromise-user-privacy/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-30-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The International Monetary Fund modifies its benchmark currency basket to include the yuan of the People's Republic of China. The basket also includes the U.S. dollar, the euro, the pound sterling, and the Japanese yen.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/30/us-imf-china-idUSKBN0TJ24Q20151130#Vkb5zzkpWoUSa3sG.97>).

<a id="event-2015-11-30-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Federal Reserve Board approves a rule prohibiting the government from extending emergency loans to "too big to fail" companies, a practice deemed essential during the global financial crisis of 2008 and 2009.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2015/11/30/Federal-Reserve-ends-too-big-to-fail-lending-policy/9611448895428/?spt=rln&amp;or=3>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-11-30-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** One person dies and at least 31 are injured when students and staff at Strathmore University in Nairobi, Kenya, frantically try to escape after hearing nearby gunshots during an “approved safety and security simulation drill.” The Strathmore campus did not hear, before or during the test, that this was a drill. Tensions have been high at Kenyan schools since April when 139 were killed during a terrorist attack at Garissa University College. Many Kenyan universities have held security drills; six were hospitalized at the latest at Kenyatta University.,

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/morning-mix/wp/2015/12/01/kenyan-university-fails-to-warn-of-realistic-terrorism-drill-causing-panic-and-death/?uid=0ef76ca8-45d6-11e0-a478-1231380f446b&amp;wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_mix>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-34969266>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-11-30-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The capitals of the world’s two most populous nations, China and India, are blanketed in hazardous, choking smog. Beijing, on the second-highest pollution alert, is closing highways, halting or suspending construction while warning residents to stay indoors. The U.S. New Delhi embassy’s monitoring station recorded an air quality index of 372, putting air pollution levels into “hazardous” territory. No action by the New Delhi government.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindustan Times](<http://www.hindustantimes.com/india/smog-chokes-new-delhi-beijing-ahead-of-paris-climate-summit/story-rk536Tg2Opm5LOrnG5UlEP.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-30-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A UNICEF report finds AIDS is now the leading cause of death for African teenagers and the second most common killer for adolescents across the globe. While the Asia Pacific region has seen a 31 percent drop in new HIV infections, and 28 percent decline in AIDS-related deaths, the estimated number of adolescents dying of AIDS in the region has more than doubled since 2005. Tomorrow is World Aids Day.,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/aids-is-leading-cause-of-death-for-african-teens-un_565c6d17e4b08e945febb3e6>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/11/30/us-asiapac-aids-youth-idUSKBN0TJ21V20151130#94ZJ9ttWCqwmUYeC.97>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-11-30-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Martyrs' Day (United Arab Emirates) is being observed in United Arab Emirates as Commemoration Day this year on November 30, 2015, recognising the sacrifices and dedication of Emirati martyrs who have given their life in the UAE and abroad in the field of civil, military and humanitarian service.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<http://gulfnews.com/news/uae/government/commemoration-day/uae-leaders-commemorate-martyrs-and-their-families-1.1628682>).

<a id="event-2015-11-30-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** South Korea's parliament approves a free trade pact with China after opposition lawmakers, concerned that deal that would hurt agriculture and fisheries, secured a $1.4 billion relief package for farmers.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2015/11/30/south-korea-parliament-ratifies-free-trade-pact-with-china/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-30-4-3"></a>

Context: 2015 United Nations Climate Change Conference.

**Archived source account.** Around 150 world leaders attend the UN Climate Change Conference in Paris, aiming for a global deal on limiting greenhouse gas emissions.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/11/29/europe/france-paris-cop21-climate-change-conference/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-30-4-5"></a>

Context: Pope Francis' 2015 visit to Africa.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis travels to a besieged Muslim neighborhood known as PK5 in the Central African Republic, a country wracked by sectarian violence. This visit is part of Francis's message of peace and reconciliation. As a result of the violence over the last two years, most of the capital Bangui's 100,000-plus Muslims have fled; now only 15,000 remain.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.bastropenterprise.com/article/ZZ/20151130/NEWS/311309968/-1/sports>).

<a id="event-2015-11-30-4-6"></a>

Context: Pope Francis' 2015 visit to Africa.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis tells a crowd in a mosque in Bangui that "Christians and Muslims are brothers and sisters."

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-34960971>).

<a id="event-2015-11-30-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israel will open a diplomatic mission to the International Renewable Energy Agency (Irena), the headquarters of which are located near the capital of the United Arab Emirates, Abu Dhabi. Israel will be the first Irena member to open such a mission; other member nations work Irena relations from their missions to the UAE, which Israel does not have.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/11/28/world/middleeast/israel-to-open-diplomatic-office-in-united-arab-emirates.html?ribbon-ad-idx=3&amp;rref=world/middleeast&amp;module=Ribbon&amp;version=context&amp;region=Header&amp;action=click&amp;contentCollection=Middle%20East&amp;pgtype=article>).
