Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Business_News/Security-Industry/2015/11/30/Russian-airborne-forces-to-hold-exercises-in-the-Arctic/2831448902143/?spt=rln&amp;or=2>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-11-30-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The University of Chicago cancels classes for the day, and asks students, faculty, and non-essential staff to stay away from its main campus after being informed by the FBI of a threat of gun violence.,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/University-of-Chicago-cancels-classes-after-threats-435791>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/2015/11/29/u-chicago-cancels-monday-classes-after-gun-violence-threat/76546560/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-30-5-1"></a>

Context: The University of Chicago cancels classes for the day, and asks students, faculty, and non-essential staff to stay away from its main campus after being informed by the FBI of a threat of gun violence.,.

**Archived source account.** One suspect, a student from the University of Illinois at Chicago is arrested. The University of Chicago announces classes remain canceled for the day.

Source citations (as archived): [The Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/local/breaking/ct-university-of-chicago-gun-threat-met-20151130-story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-11-30-5-3"></a>

Context: Russian undesirable organizations law.

**Archived source account.** Russia bans two George Soros-run foundations, including the Open Society Foundations, for posing a threat to "Russian national security". The Open Society Foundation and the Open Society Institute’s Assistance Foundation, both financed by business magnate Soros, are the latest additions to a list of “undesirable organizations”, a list the Russian government says is necessary to stop foreign governments from interfering in Russia’s internal affairs.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/nov/30/russia-bans-two-george-soros-foundations-from-giving-grants>).

<a id="event-2015-11-30-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jury selection begins for the trial of William Porter, a Baltimore, Maryland police officer charged with manslaughter and other charges surrounding the April 19 death of Freddie Gray. Porter is the first of six officers to be tried.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/11/30/us/baltimore-police-trial-freddie-gray-jury-selection/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-11-30-6-1"></a>

Context: Venezuelan parliamentary election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Venezuela announces it will suspend the sale of alcoholic beverages, fireworks and weapons before Sunday's parliamentary elections, starting Friday at 6 p.m. until next Monday at 6 p.m. Civilian permits for the possession and use of firearms and knives will also be suspended for the same period.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/11/30/Venezuela-banning-sale-of-alcohol-fireworks-and-weapons-ahead-of-elections/1961448908452/?spt=rln&amp;or=1>).

<a id="event-2015-11-30-6-3"></a>

Context: Burkinabé general election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Former prime minister Roch Marc Kaboré appears on course for a commanding victory in Burkina Faso's election, one large enough to eliminate the need for a run-off. According to the Independent National Electoral Commission, with results from about 72 percent of the country counted, Kaboré has 54 percent of the vote with his closest challenger, former finance minister Zéphirin Diabré, getting 29 percent.

Source citations (as archived): [The Globe and Mail](<https://www.theglobeandmail.com/news/world/ex-burkina-faso-pm-on-track-for-victory-in-presidential-vote/article27536026/>).

<a id="event-2015-11-30-6-5"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabia elections, 2015.

**Archived source account.** For the first time in the country's history, Saudi Arabian women are allowed to vote and to stand for office in the December 12, 2015, elections. Candidacy filings opened yesterday. In two days, more than 900 women have signed up to run for various local government positions in the Arab nation.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2015/11/30/Free-to-vote-for-first-time-nearly-1000-women-running-for-office-in-Saudi-Arabia/4021448917669/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_us>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-11-30-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Researchers at North Carolina State University discover a new diamond-like, solid phase of carbon, called Q-carbon, that can be attained at room temperature. The result is a uniquely crystalline material, harder than a real diamond and likely boasting a variety of new properties, most unknown or unstudied.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Science_News/2015/11/30/Researchers-create-diamonds-at-room-temperature/7701448910244/?spt=rln&amp;or=1>).


## December

### 2015-12-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076180442](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%201&oldid=1076180442>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-01-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Azerbaijan law enforcement agencies launch a special operation against Islamists in Nardaran, a suburb in the capital Baku.

Source citations (as archived): [Tass](<http://tass.ru/en/world/840565>).

<a id="event-2015-12-01-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War spillover in Lebanon.

**Archived source account.** The Lebanese Army and the al-Nusra Front conduct a prisoner exchange with Saja Dulaimi, former wife of Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi, leader of the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant, being one of the prisoners released. The exchange was brokered by Qatar.,

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/12/lebanese-hostages-released-prisoner-swap-151201072408599.html>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2015/12/01/mideast-crisis-lebanon-idINKBN0TK3O420151201>).

<a id="event-2015-12-01-0-4"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War, Military intervention against ISIL, American-led intervention in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** The Iraqi government, via state TV, requests all civilians leave the ISIL-held city of Ramadi in Anbar province, after several days of U.S.-led coalition airstrikes against ISIL. Observers speculate this request precedes major ground operations to retake Ramadi, which fell to ISIL in May.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/civilians-told-to-leave-is-held-iraqi-city-of-ramadi/a-18884014>).

<a id="event-2015-12-01-0-5"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War, Military intervention against ISIL, American-led intervention in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Defense Secretary Ashton B. Carter said, in testimony before the House Armed Services Committee, the Obama Administration is preparing to establish a new Special Operations task force of about 200 service members in Iraq to intensify pressure on Islamic State commanders and expand U.S. troops’ direct involvement in battling the militant group. There are now about 3,500 U.S. troops in Iraq, including some Special Operations forces who are advising Iraqi forces in northern and central Iraq.,

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/new-iraq-task-force-expands-direct-us-role-in-battle-against-islamic-state/2015/12/01/6cc41ef2-9861-11e5-8917-653b65c809eb_story.html>); [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/policy/defense/overnights/261727-overnight-defense-pentagon-deploying-task-force-to-fight-isis>).

<a id="event-2015-12-01-0-7"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** A major push by Yemen-based Houthi forces into the kingdom's southern Najran Region kills dozens of Houthi fighters. The Houthi-run Saba News Agency says that Houthi fighters have seized three Saudi military outposts near the city of Najran, destroying several armored vehicles, including two U.S.-made M1 Abrams tanks and three Bradley vehicles.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2015/12/01/uk-yemen-security-saudi-idUKKBN0TK45920151201>).

<a id="event-2015-12-01-0-9"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** U. N. attack helicopters launch strikes against positions of Allied Democratic Forces. This comes a day after a series of clashes between rebels and soldiers in a town in eastern Congo killed at least 30 people.,,

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/fierce-clashes-between-un-peacekeepers-uganda-rebels-dr-003026631.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/12/01/us-congodemocratic-uganda-idUSKBN0TK5BT20151201>); [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2015/12/01/439874/Congo-ADFNALU-MONUSCO-Uganda--->).

<a id="event-2015-12-01-0-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** A pipe bomb explodes on a Bayrampaşa overpass near the city's central metro station in suburban Istanbul, Turkey leaving five people injured.,,

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/dec/01/bomb-explodes-near-istanbul-metro-station>); [The Atlantic](<https://www.theatlantic.com/international/archive/2015/12/what-we-know-about-the-istanbul-blast/418242/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34978232>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-12-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** So called "White Student Unions" begin springing up at several Australian universities, including the University of Queensland, University of Southern Queensland, University of Technology Sydney, Macquarie University, Western Sydney University, University of New South Wales and the University of Western Australia. The groups say they are defending the interests of white students who they say are becoming marginalized from on-campus life and politics.

Source citations (as archived): [News Corp Australia](<http://www.news.com.au/finance/work/careers/behind-the-white-student-unions-springing-up-at-australian-universities/news-story/1ec829bb66b30a8e98544784f1746b75>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-12-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Facebook chief executive Mark Zuckerberg announces the plan to donate 99 percent of the company stock he and his wife Priscilla Chan own over their lifetimes, shares today worth about $45 billion, to "advance human potential and promote equality for all children."

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/the-switch/wp/2015/12/01/mark-zuckerberg-will-give-away-99-percent-of-his-facebook-stock/?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_evening>).

#### Disasters and accident

<a id="event-2015-12-01-3-1"></a>

Context: Indonesia AirAsia Flight 8501.

**Archived source account.** Indonesia releases a report into the crash of AirAsia Flight 8501 by the National Transportation Safety Committee. The report finds that crew error was responsible for the crash that claimed 162 lives.,

Source citations (as archived): [Channel News Asia](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asiapacific/airasia-qz8501-crash/2306006.html?cid=twtcna>); [Sky News](<http://www.skynews.com.au/news/top-stories/2015/12/01/crew-error-blamed-for-airasia-crash.html>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-12-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The World Health Organization urges Ukraine's health ministry to declare a state of emergency due to a polio outbreak, a move meant to prompt more action from the government in Kiev. Half of Ukraine's children have not been vaccinated against polio, according to Dorit Nitzan, head of the WHO's office in Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2015/12/01/un-polio-outbreak-in-ukraine-is-a-state-of-emergency>).

<a id="event-2015-12-01-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** One of three people who contracted Legionnaires' disease in Hannibal, Missouri, dies, according to health officials. Hannibal is about 20 miles from Quincy, Illinois, where a Legionnaires' outbreak occurred earlier this year, contributing to 12 deaths and sickening dozens more.,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151204003658/http://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/legionnaires-disease-bacteria-found-hotel-guest-died-35513533>); [ABC 7](<http://abc7chicago.com/health/quincy-legionnaires-outbreak-caught-state-officials-off-guard/991512/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-01-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** An American E. coli scare results in the recall of hundreds of thousands of products in a dozen states and covering major supermarket chains including Walmart, Safeway and Albertsons.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2015/12/01/news/companies/e-coli-recall-walmart-costco-albertsons/index.html?sr=twmoney120215e-coli-recall-walmart-costco-albertsons1227AMVODtopLink&amp;linkId=19224487>).

<a id="event-2015-12-01-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Centers for Disease Control announces the number of people newly diagnosed with diabetes declined in 2014 for the fifth consecutive year. Experts do not know whether efforts to prevent diabetes are finally started to work, or if the disease has simply peaked in the population.,

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/health-shots/2015/12/01/458024442/fewer-people-are-getting-diabetes-but-the-epidemic-isnt-over>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/12/01/health/new-diabetes-cases-at-long-last-begin-to-fall-in-the-united-states.html?_r=0>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-01-5-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Health and Human Services Department’s Office of Refugee Resettlement notifies all 50 states that if they deny services to any group of refugees, states may risk losing resettlement funding altogether. More than half of the nation’s governors have said they will not accept Syrian refugees in their states.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-nation/wp/2015/12/01/feds-to-states-no-you-cannot-ban-syrian-refugees/?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_evening>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-12-01-6-1"></a>

Context: Death of Jennifer Laude.

**Archived source account.** A Philippine Olongapo City Regional Trial Court convicts U.S. Marine Joseph Scott Pemberton of homicide over the death of a transgender Filipina woman.,,

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/nation/114533-pemberton-ruling-jennifer-laude>); [Buzzfeed](<https://www.buzzfeed.com/meredithtalusan/us-marine-is-guilty#.db5baRMGD>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-34971925>).

<a id="event-2015-12-01-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Chicago, Illinois Mayor Rahm Emanuel asked for and received the resignation of that city’s police superintendent Garry McCarthy. Emanuel spoke of the loss of the public’s confidence in the city police and announced a task force on police accountability. The change comes in the wake of protests over the release of police footage showing the October 2014 shooting of Laquan McDonald.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/01/us/chicago-laquan-mcdonald-police-shooting/index.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-01-6-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Supreme Court rejected a request from Texas and other states for a 30-day extension to file legal briefs in support of the lawsuit to block the immigration plan. Instead, the justices accepted the Justice Department’s request for a shortened eight-day extension, meaning that if the court decides to take the case, a decision would probably come by late June. The court is not expected to decide until January whether to take the case.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/supreme-court-denies-states-requests-for-filing-extension-in-immigration-suit/2015/12/01/34f5e116-987c-11e5-b499-76cbec161973_story.html?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_headlines>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-12-01-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A study published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences on gender identity reports brains do not really fit into "male" or "female" categories. Tel Aviv University's Daphna Joel's research team, in analyzing the MRI scans of some 1,400 individuals, found only a very small number of the brains studied had features that were entirely male, female, or intermediate between the two. The vast majority had a mosaic.,,

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/speaking-of-science/wp/2015/12/01/brains-arent-actually-male-or-female-new-study-suggests/?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_evening>); [The Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences](<http://www.pnas.org/content/early/2015/11/24/1509654112.abstract>); [Daphna Joel](<http://people.socsci.tau.ac.il/mu/daphnajoel/>).

### 2015-12-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076180380](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%202&oldid=1076180380>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-02-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Russia expands its military presence in Syria with an additional airbase that can accommodate fixed-winged military aircraft. The U.S. Department of Defense also confirms that Russia added S-400 surface-to-air missiles to its Syrian stockpile and armed its military aircraft with air-to-air missiles. According to Military Times, "A Pentagon spokesman expressed concern" these moves indicate Russia's commitment to aiding the embattled Assad regime as opposed to combating ISIL. No Syrian opposition groups including ISIL have combat-ready aircraft that require air-to-air missiles.,

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2015/12/01/russia-adding-2nd-airbase-in-syria-pursuing-expansion-in-military-campaign.html>); [Military Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151204033544/http://www.militarytimes.com/story/military/pentagon/2015/11/30/new-russian-surface--air-missiles-syria-dod-confirms/76567120/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-02-0-3"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present), Al-Qaeda insurgency in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Al-Qaeda militants seize control of Zinjibar, capital of Yemen's southern Abyan Governorate, as well as the town of Jaʿār, following fierce clashes with pro-Hadi government forces.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/12/02/us/al-qaeda-yemen/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-02-0-5"></a>

Context: 2015 West African offensive, Islamist insurgency in Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** Cameroon’s army, backed by a regional taskforce, has killed at least 100 members of the militant Islamist Boko Haram group and freed 900 people it had held hostage, the west African country’s defence ministry has said. Regional taskforce conducts sweep along border with Nigeria.,

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/dec/02/cameroon-boko-haram-members-killed>); [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/cameroon-army-kills-100-boko-haram-fighters-frees-001313100.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-02-0-7"></a>

Context: Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of the United Kingdom votes 397–223 to authorize Royal Air Force air strikes on ISIL in Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [The Journal](<http://www.thejournal.ie/uk-parliament-syria-air-strikes-vote-isis-2480205-Dec2015/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-02-0-9"></a>

Context: 2015 San Bernardino shooting.

**Archived source account.** Two people open fire in San Bernardino, California (U.S.) at a center for people with developmental disabilities, killing at least 14 people and injuring 14 others in what the city’s police chief described as an act of domestic terrorism.,,,,,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/12/02/us-california-shooting-idUSKBN0TL2F120151202?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>); [The Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-up-to-20-shot-in-san-bernardino-active-shooter-sought-20151202-story.html>); [AFP](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/gunman-in-mass-shooting-in-california/story-e6frg6so-1227631887153>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/12/02/us/san-bernardino-shooting/index.html>); [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2015/12/02/as-many-as-20-shot-police-in-standoff-in-san-bernardino-calif/?intcmp=hpbt1>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-nation/wp/2015/12/02/police-in-san-bernadino-calif-responding-report-of-shooting/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-02-0-10"></a>

Context: 2015 San Bernardino shooting.

**Archived source account.** A second shooting incident near 1757 Richardson in San Bernardino unfolded around 3:00 p.m. PST, with police requesting a BearCat and medical assistance. Both suspects die on-scene.,

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/live/san-bernardino-shooting/>); [The Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-san-bernardino-shooting-live-updates-htmlstory.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-12-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Institute of Contemporary History in Munich announces a publication of a two-volume set of Adolf Hitler’s Mein Kampf. The new edition, which contains 3,500 scholarly annotations, is intended, The New York Times reports, “To set the work in historical context, to show how Hitler wove truth with half-truth and outright lie, and thus to defang any propagandistic effect while revealing Nazism.” This is the first printing in Germany since the end of World War II.,

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/12/02/world/europe/scholars-unveil-new-edition-of-hitlers-mein-kampf.html>); [The Week](<http://theweek.com/speedreads/591745/after-70-years-mein-kampf-published-again-germany>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-12-02-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Janet L. Yellen, chairperson of the U.S. Federal Reserve Bank, states that economic conditions improved to the point where a rise in the Fed’s benchmark interest rate is likely when the Federal Open Market Committee meets in mid-December.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/12/03/business/economy/janet-yellen-federal-reserve-interest-rates.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-12-02-3-1"></a>

Context: 2015 South Indian floods.

**Archived source account.** Days of heavy rain in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu causes floods with many areas in the city of Chennai under water. The death toll from rain-related incidents has reached 188.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindu](<http://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/chennai/tamil-nadu-heavy-rains-lash-chennai-to-continue-for-two-more-days/article7936729.ece>).

<a id="event-2015-12-02-3-2"></a>

Context: 2015 South Indian floods.

**Archived source account.** The Indian Navy and Army are conducting rescue operations in low lying areas.

Source citations (as archived): [ND TV](<http://www.ndtv.com/tamil-nadu-news/tamil-nadu-batterred-by-rain-army-called-in-for-rescue-ops-live-updates-1249893>).

<a id="event-2015-12-02-3-3"></a>

Context: 2015 South Indian floods.

**Archived source account.** India's National Disaster Response Force sends 600 officers to Chennai to assist.

Source citations (as archived): [Indian Broadcast News Live](<http://www.ibnlive.com/news/india/ndrf-to-rush-about-600-personnel-to-chennai-1171634.html>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-12-02-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A new study by the NYU Langone Medical Center published in the Environmental Health Perspectives journal today finds exposure to emissions from coal-fired power plants over a long period of time is significantly more harmful, five times higher, to the heart than other forms of carbon pollution.,

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/health-science/coal-is-king-among-pollution-that-causes-heart-disease-study-says/2015/12/01/3fb88194-9840-11e5-8917-653b65c809eb_story.html?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_headlines>); [New York University Langone Medical Center](<http://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/coal-burning-may-produce-more-toxic-particles-than-other-pollution-sources-300186937.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-02-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hearings begin in the legal battle between the Japanese government and local officials in Okinawa over plans to move a U.S. military air base on the southern island. This fall, Okinawa Governor Takeshi Onaga revoked his predecessor’s authorization for a US Marine Corps air base.,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/773b54b3013246018cb2f9d48778141a/hearings-begin-over-battle-moving-us-base-okinawa>); [Financial Times](<http://www.ft.com/intl/cms/s/0/0fb37722-71a0-11e5-ad6d-f4ed76f0900a.html#axzz3t8tlx3YV>).

<a id="event-2015-12-02-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thai Prime Minister Prayuth Chan-ocha orders officials to improve aviation safety standards after the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) downgraded Thailand's safety ratings. The lower rating is for failure to tackle commercial aviation standards shortcomings found in an audit this year. The European Aviation Safety Agency is due to announce the results of its own audit later in December.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/12/02/us-thailand-aviation-idUSKBN0TL0DP20151202#CB5eVwobjfu3B24E.97>).

<a id="event-2015-12-02-5-3"></a>

Context: Enlargement of NATO.

**Archived source account.** NATO Secretary General Jens Stoltenberg announces the invitation sent to Montenegro to join the military alliance, 16 years after the country, as part of the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, was bombed by the alliance in the Kosovo War. Montenegro's accession would result in "retaliatory actions", according to a spokesman for Russian President Vladimir Putin.,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34981973>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/12/02/europe/nato-montenegro-membership-invitation/index.html?sr=fbCNN120215nato-montenegro-membership-invitation0837AMStoryLink&amp;linkId=19230502>).

<a id="event-2015-12-02-5-5"></a>

Context: Kuril Islands dispute.

**Archived source account.** Russia is reportedly constructing hundreds of buildings for military use on the disputed Kunashir and Iturup islands, also claimed by Japan, in the Sea of Okhotsk. The Russian Defence Ministry said the new military buildings would help “raise the combat readiness of troops on the eastern frontiers of Russia".

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<http://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2015/12/02/national/politics-diplomacy/russia-expanding-military-presence-disputed-kuril-islands/#.Vl8KJL-oNFQ>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-12-02-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Authorities arrest four Kosovo jihadists men, three in Italy and one in Kosovo, for making nonspecific threats against Pope Francis and the former U.S. Ambassador to Kosovo. The men are described by police as highly dangerous and as having celebrated the November 2015 Paris attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151203061451/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/pope-francis-threats-four-men-arrested-after-alleged-threat-against-pontiff/ar-AAfTO7R?li=BBnb7Kz>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-12-02-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Yemeni Prime Minister Khaled Bahah rejects a cabinet reshuffle ordered by President Abd Rabbuh Mansur Hadi, another sign of the deepening rift between the two leaders. These problems started in March after the president appointed the minister of health as acting foreign minister without consulting the prime minister.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/12/02/us-yemen-security-government-idUSKBN0TK4T520151202#esf0tKTQ5p2ojufk.97>).

<a id="event-2015-12-02-7-2"></a>

Context: Myanmar general election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Myanmar's democracy icon Aung San Suu Kyi discusses the smooth transfer of power to her National League for Democracy (NLD) party with President Thein Sein, their first public meeting since the November election. The new administration will be sworn in early next year.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/12/02/us-myanmar-politics-idUSKBN0TL08Q20151202#aERgAwJQPOGZASKS.97>).

<a id="event-2015-12-02-7-4"></a>

Context: 2015 protests in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Brazil's lower house of Congress opens impeachment proceedings against President Dilma Rousseff over a corruption scandal involving the state-owned oil giant, Petrobras.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-34990455>).

### 2015-12-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131606577](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%203&oldid=1131606577>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-03-0-1"></a>

Context: Military intervention against ISIL, Operation Tidal Wave II.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom's Royal Air Force bombs Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant-controlled oil wells in eastern Syria. At least four Tornado GR4 fighter jets, operating out of RAF Akrotiri in Cyprus, were involved in raids. The Ministry of Defence said initial analysis "indicates that the strikes were successful".

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1598804/raf-bombs-is-oil-wells-in-tidal-wave-ii-mission>).

<a id="event-2015-12-03-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, 2015 Russian Sukhoi Su-24 shootdown.

**Archived source account.** Russian president Vladimir Putin addresses the shootdown of one of their jets in Syria by the Turkish Air Force. He goes on to say that "if anyone thinks Russia's reaction will be limited to trade sanctions, they are deeply mistaken".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160304085916/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/putin-turkey-will-regret-syria-act/ar-AAfXVpr?li=BBnb7Kz&amp;ocid=iehp>).

<a id="event-2015-12-03-0-5"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017), American-led intervention in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** Following the Obama Administration's pledge of additional Special Operations troops to Iraq, several members of Iraq’s ruling alliance state that only the Iraqi Parliament can authorize the action, and political associates of Iraqi Prime Minister Haider al-Abadi report such a troop expansion would be unacceptable. Several members of Iraqi militias have also decried a deployment of more U.S. troops. During the pull out from Iraq, president Obama promised there would be no more "boots on the ground" in Iraq again.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/12/02/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-usa-idUSKBN0TL1U120151202#bGA4bYk8U443b5EQ.97>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-12-03-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israel’s Holocaust and Remembrance Center posthumously adds U.S. Army Master Sergeant Roddie Edmonds to the list of the Righteous Among the Nations for his actions in 1945 at a Nazi prisoner of war camp.,

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2015/12/02/458166709/u-s-soldier-posthumously-honored-for-protecting-jewish-pows-in-1945>); [Yad Vashem](<http://www.yadvashem.org/yv/en/pressroom/pressreleases/pr_details.asp?cid=960#!prettyPhoto>).

<a id="event-2015-12-03-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Harvard Law School officials are reviewing the use of the school’s seal that includes three bushels of wheat, which also appears on Isaac Royall's family coat of arms. Royall, a slaveholder whose father was known to be a cruel owner, left part of his estate to help found the law school.,

Source citations (as archived): [MSNBC](<http://www.msnbc.com/msnbc/harvard-law-school-reviews-use-crest-symbol-slavery>); [The Boston Globe](<https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/2015/12/01/harvard-law-school-forms-committee-examine-use-crest-tied-slave-ownership/1JR7OwiLIsPc3BxRUiH6yH/story.html?nl=morning-briefing&amp;em_pos=large&amp;emc=edit_nn_20151202>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-12-03-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Samsung concedes to surrender $548 million to Apple Inc. over previously court-held ruling in patent dispute over copying the look of the iPhone.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-apple-samsung-payment-idUSKBN0TN20R20151204>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-03-3-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** EU ministers discuss suspending the Schengen passport-free travel zone for two years, on the basis that the migrant crisis has exposed “serious deficiencies” at the Greek border that endanger the overall area.,

Source citations (as archived): [The Financial Times](<http://www.ft.com/intl/cms/s/0/137322ca-999d-11e5-9228-87e603d47bdc.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34983426>).

<a id="event-2015-12-03-3-2"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Swedish government wants to be able to close the Øresund Bridge connecting Sweden to Denmark if the country's record refugee influx continues.

Source citations (as archived): [The Local](<http://www.thelocal.se/20151203/sweden-mulls-bid-to-close-bridge-to-denmark>).

<a id="event-2015-12-03-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Germany's Federal Intelligence Service (BND) says Saudi Arabia is at risk of becoming a major destabilizing influence in the Arab world due to the diplomatic stance of some senior members of the House of Saud.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/middleeast/saudiarabia/12029546/Saudi-Arabia-destabilising-Arab-world-German-intelligence-warns.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-03-3-5"></a>

Context: Iran–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Russia begins deliveries of its S-300 air defense systems to Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2015/12/03/us-mideast-crisis-russia-iran-idUSKBN0TM14520151203>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-12-03-4-1"></a>

Context: Trial of Oscar Pistorius.

**Archived source account.** A court convicts South African athlete Oscar Pistorius of the murder of girlfriend Reeva Steenkamp on appeal and faces a minimum of 15 years in prison.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/oscar-pistorius-convicted-murder-appeal-faces-15-years-prison-n472771?cid=eml_nbn_20151203>).

<a id="event-2015-12-03-4-3"></a>

Context: 2015 FIFA corruption case.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Attorney General Loretta Lynch announces criminal corruption charges against 16 FIFA officials in an indictment that expands Justice's May filing that indicted 14 officials associated with FIFA (Fédération Internationale de Football Association) and related sports marketing companies. At U.S. authorities request, Swiss police arrest two South American FIFA (Fédération Internationale de Football Association) officials at the five-star Baur au Lac hotel in Zürich, on suspicion of accepting "millions of dollars" in bribes. In addition, eight of the defendants indicted in May have pleaded guilty.,

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/12/03/sport/fifa-corruption-charges-justice-department/>); [The New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/sports/soccer/fifa-bigwigs-arrested-switzerland-report-article-1.2453588>).

<a id="event-2015-12-03-4-5"></a>

Context: Upper Big Branch Mine disaster.

**Archived source account.** A court convicts Donald Blankenship, former CEO of Massey Energy Company, of violating safety standards that led to the deaths of 29 Upper Big Branch mine workers in Montcoal, West Virginia in 2010. He is acquitted of making false statements and deceiving regulators. Blankenship, who faces up to one year in prison and a fine of $250,000, is the most prominent American coal executive ever to be convicted of a charge connected to the deaths of miners.,,

Source citations (as archived): [The New Yorker](<http://www.newyorker.com/business/currency/don-blankenship-west-virginias-king-of-coal-is-guilty>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2015/12/03/456533421/former-coal-ceo-blankenship-found-guilty-of-conspiracy-in-mine-disaster-case>); [The Christian Science Monitor](<http://www.csmonitor.com/USA/USA-Update/2015/1203/Why-coal-CEO-found-guilty-of-misdemeanor-in-miner-deaths>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/12/04/us/donald-blankenship-massey-energy-upper-big-branch-mine.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-03-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Obama Administration through Defense Secretary Ash Carter announces that all combat roles in the U.S. military will be opened to women.,

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/03/politics/u-s-military-women-combat-positions/>); [The Washington Times](<http://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2015/dec/3/ash-carter-promises-same-standards-for-women-in-co/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-03-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Illinois circuit court, in an emergency order, rules Chicago authorities must notify journalists and activists before they destroy decades of records related to police misconduct., \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-nation/wp/2015/12/03/judge-chicago-police-must-notify-media-before-destroying-decades-of-misconduct-files/?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_headlines>); [The Chicago Sun-Times](<http://chicago.suntimes.com/news/7/71/1149585/lawsuit-seeks-stop-police-discipline-files-destroyed>).

<a id="event-2015-12-03-5-1"></a>

Context: Danish European Union opt-out referendum, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Danish voters reject adopting EU rules on cross-border policing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-35002158>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-12-03-6-1"></a>

Context: 2015 NFL season.

**Archived source account.** In American football, Green Bay Packers quarterback Aaron Rodgers throws a 61-yard Hail Mary pass to tight end Richard Rodgers II to give the team a 27-23 victory against the Detroit Lions and advance to 8-4. The pass is the longest game-winning Hail Mary play in National Football League history.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<https://www.espn.com/nfl/recap?gameId=400791568>); [Wisconsin State Journal](<https://madison.com/packers-beat-lions-27-23-on-rodgers-to-rodgers-hail-mary-copy/image_0bf97a51-264c-5328-ba16-28cc776fdf0b.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A mortar attack in Afghanistan's central Wardak province kills at least 12 people.

The airplanes will be limited to support activities; they will not fly combat missions.,,

### 2015-12-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076180147](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%205&oldid=1076180147>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-05-0-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** The Government of Iraq calls on Turkey to withdraw its troops from northern Iraq, near the Islamic State-controlled city of Mosul. Iraq's Foreign Ministry said Turkish forces had entered Iraqi territory without the knowledge of the central government in Baghdad.,

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/baghdad-calls-ankara-immediately-withdraw-troops-072001402.html;_ylt=AwrXgyIhmWJWk1AAbQLQtDMD;_ylu=X3oDMTByb2lvbXVuBGNvbG8DZ3ExBHBvcwMxBHZ0aWQDBHNlYwNzcg-->); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-turkey-idUSKBN0TO0AU20151205#h3HJk2K3boyfYpMu.97>).

<a id="event-2015-12-05-0-3"></a>

Context: Islamist insurgency in Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** Three suicide bombers at Lake Chad kill at least 30 people and injure at least 80 others. Three women carried out the attack at a weekly market on an island on the Chadian side of the lake. No group claims responsibility; officials suspect the attacks were carried out by members of the Boko Haram militant group from neighboring Nigeria.,

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/12/triple-suicide-blast-kills-dozens-lake-chad-island-151205143809638.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-35015556>).

<a id="event-2015-12-05-0-5"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Scotland Yard advises that it will be treating three non-fatal stabbings at the Leytonstone tube station in London as a terrorist incident.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-35018789?ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_campaign=bbc_breaking&amp;ns_source=twitter&amp;ns_linkname=news_central>).

<a id="event-2015-12-05-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bombing of people gathered at Kantajew Temple in Bangladesh leaves 10 injured.

Source citations (as archived): [India Today](<http://indiatoday.intoday.in/story/bomb-attack-on-hindu-religious-gathering-in-bangladesh/1/539359.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-12-05-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** America's largest seven-day newspaper, The New York Times, breaking with the tradition that front pages belong to the news department, publishes Saturday morning's edition with the first front page editorial since 1920. The editorial calls for tighter gun control laws after the shootings in Colorado Springs, Colorado, and San Bernardino, California, over the past eight days.,,

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/12/05/us/gun-debate-yields-page-1-editorial.html?_r=0>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/wonk/wp/2015/12/05/the-new-york-times-has-rare-front-page-editorial-calling-u-s-gun-laws-a-national-disgrace/>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/media/2015/dec/05/gun-control-new-york-times-ront-page-editorial-first-time-since-1920-san-bernardino>).

<a id="event-2015-12-05-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Colombian President Juan Manuel Santos announces the discovery of the Spanish galleon San José which sunk off that country’s coast over 300 years ago. The discovery was a joint venture between Colombia and U.S. firm Sea Search Armada, which filed a lawsuit when Colombia claimed the wreck as a heritage site. The wreck’s cargo is placed somewhere in the $4 to $17 billion range.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2015/12/05/458586878/wreck-of-legendary-spanish-galleon-is-found-colombia-says>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-12-05-2-1"></a>

Context: 2015 South Indian floods.

**Archived source account.** Floods cut off power to the intensive care unit of a Chennai hospital leaving eighteen patients dead.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151205121903/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/18-die-india-hospital-floods-cut-off-power-35594264>).

<a id="event-2015-12-05-2-2"></a>

Context: 2015 South Indian floods.

**Archived source account.** Residents in the southern Indian state of Tamil Nadu grapple with the aftermath of the worst deluge in decades, a disaster that claimed 280 lives, according to the official death toll. More than half of Chennai's 859 city areas remain under water in the flat, coastal city of six million. The National Disaster Response Force's Rekha Nambiar said, “Rescue work is over. We are focused on relief now.",

Source citations (as archived): [The Malay Mail](<http://www.themalaymailonline.com/world/article/indias-chennai-struggles-with-aftermath-of-deadly-flood-after-worst-rains-i>); [The Gulf Today](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160910144118/http://gulftoday.ae/portal/297be1da-f473-49be-a6df-32e8f62863f4.aspx>).

<a id="event-2015-12-05-2-4"></a>

Context: Storm Desmond.

**Archived source account.** The fourth named windstorm of the season makes landfall across the United Kingdom and Ireland, bringing high winds and serious flooding.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-3501474>).

<a id="event-2015-12-05-2-5"></a>

Context: Storm Desmond.

**Archived source account.** A person blown into the path of a bus by high winds in London dies.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-35015530>).

<a id="event-2015-12-05-2-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Authorities declare a state of emergency in the Greek town of Tripoli after the garbage has not been collected for three months.

Source citations (as archived): [The International New York Times](<http://www.ekathimerini.com/204077/article/ekathimerini/news/state-of-emergency-declared-in-tripoli-over-trash>).

<a id="event-2015-12-05-2-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** An offshore oil platform operated by Azerbaijan's state energy company SOCAR catches fire in the Caspian Sea killing 32 workers.,

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/world/azerbaijan-oilfield-fire-1.3352333>); [The Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/reuters/article-3347170/32-Azeri-workers-die-fire-Caspian-Sea-oil-platform--committee-head.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-05-3-1"></a>

Context: 2015 United Nations Climate Change Conference.

**Archived source account.** Delegates at the 2015 Climate Change conference in Paris reach a draft agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-35015765>).

### 2015-12-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1258725635](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%206&oldid=1258725635>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-06-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Jaafar Mohammed Saad, the governor of Yemen's southern Aden Governorate, along with six guards, are killed by a suicide bomber in the port city of Aden. The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant claims responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-governor-idUSKBN0TP05K20151206?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-35019302>).

<a id="event-2015-12-06-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** A series of air strikes in Syria's Raqqa province, believed to be carried out by U.S.-led coalition warplanes, leaves at least 32 Islamic State fighters killed and 40 more wounded. The final toll could rise as casualty figures were collected from a single hospital. The jets hit IS headquarters and bases to the north, east, and southeast of provincial capital Raqqa city.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-islamic-state-idUSKBN0TP0HD20151206#El2Bc7yBmXaeHK8j.97>); [AFP](<http://www.dawn.com/news/1224629/32-is-fighters-killed-in-us-led-raids-on-syria-assad-slams-uks-participation>).

<a id="event-2015-12-06-0-5"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** Iraq's government gives Turkey 48 hours to withdraw its forces from northern Iraq or face "all available options", including recourse to the UN Security Council.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://uk.news.yahoo.com/iraq-gives-turkish-forces-48-hours-leave-country-203701419.html#syTT6Ql>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-12-06-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Bank for International Settlements, in Basel, cautions that the regulatory push to get all derivatives trading into central clearing systems may be creating a new group of Too Big to Fail financial institutions. This time, however, they will be international.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bis-derivatives-idUSKBN0TP0AR20151206#i0J5VpQesjwgDeZx.97>).

<a id="event-2015-12-06-1-2"></a>

Context: Basic income.

**Archived source account.** Finland's government plans to give all its citizens, rich or poor, a monthly payment of €800, with no strings attached. The Finnish government says it wants to launch a “universal basic income experiment” in 2017 to test the feasibility of this program, which would replace the country’s current benefits system.

Source citations (as archived): [The Christian Science Monitor](<https://news.yahoo.com/finland-wants-citizens-rich-poor-monthly-payment-223022308.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-12-06-2-1"></a>

Context: 2015 South Indian floods.

**Archived source account.** Chennai International Airport is set to reopen as flood waters recede. The death toll currently stands at at least 280 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Indian Broadcast News live](<http://www.ibnlive.com/news/india/chennai-rains-passenger-flights-to-operate-from-tomorrow-dgca-to-review-the-situation-for-night-operations-1173125.html>); [AAP](<http://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/2015/12/06/280-people-die-india-floods>).

<a id="event-2015-12-06-2-3"></a>

Context: Storm Desmond.

**Archived source account.** The strongest windstorm of the season so far continues to bring flooding and high winds to the United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/uk-35015243>).

<a id="event-2015-12-06-2-4"></a>

Context: Storm Desmond.

**Archived source account.** Flooding and landslides on the West Coast Main Line between Preston and Carlisle result in the suspension of all services between northern England and Scotland via the West Coast.

Source citations (as archived): [The Manchester Evening News](<http://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/news/greater-manchester-news/manchester-piccadilly-trains-delays-landslip-10553844>).

<a id="event-2015-12-06-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A collision between a train and a minibus in Jakarta kills 14 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel News Asia](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asiapacific/14-killed-in-collision/2323452.html?cid=twtcna>).

<a id="event-2015-12-06-2-7"></a>

Context: Pollution in China.

**Archived source account.** Elementary and middle schools in the Chinese capital Beijing suspend outdoor activities due to heavy smog.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg vs The Straits Times](<http://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/beijing-suspends-outdoor-activity-at-schools-as-smog-returns>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-12-06-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former U.S. President Jimmy Carter announces that his latest medical tests show he is cancer-free. Carter, 91, announced in August that a melanoma for which he had been treated had returned.

Source citations (as archived): [The Atlantic Journal-Constitution](<http://www.ajc.com/news/news/carter-cancer-is-gone/npdFQ/>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2015/12/06/458680791/former-president-jimmy-carter-says-he-is-cancer-free>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-06-4-1"></a>

Context: Turkey–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** Turkish and Ukrainian firms talk out a cooperation deal to help modernize their country's militaries in the wake of military actions by Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [Defense News](<http://www.defensenews.com/story/defense/land/vehicles/2015/12/06/turkish-ukraine-defense-firms-in-talks-for-tank-upgrades/76889304/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-06-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Germany's vice-chancellor, Sigmar Gabriel, accuses Saudi Arabia of financing Islamic extremism in the West and warns that it must stop. He tells German media, “We have to make clear to the Saudis that the time of looking away is over, Wahhabi mosques all over the world are financed by Saudi Arabia. Many Islamists who are a threat to public safety come from these communities in Germany". His comments come days after Germany's Federal Intelligence Service released a report saying Saudi Arabia was "destabilizing" the Arab world.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/europe/germany/12035838/German-vice-chancellor-accuses-Saudi-Arabia-of-funding-Islamic-extremism-in-the-West.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-12-06-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Clashes erupt in Athens between left-wing demonstrators and Greek police with at least eighteen people arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eurozone-greece-clashes-idUSKBN0TP0SD20151206?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=worldNews>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-12-06-6-1"></a>

Context: 2015 San Bernardino shooting.

**Archived source account.** President Barack Obama called the San Bernardino shootings "an act of terrorism designed to kill innocent people".

Source citations (as archived): [LA Times](<http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-san-bernardino-terror-probe-widens-as-obama-set-to-speak-20151206-story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-06-6-3"></a>

Context: Venezuelan parliamentary election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan opposition leaders say their Democratic Unity Roundtable has won control of the 167-seat legislature from the ruling Socialists for the first time since 1998. There is no confirmation on Sunday's election from the national electoral board. An opposition victory would be a major setback for the socialist revolution started 17 years ago by the late Hugo Chávez.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/L/LT_VENEZUELA_ELECTIONS?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-election-idUSKBN0TP03Y20151207#kBG7mf0wty4AB8cq.97>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/08f41ab3928b490f81647579ab2f1dcb/challenge-socialists-venezuelans-elect-legislature>).

<a id="event-2015-12-06-6-5"></a>

Context: Armenian constitutional referendum, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Armenia go to the polls to vote in a referendum to change from a presidential to a parliamentary form of government.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/armenia-referendum-constitution-sarkisian/27409522.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-06-6-7"></a>

Context: French regional elections, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Voters in France begin voting in the first round of regional elections just three weeks after the deadly Islamic State militant attacks in Paris. Exit polls show strong gains for the far-right National Front which is leading in six regions and reshape the political landscape after decades of domination by the centre-left and the centre-right coalitions. Midday voter participation is 16.27 percent, marginally higher than five years ago. There are 44.6 million eligible voters. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-politics-idUSKBN0TO0S920151206#iHEpimUxbGDH8Oec.97>); [France 24](<http://www.france24.com/en/breaking/20151206-france-far-right-national-front-tops-first-round-voting-regional-elections-with-306-vote-estimate-if-0/?ns_campaign=al_en&amp;ns_mchannel=email_marketing&amp;ns_source=AL_20151206_2016&amp;ns_linkname=20151206_breaking_news&amp;ns_fee=0&amp;f24_member_id=1080960490882>); [France24](<http://www.france24.com/en/?ns_campaign=al_en&amp;ns_mchannel=email_marketing&amp;ns_source=AL_20151206_2020&amp;ns_linkname=homepage&amp;ns_fee=0&amp;f24_member_id=1080960490882>).

<a id="event-2015-12-06-6-9"></a>

Context: Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Rival governments in eastern and western Libya reach the initial phase of an agreement designed to foster elections that would bring about a single ruling entity in the North African country. The deal must be endorsed by the internationally-recognized government in Tobruk and the General National Congress in Tripoli.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/12/06/Rival-governments-in-Libya-reach-power-sharing-agreement/1051449444071/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_int>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-12-06-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following the previous explosion of Orbital Sciences' Cygnus CRS Orb-3 on October 28, 2014, an unmanned Atlas V 401 rocket carrying Orbital ATK's Cygnus CRS Orb-4 resupply mission to NASA's International Space Station launches from Cape Canaveral in the U.S. state of Florida. The mission includes 7,380 pounds of cargo.

Source citations (as archived): [Spaceflight Now](<http://spaceflightnow.com/2015/12/02/av061journal/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-06-7-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scientists warn a new strain of the Panama Disease fungus, which in the 1950s nearly wiped out the most popular banana in the world, the Gros Michel, is threatening today's favorite, the Cavendish, according to a new study published in PLOS Pathogens. This untreatable fungal disease, called Tropical Race 4, has been active for decades in Southeast Asia. It recently has spread to other parts of Asia, Africa, the Middle East, and Australia, and is expected to make its way to Latin America, where the vast majority of the world's exported bananas are grown.

Source citations (as archived): [Tech Times](<http://www.techtimes.com/articles/113050/20151206/bananas-may-go-extinct-as-lethal-fungus-threatens-worlds-favorite-fruit.htm>); [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/world/disease-threatens-the-commercial-banana-20151205-glgh1y>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-12-06-8-1"></a>

Context: MLS Cup 2015.

**Archived source account.** The Portland Timbers win the championship game of the 2015 Major League Soccer season, winning 2–1 at Columbus Crew SC.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/sport/football/article-3348536/Columbus-Crew-goalkeeper-Steve-Clark-makes-nightmare-start-MLS-final-just-27-SECONDS-attempted-clearance-lands-net-legs-Portland-Timbers-striker-Diego-Valeri.html>).

### 2015-12-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076180027](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%207&oldid=1076180027>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-07-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syria's government says a U.S.-led military coalition airstrike on a Syrian Army camp in the eastern Deir ez-Zor Governorate, killed three Syrian soldiers and wounded 13 others. A senior U.S. military official denied responsibility for the airstrike and said that the U.S. is certain it was a Russian airstrike.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-mideast-crisis-syria-idUKKBN0TQ0E920151207>); [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/U/US_UNITED_STATES_SYRIA?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT&amp;CTIME=2015-12-07-11-34-31>).

<a id="event-2015-12-07-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights says at least 26 civilians have been killed in suspected U.S.-led coalition airstrikes near the ISIL-controlled town of Al-Hawl in Syria's northeast Al-Hasakah Governorate. A U.S. military spokesman in Iraq said the reports would be investigated.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-35031531>).

<a id="event-2015-12-07-0-4"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** Turkey refuses to withdraw its forces from northern Iraq despite being given a 48 hour ultimatum by Iraq to leave the country. Turkey says the troops are there as part of an international mission to train and equip Iraqi forces to fight against the Islamic State. The Iraqi government says it never invited such a force, and will take its case to the United Nations if they are not pulled out.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-turkey-idUSKBN0TQ0SS20151207>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-12-07-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Federal Trade Commission (FTC) files an administrative complaint challenging office-supplies giant Staples' proposed $6.3 billion acquisition of top rival Office Depot. The FTC said the deal would significantly reduce national competition in the market for office supplies sold to large business customers. The companies plan to contest the FTC decision.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/money/2015/12/07/ftc-challenges-63b-staples-home-depot-deal/76930420/>); [Bloomberg](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/business/ct-staples-office-depot-merger-20151207-story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-07-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** General Electric announces that it has abandoned its plan to sell its appliances business to Sweden's Electrolux. The U.S. Department of Justice had filed an antitrust suit in summer 2015 to block the $3.3 billion acquisition.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/ge-terminates-sale-of-appliance-business-to-electrolux-1449474391>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-12-07-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A powerful, magnitude 7.2 earthquake has shaken Tajikistan. It was felt as far away as India, Pakistan, and Afghanistan. No damage or casualties have been reported as the epicenter lies within the vast Badakhshan national park. The US Geological Survey describes the area as one of the “most seismically hazardous regions on Earth” because of tectonic activity along shifting fault lines.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/1dea2d809ca545339710dbe309aca5cc/powerful-earthquake-shakes-tajikistan>); [USGS](<https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/us100044k6#general_summary>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/asia/tajikistan-earthquake-magnitude-72-earthquake-felt-as-far-away-as-india-pakistan-and-afghanistan-a6762976.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-07-2-2"></a>

Context: Pollution in China.

**Archived source account.** Beijing's city government issues its first red alert for pollution, ordering schools to close, halting outdoor construction, and restricting car use due to hazardous air quality.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/07/asia/china-beijing-pollution-red-alert/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-07-2-5"></a>

Context: 2015–16 UK and Ireland windstorm season / Storm Desmond.

**Archived source account.** Storm Desmond shatters U.K. rainfall records as an incredible 13.44 inches of rain fell in 24 hours at Honister Pass in the Lake District in North West England. The 15.94 inches of rain at Thirlmere — also in the Lake District — set a new record for the 48-hour period.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/capital-weather-gang/wp/2015/12/07/13-inches-in-24-hours-flooding-storm-desmond-shatters-u-k-rainfall-records/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-07-2-6"></a>

Context: 2015–16 UK and Ireland windstorm season / Storm Desmond.

**Archived source account.** Desmond's fury and flooding has resulted in at least two deaths. Cumbria Police say about 5,000 properties were flooded and around 3,000 remain without power.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1601012/number-of-deaths-caused-by-storm-desmond>); [ITV](<http://www.itv.com/news/update/2015-12-07/truss-several-weather-related-deaths-in-storm-desmond/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-07-2-7"></a>

Context: 2015–16 UK and Ireland windstorm season / Storm Desmond.

**Archived source account.** Flooding that's devastated parts of northwest England, on Sunday temporarily brought a 260-foot high waterfall in the Yorkshire Dales National Park back to life for the first time in residents' living memory. But by today, it stopped.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1601604/floods-bring-260ft-high-waterfall-back-to-life>).

<a id="event-2015-12-07-2-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** A blaze, sparked by a quick succession of between 15 and 20 gas cylinder explosions, in the Kandivali suburb of Mumbai, India, kills at least two and injures 11 while destroying around 1,000 hutment homes.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1601474/mumbai-slum-fire-destroys-1000-homes>); [The Hindu](<http://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/mumbai/fire-breaks-out-in-a-godown-in-mumbais-kandivali-area/article7957850.ece>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-07-3-1"></a>

Context: Russia–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Turkey’s Foreign Minister Mevlüt Çavuşoğlu accuses Russia of provoking military gestures as a sailor aboard a Russian naval vessel wielded a rocket launcher as the ship passed through the Bosphorous Strait in the wake of Russia’s imposing sanctions on Turkey for that country’s downing of a Russian aircraft

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-turkey-russia-idUSKBN0TP0JW20151206#Zb6FGGqegmpT2WYE.97>).

<a id="event-2015-12-07-3-2"></a>

Context: Russia–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Turkey’s President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, in a televised speech, states that it is possible to find alternatives to Russian energy sources following his return from Qatar where he arranged a deal for liquefied natural gas (LNG) and the Turkish Prime Minister’s visit to Azerbaijan where energy matters were reportedly discussed. Turkish officials have reportedly discussed energy deals with other countries as well.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe](<http://www.rferl.org/content/turkey-russia-energy-alternatives/27409842.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-07-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russia's envoy to the International Atomic Energy Agency says he expects the historic nuclear deal between Iran and world powers, the P5+1, to be implemented in January. Before the end of the year, Iran will exchange its stockpile of low-enriched uranium for Russia's non-enriched forms of uranium, he said.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-nuclear-idUSKBN0TQ1II20151207#WBsOXfB9vVMZmOqk.97>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-12-07-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran's Cyber Police Chief announces the arrest of some 53 people for allegedly running websites supportive of the Islamic State militant group.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-police-arrests-idUSKBN0TQ0TO20151207#3eIsvwevd7p7J3ge.97>).

<a id="event-2015-12-07-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Supreme Court declines (Friedman v. Highland Park) to review the ability of cities and states to prohibit semiautomatic, high-capacity assault weapons that have been used in some of the nation’s most deadly recent mass shootings. The nationwide assault weapons ban law expired in 2004. Since the District of Columbia v. Heller decision in 2008 found the Second Amendment provides the right for an individual to keep a weapon in the home, the court has avoided all cases that might clarify if that right is more expansive.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/courts_law/supreme-court-wont-review-laws-banning-so-called-assault-weapons/2015/12/07/b562678e-96fb-11e5-94f0-9eeaff906ef3_story.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-court-guns-idUSKBN0TQ1SU20151207>).

<a id="event-2015-12-07-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of Justice will investigate the Chicago, Illinois police department. Long concerned with Chicago police department practices, the investigation is precipitated by the recent release of a video of the shooting death of Laquan McDonald. The Chicago police are set to release another video showing the police killing of Ronald Johnson in October of 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/12/07/us/justice-dept-expected-to-investigate-chicago-police-after-laquan-mcdonald-case.html?_r=0>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/07/us/chicago-police-shooting-ronald-johnson/index.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-07-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** United States Homeland Security Secretary Jeh Johnson says the Obama administration will announce a new terror alert system "in the coming days," that will better inform the public about threats to the United States. This will be the third terror alert system put in place since the September 11, 2001, terrorist attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.mlive.com/news/us-world/index.ssf/2015/12/us_getting_new_terror_alert_sy.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-07-4-5"></a>

Context: Whaling in Japan.

**Archived source account.** Australia is threatening to take legal action against Japan over its resumption of its controversial whale hunt in the Antarctic Ocean. A whaling fleet set sail last week, ignoring international condemnation, and last year's ruling by the International Court of Justice (ICJ) prohibiting these hunts.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.seattletimes.com/nation-world/australia-threatens-legal-action-against-japanese-whaling/>); [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151209215522/http://www.voanews.com/content/australia-launches-new-protest-against-japanese-whale-hunt/3092026.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-12-07-5-1"></a>

Context: Venezuelan parliamentary election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Venezuela's National Electoral Council announces the opposition Democratic Unity Roundtable (MUD) has won at least 99 seats in the 167-member National Assembly in Sunday's elections. The previous-ruling United Social Party of Venezuela (PSUV) picked up 46. Results for 22 contests remain to be determined. Voter turnout was a stunning 74.3 percent. "Within seconds," President Nicolás Maduro recognized the opposition's win, saying that despite (his party's) adverse result, Venezuela's democracy has triumphed.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/2ef2bd1fe3a44373ac301bff918a76c5/venezuelas-opposition-wins-control-national-assembly>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-35019111>); [BBC](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/07/americas/venezuela-oelections/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-07-5-3"></a>

Context: Armenian constitutional referendum, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Armenian voters approve, by 63.35 percent to 32.42 percent, proposed amendments to the Constitution that change the country's form of government to a parliamentary republic. Sunday's election had a 50.51 percent turnout of its registered voters. The opposition alleged wide-spread fraud which the Armenian Revolutionary Federation said didn't happen.

Source citations (as archived): [Asbarez](<http://asbarez.com/142597/armenia-adopts-new-constitution/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-12-07-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The JAXA probe Akatsuki successfully enters orbit around Venus five years after the first attempt. This mission is Japan's first successful mission to another planet. The orbital injection was achieved using the probe's attitude control thrusters, a feat which has never been done before.

Source citations (as archived): [Gizmag](<http://www.gizmag.com/jaxa-venus-akatsuki-orbit/40770/>); [Spaceflight Now](<https://spaceflightnow.com/2015/12/06/japanese-space-probe-to-steer-into-orbit-around-venus/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-08-0-1"></a>

Context: 2015 San Bernardino attack investigation.

Investigators are exploring whether the transaction was a personal loan or something else.

Source citations (as archived): [SBS](<http://www.sbs.com.au/news/storystream/bank-deposit-28500-made-california-shooter-reports>); [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2015/12/08/bank-records-show-28500-deposit-to-syed-farooks-account-two-weeks-before-shooting-source-says.html?intcmp=hpbt1>).

<a id="event-2015-12-08-0-11"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Saudi-led coalition airstrikes, targeting Houthi rebels battling pro-government fighters, killed and wounded dozens in the port city of Mocha, according to Yemeni security officials. Around 35 fighters on both sides were killed in the battle over a key military base near the city of Taiz. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Context: Syrian Civil War / Russian military intervention.

**Archived source account.** For the first time, Russia strikes Islamic State targets in northern Syria with 3M-54 Klub (Kalibr) cruise missiles launched from a Kilo-class submarine in the Mediterranean, according to the Russian Minister of Defence, Sergey Shoygu.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/325143-russia-strikes-isis-submarine/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-08-0-15"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Rebels in Homs and the Syrian government agree to a local ceasefire that is to include the withdrawal of opposition fighters from the al-Waer neighborhood, the only area of the heavily damaged city still under rebel control. The evacuation is expected to start Wednesday. Residents are hoping to return in the next few days.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-3351550/Life-slow-return-shattered-Syrian-city-Homs.html>); [CBS News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151212023300/http://www.hawaiinewsnow.com/story/30700866/rebels-in-homs-agree-to-deal-with-syrias-assad-regime>).

<a id="event-2015-12-08-0-17"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Four Egyptian security personnel are killed and another four are injured by a roadside bomb near the border town Rafah in the Sinai Peninsula. Islamist militants are suspected to have remotely detonated the device as an armored vehicle drove by the town's center, near the border with the Gaza Strip and Israel, security sources told Ahram Online.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/12/08/Bomb-attack-kills-four-Egyptian-security-personnel-in-North-Sinai/4021449622446/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_int>); [Ahram Online](<http://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/64/172938/Egypt/Politics-/Bomb-attack-kills-four-security-personnel-in-Egypt.aspx>); [Anadolu Agency](<http://aa.com.tr/en/world/blast-kills-four-army-soldiers-in-egypt-s-sinai/487635>).

<a id="event-2015-12-08-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** UK-based Anglo American plc (AAUKF) announces plans to slash 85k jobs and shed 60% of assets over the next several years; it will also halt dividend payments for the rest of 2015-16 and cut capital expenditures. The company cited depressed commodity prices for its actions.

The DigniCap scalp cooling system, a product first available in Sweden in the 1990s, produces near-freezing temperatures that make it harder for cancer-fighting drugs to reach and harm hair follicles. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

This facility, the final step of a project first proposed in the early 1990s, will be just the second cross-border airport in the world. U.S. Customs will operate a checkpoint on the bridge for those entering the country. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

<a id="event-2015-12-08-6-0"></a>

The suit, which alleges that congressional district boundaries were changed to make it easier for Democrats to win in seven of the state’s eight districts, had been rejected by both district and circuit courts due to lack of standing.

**Archived source account.** New research by a team of British archaeologists, published in the current issue of the journal Antiquity, revives an older theory of Herbert Henry Thomas that Stonehenge may have stood in Wales hundreds of years before it was dismantled and transported to Salisbury Plain in Wiltshire in South West England.

<a id="event-2015-12-09-2-1"></a>

Context: 2015 South Indian floods.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindu](<http://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/no-sign-of-letup-in-the-downpour/article7963264.ece>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-09-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States expands sanctions against North Korea over its alleged weapons breaches.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-35048138>).

<a id="event-2015-12-09-3-2"></a>

Context: Cuba–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Government officials from Cuba and the U.S. met in Havana, beginning settlement discussions surrounding $1.9 billion worth of U.S. assets seized by Fidel Castro’s regime in the early 1960s. By law, the United States embargo against Cuba cannot cease until settlements are made.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/in-major-breakthrough-cuba-and-us-discuss-19billion-in-property-claims/2015/12/08/9bc2ced0-9d23-11e5-9ad2-568d814bbf3b_story.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-12-09-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Australian Federal Police raid the Sydney home of Craig Steven Wright – whom media today claimed was suspected to be Satoshi Nakamoto, the founder of Bitcoin – in relation to possible tax offences.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-12-09/sydney-home-of-suspected-bitcoin-founder-raided-by-afp/7014254>).

<a id="event-2015-12-09-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Chinese state television reports Guo Youming, former deputy governor of Hubei province, is found guilty of taking bribes totaling more than 23.8 million yuan ($3.70 million). Guo is the latest to be convicted as a result of China's paramount leader Xi Jinping's anti-corruption campaign that started when Xi took Party general secretary office three years ago.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-corruption-court-idUSKBN0TS08F20151209#27OchWCcJTvYgfyH.97>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-12-09-5-0"></a>
