**Archived source account.** A group of mayors and officials from American cities such as Philadelphia and New York City say that if they had their way Donald Trump would be banned from their cities for his comments on Muslims.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC](<http://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2016-election/american-mayors-want-ban-donald-trump-cities-message-hate-n476566>).

<a id="event-2015-12-09-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Republican Speaker of the House Paul Ryan and Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell distance the party from presidential candidate Donald Trump’s recent comments calling for a ban on Muslims entering the United States. While not entering into a political fray – in view of U.S. partnerships with Muslim nations and Muslim personnel serving in the United States Armed Forces – the Pentagon press secretary calls anti-Muslim rhetoric a national security threat.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/08/politics/paul-ryan-trump-comments-not-who-we-are-as-a-party/>); [Politico](<http://www.politico.com/story/2015/12/pentagon-muslim-rhetoric-donald-trump-islamic-state-216560>).

<a id="event-2015-12-09-5-3"></a>

Context: Elections in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** Millions of voters in the world's third biggest democracy participated in Indonesia's local elections in 264 regions, just over half of the country's electorates. There is heightened security due to threats by domestic terror groups linked to the Islamic State, as well as increased scrutiny to prevent electoral fraud. Direct elections to choose local leaders were established a decade ago. Official results from the polls will not be available until December 18, 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [Straits Times](<http://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/millions-vote-in-historic-elections>); [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/tens-of-millions-to-vote-in-indonesia-regional-elections/a-18903243>).

### 2015-12-10

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1165836852](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%2010&oldid=1165836852>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-10-0-1"></a>

Context: Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** While testifying about the United States military’s current strategy, Vice Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff General Paul J. Selva warns the Senate Armed Services Committee (SASC) against falling into a ground fight trap with ISIL and U.S. Defense Secretary Ashton Carter cautions that increased U.S. ground presence will “Americanize” the conflict. The Daily Beast reports that both Pentagon officials “did little to assuage lawmakers’ concerns that the strategy isn’t working.’’ At the same time, former U.S. defense officials tell SASC the current approach is inadequate.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Beast](<http://www.thedailybeast.com/articles/2015/12/09/pentagon-insiders-isis-war-plan-is-not-working.html#>); [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/policy/defense/262484-former-obama-defense-official-isis-threat-getting-worse-not-better#.VmglA3tFYfk.facebook>); [Defense News](<http://www.defensenews.com/story/defense/policy-budget/congress/2015/12/09/carter-cautions-us-ground-troops-would-americanize-isis-fight/77043772/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-10-0-2"></a>

Context: Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** The United States says recent coalition airstrikes killed three ISIL senior leaders, including financial minister, Abu Salah; a senior leader responsible for coordinating the group's extortion activities; and, another leader who acted as an executive officer.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/isis-terror/isis-finance-minister-abu-salah-killed-american-airstrike-n477881?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_daily202>).

<a id="event-2015-12-10-0-4"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Pro-Hadi government forces backed by Arab coalition air and naval forces, seize control of the Hanish Islands off the coast of Yemen, near the strategic Bab-el-Mandeb strait from troops loyal to former president Ali Abdullah Saleh. The islands have been subject to heavy shelling by coalition forces for weeks according to local fishermen.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-hanish-idUSKBN0TT0X520151210>).

<a id="event-2015-12-10-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Swiss officials say police, based on a CIA tip, are hunting for at least four Islamic State-associated suspects believed to be plotting an attack in Geneva.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/E/EU_PARIS_ATTACKS?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT&amp;CTIME=2015-12-10-13-59-47>).

<a id="event-2015-12-10-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** A United States Treasury official says ISIL has made over $500 million selling oil to Syrian President Bashar Assad’s government, and has also sold oil to Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.com/isis-sells-oil-syrias-assad-regime-some-turkey-us-official-says-2221300>); [Reuters](<https://www.cnbc.com/2015/12/10/islamic-state-oil-is-going-to-assad-some-to-turkey-us-official-says.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-12-10-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Hollywood Foreign Press Association announces the 73rd Golden Globe Awards nominees for the best films and television productions of 2015. The winners will be announced on January 10, 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/entertainment/envelope/la-env-golden-globe-nominations-live-updates-htmlstory.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-10-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Pew Research Center announces a new study that shows the American middle class, long seen as the economic backbone of the country, is shrinking and no longer constitutes a majority (49.89%). Also, the "nation's aggregate household income has substantially shifted from middle-income to upper-income households."

Source citations (as archived): [Headlines &amp; Global News](<http://www.hngn.com/articles/159139/20151210/pew-middle-class-shrinking-longer-constitutes-majority.htm>); [Christian Science Monitor](<http://www.csmonitor.com/USA/USA-Update/2015/1210/The-Middle-Class-is-shrinking-Does-it-matter>); [Pew Research Center](<http://www.pewsocialtrends.org/2015/12/09/the-american-middle-class-is-losing-ground/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-10-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Vatican releases a 10,000-word document that, among other things, says Jews don't need to be converted to find salvation, and that Catholics should work with Jews to fight antisemitism.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2015/12/10/459223058/catholics-should-not-try-to-convert-jews-vatican-commission-says>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pope-jews-idUSKBN0TT1BK20151210#bdz0KPLr1Y8xfUAR.97>); [Vatican-full text](<http://www.news.va/en/news/vatican-issues-new-document-on-christian-jewish-di>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-12-10-2-1"></a>

Context: Volkswagen emissions scandal.

**Archived source account.** Volkswagen executives admit the diesel emissions cheating was the result of a collection of failures within the company, rather than just the actions of rogue engineers. In 2005, VW began working on software after they were unable to find an affordable technical solution to U.S. nitrogen oxide emissions standards.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/2015/dec/10/volkswagen-emissions-scandal-systematic-failures-hans-dieter-potsch>); [New York Times](<http://www.sfgate.com/business/article/Volkswagen-emissions-cheating-was-not-a-one-time-6690045.php>); [The Guardian press conference text](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2015/dec/10/volkswagen-vw-grilling-emissions-scandal-bank-of-england-business-live>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-10-3-1"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** Kim Jong-un, the supreme leader of North Korea, announces that the country is now in possession of a hydrogen bomb, according to North Korean state media. Experts from South Korea however are skeptical about this claim.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/325300-north-korea-hydrogen-bomb/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-35060035>).

<a id="event-2015-12-10-3-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian opposition politicians and rebels, attending a two-day meeting hosted by Saudi Arabia in Riyadh, agree on a framework that would guide proposed talks to end Syria's nearly five-year conflict: a civil, democratic Syria with a transitional government that would respect human rights and the territorial integrity of the country; and, safeguard state institutions while restructuring security forces. Ahrar ash-Sham, a Saudi-backed ultraconservative group, withdrew from the talks at the end of the meeting.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-35060935>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/ad4e978fab86467e82ae32cde60f26f0/saudi-fm-syrias-assad-must-leave-or-be-forced-out>).

<a id="event-2015-12-10-3-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry says that the new International Syrian Support Group are working toward a December 18 meeting in New York.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-kerry-idUSKBN0TT1J420151210#l3rpRZ3tSUiDCC79.97>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-12-10-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the United States, Suffolk County police ask the FBI for more help in their investigation of a possible serial killer who preyed on prostitutes and left their bodies strewn along a Long Island beach in New York. Ten bodies were found along an isolated stretch of the South Shore's Gilgo Beach between December 2010 and April 2011.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-new-york-serial-killer-idUSKBN0TU0FE20151211#TCQI7UrfHHlUbiy2.97>); [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/new-york/nyc-crime/fbi-larger-role-gilgo-beach-murders-investigation-article-1.2461853>).

### 2015-12-11

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131607141](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%2011&oldid=1131607141>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-11-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** The Taliban claims responsibility for a car bomb attack near the Spanish embassy in Kabul. At least one Spanish security officer is killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-blast-idUSKBN0TU1N220151211#CPCHO6JKPGU8GgqF.97>).

<a id="event-2015-12-11-0-3"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict (2015),.

**Archived source account.** Three Palestinians are killed by Israeli forces, two in Hebron, one of whom reportedly tried to ram his car into soldiers and the other during a violent demonstration in the West Bank city. A third Palestinian died in clashes with Israeli troops at the border fence between the Gaza Strip and Israel. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Today](<http://www.todayonline.com/world/palestinian-driver-rams-israeli-soldiers-west-bank-shot-dead?singlepage=true>); [AP](<http://www.stripes.com/news/middle-east/israel-palestinian-assailant-killed-2-protesters-dead-1.383450>).

<a id="event-2015-12-11-0-5"></a>

Context: 2015 Burundian unrest.

**Archived source account.** Burundi’s army repels attacks on military barracks in the capital, Bujumbura, in the worst violence since this spring's unrest that developed after President Pierre Nkurunziza decided to seek a third term in office. According to an army spokesman, at least 12 gunmen are killed and 20 captured. Reports that at least five soldiers have been killed are denied by the army, which says the soldiers were wounded. Two southern sites, a police station and an army camp, were also attacked, with no report on casualties. Kenya Airways and RwandAir cancels its flights to Bujumbura.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://america.aljazeera.com/articles/2015/12/11/burundi-military-sites-attacked.html>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-12-11/burundi-capital-rocked-by-gunfire-amid-reports-dozens-killed>).

<a id="event-2015-12-11-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Syrian Kurdish–Islamist conflict (2013–present).

**Archived source account.** A triple truck-bomb attack on the Kurdish YPG militia-controlled town of Tell Tamer in Syria's northeast Al-Hasakah Governorate leaves as many as 50 people dead and 80 others wounded. The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant claims responsibility for the attacks, saying in an online statement that three of its fighters driving three separate vehicles had detonated the suicide bombs targeting "bases" belonging to Kurdish fighters.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/isis-terror/isis-truck-bombs-kill-least-50-tel-tamer-syria-n478376>).

<a id="event-2015-12-11-0-9"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant's branch in Libya (Libya Province) seizes control of the western Libyan town of Sabratha, after storming it in retaliation after two of their men were arrested in a house nearby; however they then set up checkpoints around the town, with little opposition from the local militias that were supposed to be in control of the area. There are now fears that the militant group could destroy the town's Roman amphitheatre, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/islamic-state/12045883/Islamic-State-seizes-Unesco-heritage-site-in-Libya.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-11-0-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Swiss police in Geneva, following yesterday's CIA tip, arrest two Syrian nationals. Apparently, traces of explosives were found in their car. President Simonetta Sommaruga says, "There is currently no indication that there was a concrete attack planned."

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1604195/two-arrests-after-is-cell-tip-off-in-geneva>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-12-11-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Chinese tycoon Guo Guangchang, founder and chairman of Fosun, is reported missing amid the Chinese anti-corruption campaign.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/dec/11/guo-guangchang-chinas-warren-buffet-goes-missing-amid-corruption-crackdown>).

<a id="event-2015-12-11-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two of the U.S.’s oldest and largest companies, DuPont and Dow Chemical Company, will merge in an all-stock deal valued at $130 billion. The deal, which includes future plans for DowDuPont to split into three independent, public companies, is expected to face intense scrutiny from federal antitrust regulators, who will examine the impact on prices and the availability of vital seeds and herbicides.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-dow-m-a-dupont-idUSKBN0TU1B220151211#foIQzcZvrOmHb3W1.97>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/business/wp/2015/12/11/dow-and-dupont-two-of-americas-oldest-giants-to-merge-in-job-dropping-megadeal/?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_evening>).

<a id="event-2015-12-11-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** China's Alibaba Group Holding Limited acquires Hong Kong's largest English-language newspaper, the South China Morning Post, in a deal reported to be worth about $100 million.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Business_News/2015/12/11/Alibaba-to-buy-South-China-Morning-Post-in-reported-100M-deal/5831449867302/?spt=hs&amp;or=bn>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-12-11-2-1"></a>

Context: 2015 South Indian floods.

**Archived source account.** Major UK-based reinsurance broker Aon Benfield estimates India has suffered over US$3 billion (over Rs. 200 billion) worth of losses as a result of the flooding, and rates them as the costliest floods and the eighth-costliest natural disaster of 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Standard](<http://www.business-standard.com/article/current-affairs/chennai-floods-are-world-s-8th-most-expensive-natural-disaster-in-2015-115121100487_1.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-11-3-1"></a>

Context: 2015 United Nations Climate Change Conference.

**Archived source account.** French Foreign Minister Laurent Fabius announces the world climate talks (COP 21) will be extended to at least Saturday.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/376459cdb72242209226d0fb01c4c9d1/latest-french-host-says-climate-talks-extend-1-day>).

<a id="event-2015-12-11-3-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian President Bashar al-Assad says he will not negotiate with armed groups, a day after the Syrian opposition's multi-group, two-day meeting in Riyadh agreed on a framework for future negotiations to end the conflict. Assad's statement also appears to put a damper on peace talks Russia and the United States are working to set up.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-idUSKBN0TU2F920151211#mHxMtl1qTu26eLs3.97>); [Syria Online](<http://www.syriaonline.sy/?f=Details&amp;catid=12&amp;pageid=19986>).

<a id="event-2015-12-11-3-5"></a>

Context: War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** The United States and Russia exchanged charges concerning U.N. Assistant Secretary-General for Human Rights Ivan Šimonović's presentation at the U.N. Security Council meeting on Ukraine. While violence between Ukrainian troops and pro-Russian rebels has lessened since September's agreement, Šimonović warned of the massive civilian toll if major hostilities re-erupt. OCHA's John Ging said locals face unacceptable physical hardships and indignities, and that the suspension of humanitarian programs and expulsion of humanitarian workers in non-government controlled areas must end.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-crisis-un-idUSKBN0TU2Q120151211#xkpb8W8LpCFyGOD9.97>); [UN](<http://www.un.org/apps/news/story.asp?NewsID=52798#.VmtJ4F5BnYs>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-12-11-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hannibal Gaddafi, son of Libya's late leader Muammar Gaddafi, who was kidnapped by militants, is released in Baalbek, Lebanon. Gaddafi's abductors said they were seeking information on the fate of Shiite cleric Imam Moussa al-Sadr, who disappeared during a trip to Tripoli in 1978.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151212064949/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/son-late-libyan-leader-gadhafi-kidnapped-lebanon-35721493>); [Epoch Times](<http://www.theepochtimes.com/n3/1917587-muammar-gaddafis-son-hannibal-kidnapped-in-lebanon-reports/>); [AP](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/muammar-gaddafis-son-kidnapped-released-lebanon-n478821>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-12-11-5-1"></a>

Context: Libyan Civil War (2014–present).

**Archived source account.** Martin Kobler, United Nations envoy to Libya, announces the country's two rival parliaments agreement to set a target date of Dec. 16 to sign a U.N.-sponsored agreement on forming a national unity government.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151212074317/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/dec-16-target-sign-libya-unity-government-agreement-35723192>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/libya-security-idINKBN0TU22C20151211>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-12-11-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Washington State University researchers report in the Journal of the American Chemical Society that they have invented a new catalyst that promises to enable production of bio-based chemicals and plastics. In the future, products could be made from bio-based ethanol rather than superheated crude oil. Other uses for this new catalyst are being explored.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Science_News/2015/12/11/New-catalyst-to-make-eco-fiendly-bio-based-plastics-possible/2051449871130/?spt=hs&amp;or=sn>); [Phys.org](<http://phys.org/news/2015-12-catalyst-paves-bio-based-plastics-chemicals.html>).

### 2015-12-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1218716366](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%2012&oldid=1218716366>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-12-0-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber attacks an Iraqi Army post in Al Anbar Governorate on the border with Saudi Arabia, killing at least six guards.

Source citations (as archived): [Ahram Online](<http://english.ahram.org.eg/News/173270.aspx>).

<a id="event-2015-12-12-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Sixteen people are killed and many more injured by a car bomb and a second, delayed explosion near a hospital in Syria's mainly Alawite, government-controlled neighborhood of al-Zahra, east of Homs' old city, the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reports. The attack comes just five days after the government and rebels agreed on a local ceasefire in the western al-Waer suburb.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-blast-idUSKBN0TV0AZ20151212#8Wrebpd8a9PrsS52.97>); [EuroNews](<http://www.euronews.com/2015/12/12/syria-explosions-in-homs-leave-at-least-16-dead/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-12-0-5"></a>

Context: 2015 Burundian unrest.

**Archived source account.** Burundi's army reports 87 people, including eight government defenders, were killed, and 45 attackers captured in Friday's clashes at three military sites in Bujumbura. Police have not identified the gunmen. Witnesses report some of the victims' arms were tied behind their backs while others were killed at close range. This was the worst violence since this spring's attempted coup d'état. One of the generals behind the failed coup says his rebel group still wants to oust the president.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-burundi-unrest-idUSKBN0TV08D20151212#AAyzzFziOmv2hi3U.97>); [AFP](<http://www.globalpost.com/article/6704225/2015/12/12/87-killed-burundi-clashes>).

<a id="event-2015-12-12-0-7"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** All sides in the Yemeni civil war announce a seven-day ceasefire will start on Monday.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Arabiyah](<http://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/2015/12/12/Houthis-say-ceasefire-to-start-on-Dec-14-.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-12-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nigerian soldiers kill at least 12 people and injure dozens more in a clash with followers of Shi'a cleric Ibrahim Zakzaky's Islamic movement in the northern town of Zaria. The army says the crowd surged towards General Tukur Buratai's convoy, some firing and attempting to kill Buratai. Afterward, the Nigerian Army and the Islamic Movement accuse each other of instigating the attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [EagleOnline](<http://theeagleonline.com.ng/zakzakys-followers-attack-chief-of-army-staff-convoy/>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/25216ef3caae490f9cec0279e3deba14/shiites-nigerian-soldiers-kill-12-besiege-islamic-movement>); [Premium Times](<http://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/195051-nigerian-army-shiites-in-war-of-words-after-deadly-zaria-attack-that-killed-many.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-12-0-11"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021) / Battle of Kunduz.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations mission in Afghanistan reports 289 civilians were killed (301 with MSF update) and 559 injured during fighting in Kunduz between Taliban militants and Afghan National Security Forces in September and October. The U.N. says these numbers include casualties from the friendly-fire attack on the Doctors Without Borders hospital and noted the totals were likely to rise as more information becomes available.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-fighting-report-idUSKBN0TV07720151212#2QL88hCCMPdAPCwZ.97>); [Radio Free Europe](<http://www.rferl.org/content/afghanistan-un-report-kunduz-violence/27422671.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-12-0-13"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021) / Kunduz hospital airstrike.

**Archived source account.** After two months of investigations, Médecins Sans Frontières (Doctors Without Borders) announces the death toll from the U.S. airstrikes on its Kunduz Trauma Centre has risen from 30 to 42. MSF says 14 MSF staff were killed, as well as four caretakers and 24 patients. Also, MSF delivered a petition to the White House this week, signed by 547,000 people, calling for an independent investigation into the US airstrike.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/dec/12/msf-afghanistan-hospital-airstrike-death-toll-42>); [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/afp/article-3357169/MSF-says-death-toll-rises-42-Afghan-hospital-strike.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-12-1-1"></a>

Context: 2015 United Nations Climate Change Conference.

**Archived source account.** In Paris, delegates from 195 countries approve an agreement that seeks to dramatically reduce greenhouse gas emissions.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-35079532#>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/energy-environment/wp/2015/12/12/proposed-historic-climate-pact-nears-final-vote/?hpid=hp_rhp-top-table-main_ee-climate-801am:homepage/story&amp;wpisrc=al_alert-COMBO-world%252Bnation>).

<a id="event-2015-12-12-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japan and India sign an agreement on high-speed rail, defence technology and a memorandum of understanding on civil nuclear cooperation.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/afp/article-3357081/Japan-India-sign-bullet-train-nuclear-deals.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-12-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** North Korea's all-female Moranbong Band, which was formed by leader Kim Jong-un, surprisingly cancels tonight's concert at Beijing's National Centre for the Performing Arts, and two others and returns to Pyongyang. Rumors for the sudden change abound, but no reason has been given. The sudden cancellation could hurt Chinese-North Korean relations, cooler since between Kim assumed power in 2011.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/north-korea-girl-band-rumors_566c43f0e4b011b83a6b79f1>); [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151212203730/http://atimes.com/2015/12/n-korean-pop-band-cancels-beijing-concert-leaves-for-home/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-12-12-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Wisconsin gun shop, which a jury found negligently sold the gun an assailant used to injure two Milwaukee police officers to a straw buyer, reaches a $1 million settlement with the officers.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.seattlepi.com/news/crime/article/Wisconsin-gun-shop-to-pay-1M-to-settle-officers-6694184.php>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-wisconsin-guns-idUSKBN0TV01820151212>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-12-12-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** President Yahya Jammeh of Gambia declares the country an Islamic republic.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/dec/12/gambia-now-an-islamic-republic-says-president-yahya-jammeh>).

<a id="event-2015-12-12-3-2"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian municipal elections, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Saudi Arabia go to the polls for municipal elections, with women voting and standing for election for the first time. Seventeen women are elected to office.,

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/world/middleeast/la-fg-saudi-arabia-elections-20151211-story.html>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/first-women-elected-public-office-saudi-arabia-n479191>).

<a id="event-2015-12-12-3-4"></a>

Context: Houston mayoral election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Residents in the United States' fourth largest city are voting in a runoff election to choose the new mayor of Houston, Texas. The race is between the top two finishers in November's non-partisan election: Sylvester Turner, a veteran lawmaker seeking to expand economic opportunities; and, Bill King, a businessman pledging to fix city finances.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-houston-vote-idUSKBN0TV0GW20151212#B6JbEypdBG2qgpqF.97>); [KPRC-TV](<http://www.click2houston.com/news/polls-open-for-houston-mayoral-runoff-election>).

<a id="event-2015-12-12-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thirty-three people are arrested in Moscow in Constitution Day protests against alleged human rights abuses.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/12/crackdown-constitution-day-moscow-151212143214815.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-12-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Poland protests: Thousands march against the Law and Justice (PiS) party in Warsaw, with an estimated 50,000, and other cities protesting President Andrzej Duda and the country's new conservative government appointing new Constitutional Tribunal judges who are loyal to the PiS.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-35083561>); [AP](<https://news.yahoo.com/thousands-opponents-government-march-poland-150103855.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-12-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pro-Russian opposition parties protest against Montenegro's NATO membership, demanding a referendum on the issue.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/thousands-rally-against-montenegros-nato-membership-223202533.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-12-12-4-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Heisman trophy.

**Archived source account.** In American football, running back Derrick Henry of the Alabama Crimson Tide football team wins the Heisman Trophy for best college football player.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/12/12/us/heisman-trophy/index.html>).

### 2015-12-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076179602](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%2013&oldid=1076179602>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-13-0-1"></a>

Context: War in North-West Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** At least 25 people are killed and dozens injured in a bombing at a second-hand clothes market in the city of Parachinar in the Kurram Valley.

Source citations (as archived): [Pakistan Tribune](<http://tribune.com.pk/story/1009233/four-dead-several-wounded-in-parachinar-blast/>); [The News](<http://www.thenews.com.pk/print/81755-25-killed-70-injured-in-Parachinar-market-blast>).

<a id="event-2015-12-13-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian rebels fire volleys of mortar shells into Damascus, killing three people and wounding at least 30. Government forces respond with airstrikes into rebel-controlled Douma, just northeast of the capital, and surface-to-surface missiles into Eastern Ghouta and Saqba, that kill at least 35 people and injure many more, according to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/syria-child-killed-as-mortar-shells-strike-damascus/2015/12/13/7c0e68d2-a184-11e5-8318-bd8caed8c588_story.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/syria-child-killed-as-mortar-shells-strike-damascus/2015/12/13/7c0e68d2-a184-11e5-8318-bd8caed8c588_story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-13-0-5"></a>

Context: Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant.

**Archived source account.** Israel says an Arab-Israeli man who served in the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) has joined Islamic State militants in Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-islamicstate-israel-idUSKBN0TW0LW20151213>).

<a id="event-2015-12-13-0-7"></a>

Context: 2015 Burundian unrest.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. State Department issues a travel advisory for Burundi and advises its citizens there to leave as soon as possible due to the increased violence in the capital Bujumbura where 87 people were killed this weekend. Families of U.S. government personnel and non-emergency personnel have been ordered to leave immediately.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/12/13/United-States-warns-citizens-to-leave-Burundi-as-death-toll-in-barracks-attacks-rises-to-87/2271450053812/?spt=rln&amp;or=1>); [US State](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151217032710/http://travel.state.gov/content/passports/en/alertswarnings/burundi-travel-warning.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-13-0-9"></a>

Context: Gaza–Israel conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Air Force planes hit two Hamas targets in Gaza in retaliation for rocket fire from the Palestinian territory.

Source citations (as archived): [Ynet News](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4738813,00.html>); [The Times of Isarel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/israeli-jets-strike-gaza-after-rocket-attack/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-12-13-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Louisa Johnson wins The X Factor after beating Ghanaian duo Reggie N Bollie, becoming the show's youngest ever winner at the age of 17. her cover of Bob Dylan's 1974 track "Forever Young" released after she won.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/tvshowbiz/article-3358503/X-Factor-2015-winner-Louisa-Johnson-youngest-win-show.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-12-13-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 23 patients are killed and 23 injured in a psychiatric hospital fire in the Voronezh Oblast in western Russia. The remaining 24 patients were safely evacuated. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News America](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-12-13/21-killed-in-fire-at-russian-psychiatric-hospital/7024632>); [AP](<http://www.charlotteobserver.com/news/article49531850.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-13-3-1"></a>

Context: European migration crisis.

**Archived source account.** On the eve of the Christian Democratic Union (CDU) party's convention in Karlsruhe, Chancellor of Germany Angela Merkel says, "We want to noticeably reduce the number of people who come to us, but not through unilateral national measures alone." She acknowledges the crisis could overwhelm Germany if it went on much longer. Merkel warded off pressure from immigration skeptics within the CDU to include a quota in the refugee policy motion the convention will vote on.

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/Merkel-wants-to-drastically-reduce-refugee-arrivals-in-Germany-437220>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-12-13/merkel-stamps-out-revolt-on-refugees-as-party-anger-simmers>); [Reuters](<http://www.ibtimes.com/merkel-reverses-course-wants-limit-refugees-2223461>); [The Financial Times](<http://www.ft.com/intl/cms/s/0/3c146892-a1cc-11e5-bc70-7ff6d4fd203a.html#axzz3uF56erK3>).

<a id="event-2015-12-13-3-3"></a>

Context: Russia–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** A Russian warship fires warning shots at a Turkish vessel in the Aegean Sea to "avoid a collision", according to the Russian Defence Ministry.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-35087050>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-12-13-4-1"></a>

Context: Houston mayoral election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Veteran Texas lawmaker Sylvester Turner edges out businessman Bill King by just over 4,000 votes in Houston's runoff mayoral election. Turner, a Democratic member of the Texas House of Representatives since 1989, took 51 percent of the vote. King conceded defeat and encouraged Houston citizens to support the incoming mayor. Turner succeeds Annise Parker who was not eligible to run for re-election.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-houston-vote-idUSKBN0TV0GW20151213#JwkwBJkS0l5TXS3o.97>); [KHOU](<http://www.khou.com/story/news/local/2015/12/12/polls-close-early-election-results-come-in/77227836/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-13-4-3"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian municipal elections, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Unofficial results show at least 17 Saudi Arabian women won municipal council seats in the kingdom's third-ever election, and the first to allow female participation. Voters elected representatives for two thirds of the municipal council seats. The government announced that 979 women were candidates.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/saudi-election-idUSKBN0TW08G20151213#56BeaUQh7ioGvHfu.97>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2015/12/13/459554429/saudi-arabia-elects-its-first-woman-to-municipal-council>); [Daily Pakistan](<http://en.dailypakistan.com.pk/world/17-saudi-women-win-historic-local-council-polls/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-13-4-5"></a>

Context: French regional elections, 2015.

**Archived source account.** With most of the votes counted, the opposition conservatives of former president Nicolas Sarkozy's party win in six of the country’s 13 regions and lead in the Paris region. The ruling Socialists of President François Hollande's party capture five regions. The winner in Corsica is not affiliated with a major party. France's far-right National Front (FN) fails to win a single region but did record its best showing in its history. Voter turnout was 58 percent. Definitive results are expected Monday.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2015/dec/13/french-regional-elections-2015-live>); [Politico](<http://www.politico.eu/article/voter-turnout-high-in-french-regional-elections/>); [The Straits Times](<http://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/french-far-right-fails-to-win-a-single-region-in-elections>); [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1605202/far-right-defeated-in-french-regional-elections>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-politics-idUSKBN0TW00320151213#tqVVDB0mhH2IAfY5.97>).

<a id="event-2015-12-13-4-7"></a>

Context: Central African Republic constitutional referendum, 2015.

**Archived source account.** While voters in Central African Republic cast their ballots in a constitutional referendum aimed at ending years of sectarian strife, clashes erupt in the capital Bangui's PK5 Muslim neighborhood, killing at least two and injuring over 20. PK5 residents, visited by Pope Francis two weeks ago, marched to the U.N. headquarters in the country to complain they were unable to cast their ballots. The proposed constitution would limit a president to two terms, add an upper house to go along with the National Assembly, and fight institutional corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [France24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20151213-fighting-erupts-during-crucial-central-african-republic-referendum>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-centralafrica-referendum-idUSKBN0TW07Z20151213#mpDRV9JlAPSMRFQt.97>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/12/heavy-fighting-eurpts-car-referendum-voting-151213135951268.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-13-4-9"></a>

Context: 2015 protests in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Tens of thousands of Brazilians protest in cities around the country to demand that Congress impeach President Dilma Rousseff. The lower house of Congress opened impeachment proceedings on 2 December 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-rousseff-protests-idUSKBN0TW0L420151213#BexMrEXvCoGOV1XO.97>); [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151215072228/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/thousands-brazil-rally-demand-presidents-impeachment-35746679>); [Reuters-Congress](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-corruption-rousseff-idUSKBN0TL2XN20151203#Gu6IhBgAp0ZaULP8.97>).

### 2015-12-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076179544](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%2014&oldid=1076179544>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-14-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present), Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Two senior army commanders from Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates are killed, including the head of the Saudi Special forces in Yemen, Colonel Abdullah al-Sahyan, along with dozens of Saudi, Emirati, Sudanese and Yemeni coalition troops in an OTR-21 Tochka missile attack by Houthi forces on their base near the city of Taiz in southwestern Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-yemen-security-idUKKBN0TX0FN20151214>).

<a id="event-2015-12-14-0-3"></a>

Context: Metrojet Flight 9268.

**Archived source account.** Egypt's Civil Aviation Ministry reports their investigation of the 31 October 2015 deadly crash of Russian Metrojet Flight 9268 in the Sinai has not found any evidence of terrorism. Prior to this, the working assumption has been that plane was brought down by a bomb, and a group affiliated with ISIL said it was responsible.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1605434/egypt-russian-jet-not-downed-by-terrorists>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/14/world/egypt-russian-jet-crash-investigation/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-14-0-5"></a>

Context: Israeli-Palestinian conflict (2015).

**Archived source account.** A Palestinian rams his car into a bus stop near the Chords Bridge at the entrance to Jerusalem before being shot dead by police; fourteen people, including a toddler, are injured in the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Ynet News](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4739169,00.html>); [The Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/at-least-9-injured-in-terror-attack-at-jerusalems-chords-bridge/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-14-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Army backed by Hezbollah fighters retakes a key airbase on the eastern outskirts of Damascus. The Marj al-Sultan airbase had been under rebel control since November 2012.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-35097609>).

<a id="event-2015-12-14-0-9"></a>

Context: 2015 PKK rebellion.

**Archived source account.** At least seven people are killed in clashes between Turkish security forces and Kurdish protesters across southeast Turkey, as Turkish authorities declare new curfews across the restive region. According to the Human Rights Foundation of Turkey, 52 curfews have been imposed since mid-August by Turkish authorities across seven Turkish provinces in the region, placing around 1.3 million people under curfew.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-kurds-idUKKBN0TX19620151214>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-12-14-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Oil price reached its lowest since December 2008. Other indicators in broader markets caused investor jitters ahead of the expected interest rate hike by the U.S. central bank on Wednesday.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-global-markets-idUSKBN0TX01D20151214#PCHFPTJO6Pv3W4AT.97>).

<a id="event-2015-12-14-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Seattle City Council unanimously votes to give Uber, Lyft, and other contract drivers the power to join trade unions. The Washington city becomes the first in the United States to do so. Seattle Mayor Ed Murray opposes the bill which can still become law without his signature. Court challenges are expected.

Source citations (as archived): [The Seattle Times](<http://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/politics/unions-for-taxi-uber-drivers-seattle-council-votes-today/>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/tech/2015/12/14/seattle-decide-if-uber-lyft-can-unionize/77318652/>); [The Seattle Times - background](<http://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/politics/unionize-ride-app-drivers-seattle-in-us-spotlight/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-12-14-2-2"></a>

Context: 2015 Pacific typhoon season / Typhoon Melor (Nona).

**Archived source account.** Thousands of residents are evacuated as Typhoon Melor, also known as Nona in the Philippines, slams into tiny Batag Island in the eastern Philippines. The storm, headed to Sorsogon province, has intensified into the equivalent of a Category 4 hurricane. Authorities shut schools and suspended fishing and ferry services in the central Philippines. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.ledger-enquirer.com/news/nation-world/article49621565.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-typhoon-idUSKBN0TW0WX20151213#Xg7Zhx8SAMlA5PBt.97>); [AccuWeather](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151214060543/http://www.accuweather.com/en/weather-news/melor-to-threaten-philippines/54139705>).

<a id="event-2015-12-14-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 41 people are dead after an Argentine National Gendarmerie bus crashes near the city of Salta in north-west Argentina.,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-35093063>); [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151214201737/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/41-gendarmes-die-bus-crash-northern-argentina-35752859>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-12-14-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. mayor of Flint, Michigan, declares a state of emergency because of lead levels in children’s blood caused by problems with the city's water system.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/flint-mayor-declares-state-of-emergency-over-contaminated-water/>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/morning-mix/wp/2015/12/15/toxic-water-soaring-lead-levels-in-childrens-blood-create-state-of-emergency-in-flint-mich/?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_mix>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-12-14-4-1"></a>

Context: Censorship in China.

**Archived source account.** Chinese human rights lawyer Pu Zhiqiang goes on trial in Beijing for online social commentary critical of the ruling Communist Party.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/1806e5bf2da94ca0a2efc90ec79cc0f8/chinese-rights-lawyer-stand-trial-social-media-posts>).

<a id="event-2015-12-14-4-2"></a>

Context: Censorship in China.

**Archived source account.** Chinese police prevent United States senior diplomat Dan Biers from delivering a statement outside the trial of Pu Zhiqiang.

Source citations (as archived): [Twitter](<https://twitter.com/tomphillipsin/status/676243083487518721/>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/12/13/asia/china-trial-pu-zhiqiang/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-14-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Australian court orders British consumer goods company Reckitt Benckiser to stop selling several versions of the popular painkiller, Nurofen, that were identical to its standard ibuprofen pills but nearly twice as expensive.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/dca7ee0c492b453485eb9969e65ac941/austalia-court-uk-company-misled-customers-about-painkiller>).

<a id="event-2015-12-14-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** United States Army sergeant Bowe Bergdahl will face a court martial on charges of misbehavior before the enemy and desertion related to his capture by the Taliban-aligned Haqqani network in Afghanistan in June 2009.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://abcnews.go.com/Politics/bowe-bergdahl-face-general-court-martial/story?id=35761933>).

<a id="event-2015-12-14-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Palestinian man from eastern Jerusalem, Muhammad Abu Kaf, is indicted by Israeli prosecutors on eight counts of incitement to violence or terror for posting a video on Facebook calling on people to stab Jews.

Source citations (as archived): [Ynet News](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4738881,00.html>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2015-12-14-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Geminids meteor shower is visible tonight.

Source citations (as archived): [Lifehacker](<http://www.lifehacker.com.au/2015/12/how-to-watch-tonights-geminid-meteor-shower-in-australia/>).

### 2015-12-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1089082497](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%2015&oldid=1089082497>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-15-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The U.N. Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs reports that increased airstrikes by Russia have forced humanitarian assistance organizations to curtail their relief efforts, exacerbating the humanitarian crisis in northern Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/russian-airstrikes-force-a-halt-to-aid-in-syria-triggering-a-new-crisis/2015/12/14/cebc4b66-9f87-11e5-9ad2-568d814bbf3b_story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-15-0-3"></a>

Context: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea.

**Archived source account.** United States Pacific Fleet commander Scott H. Swift warns of a possible South China Sea arms race.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151219005542/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/us-navy-commander-warns-of-possible-south-china-sea-arms-race/ar-BBnyNSX?li=BBnb7Kz&amp;ocid=iehp>).

<a id="event-2015-12-15-0-5"></a>

Context: Islamist insurgency in Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** At least 30 people are killed after Boko Haram militants attack three villages in Nigeria's northeast Borno state.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/30-dead-boko-haram-attack-three-nigeria-villages-220803427.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-15-0-7"></a>

Context: Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** France's Air Force carries out its first cruise-missile strikes targeting Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant installations in Iraq, including “a training center and logistical depot,” according to the French defence ministry.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.defensenews.com/story/defense/international/mideast-africa/2015/12/15/france-uses-first-cruise-missiles-against-defense-ministry-says/77359138/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-12-15-1-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** Typhoon Melor (Nona) causes widespread flooding and blackouts in the Philippines. More than 700,000 people had been evacuated ahead of the storm which hit late on Monday night.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/12/15/world/asia/mass-evacuations-conducted-as-typhoon-hits-philippines.html?_r=0>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-12-15-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Food and Drug Administration approves the Merck &amp; Co. drug, Bridion, that reverses the effects of muscle relaxants used during surgery.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-merck-co-fda-bridion-idUSKBN0TY2TK20151215>); [FDA](<http://www.fda.gov/NewsEvents/Newsroom/PressAnnouncements/ucm477512.htm>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-15-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia announces the formation of a 34-member Islamic Military Alliance against terrorism including Egypt, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates, Turkey, Malaysia and Pakistan with a joint operations centre based in Riyadh.

Source citations (as archived): [SBS](<http://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/2015/12/15/saudi-arabia-announces-34-state-islamic-military-alliance-against-terrorism>); [BNO News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151216205728/http://bnonews.com/news/index.php/news/id3043>).

<a id="event-2015-12-15-3-2"></a>

Context: Nuclear program of Iran.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations finds Iran's firing of a medium-range ballistic missile in October violated a June 2010 resolution banning the Islamic Republic from launches capable of delivering nuclear weapons. The test was not technically a violation of the July nuclear deal between Iran and six world powers. It's not known if the Security Council will take any action.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.csmonitor.com/World/2015/1215/Iran-s-October-missile-test-violated-UN-sanctions-experts-say>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-missiles-un-exclusive-idUSKBN0TY1T920151215>).

<a id="event-2015-12-15-3-3"></a>

Context: Nuclear program of Iran.

**Archived source account.** The U.N. International Atomic Energy Agency's (IAEA) Board of Governors decides, by consensus unopposed, to close its investigation into whether Iran once had a secret nuclear weapons program. The IAEA will continue to police Tehran's activities.

Source citations (as archived): [The News Telegraph](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160304102200/http://thenewstelegraph.com/2015/12/15/un-closes-the-books-on-decade-long-nuclear-probe-of-iran/>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/iran-nuclear-idINKBN0TY0UR20151215>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-12-15-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Baltimore, Maryland deadlocked jury was told by the trial judge to resume deliberations after closing arguments in the first trial of police officer William Porter, charged in the death of Freddie Gray. With demonstrations and unrest following the death, the city has cancelled leave for police officers and the mayor has called for calm when a verdict is announced.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/15/us/baltimore-police-trial-freddie-gray/index.html>); [The Gazette](<http://gazette.com/freddie-gray-jurors-deadlocked-judge-says-keep-deliberating/article/1565765>).

<a id="event-2015-12-15-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Schools in the Los Angeles Unified School District close after receiving an unspecified "electronic" threat. Later, authorities conclude the threat was a hoax, and announce schools will reopen Wednesday. New York City schools' initial response to a similar threatening email was to treat it as a hoax. The emails were largely identical and had been routed through a server in Frankfurt, apparently by the same person.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-35102954?ocid=socialflow_facebook&amp;ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_campaign=bbcnews&amp;ns_source=facebook>); [ITV](<http://www.itv.com/news/update/2015-12-15/public-schools-in-la-to-reopen-wednesday-after-hoax/>); [LA School Report](<http://laschoolreport.com/nyc-gets-threat-similar-lausd-considers-hoax/>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/15/us/la-new-york-school-threats/>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/12/16/us/los-angeles-schools-bomb-threat.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-15-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** American entertainer Bill Cosby, in response to dozens of accusations of sexual assault and misconduct spanning decades, has filed in U.S. federal court in Massachusetts a defamation suit against seven accusers.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/12/15/arts/bill-cosby-files-defamation-suit-against-women-who-accused-him.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-15-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** United Kingdom police arrest a 21-year-old man in Berkshire in the hacking of Hong Kong-based electronic toy maker VTech. Details of more than six million people from servers used to support VTech's learning products app store were compromised.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-35100735>); [Digital Trends](<http://www.digitaltrends.com/dt-daily/vtech-hacking-suspect-nabbed-by-uk-police-video-dt-daily/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-12-15-5-1"></a>

Context: New Zealand flag referendums, 2015–16.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand announces the flag design chosen by the public that will challenge the current flag in a March 2016 vote. Voters will choose between the current flag, which features the British Union Jack with a dark blue background, and the challenger, a silver fern and four red stars on a black and blue background.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV](<http://www.ctvnews.ca/world/new-zealand-picks-new-flag-design-that-could-replace-current-flag-1.2700539>); [Stuff](<http://www.stuff.co.nz/national/75129464/flag-referendum-final-voting-figures-due-soon>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-12-15-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Soyuz TMA-19M, consisting of Expedition 46 crew members Yuri Malenchenko (RSA), Timothy Kopra (NASA) and Tim Peake (ESA), launches from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan for the International Space Station (ISS) with Peake becoming the first Briton to represent the European Space Agency at the ISS.

Source citations (as archived): [Bay News 9](<http://www.baynews9.com/content/news/baynews9/news/article.html/content/news/articles/cfn/2015/12/15/three_launch_for_iss.html>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/science/space/12050401/Tim-Peake-launch-Britains-first-astronaut-blasts-off-for-International-Space-Station-live.html>).

### 2015-12-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1297422095](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%2016&oldid=1297422095>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-16-0-1"></a>

Context: 2015 San Bernardino attack.

**Archived source account.** Neither Syed Rizwan Farook nor his wife Tashfeen Malik made open posts on social media regarding radical Islamic jihad or martyrdom prior to the attack, according to FBI Director James B. Comey. There were, however, direct, private messages to each other that did reflect this commitment.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/nation/la-ln-fbi-san-bernardino-social-media-20151216-story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-16-0-3"></a>

Context: 2015 Chattanooga shootings.

**Archived source account.** FBI Director Comey also announces the five military shooting deaths last July in Chattanooga, Tennessee, are now officially classified as a terrorist attack. The shooter, Muhammad Youssef Abdulazeez, was inspired and motivated by foreign terrorist propaganda. U.S. Navy Secretary Ray Mabus announces the Navy will award the Purple Heart to the four Marines and one sailor who were killed, and the one Marine who was injured.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151217045835/http://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/navy-award-purple-hearts-chattanooga-victims-35808480>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/nation/la-ln-fbi-san-bernardino-social-media-20151216-story.html>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-12-16-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In a widely expected move, the United States Federal Reserve Board raised the federal funds interest rate, the rate banks charge each other for overnight loans, from the 0-.25% range to the.25-.50% range. U.S. stock markets rallied on the news. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [CNNMoney](<http://money.cnn.com/2015/12/16/news/economy/federal-reserve-interest-rate-hike/index.html>); [Consumer Affairs](<http://www.consumeraffairs.com/news/federInternatial-reserve-raises-key-interest-rate-121615.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-12-16-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Air India aircraft maintenance technician is killed at Mumbai's Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport in India after being sucked by an Air India Airbus A319's aircraft engine during pushback.

Source citations (as archived): [Press Trust of India](<http://www.business-standard.com/article/current-affairs/air-india-technician-gets-sucked-into-plane-engine-dies-115121601336_1.html>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/12/17/asia/air-india-engineer-sucked-into-plane-engine/index.html>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-12-16-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A study published in JAMA: The Journal of the American Medical Association reports children with simple appendicitis who started with antibiotic treatment instead of immediate surgery, often recovered without ever needing surgery. They also had a shorter recovery and a smaller healthcare bill.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-surgery-appendicitis-idUSKBN0TZ33N20151216>); [WebMD](<http://www.webmd.com/children/news/20151216/antibiotics-often-enough-for-kids-appendicitis>); [JAMA](<http://archsurg.jamanetwork.com/article.aspx?articleid=2475977#Abstract>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-16-4-1"></a>

Context: Cuba–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States and Cuba reach an understanding on restoring regularly scheduled commercial flights. Currently, the only option available is charter flights.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/us-cuba-reach-understanding-on-restoring-commercial-flights/2015/12/16/aea540ca-a44c-11e5-8318-bd8caed8c588_story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-16-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** NATO leadership signs an agreement with the Ukrainian government to assist the country's modernization of its defense industry and capabilities.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Business_News/Security-Industry/2015/12/16/NATO-Ukraine-officials-sign-defense-cooperation-agreement/9201450299570/?spt=hs&amp;or=si>).

<a id="event-2015-12-16-4-4"></a>

Context: Taiwan–United States relations, Territorial disputes in the South China Sea.

**Archived source account.** The United States announces a deal to sell $1.83 billion worth of arms to Taiwan, which includes two decommissioned U.S. Navy frigates, Assault Amphibious Vehicles, and surface-to-air missiles. China has also expressed its disapproval over the deal, claiming it would affect their internal affairs.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-35115507?>); [Financial Times](<http://www.ft.com/intl/cms/s/0/a5fa0b54-a424-11e5-873f-68411a84f346.html>); [RT](<https://www.rt.com/usa/326164-taiwan-weapons-china-angry/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-16-4-6"></a>

Context: Islamic Military Alliance.

**Archived source account.** Pakistan says it was surprised to learn of the country's inclusion in Saudi Arabia's so-called "Islamic anti-terrorist alliance", and that Pakistan was not consulted before inclusion in the alliance by the Saudis. Pakistan's Foreign Secretary Aizaz Ahmad Chaudhry says he has asked the country’s ambassador in Riyadh to get a clarification from Saudi Arabia on the matter. Malaysia has also denied any involvement in Saudi Arabia’s military coalition to counter terrorism.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-35114060>); [DAWN](<http://www.dawn.com/news/1226723/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-16-4-8"></a>

Context: Latvia–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Latvia's State Border Guard begins the construction of a border fence that will cover almost a third of the Latvia–Russia border in an effort to keep out migrants who attempt to illegally cross the border from Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<http://uk.businessinsider.com/latvia-border-fence-russia-2015-12?r=US&amp;IR=T>).

<a id="event-2015-12-16-4-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** As many as 53 members of the World Trade Organization sign an agreement in Nairobi, Kenya, to remove import tariffs on 201 information technology products that account for trade of $1.3 trillion annually.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/wto-trade-idUSL1N1451JF20151216>); [The Financial Express](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151219023504/http://www.financialexpress.com/article/economy/wto-members-in-agreement-on-1-3-trillion-it-trade-deal/180508/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-12-16-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japan's Supreme Court upholds a 19th-century law that requires married couples to have the same surname, but struck down another law that barred women from remarrying within six months of a divorce as unconstitutional.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/dec/16/japanese-court-rules-married-women-cannot-keep-their-surnames>).

<a id="event-2015-12-16-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The North Korean (DPRK) supreme court convicts and sentences South Korea-born Canadian pastor Hyeon Soo Lim to hard labor for life for trying to overthrow the DPRK and undermine the country's social system. Lim's relatives said he's traveled to North Korea more than 100 times since 1997, to help people, but not for any particular political purpose. Lim, from the Light Korean Presbyterian Church in Toronto, has been in custody since February.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-canada-pastor-idUSKBN0TZ0CI20151216>); [Xinhua News Agency](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2015-12/16/c_134922727.htm>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/dec/16/hyeon-soo-lim-canadian-pastor-given-life-sentence-in-north-korea>).

<a id="event-2015-12-16-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bank in Minnesota (U.S.) is robbed by the same person a second time while an Iowa television station was doing a live update on the first robbery. The robber was arrested shortly afterwards.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151219000020/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/crime/tv-station-reporting-live-when-minnesota-bank-robbed-again/ar-BBnCNoh?li=BBnbfcL&amp;ocid=iehp>).

<a id="event-2015-12-16-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** After the jury fails to reach a unanimous decision, a Baltimore, Maryland, judge declares a mistrial in the trial of police officer William Porter, the first officer to be charged in the death of Freddie Gray.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/hung-jury-trial-baltimore-cop-freddie-gray-case-n481296>); [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/US/hung-jury-freddie-gray-trial/story?id=35795635>).

<a id="event-2015-12-16-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** About 100 men in more than 50 machine gun-mounted trucks kidnap at least 26 Qataris, including members of the royal family, from a hunting camp in Iraq near the Saudi border.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1607162/qatari-royals-kidnapped-while-hunting-in-iraq>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-12-16-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Members of the U.S. Congress reach a spending deal that, once passed by both houses, will prevent a year-end government shutdown and will fund Fiscal Year 2016 federal government operations. President Barack Obama signs a separate bipartisan bill that extends government funding through Tuesday, December 22.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/2015/12/15/congress-nears-deal-2016-spending-bill-fund-federal-government/77353838/>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/powerpost/wp/2015/12/15/congress-reaches-year-end-deal-on-taxes-and-spending/>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/White-House-Emergency-Documents-signed-to-prevent-US-government-shutdown-437573>).

<a id="event-2015-12-16-6-2"></a>

Context: Spanish general election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Spanish Prime Minister Mariano Rajoy is punched in the face by a teenager during a People's Party campaign event in the city of Pontevedra.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/dec/16/spanish-pm-punched-during-election-walkabout>).

### 2015-12-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1359118304](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%2017&oldid=1359118304>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-17-0-1"></a>

Context: Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Delegates from Libya's warring factions sign a U.N.-brokered agreement to form a national unity government. Some of Libya's armed brigades are closely allied with political leaders who oppose this agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/libya-security-idINKBN0U02FA20151217>); [Al Arabiya](<http://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/2015/12/17/Libyan-factions-meet-to-sign-U-N-peace-deal.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-17-0-3"></a>

Context: 2015 PKK rebellion.

**Archived source account.** Turkish security forces kill 23 suspected members of the Kurdistan Workers' Party in operations in the Kurdish-majority cities of Cizre and Silopi.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-35120148>).

<a id="event-2015-12-17-0-4"></a>

Context: 2015 PKK rebellion.

**Archived source account.** The Turkish Army deploys tanks into civilian areas of Silopi and soldiers are reportedly going house-to-house in search of PKK militants. The pro-Kurdish opposition Peoples' Democratic Party (HDP) condemns the Turkish military actions in Silopi.

Source citations (as archived): [Today's Zaman](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160116103550/http://www.todayszaman.com/anasayfa_hdp-deputy-security-forces-fired-in-streets-raided-homes-in-silopi_407133.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-17-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Niger's president Mahamadou Issoufou announces that an attempted coup, involving the use of aerial firepower to overthrow the government has been foiled and those behind it have been arrested. Among those taken into custody were the former military chief of staff, General Souleymane Salou, and Lt. Colonel Dan Haoua, head of the air force base in the capital Niamey.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/dec/17/niger-government-foiled-attempted-coup-president-announces>).

<a id="event-2015-12-17-0-7"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–2021).

**Archived source account.** American-led airstrikes kill at least 180 Islamic State fighters while local Kurdish forces repel an assault by 300 heavily armed militants in northern Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/islamic-state-offensive-in-northern-iraq-although-repelled-shows-groups-resilience/2015/12/17/752f207c-a4ec-11e5-b53d-972e2751f433_story.html?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_headlines>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-12-17-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 6.4-magnitude earthquake hits the southern Mexican state of Chiapas. The epicenter was 11 kilometers (7 miles) from the town of Tres Picos, not far from the Pacific coast. There are no immediate reports of major damage or injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-quake-idUSKBN0U02T620151217>); [USGS](<https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/us100047zq#general_summary>).

<a id="event-2015-12-17-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** As many as 36 miners die in a pair of accidents in Northeast China.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151218095233/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/17-die-chinese-mine-accident-35832391>).

<a id="event-2015-12-17-1-2"></a>

Context: As many as 36 miners die in a pair of accidents in Northeast China..

**Archived source account.** Nineteen workers trapped by Wednesday's gas explosion and raging fire in a coal mine in Hegang in Heilongjiang privince are not expected to survive because of carbon monoxide and the high temperatures from the fire, according to the rescue and command office's Zhang Qinxiang. Thirty-three miners escaped.

Source citations (as archived): [MINING.com](<http://www.mining.com/hope-fades-for-19-trapped-coal-miners-in-china/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-17-1-3"></a>

Context: As many as 36 miners die in a pair of accidents in Northeast China..

**Archived source account.** A fire caused by sparks from welding equipment kills 17 workers in the Xingli coal mine in Huludao city in Liaoning province. The State Administration of Work Safety reports 13 miners died at the site while four died at the hospital. Another ten miners are hospitalized.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2015-12/18/c_134929584.htm>); [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/17-die-in-chinese-mine-accident/2015/12/17/1e98a6d2-a52f-11e5-8318-bd8caed8c588_story.html>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-12-17-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Researchers at University College London report in The Lancet that an annual blood test could help reduce women's risk of dying from ovarian cancer by about 20 percent.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/ovarian-cancer-blood-test-saves-lives-study-finds/>); [WebMD](<http://www.webmd.com/ovarian-cancer/news/20151217/annual-blood-test-might-help-prevent-deaths-from-ovarian-cancer>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-17-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** China summons Kaye Lee, the U.S. deputy chief of mission in Beijing, to protest Washington's announcement that it is selling two warships to Taiwan as part of a $1.83 billion arms deal. U.S. state department spokesman John Kirby says the sale is consistent with the 1979 Taiwan Relations Act while Chinese Vice-Foreign Minister Zheng Zequang threatens to impose sanctions on U.S. firms because the proposed sale "severely damaged China's sovereignty and security interests."

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/china/china-summons-u-s-envoy-over-1-83b-arms-sale-n481646>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-35115507>).

<a id="event-2015-12-17-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council unanimously adopts a resolution aimed at disrupting revenue the Islamic State gets from oil sales, ransom payments, and other criminal activities.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-islamic-state-un-idUSKBN0U030P20151217>); [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/un-unanimously-adopts-resolution-targeting-finances-203644810.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-17-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The World Trade Organization approves Afghanistan's membership at its 10th ministerial conference in Nairobi, Kenya. Afghanistan becomes the 164th WTO member and is the 36th least developed country (LDC) in the global trade body.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua News Agency](<http://www.globalpost.com/article/6707307/2015/12/17/afghanistans-wto-membership-approved-after-11-years-talks>); [Channel News Asia](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/business/afghanistan-joins-world/2357102.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-17-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations General Assembly passes a resolution condemning North Korea's human rights abuses and calls on the Security Council to refer violations to the International Criminal Court.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/12/18/UN-adopts-resolution-condemning-North-Korea-human-rights-violations/4051450461987/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_int>); [The Japan Times](<http://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2015/12/18/asia-pacific/u-n-adopts-motion-north-korea-right-abuses-urging-criminal-court/#.VnQ0EcArI6V>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-12-17-4-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Riots break out in the western Dutch town of Geldermalsen over plans to establish a centre for asylum seekers in the town. Local police say they made several arrests. Including this year's arrivals, the Dutch government said in November it expected to receive 58,000 asylum seekers by the end of 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-35118496>).

<a id="event-2015-12-17-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** United States federal prosecutors in New York City arrest Martin Shkreli on securities fraud charges for allegedly plundering for personal gain Retrophin, a biopharmaceutical company he ran as CEO from 2012 to 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/business/ct-martin-shkreli-arrested-20151217-story.html>); [ABC](<http://abcnews.go.com/Health/turing-pharmaceuticals-ceo-martin-shkreli-arrested-securities-fraud/story?id=35819042>).

<a id="event-2015-12-17-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japanese journalist Tatsuya Kato is acquitted by a South Korean court of defamation charges resulting from questions he raised about South Korean President Geun-hye Park's whereabouts during the Sewol ferry disaster.

Source citations (as archived): [The Chosun Ilbo](<http://english.chosun.com/site/data/html_dir/2015/12/18/2015121801092.html>); [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151218104936/http://www.voanews.com/content/japanese-journalist-cleared-in-south-korea-defamation-case/3106725.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-17-4-5"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** The New York Times reports the U.S. Navy covered up a Naval Criminal Investigative Service (NCIS) report on Afghan detainee abuses. The NCIS investigation found that Navy SEAL Team 2's abuse resulted in the death of a 24-year old married Afghan detainee with a new baby, and that the SEALs failed to restrain the Afghan Local Police's detainee abuses.
