This drove some previously cooperative Afghans to leave for Taliban-controlled areas, the Times reports. Their commander in Afghanistan recommended these men be forced out of the elite SEAL teams. Two of the SEALs and their lieutenant have since been promoted. Rachel E. VanLandingham, former United States Central Command’s chief legal adviser on detainee and interrogation issues from 2006 to 2010, and other military lawyers, have called for the case to be reopened.

Source citations (as archived): [Headline &amp; Global News](<http://www.hngn.com/articles/161483/20151217/seals-death-cover-up-beatings-afghan-detainees.htm>); [The New York Times](<http://www.tampabay.com/news/military/war/navy-seals-and-coverup-claims-after-an-afghan-detainees-death/2258174>); [Sky Valley Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151220031124/http://www.skyvalleychronicle.com/BREAKING-NEWS/U-S-NAVY-SEALS-BEAT-AFGHAN-MAN-TO-DEATH-THERE-WAS-A-COVER-UP-AND-NONE-WERE-CHARGED-br-Suggests-new-report-2349556>); [The New York Times - synopsis](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/12/17/world/asia/navy-seals-ncis-report.html?em_pos=large&amp;emc=edit_nn_20151218&amp;nl=morning-briefing&amp;nlid=11553763&amp;_r=0>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-12-17-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin calls U.S. Republican presidential candidate Donald Trump, "a very colorful person. Talented, without any doubt" as well as an "absolute leader" in the race for the presidency.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/russian-president-vladimir-putin-praises-donald-trump-talented/story?id=35816611>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-12-17-6-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 Premier League.

**Archived source account.** José Mourinho is sacked as Chelsea F.C.'s manager on his second spell after the club lost nine of their 16 league games, placing the club one point above the relegation zone.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/34670192>); [France24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20151217-jose-mourinho-sacked-chelsea-fc-manager-football-england>).

### 2015-12-18

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1355907676](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%2018&oldid=1355907676>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-18-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Two ballistic missiles are fired from Yemen at Saudi Arabia, one of which is intercepted by the kingdom's air defences, while the other missile lands near the city of Najran, according to a coalition statement on Saudi state media. No casualties have been reported.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/2/8/173847/World/Region/BREAKING-Two-ballistic-missiles-fired-at-Saudi-fro.aspx>).

<a id="event-2015-12-18-0-3"></a>

Context: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea.

**Archived source account.** A U.S. B-52 long-range bomber on a routine mission over the South China Sea mistakenly flew within two nautical miles of an artificial island built by China near the Cuarteron Reef in the disputed Spratly Islands archipelago, according to a senior U.S. defense official. The Chinese Defense Ministry issues a statement accusing the U.S. of deliberately raising tensions in the disputed region.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/dec/19/south-china-sea-us-bomber-angers-beijing-with-spratly-islands-flypast>).

<a id="event-2015-12-18-0-5"></a>

Context: International intervention in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** An airstrike by the U.S.-led coalition hit Iraqi forces as the army engaged militants in poor weather conditions south of the city of Fallujah. Official reports state one soldier was killed, and nine were injured, but casualties may be significantly higher. A military medic says he's treated at least 20 for injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/errant-us-airstrike-hit-iraqi-forces-baghdad-government-says/2015/12/18/64606bea-a5c1-11e5-ad3f-991ce3374e23_story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-18-0-7"></a>

Context: 2015 Burundian unrest.

**Archived source account.** The African Union's Peace and Security Council approves the plan to send 5,000 peacekeepers to Burundi to protect civilians caught up in the growing crisis; approval by the U.N. Security Council is required. Burundi's Philippe Nzobonariba says the force would not be allowed in without government permission.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.houstonchronicle.com/news/nation-world/world/article/African-Union-OKs-deployment-of-Burundi-6708527.php>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-burundi-politics-mission-idUSKBN0U10EU20151218>).

<a id="event-2015-12-18-0-9"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights says suspected Russian airstrikes kill 32 civilians, half of them women and children, in three areas in northern Syria. No suspected militants were killed in the attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/suspected-russia-raids-kill-32-civilians-in-north-syria/>); [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1608377/russian-airstrikes-kill-32-syrian-civilians>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-12-18-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Vatican announces Mother Teresa's eligibility for canonization after a Vatican spokesman confirmed Pope Francis' recognition of a second miracle attributed to her involving the healing of a Brazilian man with multiple brain tumors. The Vatican has yet to confirm a canonization date for Teresa.

Source citations (as archived): [Agence France-Presse](<https://www.theguardian.com/news/2015/dec/18/mother-teresa-to-become-saint-after-pope-recognises-miracle-report>); [Reuters](<http://www.thehindu.com/news/international/mother-teresa-to-be-made-catholic-saint-in-september-paper/article8004016.ece>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-12-18-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the United States, JPMorgan Chase agrees to pay $307 million to settle federal cases where the bank failed to disclose certain conflicts of interest to some of its wealth management clients.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/jpmorgan-sec-settlement-idINL1N1471LF20151218>); [Huffington Post](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/jpmorgan-chase-fines_56744228e4b0b958f6566bda>).

<a id="event-2015-12-18-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Isis Pharmaceuticals Inc. announces it will change its name to Ionis Pharmaceuticals Inc. on December 22. Its stock exchange ticker symbol will be IONS.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-isis-pharma-namechange-idUSKBN0U12A720151218>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-12-18-3-1"></a>

Context: Pollution in China.

**Archived source account.** The Chinese government warns residents in Northern China to prepare for a wave of choking smog arriving over the weekend and lasting through Tuesday, with Beijing affected hardest. The capital city issues its second-ever "red alert" -- the first was announced on December 7, 2015. This alert triggers the odd-even license plate system to halve cars on the road, and recommends schools close. China's National Meteorological Center reports the pollution will stretch from Xi'an, across part of Central China, through Beijing and up into Shenyang and Harbin in China's frigid northeast.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/us-china-pollution-idINKBN0U102Z20151218>); [South China Morning Post](<http://www.scmp.com/news/china/policies-politics/article/1892504/airpocalypse-iii-worst-smog-year-headed-northern-china>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-18-4-1"></a>

Context: Australia–Japan relations.

**Archived source account.** In Tokyo, Australian Prime Minister Malcolm Turnbull says his country is “very disappointed” with Japan's decision to resume whaling, but this dispute should not be allowed to hurt the two countries' special strategic ties. Malcolm Turnbull, who replaced Tony Abbott in September, is on his first visit to Japan which will include talks with Japanese Prime Minister Shinzō Abe.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-australia-idUSKBN0U107T20151218>); [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/australia-leader-disappointed-with-japans-return-to-whaling/2015/12/18/dfe2b820-a546-11e5-8318-bd8caed8c588_story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-18-4-3"></a>

Context: Romania–NATO relations.

**Archived source account.** NATO's Aegis Ashore Ballistic Missile Defense System becomes partly operational at Romania's Deveselu airbase, as U.S. Navy personnel takes control of the site after years of construction. Aegis Ashore facilities in Romania form part of NATO's European missile defence system, with another site under construction in Poland expected to become operational by 2018. The United States Ambassador to Romania Hans G. Klemm says that they have explained to the Russians on numerous occasions that the missile system is, "not directed at Russia, nor does it have the capability to threaten Russia." The head of Russia's Strategic Missile Troops, Colonel General Sergei Karakayev, has dismissed the purported effectiveness of the missile defense system, saying Moscow develops “brand new and effective means and techniques to penetrate any missile defense system”.,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://news.yahoo.com/us-nato-certify-anti-missile-defense-south-romania-120109783.html>); [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/326398-nato-missile-defense-romania/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-18-4-5"></a>

Context: Russia–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian Prime Minister Arseniy Yatsenyuk says his country is imposing a moratorium on repayment of a $3 billion debt to Russia following Moscow's refusal to accept repayment terms already offered to other international creditors. This means Ukraine is likely to default on the debt, which is due Sunday.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.nbcnews.com/business/economy/ukraine-russia-we-cant-pay-3-billion-debt-we-owe-n482371>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-35132258>).

<a id="event-2015-12-18-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Union warns Thailand that the country needs to quickly address the human rights and slavery issues in its seafood industry if it wants to avoid an EU import ban.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/98bff6da2e6d4906bfbf41fd8f2140ca/eu-demands-thailand-address-slavery-its-seafood-industry>); [AP investigation](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151221215029/http://neurope.eu/wires/portrait-of-slavery-fisherman-jailed-by-captain-for-wanting-to-go-home-returns-to-family/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-18-4-9"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** NATO allies agree to send aircraft and ships to strengthen Turkey's Syrian border air defenses and avoid incidents similar to November's downing of a Russian jet.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-turkey-nato-exclusive-idUSKBN0U123520151218>).

<a id="event-2015-12-18-4-10"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Following Russia and the United States agreement on the text, the U.N. security council unanimously approves an international roadmap for a peace process in Syria. The resolution does not touch on the question of Bashar al-Assad's fate.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/dec/18/un-security-council-agree-resolution-on-syrian-peace-process>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/global-leaders-struggle-to-agree-on-a-way-to-end-the-crisis-in-syria/2015/12/18/8c194686-a5ab-11e5-9c4e-be37f66848bb_story.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-12-18-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the United States, a group of hospitals, 32 in 15 states, agree to pay a total of $28 million to settle charges they submitted false claims to Medicare for a type of spinal fracture treatment. This is the latest settlement stemming from a decade-old whistleblower lawsuit about alleged inappropriate billing for kyphoplasty. More than 130 hospitals have paid about $105 million to settle billing claims from this spinal procedure.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hospitals-medicare-settlement-idUSKBN0U120420151218>); [The Arizona Republic](<http://www.azcentral.com/story/news/arizona/investigations/2015/12/18/banner-health-settlement-overbilling-medicare/77578924/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-12-18-6-1"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** The Democratic National Committee suspends Vermont Senator Bernie Sanders' presidential campaign's access to its national voter database after a member of his campaign staff took advantage of a software error to review Hillary Clinton's private campaign data. In response, the campaign files a lawsuit.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/sanders-threatens-to-sue-dnc-if-access-to-voter-list-isnt-restored/2015/12/18/fa8d6df8-a5a2-11e5-ad3f-991ce3374e23_story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-18-6-2"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Jeff Weaver, presidential campaign manager for Vermont Senator Bernie Sanders, says the DNC's suspending access to the Democratic voter file is part of a "pattern" of actions that suggest the DNC is not impartial. The campaign, which had notified the DNC of software problems, threatens to take the DNC to federal court if the party organization doesn't restore the campaign's access.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2015/12/18/Bernie-Sanders-campaign-threatens-to-sue-DNC/5791450462344/?spt=hs&amp;or=tn_us>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/18/politics/bernie-sanders-campaign-dnc-suspension/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-18-6-3"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Michael Briggs of the Sanders campaign says the voter data access issue has been “resolved.”

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/US/sanders-campaign-sues-dnc-blocking-voter-data-access/story?id=35852585>).

### 2015-12-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131607456](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%2019&oldid=1131607456>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-19-0-1"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–2021).

**Archived source account.** Iraqi Defense Minister Khaled al-Obaidi updates the death toll from Friday's friendly fire airstrike near Fallujah to 10, one officer and nine soldiers. U.S. Defense Secretary Ashton B. Carter says it appears an American jet conducted the strike. Carter called Iraqi Prime Minister Haider al-Abadi to express condolences.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/iraq-says-10-soldiers-killed-in-misfire-by-us-led-coalition/2015/12/19/7aaa83e8-a63b-11e5-9c4e-be37f66848bb_story.html?gtontid=pm_world_pop_b>).

<a id="event-2015-12-19-0-3"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** Turkey’s foreign ministry says it will continue to move some of its troops out of a military base at Bashiqa in Nineveh province in northern Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/turkey-acknowledges-miscommunication-over-troops-in-iraq/2015/12/19/ee6ccb10-a69a-11e5-9c4e-be37f66848bb_story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-19-0-5"></a>

Context: Turkey–PKK conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Turkish army says 69 Kurdish insurgents and two Turkish soldiers were killed in four days of fighting in Cizre and Silopi, near the Syrian and Iraqi borders, in southeast Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-kurds-idUSKBN0U208M20151219>).

<a id="event-2015-12-19-0-7"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A car bomb outside a shopping mall in the Somali capital Mogadishu kills at least three and injures at least eight. The al Qaeda-linked Al Shabaab claim responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/somalia-blast-idINKBN0U20HX20151219>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/19/africa/somalia-deadly-bombing/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-19-1-1"></a>

Context: Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action.

**Archived source account.** Iran nuclear chief Ali Akbar Salehi says nine tons of Iran's enriched uranium will be exported to Russia in the next few days, as the country moves to implement the nuclear deal and secure relief from international sanctions.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-nuclear-idUSKBN0U208420151219>); [Ya Libnan](<http://yalibnan.com/2015/12/19/iran-to-ship-enriched-uranium-to-russia-soon-as-it-rushes-to-secure-relief-from-sanctions/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-19-1-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Germany's refugee crisis coordinator Peter Altmaier says, in an interview with German magazine Focus, that he and Austrian special minister Josef Ostermayer are working on a proposal for a common European asylum law. He added other countries such as France and The Netherlands would be approached soon.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-germany-austria-idUSKBN0U20ID20151219?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=newsOne&amp;google_editors_picks=true>); [Sputnik News](<http://sputniknews.com/europe/20151219/1032029475/berlin-vienna-eu-refugees.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-12-19-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Swiss Attorney General Michael Lauber announces criminal proceedings are underway against an unnamed Islamic Central Council of Switzerland (ICCS) board member for spreading jihadist propaganda. ICCS reports the individual is their head of multimedia, Naim Cherni, who released a videotape of his trip to Syria which included interviews with Islamist leaders. (de)

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-swiss-investigation-islamic-council-idUSKBN0U20C520151219>); [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/swiss-investigate-top-member-of-largest-islamic-organization-for-jihadist-propaganda/a-18929810>); [Blick](<http://www.blick.ch/news/schweiz/bern/wegen-video-ueber-syrien-reise-strafverfahren-gegen-izrs-vorstand-eroeffnet-id4479957.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-12-19-3-1"></a>

Context: Rwandan constitutional referendum, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Rwandans vote overwhelmingly to lift constitutional restrictions that will allow President Paul Kagame to run for more terms in office. The National Electoral Commission reports more than 98 percent of voters approved the referendum. Final official results will be released Monday.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-35138671>); [AP](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/huff-wires/20151219/af-rwanda-term-limits/?utm_hp_ref=homepage&amp;ir=homepage>).

### 2015-12-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076179148](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%2020&oldid=1076179148>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-20-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Air France Flight 463 en route to Paris from Mauritius makes an emergency landing in Mombasa, Kenya, after a package, suspected to be a bomb is found in the toilet. Later, Air France CEO Frédéric Gagey says it was a false alarm; the package contained a mixture of cardboard, sheets of paper, and a timer.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.news24.com/News24/World/News/air-france-flight-forced-to-land-in-kenya-over-bomb-scare-20151220-2>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/12/20/africa/air-france-flight-emergency-landing-kenya/index.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-kenya-airlines-airfrance-idUSKBN0U307C20151220>).

<a id="event-2015-12-20-0-2"></a>

Context: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea, China–Vietnam relations.

**Archived source account.** Vietnam is reported to be preparing for a possible military conflict with China over territorial claims in the South China Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-vietnam-china-conflict-insight-idUKKBN0U004820151218>).

<a id="event-2015-12-20-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A missile-strike in Jaramana in southern Syria kills high-ranking Lebanese Hezbollah commander Samir Kuntar and eight National Defence Force (NDF) personnel. The responsibility for the incident taken by the Free Syrian Army, though Hezbollah alleges Israeli involvement. Kuntar was the longest serving Lebanese prisoner in Israel until his release in 2008. On April 22, 1979 Kuntar and his team broke into an apartment building and kidnapped a father, 31-year-old Danny Haran, and his 4-year-old daughter, Einat, taking them to a nearby beach and killing them.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-jaramana-idUSKBN0U301G20151220>).

<a id="event-2015-12-20-0-6"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Airstrikes, apparently from Russian jets, kill scores of people in the center of rebel-held Idlib in northwest Syria. The missiles hit a busy market place, several government buildings, and residential areas. At least 73 bodies, 30 unidentified, have been recovered.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-airstrikes-idUSKBN0U30JV20151220>).

<a id="event-2015-12-20-0-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** A motorist runs over pedestrians at the Las Vegas Strip between Planet Hollywood and Paris Las Vegas, killing one person and injuring at least 26 more.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-12-21/las-vegas-police-respond-to-accident-reports-dozens-injured/7045948>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-12-20-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Miss Philippines, Pia Wurtzbach, is crowned Miss Universe 2015 in Las Vegas, moments after host Steve Harvey incorrectly announced 1st runner-up Miss Colombia, Ariadna Gutiérrez, as the winner.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-missuniverse-idUSKBN0U30SA20151221>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-12-20-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands, including families, children, and miners from around the country, march from Knottingley to North Yorkshire to mark the end of deep coal mining in the United Kingdom. The last facility, Kellingley Colliery in Beal, North Yorkshire, closed down, Friday, 18 December 2015. The march was organized by two miners' wives to pay tribute to this industry.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/kellingley-colliery-miners-march-in-final-farewell-to-the-last-coal-mine-and-british-mining-a6780301.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-35144942>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-12-20-3-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Shenzhen landslide.

**Archived source account.** Thirty-three buildings collapse after a landslide hit an industrial park in Shenzhen, China, leaving at least 91 people missing.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/12/20/asia/china-landslide/index.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-20-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** An avalanche in Svalbard, a Norwegian Arctic archipelago, kills one and injures nine others as the snow smashes into 10 houses in Longyearbyen. The deluge from Sukkertoppen mountain follows Friday's 60 mph storm that ripped off a school roof and temporarily closed the airport. Dozens of homes at the foot of the mountain were evacuated and all of the area's residents have been located, according to Tone Hertzberg, a spokeswoman for Svalbard's governor. Experts from Norges Geotekniske Institutt are examining nearby slopes.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/deadly-avalanche-norway-arctic-svalbard-archipelago/>); [newsinenglish.no](<http://www.newsinenglish.no/2015/12/20/more-avalanches-threaten-svalbard/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-20-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A ferry ran into trouble in rough seas off the coast of Indonesia's island of Sulawesi, with at least three killed, including two children, 39 rescued, and 77 missing. The New Marina, a fiberglass boat, was reported to be carrying 109 passengers with a crew of 10. The National Search and Rescue Agency says the boat sank 22.5 km (24 miles) off the coast of the Wajo Regency in South Sulawesi. Rescue teams expect to resume their search for the missing, Monday.

Source citations (as archived): [BenarNews](<http://www.benarnews.org/english/news/indonesian/sulawesi-sinking-12202015004255.html>); [Muscat Daily](<https://web.archive.org/web/20190909200010/https://muscatdaily.com//Archive/World/Nearly-80-still-missing-in-Indonesian-ferry-accident-4hwh>).

<a id="event-2015-12-20-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two pilots are killed after a South Korean-made KAI T-50 Golden Eagle crashes and bursts into flames at an air show in Yogyakarta on Indonesia's Java island.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/asia/indonesia/12060915/Two-pilots-killed-as-jet-crashes-at-Indonesia-air-show.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-12-20-4-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Spanish general election.

**Archived source account.** Today's parliamentary election is forecast to end Spain's two-party system as the traditional powers, the center-right People's Party (PP) and the center-left Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE), are facing real challenges from the anti-austerity Podemos Party and the liberal Ciudadanos party (C's). Analysts expect a high turnout.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/spain-election-results_5676bcdee4b06fa6887db39c>); [Newsweek](<http://www.newsweek.com/spanish-elections-all-you-need-know-407060>).

<a id="event-2015-12-20-4-3"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Vermont Senator Bernie Sanders presidential campaign fires national data director Josh Uretsky, and suspends two staffers following Friday's announcement the campaign had improperly accessed and downloaded voter data belonging to Hillary Clinton's campaign. NBC News reports at least four individuals affiliated with the campaign were involved in the breach, which occurred Wednesday.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2016-election/sanders-campaign-suspends-two-more-staffers-over-clinton-data-breach-n483411>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/politics/articles/2015-12-20/bill-clinton-to-hit-the-campaign-trail-in-january>).

<a id="event-2015-12-20-4-6"></a>

Context: Elections in Iran / 2016 Iranian legislative election.

**Archived source account.** Iran starts registering candidates for the 290-seat parliamentary elections scheduled for 26 February 2016. Potential candidates must be approved by the Guardian Council. The elections will, effectively, be a vote on President Hassan Rouhani's moderate policies that received a boost from the July 14 landmark nuclear deal.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/registration-starts-for-iran-parliamentary-election/2015/12/19/f368f9b8-a659-11e5-8318-bd8caed8c588_story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-20-4-8"></a>

Context: Elections in Iran / 2016 Iranian Assembly of Experts election.

**Archived source account.** Elections for the 88-seat Experts Assembly, a clerical body empowered to choose or dismiss Iran's supreme leader and supervise his activities, are scheduled for Thursday 25 February 2016. Those elected may decide who replaces Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, who is 76.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/upcoming-iran-elections-after-nuclear-deal-may-have-consequences-for-years-to-come/a-18926340>).

### 2015-12-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1357886120](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%2021&oldid=1357886120>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-21-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021) / 2015 Bagram suicide bombing.

**Archived source account.** A suicide-bomb attack on a joint Afghan-U.S. patrol near Bagram Air Base in Afghanistan's Parwan Province, kills at least six U.S. soldiers and wounds another six. The Taliban's spokesman, Zabiullah Mujahid, claims responsibility for the attack in a message on Twitter.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-attack-idUSKBN0U418520151221>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/checkpoint/wp/2015/12/21/mass-casualty-in-afghanistan-six-u-s-troops-dead-others-wounded/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-21-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Taliban forces overrun the Sangin District in Afghanistan's southern Helmand Province following clashes with Afghan security forces which left dozens dead. Taliban militants have reportedly surrounded the local police compound with around 170 officers trapped inside the compound, according to a local official.

Source citations (as archived): [FRANCE 24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20151221-afghanistan-taliban-advance-key-sangin-afghan-helmand-province-deputy-governor-facebook-app>).

<a id="event-2015-12-21-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** At least three rockets hit the capital Kabul, with two landing in the diplomatic zone of the Wazir Akbar Khan neighbourhood near the U.S. embassy building, while the other struck near the presidential palace complex. There were no reports of any casualties.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-afghanistan-blast-idUKKBN0U422C20151221>); [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/326689-rockets-hit-kabul-explosions/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-21-0-6"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Kenya, War in Somalia.

**Archived source account.** At least two people are killed in an attack, near the north-eastern village of El Wak in Mandera County near the Somali border. A group of Kenyan Muslims traveling on a bus ambushed by suspected Al-Shabaab insurgents, protected Christian passengers by refusing to be split into groups, according to eyewitnesses.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-35151967>).

<a id="event-2015-12-21-0-8"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017), Military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** Around 20 people, including civilians and Islamic State militants, are killed in airstrikes on Mosul in northern Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-mideast-crisis-iraq-airstrikes-idUKKBN0U42IM20151221>).

<a id="event-2015-12-21-0-10"></a>

Context: 2015 PKK rebellion.

**Archived source account.** Fighting continues to rage between the Turkish Army and PKK militants across southeastern Turkey, with the Kurdish-majority cities of Cizre and Silopi both becoming war zones as street-to-street fighting takes place. Turkish tanks shelled civilian houses in Silopi, while a Turkish military helicopter was damaged by PKK fire as it attempted to land in Cizre. Also, two Turkish soldiers were killed and six others wounded in a roadside bombing near the town of Bitlis. Many within Turkey are saying a civil war is now underway.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/12/turkish-forces-pkk-engage-intense-clashes-151221183939375.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-21-0-11"></a>

Context: 2015 PKK rebellion.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan says military operations will continue in southeast Turkey and vowed that Kurdish rebels (PKK) along with their supporters, “will be buried in the trenches they have dug”. The state-run Anadolu Agency reports at least 115 PKK militants have been killed since December 15.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/dec/21/erdogan-vows-kurdish-rebels-will-be-buried>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-12-21-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis, in his annual pre-Christmas speech, urged the Roman Curia (cardinals and bishops who direct Holy See actions), to follow his "catalogue of virtues," e.g., to show more maturity, honesty, humility, and sobriety in their tasks. He listed "Curial antibiotics" to treat the "15 ailments of the Curia" he outlined last year and which still plague the Vatican.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.therecord.com/news-story/6202934-flu-stricken-pope-issues-catalogue-of-virtues-to-curia/>); [National Catholic Reporter](<http://ncronline.org/news/vatican/francis-exhorts-vatican-prelates-be-more-mature-recognize-smallness-work>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-12-21-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA) lifts the 32-year-old, lifetime ban on blood donations from gay and bisexual men. Men can donate if they haven't had sex with another man in the previous year. The FDA stance is in line with other countries, such as Australia, Brazil, Canada, New Zealand, and the U.K., and is consistent with rules on recent blood transfusion or accidental exposure to another individual's blood.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2015/dec/21/fda-lifts-ban-blood-donations-gay-bisexual-men>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/to-your-health/wp/2015/12/21/fda-officially-alters-decades-old-ban-on-blood-donations-from-gay-and-bisexual-men/>); [FDA](<http://www.fda.gov/NewsEvents/Newsroom/PressAnnouncements/ucm478031.htm>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-21-3-1"></a>

Context: Armenia–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Russia reinforces the joint Armenian-Russian run Erebuni Airport, home to the Russian 3624th Air Base, with six attack and transport helicopters. The Russian Defence Ministry said the Mi-24 and Mi-8 helicopters had been transferred from a military base in the southern Russian region of Krasnodar Krai to the air base in Erebuni, Armenia.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe](<http://www.rferl.org/content/armenia-russia-reinforces-base/27440370.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-21-3-3"></a>

Context: War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** The European Union extends Russian sanctions for interference in Ukraine another six months, until 31 July 2016. The EU says it's extending the sanctions because the Minsk peace accords would not be fully implemented by the end of this year.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-12-21/eu-extends-russia-sanctions-to-july-amid-fragile-ukraine-peace>); [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151229015144/http://www.voanews.com/content/eu-russia-sanctions/3111894.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-12-21-4-1"></a>

Context: Slovenian same-sex marriage referendum, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Slovenian voters reject a bill legalizing same-sex marriage in the country with only 36% of registered voters supporting it, while over 63% of voters voted against the bill.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/12/21/europe/slovenia-rejects-same-sex-marriage/index.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-21-4-3"></a>

Context: Spanish general election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** In Sunday's elections, Spain's center-right ruling People's Party (PP) wins 123 seats (35.1%), and the center-left Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE) takes 90 (25.7%) of the 350 seats in parliament, thereby ending Spain's two-party system since neither major party won an absolute majority. Turnout was 73 percent. Spain's new political forces, Podemos and Ciudadanos (C's), get 69 and 40 seats, respectively. Smaller parties split the remaining 28 seats, 17 to Catalonia parties which favor secession. It appears that a coalition government will be necessary. PSOE has declined to join the PP, which actually doesn't want that either. King Felipe VI, who ascended the throne in June 2014, is constitutionally empowered to mediate.

Source citations (as archived): [Stratfor](<https://www.stratfor.com/analysis/spains-elections-yield-unsettled-landscape#>); [Fortune](<http://fortune.com/2015/12/21/spain-election-results/>); [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.com/spain-elections-2015-popular-party-wins-greatest-influence-national-government-poised-2233806>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-27918094>).

<a id="event-2015-12-21-4-5"></a>

Context: 2016 United States presidential election, Republican Party presidential candidates, 2016.

**Archived source account.** South Carolina Senator Lindsey Graham ends his campaign for the Republican Party nomination for President. During his campaign he has failed to poll above single digits nationally or in the early voting states.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/elections/2015/12/21/graham-abandons-presidential-bid/77690620/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-21-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israeli Vice Prime Minister Silvan Shalom (Likud party) resigns because of allegations he sexually harassed several women during his career. Israel's attorney general has started an investigation of Shalom, who also resigned his Interior Minister position and Knesset seat.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-politics-idUSKBN0U30RQ20151221>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2015/12/21/Israeli-Interior-Minister-Shalom-resigns-after-sexual-harassment-allegation/3201450699634/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-21-4-8"></a>

Context: Future Iraqi Kurdistan independence referendum.

**Archived source account.** President Massoud Barzani of Iraqi Kurdistan instructs senior party officials to work on preparations for holding a referendum to decide whether to secede from Iraq, a long-standing Kurdish aspiration.

Source citations (as archived): [Today's Zaman](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151223011655/http://www.todayszaman.com/diplomacy_krg-leader-instructs-officials-to-expedite-independence-referendum_407583.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-12-21-5-1"></a>

Context: 2015 FIFA corruption case.

**Archived source account.** FIFA's ethics committee issues an eight-year ban on President Sepp Blatter and UEFA President Michel Platini from any football-related activity for a CHF 2,000,000 (£1.3m/US$2.02m) payment to Platini that Blatter approved. Ethics judges decided the pair, who were also fined, broke rules on conflict of interest, breach of loyalty, and offering or receiving gifts. Both men deny wrongdoing and intend to appeal to the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/35144652>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-soccer-fifa-idUSKBN0U40S320151221>); [Al Jazeera](<http://america.aljazeera.com/articles/2015/12/21/fifa-bans-blatter-platini-for-eight-years1.html>); [FIFA text](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/sport/fifa-statement-on-blatter/2366780.html>).

### 2015-12-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076179033](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%2022&oldid=1076179033>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-22-0-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017), Battle of Ramadi.

**Archived source account.** The Iraqi Army advances into the center of Ramadi, the latest development in the effort, which began in November, to regain the city from the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-ramadi-idUSKBN0U50TL20151222>).

<a id="event-2015-12-22-0-3"></a>

Context: Islamist insurgency in Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** More than 1 million children have been forced out of school as a result of Boko Haram terrorism in northeastern Nigeria and its neighboring countries, which leaves the children more susceptible to violence, poverty and child marriage, Manuel Fontaine, UNICEF’s West and Central Africa regional director, said in a statement.

Source citations (as archived): [Huffington Post](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/over-1-million-children-out-of-school-due-to-boko-haram-attacks_56797c5ee4b06fa6887ebf3f>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-boko-haram-idUSKBN0U500B20151222>).

<a id="event-2015-12-22-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mali declares a 10-day state of emergency effective at midnight, following a series of threats from unnamed jihadist groups, and last month's siege at a Bamako hotel, where 20 people were killed. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<http://www.dw.com/en/mali-declares-tunisia-extends-state-of-emergency-over-terror-fears/a-18935040>); [TV360Nigeria](<http://www.tv360nigeria.com/mali-declares-10-day-state-of-emergency/>); [NDTV](<http://www.ndtv.com/world-news/mali-reimposes-state-of-emergency-for-years-end-1257877>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-12-22-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Turing Pharmaceuticals says that it is looking for a new CEO in the aftermath of the indictment of its old boss, Martin Shkreli, on securities fraud charges. Turing and Shkreli became infamous together in September 2015, when they hiked the price of an AIDS drug by 5000%.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turingpharma-ceo-idUSKBN0U605D20151223>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-12-22-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Indian Border Security Force plane headed to Ranchi crashes just outside New Delhi, killing all 10 on board. The Super King Air turboprop aircraft hit an airport wall and landed in a small body of water.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/india-dwarka-crash-idINKBN0U50IO20151222>); [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2015/12/22/indian-paramilitary-plane-crashes-killing-all-10-aboard.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-22-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 30 people are injured from an explosion at a gas pipeline near Villahermosa, Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/12/23/americas/mexico-gas-pipeline-explosion/index.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-22-2-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Turkey's state-run Anadolu Agency reports 11 migrants, including three children, drowned, and the Turkish coast guard rescued seven Syrians from a capsized boat headed to the Greek island of Samos.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/the-latest-luxembourg-fm-says-eu-migrant-response-failed/2015/12/22/6653d6b6-a8ab-11e5-b596-113f59ee069a_story.html>).

#### Health

<a id="event-2015-12-22-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Philippines becomes the first country in Asia, and second in the world (after Mexico), to approve use of the dengue vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/science-nature/life-health/116862-philippines-clear-dengue-vaccine-asia>); [CNN](<http://cnnphilippines.com/news/2015/12/23/PH-approves-first-anti-dengue-vaccine-in-Asia.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-22-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** According to industry sources, the Indian health ministry is considering Sanofi Pasteur's dengue fever vaccine for large-scale clinical trial exemption which would accelerate approval for marketing. India reported a record number of dengue fever cases this year.

Source citations (as archived): [The Economic Times](<http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/healthcare/biotech/pharmaceuticals/government-may-exempt-sanofis-dengue-vaccine-from-large-scale-clinical-trials/articleshow/50278156.cms>).

<a id="event-2015-12-22-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Colombian President Juan Manuel Santos signs a decree fully legalizing medical marijuana. Growers must apply to the National Narcotics Council for a license. Earlier, Colombia decriminalized personal possession of up to 20 grams.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-35165169>); [VICE News](<https://news.vice.com/article/colombias-president-signs-a-decree-legalizing-medical-weed>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-12-22-4-1"></a>

Context: Philippine presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** The Philippine Commission on Elections disqualifies presidential frontrunner Grace Poe, who is a rival of Mar Roxas, the candidate favored by President Benigno Aquino III. The move is widely believed to be politically motivated.

Source citations (as archived): [(Inquirer),](<http://newsinfo.inquirer.net/733034/poes-disqualification-cases-politically-motivated-ally-says>); [(GMA News),](<http://www.gmanetwork.com/news/story/548816/news/nation/comelec-en-banc-disqualifies-grace-poe-from-presidential-polls>).

<a id="event-2015-12-22-4-2"></a>

Context: Philippine presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Petitioners alleged Poe doesn't meet the residency and citizenship requirements. The actual decision is still to be released. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://cnnphilippines.com/news/2015/12/22/comelec-en-banc-cancles-grace-poes-coc-for-presidency.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-22-4-4"></a>

Context: Central African constitutional referendum, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Central African Republic's National Election Authority announces voters approved (93%) the new constitution in the December 13 referendum. Amid sporadic violence, 39 percent of registered citizens voted in the two-day poll. The first round of the presidential elections and Parliamentary elections now can be held on December 27, 2015. Acting President Catherine Samba-Panza and current members of the legislature cannot participate. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/central-african-republic-voters-say-yes-to-new-constitution/a-18933653>); [Toronto Metro News](<http://www.metronews.ca/news/world/2015/12/22/central-african-republic-overwhelmingly-votes-yes-on-constitutional-referendum.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-22-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Virginia Attorney General Mark Herring announces, effective February 1, 2016, that Virginia will no longer recognize concealed carry handgun permits from 25 (of the 30) states with reciprocity agreements with the commonwealth whose concealed handgun regulations are weaker than Virginia's. The state agreements with the other five states will not change. Virginia’s concealed carry permits will not be recognized by at least six states because they require mutual recognition of permits. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/virginia-politics/va-attorney-general-mark-herring-delivers-blow-to-gun-rights-advocates/2015/12/21/d72ce3d0-a821-11e5-9b92-dea7cd4b1a4d_story.html>); [AP](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/sns-bc-va--concealed-handgun-permits-20151222-story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-22-4-7"></a>

Context: Haitian presidential election, 2015, Haitian parliamentary election, 2015.

**Archived source account.** Haiti’s Provisional Electoral Council postpones presidential and legislative runoff elections scheduled for Sunday, December 27, 2015. Authorities are waiting for findings from the not-yet-installed special commission evaluating the widely criticized first round of elections before determining how to proceed.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/haiti-officials-postpone-vote-set-for-this-weekend/2015/12/21/f6de6da6-a845-11e5-b596-113f59ee069a_story.html>); [Haitian-Caribbean News Network](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151230215650/http://hcnn.ht/en/2015_10/politics/489/Haiti-presidential-and-partial-legislative-runoff-elections-postponed.htm>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2015-12-22-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** American actor Nicolas Cage agrees to return to Mongolia a stolen dinosaur skull he bought in 2007 for $276,000. Cage says he was unaware the skull had entered the country illegally.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151224210713/http://www.msn.com/en-us/movies/celebrity/actor-nicolas-cage-returns-stolen-dinosaur-skull-he-bought/ar-BBnNWxx?li=BBnb7Kz&amp;ocid=iehp>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/life/2015/12/22/nicolas-cage-returns-stolen-dinosaur-skull-mongolian-government/77743080/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-22-5-2"></a>

Context: Falcon 9 Flight 20.

**Archived source account.** American aerospace manufacturer and space transport services company SpaceX makes history by sending the first orbital rocket into space and landing the first stage back on the ground at Cape Canaveral Air Force Station.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/tech/innovation/spacex-set-attempt-first-rocket-launch-falcon-9-explosion-n483921>).

### 2015-12-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1185132632](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%2023&oldid=1185132632>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-23-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Amnesty International reports at least 200 civilians have been killed in Russian air strikes in Syria, indicating "serious failures by Russia to respect international humanitarian law". Moscow denies causing civilian deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-35162523>).

<a id="event-2015-12-23-0-4"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** An overnight raid by suspected Boko Haram militants on Niger's southern border town of Abadam, kills two Nigerien Army soldiers and three civilians. And, separately, a suicide-bomb attack on Lake Chad killed three of the attackers but no one else. A military convoy was also ambushed by militants in northern Cameroon, although there were no reported deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-violence-niger-idUSKBN0U618O20151223?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=worldNews>).

<a id="event-2015-12-23-0-6"></a>

Context: Israeli-Palestinian conflict (2015).

**Archived source account.** Two Palestinian attackers stab passers-by at the Old City's Jaffa Gate in Jerusalem, Israel, killing two and injuring one; the attackers are shot and killed by two Israeli Border Police officers.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/12/23/middleeast/jerusalem-violence-stabbing/>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Arab-Israeli-Conflict/Breaking-At-least-three-wounded-in-suspected-stabbing-attack-at-Jerusalems-Jaffa-Gate-438171>).

<a id="event-2015-12-23-0-8"></a>

Context: 2015 PKK rebellion.

**Archived source account.** Clashes continue between PKK militants and Turkish Army troops in the Kurdish-majority city of Diyarbakır in southeastern Turkey. At least one Turkish soldier is killed and several are wounded in a bomb attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-kurds-idUSKBN0U61J320151223>).

<a id="event-2015-12-23-0-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hacktivist collective Anonymous declares a cyber-war on Turkey, and claims responsibility for the major week-long cyber-attack between 14 and 21 December on Turkey, which it accuses of supporting the jihadist Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL), and threatened additional attacks in case the alleged support continues. “We will continue attacking your internet, your root DNS, your banks and take your government sites down,” it said. “After the root DNS, we will start to hit your airports, military assets and private state connections. We will destroy your critical banking infrastructure,” the group added.

Source citations (as archived): [Hurriyet Daily News](<http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/anonymous-claims-cyberattacks-on-turkey-declares-cyber-war.aspx?PageID=238&amp;NID=92907&amp;NewsCatID=352>); [Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/gadgets-and-tech/news/anonymous-declares-war-on-turkey-opsis-russia-cyberattack-erdogan-a6784026.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-23-0-11"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Australia.

**Archived source account.** Australian police in Sydney arrest two men who, police say, were planning attacks on locations such as naval bases and police headquarters. New South Wales Deputy Police Commissioner Catherine Burn said Wednesday's activity brings the number of people arrested in connection with last year's Operation Appleby to 13.

Source citations (as archived): [Australian Broadcasting Corporation](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-12-23/two-charged-after-sydney-counter-terrorism-raids/7049918>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-australia-security-idUSKBN0U60CL20151223>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2015-12-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The governments of Somalia, Tajikistan and Brunei ban celebrations of Christmas, with punishments ranging up to a five-year jail term. Each country has a majority-Muslim population.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/dec/23/christmas-banned-somalia-tajikistan-brunei>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-12-23-2-1"></a>

Context: Tornadoes of 2015.

**Archived source account.** At least six people die and dozens injured as major storms, packed with tornadoes, move through the American South and Midwest. Three people died when a tornado hit northern Mississippi, one was killed in Arkansas and two more in Tennessee. Officials continue searching into the night for the missing.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/23/us/severe-weather/>); [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/winter-tornadoes-touch-down-in-mississippi-indiana/2015/12/23/367085f2-a9d7-11e5-b596-113f59ee069a_story.html>); [Weather.com](<http://www.weather.com/travel/commuter-conditions/news/southern-severe-weather-flooding-impacts>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-christmas-season-travel-idUSKBN0U628C20151224>).

#### Health

<a id="event-2015-12-23-3-1"></a>

Context: South Korean MERS outbreak.

**Archived source account.** South Korea announces an end to the Middle East respiratory syndrome (MERS) outbreak that has killed 36 people since May 2015. The virus infected 186 people, with nearly 17,000 people confined to their homes and thousands of schools temporarily closing at the peak of the largest MERS outbreak outside Saudi Arabia, where it first appeared in 2012.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160304195449/http://www.france24.com/en/20151223-south-korea-announces-official-end-mers-outbreak?ns_campaign=reseaux_sociaux&amp;ns_source=twitter&amp;ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_linkname=editorial&amp;aef_campaign_ref=partage_aef&amp;aef_campaign_date=2015-12-23&amp;dlvrit=65413>).

<a id="event-2015-12-23-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brazilian health officials announce 2,400 babies (up from 147 in 2014) have been born this year with microcephaly, a neurological disorder that can result in incomplete brain development which can be caused by the mosquito-borne Zika virus, and advise would-be parents, especially in the country's northeast where most of the cases occurred, to avoid pregnancy.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/23/health/brazil-zika-pregnancy-warning/>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/to-your-health/wp/2015/12/23/brazil-declares-emergency-after-2400-babies-are-born-with-brain-damage-possibly-due-to-mosquito-borne-virus/>); [Medical Daily](<http://www.medicaldaily.com/brazilian-couples-urged-hold-pregnancies-due-microcephaly-surge-suspected-zika-virus-366718>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-23-4-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Crisis.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council expressed “deep concern” at the number of violations of Yemen’s ceasefire. U.N. envoys warned that a fledgling peace process was hanging by a thread, and that Yemen faces permanent fragmentation if the conflict is not ended soon.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-un-idUSKBN0U61U320151223>); [Time](<http://time.com/4159810/yemen-conflict-un-balkanization/>); [Saudi Gazette](<http://saudigazette.com.sa/world/yemen-peace-plan-fragile-says-special-un-envoy/>); [UN](<http://www.un.org/apps/news/story.asp?NewsID=52897#.VnsU5E9BmQw>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-12-23-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The public interest non-profit Cause for Action files a Freedom of Information Act request for United States Secretary of Defense Ashton Carter’s personal emails following his disclosure of using that account for official government emails, this in the wake of the former U.S. Secretary of State Hillary Clinton email controversy and the Office of Personnel Management data breach. The U.S. Federal Records Act restricts use of personal email for official business.

Source citations (as archived): [Federal Times](<http://www.federaltimes.com/story/government/management/agency/2015/12/22/non-profit-files-foia-carter-emails/77745300/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-23-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Metropolitan Police Department of the District of Columbia report reveals that an agent with the Presidential Protective Service of the United States Secret Service had his weapon, shield, and other professional equipage stolen from his vehicle in broad daylight in downtown Washington, D.C.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/22/politics/secret-service-gun-badge-stolen-dc/index.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-23-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russia issues an international arrest warrant for former oil tycoon Mikhail Khodorkovsky on charges of organizing the murder of Vladimir Petukhov, mayor of Nefteyugansk in 1998.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/dec/23/russia-issues-international-arrest-warrant-for-putin-critic-khodorkovsky>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-12-23-6-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Spanish general election.

**Archived source account.** Pedro Sánchez, the leader of Spain's Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE), rejects a pact with the ruling People's Party (PP). "We say 'no' to Rajoy and his policies," Sánchez told a news conference after meeting with Spanish Prime Minister Mariano Rajoy.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-spain-politics-idUKKBN0U60RR20151223>).

<a id="event-2015-12-23-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister of Georgia Irakli Garibashvili unexpectedly announces his resignation, without giving any specific reason for his decision.

Source citations (as archived): [Civil Georgia](<http://civil.ge/eng/article.php?id=28876>).

<a id="event-2015-12-23-6-3"></a>

**Editorial account; source review partial.** Croatia gave Teva executive Oreskovic a mandate to form a government with the stated support of 78 MPs.

Editorial date: 2015-12-23. Checked: 2026-10-22. The mandate and majority are supported. The opened passages do not establish his Israel-based location or the exact November election date. A mandate is distinct from completed confirmation.

Evidence: [Business Recorder](<https://www.brecorder.com/news/269779/croatia-taps-pharma-exec-lead-government-heal-economy>).

Original source account: Croatian President Kolinda Grabar-Kitarović selects Israel-based Teva Pharmaceuticals executive Tihomir Orešković to be the new prime minister following the inconclusive November 8 election. The "technocrat" is the choice of conservatives and reformists, who have 78 parliamentary seats, enough for confirmation.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-12-23-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States National Center for Health Statistics reports the rate of twin births has hit an historic high. Researchers say the increase in twin births may be affected by changes in reproductive technology, including in vitro fertilization, and by more women giving birth later in life--a time when the occurrence of twins is higher.

Source citations (as archived): [Science World Report](<http://www.scienceworldreport.com/articles/35043/20151223/twin-birth-rate-in-u-s-hits-historic-high.htm>); [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/health/article-3370965/Twin-birth-rate-hits-new-high-drop-higher-multiples.html>).

### 2015-12-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1189842958](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%2024&oldid=1189842958>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-24-0-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Zaria Shia Massacre.

**Archived source account.** Human Rights Watch (HRW) reports Nigeria’s military has quickly buried the corpses of at least 300 Shia Muslims killed during raids at the house of Ibrahim Zakzaky in Zaria earlier in December.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-35168211>); [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.co.uk/nigeria-zaria-killings-army-quickly-buried-300-shia-muslims-killed-unjustified-violence-1534703>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2015-12-24-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three business services companies are engaged in an auction to purchase Perot Systems from Dell.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-perotsystems-m-a-exclusive-idUSKBN0U717Q20151224>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-12-24-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire at the Jizan General Hospital in Jizan, Saudi Arabia, kills at least 24 people and injures over 100. The blaze began on the first floor of the hospital which contains the maternity ward and intensive care unit. Government-controlled Al Ekhbariya television reports the cause of the fire seems to be electrical.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/12/deadly-fire-rips-saudi-arabian-hospital-151224044501095.html>); [The News Tribe](<http://www.thenewstribe.com/2015/12/24/fire-engulfs-hospital-in-saudi-arabia-25-dead-107-injured/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-fire-idUSKBN0U70AI20151224>); [Pakistan Today](<http://www.pakistantoday.com.pk/2015/12/24/foreign/25-dead-in-saudi-hospital-fire/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-24-2-2"></a>

Context: Tornadoes of 2015.

**Archived source account.** Officials report the casualties from yesterday's spring-like storm that triggered more than 20 tornadoes, destroyed homes, delayed and cancelled air flights, and caused power outages in the U.S. Midwest and Southeast have risen to at least 11 people killed with dozens injured. Mississippi Governor Phil Bryant declares a state of emergency in areas affected by the storm.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/weather/death-toll-rises-after-tornadoes-storms-ravage-south-n485506>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/christmas-season-travel-idINKBN0U710C20151224>).

<a id="event-2015-12-24-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Up to 100 people die in an explosion at an LPG gas plant in Nnewi, Anambra, in southern Nigeria. Sources indicate the accident was caused by a truck discharging its contents before the mandatory cooling time had expired.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-35178194>); [Vanguard](<http://www.vanguardngr.com/2015/12/breaking-christmas-tragedy-100-burnt-to-death-in-anambra-gas-explosion/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-24-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Uruguay's National Emergencies System reports two people have died in flooding from heavy rains in its northern provinces, and almost 5,500 have been evacuated. The Uruguay River has risen close to three meters over safe levels in Paysandú, and almost four meters (13 feet) in Salto.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News Latino](<http://latino.foxnews.com/latino/news/2015/12/24/almost-5500-evacuees-in-uruguay-due-to-flooding/>); [Latin American Herald Tribune](<http://www.laht.com/article.asp?ArticleId=2402421&amp;CategoryId=23620>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2015-12-24-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The same day the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration announces it is easing restrictions on medical research involving cannabidiol (CBD), a key component in marijuana, NYU Langone Medical Center researchers report a clinical trial suggests a pill containing CBD may reduce seizures for children and young adults with epilepsy.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/marijuana-derived-drug-reduces-seizures-in-hard-to-treat-epilepsy/>); [Health Day](<http://health.usnews.com/health-news/articles/2015-12-24/marijuana-chemical-may-help-prevent-epileptic-seizures-in-kids-young-adults>); [Leafly.com](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160304100554/https://www.leafly.com/news/headlines/dea-eases-restrictions-on-cannabidiol-studies>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-24-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Australia, the UK, France, and the United States, all issue security alerts for westerners in Sanlitun in the Chaoyang District of Beijing, a popular diplomatic and entertainment district. Chinese officials indicate they have taken appropriate measures in response to this information.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-security-idUSKBN0U70OS20151224>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/24/asia/british-us-embassy-warn-of-threats-against-westerners-beijing/>); [Latin American Herald Tribune](<http://www.laht.com/article.asp?ArticleId=2402385&amp;CategoryId=12395>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-12-24-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** One person is shot and killed by a policeman at the Northlake Mall in Charlotte, North Carolina.

Source citations (as archived): [TWC News](<http://www.twcnews.com/nc/charlotte/news/2015/12/24/police-investigating-shooting-at-north-lake-mall.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-12-24-6-1"></a>

Context: 2016 United States federal budget, Iran hostage crisis.

**Archived source account.** The 53 Americans taken hostage in Tehran, Iran, in 1979, or their families, will receive compensation of $4.4 million each from the United States government as a result of a provision in the spending deal signed into law last week.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/Politics/iran-hostage-crisis-victims-compensation-36-years/story?id=35946041>); [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/policy/defense/264202-iran-hostages-quietly-granted-compensation-in-year-end-funding-bill>).

### 2015-12-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1226057700](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%2025&oldid=1226057700>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-25-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Russian military intervention.

**Archived source account.** Zahran Alloush, founder of Islamist rebel group Jaysh al-Islam (army of Islam), the group's deputy leader, and other officials die in Russian airstrikes on a meeting east of Damascus, according to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights. Jaysh al-Islam was one of the opposition groups at the December 10th conference that agreed on principles to guide peace talks, which both Bashar al-Assad and Russia rejected.

Source citations (as archived): [The News Hub](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160915001735/https://www.the-newshub.com/international/key-syrian-islamist-leader-killed-in-russian-airstrike>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-35178684>); [Irish Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/world-news/syrian-rebel-leader-zahran-allouch-killed-in-air-strike-near-damascus-34314423.html>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-12-25-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** With the death of an 18-year-old killer whale at its San Antonio, Texas facility and the recent malfunction of the Sky Tower ride at its park in Orlando, Florida, SeaWorld’s problems in the wake of recent earning shortfalls, decline in attendance, and drop the values of its shares. In response, the company plans new pricing and attractions.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/22/us/seaworld-killer-whale-death/?iid=ob_homepage_deskrecommended_pool&amp;iref=obnetwork>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/21/us/passengers-stuck-on-seaworld-ride/index.html>); [CNNMoney](<http://money.cnn.com/2015/11/05/investing/seaworld-earnings-attendance-blackfish/index.html?iid=EL>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-12-25-2-1"></a>

Context: December 2015 Hindu Kush earthquake.

**Archived source account.** At least 17 people are injured in Peshawar, Pakistan, and five people are hurt in Afghanistan's Nangarhar Province after a 6.3-magnitude earthquake hit near the Afghanistan-Tajikistan border. The epicenter is in Afghanistan's quake-prone Ishkashim district, a mountainous area where mainly impoverished farmers live in homes made with mud, according to Peshawar District Officer Muhmand Asim Khan. Other details about damage or casualties are not presently available.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/6-2-magnitude-earthquake-hits-northern-afghanistan-pakistan-n485931>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/25/asia/afghanistan-tajikistan-earthquake/>); [USGS](<https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/us100049i1#general_summary>); [BNO News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151227195435/http://bnonews.com/news/index.php/news/id3119>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-25-3-1"></a>

Context: Japan–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** South Korea announces that Foreign Minister Yun Byung-se will meet with Japanese Foreign Minister Fumio Kishida in Seoul Monday to work toward a final settlement concerning sex slavery during World War II. The Nikkei reports that Japanese Prime Minister Shinzō Abe plans to create a new government-backed fund, containing over 100 million yen (US$831,200/£556,600) to help former South Korean "comfort women," and is also considering making an apology for the wartime sexual enslavement.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-southkorea-idUSKBN0U801P20151225>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-12-25/abe-bids-to-reconcile-with-park-by-end-of-anniversary-year>); [The Nikkei](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151226042650/http://asia.nikkei.com/Politics-Economy/International-Relations/Tokyo-eyes-new-fund-to-assist-comfort-women>); [The Korea Times](<http://www.koreatimes.co.kr/www/news/nation/2015/12/116_194042.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-25-3-3"></a>

Context: India–Pakistan relations.

**Archived source account.** Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi is met by Pakistani Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif at Allama Iqbal International Airport in Lahore for a two-hour meeting. Modi's surprise stopover is the first since Indian Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee visited Pakistan in 2004.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/25/asia/india-pm-visits-pakistan/>); [The Hindu](<http://www.thehindu.com/news/modi-stuns-all-with-surprise-stopover-in-lahore-following-unannounced-stop-in-kabul/article8029007.ece>).

### 2015-12-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076172613](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%2026&oldid=1076172613>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-26-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least one person is injured and another is arrested after a machete attack at Intu Bromley shopping centre in the United Kingdom during the busy annual Boxing Day sales. A motive or possible link to terrorism has not yet been established.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2015/dec/26/armed-police-respond-to-man-with-machete-at-kent-shopping-centre>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-12-26-1-1"></a>

Context: 2015–16 Australian bushfire season.

**Archived source account.** A bushfire in Victoria state has destroyed 116 homes. The 2200-hectare Jamieson Track blaze razed 98 homes in Wye River and 18 at Separation Creek. The fire stopped just 500 meters short of Kennett River. A dousing of rain on Saturday was unlikely to do much in the long term as this blaze could continue into January or February, says emergency management commissioner Craig Lapsley. No injuries are reported.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://www.skynews.com.au/news/top-stories/2015/12/26/vic-fire-crews-battle-huge-fire-overnight.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-35179209>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2015/dec/26/great-ocean-road-bushfire-destroys-more-than-50-homes>).

<a id="event-2015-12-26-1-4"></a>

Context: 2015–16 UK and Ireland windstorm season / Storm Eva.

**Archived source account.** Heavy rain from the fifth officially named storm of the season leads to serious flooding across Lancashire and Yorkshire in northern England.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-35181139>).

<a id="event-2015-12-26-1-6"></a>

Context: Tornadoes of 2015.

**Archived source account.** The death toll in the spring-like, tornado-laden storms that began Wednesday in the American South has risen to 18 with additional tornadoes hitting north-central Alabama Friday and one outside of Dallas, Texas, today.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/weather/death-toll-southern-storms-rises-18-n486256>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/weather/2015/12/26/severe-weather-slams-south-new-system-looms/77916140/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-26-1-8"></a>

Context: December 2015 Hindu Kush earthquake.

**Archived source account.** Officials report at least four people died and more than 100 were injured, most in Pakistan, after Friday night's 6.3 magnitude earthquake in northeast Afghanistan. Casualty numbers may change since rescue teams have not reached all affected areas.

Source citations (as archived): [Latin American Herald Tribune](<http://www.laht.com/article.asp?ArticleId=2402469&amp;CategoryId=12395>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-26-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** China's Foreign Ministry announces French journalist Ursula Gauthier of news magazine L'Obs would not be issued press credentials for 2016, effectively expelling her at the end of month. Gauthier allegedly made speculative reports on the deadly attack at a coal mine in Xinjiang.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/worldviews/wp/2015/12/26/china-expels-french-journalist-for-terrorism-coverage/?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_headlines>); [ABC Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-12-27/french-journalist-at-l&#x27;obs-to-be-forced-to-leave-china/7055198>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-12-26-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the Louisville community of St. Matthews, Kentucky, US, disruptive behavior by a crowd of up to 2,000 teenagers and young adults, including numerous fights and unconfirmed reports of gunshots fired, causes Mall St. Matthews, one of the largest shopping malls in the state, to close early. Despite the unrest, no arrests were made and only minor injuries were reported.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/kentucky-s-mall-st-matthews-shuts-down-after-brawls-involving-n486341>).

### 2015-12-27

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-27-0-2"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017) / Battle of Ramadi.

**Archived source account.** The Iraqi Army declares victory over Islamic State militants as their forces retake an important government compound in Ramadi.

<a id="event-2015-12-27-0-4"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/africa/boko-haram-attacks-northeast-nigerian-city-many-killed/2015/12/27/66d61546-acfb-11e5-b281-43c0b56f61fa_story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-27-0-5"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** A twin suicide-bomb attack carried out by two female suicide bombers at a market in the town of Madagali, Adamawa state, leaves over 25 people dead.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-35189041>).

<a id="event-2015-12-27-0-8"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Military intervention against ISIL / Tishrin Dam offensive.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) backed by U.S.-led coalition airstrikes, seize control of the strategic Tishrin Dam on the Euphrates in eastern Aleppo from Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant forces.
