#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-12-27-1-2"></a>

Context: 2015–16 UK and Ireland windstorm season / Storm Eva.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people are evacuated from their homes as flood waters continue to rise across large parts of northern England, with York particularly badly affected.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/uk-england-35182274#lx-commentary-top>).

<a id="event-2015-12-27-1-4"></a>

Context: Tornadoes of 2015, 2015–16 North American winter, 2015–2016 El Niño event.

**Archived source account.** At least 11 people are killed as tornadoes strike Dallas, Texas, and five people die in a flash flood in Illinois. A total of 34 people have died in this week's smörgåsbord of storms that started Wednesday. Mark Wiley of the National Weather Service says this rare run of December tornado storms in the South and Midwest, and spring-like temperatures across much of the North and East, in part to a strong El Niño.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/weather/2015/12/27/severe-weather-tornadoes-texas-south/77939562/>); [AP](<http://www.greenevillesun.com/news/ap_state_news/at-least-died-from-in-texas-storms-that-spawned-tornadoes/article_4b00b102-aebc-50c7-b37a-50cd6cbb303f.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-27-1-5"></a>

Context: Tornadoes of 2015, 2015–16 North American winter, 2015–2016 El Niño event.

**Archived source account.** Missouri governor Jay Nixon declares a state of emergency as widespread flash flooding continues to impact the midwestern state.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox2Now](<http://fox2now.com/2015/12/27/state-of-emergency-declared-by-gov-nixon-after-deadly-floods-hit-missouri/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2015-12-27-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Olympic champion swimmer Michael Phelps will coach the sport at Arizona State University upon his presumed retirement following the 2016 Olympics.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2015/12/27/461185655/michael-phelps-to-coach-at-arizona-state-university>); [The Arizona Republic](<http://www.azcentral.com/story/sports/college/asu/2015/12/24/olympians-michael-phelps-allison-schmitt-embrace-move-arizona/77860306/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-28-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** At least 32 people are killed and 90 injured following a car bomb and suicide-bomb attack in the al-Zahra district of the Syrian city of Homs.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-homs-idUSKBN0UB0PB20151228>).

<a id="event-2015-12-28-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Under a United Nations agreement, vehicles are set to ferry scores of insurgents from rebel-held Al-Zabadani to Turkey. Families from two besieged Shi'ite towns in the mainly rebel-held Idlib province are also headed to the border and will eventually fly on to Beirut.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/mideast-crisis-syria-evacuation-idINKBN0UB04N20151228>); [Raidió Teilifís Éireann](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2015/1228/756499-syria-fighter-evacuation-un/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-28-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/suicide-car-bomb-strikes-near-kabul-airport-officials-044244065.html>); [Reuters](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/kabul-attack-taliban-suicide-bomb-near-airport-kills-civilian-injures-n486581>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2015-12-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Whole Foods agrees to pay $500,000 to resolve a New York City Department of Consumer Affairs investigation that the supermarket chain charged too much for some prepackaged foods at its New York City stores.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/business/consumer/whole-foods-pay-500k-settle-overcharging-allegations-n-y-n487021>); [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2015/12/28/news/companies/whole-foods-nyc-overcharging-500000/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-12-28-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Queensland, Australia, authorities revise the estimated amount of sulphuric acid leaked from Sunday's 26-carriage Aurizon freight train derailment near Julia Creek to 31,500 liters. The train was carrying 819,000 liters, not 200,000 liters as originally thought. Flinders Highway remains closed in both directions.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1613206/freight-train-carrying-sulphuric-acid-derails>); [ABC Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-12-28/freight-train-derailment-emergency-continues-near-julia-creek/7056322>).

<a id="event-2015-12-28-2-2"></a>

Context: 2015 Shenzhen landslide.

**Archived source account.** A Chinese official who sanctioned a dump of construction debris that led to a deadly landslide in the southern city of Shenzhen that killed at least 7 people and has left over 70 missing, kills himself by jumping from a building in the city’s Nanshan district, according to the South China Morning Post.

Source citations (as archived): [TIME](<http://time.com/4162842/china-shenzhen-landslide-official-suicide/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2015-12-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Japan–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** Japan and South Korea agree to 'irreversibly' resolve a long-running dispute over Korean women the Japanese military used as sex slaves during World War II. Japanese Prime Minister Shinzō Abe will issue a formal apology to the so-called "comfort women." Tokyo will set up an aid fund of about 1 billion yen ($8.3 million).

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2015/12/28/south-korea-japan-comfort-women/77962792/>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/japan-southkorea-comfortwomen-idINKBN0UB0DU20151228>).

<a id="event-2015-12-28-3-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Germany recruits 8,500 teachers to provide special German language lessons for 196,000 Syrian child refugees.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/germany-recruits-8500-teachers-to-teach-german-to-child-refugees-a6788681.html>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2015/12/28/europe/germany-refugees-8500-new-teachers/index.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-28-3-5"></a>

Context: Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action.

**Archived source account.** Eleven tons of enriched uranium are on a ship heading from Iran to Russia, per the July 14th international agreement. Iran delivers 200 tons of Russian yellowcake in return. The International Atomic Energy Agency will decide when Tehran has complied with its obligations which would make dismantling of economic sanctions possible.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/I/IRAN_NUCLEAR?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT&amp;CTIME=2015-12-28-16-15-22>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-35191146>); [Mehr](<http://en.mehrnews.com/news/113217/Iran-swaps-enriched-uranium-for-Russia-s-yellowcake>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-12-28-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A police officer storms the police headquarters in the city of Ponce, Puerto Rico, and shoots dead three fellow officers, including a commanding officer. Authorities say Guarionex Candelario, 50, was arrested for the killings shortly afterwards and taken to hospital for minor injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [NY Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/news/national/puerto-rico-police-officers-shot-killed-fellow-article-1.2478627>).

<a id="event-2015-12-28-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A U.S. grand jury decides not to bring charges against a Cleveland policeman over the killing of 12 year old Tamir Rice.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-35191347>).

<a id="event-2015-12-28-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Guatemalan Gustavo Alejos Cambara, once private secretary to former President Álvaro Colom, turns himself in to authorities on charges related to government medicine procurement corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/0f728b2e171f4927b9b90f122f51e441/ex-official-turns-himself-guatemala-corruption-case>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-12-28-5-1"></a>

Context: Polish constitutional crisis, 2015.

**Archived source account.** The leader of Poland's Democracy Defence Committee, Mateusz Kijowski, says the government has "broken the country" after Polish President, Andrzej Duda, enacted a measure curbing the powers of the country's highest legislative court, the Constitutional Tribunal, despite protests and warnings from the European Union. Kijowski further called for foreign intervention in the country from "Europe and the United States" to topple the Law and Justice (PiS) government, saying "they must help us, otherwise Poland will leave the community of democracies". After news broke that Duda had signed into law the constitutional tribunal bill, he made a speech on television defending his move. Polish newspaper Gazeta Wyborcza quoted U.S. sources saying Barack Obama had objections and had let it be known he would delay meeting Duda. The newspaper also suggested Poland’s hosting of the next NATO summit, planned for July 2016, was in the balance.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2015/dec/28/poland-law-curb-power-top-court-end-democracy-andrzej-duda>).

<a id="event-2015-12-28-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In sailing, Comanche takes line honours to win the 2015 Sydney to Hobart Yacht Race.

Source citations (as archived): [SBS](<http://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/2015/12/28/comanche-stages-epic-comeback-win-sydney-hobart-race>).

Context: 2015 Flood in Missouri.

**Archived source account.** Missouri Governor Jay Nixon warns residents that the state faces historic flooding that likely will rival Great Flood of 1993 levels. Swollen rivers are still rising and won't crest for days. The Mississippi River is expected to reach nearly 15 feet above flood stage on Thursday. Nixon pleaded with drivers to stay off inundated roadways. Twelve of the 13 people killed from these recent storms died after their vehicles were swept from flooded roadways.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/missouri-governor-warns-historic-dangerous-floods-n487541>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2015/12/29/Midwest-Weather-Missouri-governor-Nixon-warns-of-historic-water-levels-to-rival-Great-Flood-of-93/2371451386905/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-29-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Anchorage, Alaska pilot Doug Demarest flew a from the Civil Air Patrol without permission and crashed into building which housed his wife's law office and the Alaska Department of Law, killing himself. His family said that the crash was a suicide, while the FBI reiterated that "there is no indication this was a terrorist act"

Mexican officials will remand Couch and his mother, with whom he fled, to the U.S. Marshals Service.

Meanwhile, security forces in northern Lebanon found two workshops producing Captagon and other drugs during a series of raids. The drug is infamous as being used by Islamist militants in the Syrian civil war.

### 2015-12-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076172316](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2015%20December%2030&oldid=1076172316>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-30-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / 2015 al-Qamishli bombings.

**Archived source account.** Several suicide-bomb attacks targeting Assyrian Christians celebrating New Year's Eve at restaurants in the Kurdish-controlled Syrian city of Al-Qamishli, Al-Hasakah Governorate, leave at least 16 people dead and 35 wounded. The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant are suspected to be behind the bombings.

**Archived source account.** Burundi's President, Pierre Nkurunziza, says Burundians will fight against any African Union peacekeepers sent into the country in response to the ongoing crisis, "everyone has to respect Burundian borders," Nkurunziza said. The African Union said this earlier this month it was ready to send 5,000 peacekeepers to protect civilians caught up in months of violence.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-burundi-politics-idUSKBN0UD0JV20151230>).

Last month the Turkish army mounted a big offensive invasion into Iraq's Kurdish territory including tanks and artillery without permission or even negotiation with the Iraqi government.

<a id="event-2015-12-30-4-1"></a>

Context: Bill Cosby sexual assault allegations.

**Archived source account.** American entertainer Bill Cosby is charged with aggravated indecent assault in Montgomery County, Pennsylvania. The county's District Attorney-elect said his office is also examining evidence related to other cases. The current charges relate to one particular 2004 incident.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2015/12/31/business/media/bill-cosby-charged-in-sexual-assault-case.html?hp&amp;action=click&amp;pgtype=Homepage&amp;clickSource=story-heading&amp;module=first-column-region&amp;region=top-news&amp;WT.nav=top-news&amp;_r=0>).

<a id="event-2015-12-30-4-3"></a>

Context: 2015 Brussels lockdown.

**Archived source account.** Two Belgian policewomen and eight soldiers reportedly held an orgy at a police station in the Brussels neighbourhood of Ganshoren while colleagues hunted for the Paris terror attacks suspects. The police station was near Molenbeek, where anti-terror raids had been taking place. Police spokesman, Johan Berckmans, said “we have launched an investigation to find out what exactly happened".

<a id="event-2015-12-30-5-1"></a>

Context: Central African general election, 2015–16.

**Archived source account.** Voters in the Central African Republic are heading to the polls for the rescheduled parliamentary elections and the first round of the presidential election, where 30 candidates are running to replace Acting President Catherine Samba-Panza. The presidential runoff election is scheduled for 31 January 2016. The Central African Republic has been rocked by unrest since the March 2013 coup of president François Bozizé by Séléka, a mostly Muslim alliance of anti-government groups. Thousands have died and about one million people have been displaced in the ongoing sectarian violence between Séléka and the Christian anti-balaka militia. The United Nations peacekeeping mission has promised a heavy security presence today.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/africa/central-african-republic-to-hold-national-elections/2015/12/29/3eb6fba2-aea4-11e5-b281-43c0b56f61fa_story.html>); [Pulse News Agency](<http://pulse.ng/world/central-african-republic-country-to-vote-in-election-to-restore-democracy-id4507108.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-30-5-2"></a>

Context: Central African general election, 2015–16.

**Archived source account.** Ballot counting is underway after a peaceful election day in this country plagued by years of sectarian violence. National Elections Authority President Marie-Madeleine Koue says at least 65 percent turnout was expected.

Source citations (as archived): [EuroNews](<http://www.euronews.com/2015/12/30/counting-underway-after-peaceful-car-election/>); [Bloomberg](<http://www.thenational.ae/world/africa/elections-in-central-african-republic-end-without-violence-as-voters-seek-peace>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2015-12-30-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The freak weather system responsible for heavy rain and tornadoes in the U.S., and high winds and rainfall in the British Isles, also has impacted the Arctic where the average winter temperature is normally around -20 °F. Temperatures around the North Pole have surpassed the 32 °F threshold for a brief moment, according to the U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration's Ocean Prediction Center, which is 50 °F change higher than usual for December.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/capital-weather-gang/wp/2015/12/30/freak-storm-has-pushed-north-pole-to-freezing-point-50-degrees-above-normal/?wpmm=1&amp;wpisrc=nl_evening>); [South China Morning Post](<http://www.scmp.com/news/world/article/1896681/not-so-icy-pole-freak-weather-makes-north-pole-warmer-vancouver-or-vienna>); [Sputnik News](<http://sputniknews.com/world/20151231/1032526480/monster-storm-system-unfreezes-north-pole.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2015-12-31-0-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Belgian house raids result in the arrest of six people concerning a New Year's Eve celebrations' plot in Brussels, the nation's capital.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-belgium-security-idUSKBN0UE0P720151231>).

<a id="event-2015-12-31-0-2"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Munich's main train station and the station in the city's western district of Pasing, are evacuated during New Year's Eve celebrations, and train service is stopped, because of potential ISIS suicide threats. A foreign security service, which wasn't identified, passed on information that five to seven suicide attackers are involved in the plot.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/isis-terror/two-munich-germany-train-stations-evacuated-over-terrorism-threat-n488721>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/31/europe/munich-germany-train-stations/>).

<a id="event-2015-12-31-0-4"></a>

Context: Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant.

**Archived source account.** Rochester, New York, police arrest 25-year-old Emanuel Lutchman who allegedly planned to attack a local bar with knives and machetes and a pressure cooker bomb to prove he was worthy of joining the Islamic State group. Rochester cancels New Year's Eve fireworks.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.witn.com/home/headlines/Rochester-NY-cancels-fireworks-after-New-Years-Eve-attack-plot-363967451.html>); [Waltonian](<http://waltonian.com/2016/01/suspected-isis-backer-plotted-new-years-eve-attack-in/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2015-12-31-1-1"></a>

Context: 2015 Missouri flooding.

**Archived source account.** Record flooding along the Mississippi River and its tributaries that has closed major highways, forced evacuations, and overflowed levees, continues to threaten the Midwestern United States where at least 24 have died. The Mississippi is expected to crest in the next few days in Thebes, Illinois, at 47.5 feet, breaking the 1995 record by more than a foot and a half (46 cm). And now periods of below-freezing air will cause some flooded areas to turn icy.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-weather-storm-idUSKBN0UC0PD20151231>); [AccuWeather](<https://web.archive.org/web/20151231133527/http://www.accuweather.com/en/weather-news/mississippi-ohio-missouri-illinois-arkansas-major-river-flooding-challenge-records-december-january-2016/54483549>); [Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/nationworld/midwest/ct-flooding-st-louis-i-55-20151231-story.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-31-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Air Canada Flight 88, a scheduled flight from Shanghai to Toronto, diverts to Calgary International Airport after the aircraft, a Boeing 777, encountered violent turbulence. Twenty-one passengers, including three children, were taken to hospital.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/calgary/turbulence-injures-21-air-canada-passengers-coming-into-calgary-1.3384986>).

<a id="event-2015-12-31-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire breaks out at The Address Downtown Dubai hotel. Fourteen people are reported as injured, with one indirect casualty.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2015/12/31/middleeast/dubai-address-hotel-fire/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2015-12-31-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin signs an amendment to Russia's law regarding the regulation of the use of weapons, giving the FSB the authority to use lethal force on crowds in order to "prevent acts of terrorism, rescue hostages, or repel attacks on public buildings."

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/russia-fsb-weapons-crowds/27459140.html>).

<a id="event-2015-12-31-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Indonesian government plans an appeal to a South Sumatra court's rejection of a Rp 7.8 trillion (SGD 780 million) lawsuit against a pulp and paper company accused of contributing to the recurring Southeast Asian hazes, particularly the recent incident of hazes in 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-35203609>); [AFP](<http://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/indonesia-to-appeal-courts-rejection-of-lawsuit-against-firm-over-haze-causing-fires>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2015-12-31-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Venezuelan Supreme Court bars four incoming lawmakers (three from the opposition and one from the ruling Socialist party) from taking office, putting the opposition's two-thirds legislative "supermajority" at risk, won via a landslide victory in the December 6 election by just one seat. The court is yet to specify the quorum for the new House, which would determine the number of seats needed for a two-thirds majority. The new National Assembly convenes Tuesday.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://latino.foxnews.com/latino/news/2015/12/31/venezuelan-supreme-court-bars-four-opposition-legislators-from-taking-office/>); [Latin American Herald Tribune](<http://www.laht.com/article.asp?ArticleId=2402697&amp;CategoryId=10717>).
